    PlayerTextDrawBoxColor(playerid, box, 0x000000AA);
    PlayerTextDrawTextSize(playerid, box, 632.0, 0.0);
    PlayerTextDrawLetterSize(playerid, box, 0.0, 17.6);
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_BOX] = box;

    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_TITLE] = TextWars_CreateLabel(playerid, 476.0, 153.0, "TEXT-WARS", 0.3, 1.2, 0xFF3333FF);
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_WAR] = TextWars_CreateLabel(playerid, 476.0, 172.0, "_", 0.2, 0.9, 0xFFFFFFFF);
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_FIGHT] = TextWars_CreateLabel(playerid, 476.0, 186.0, "_", 0.2, 0.9, 0xFFFF00FF);
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_LAND] = TextWars_CreateLabel(playerid, 476.0, 200.0, "_", 0.2, 0.9, 0x99FF99FF);
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_FACTION] = TextWars_CreateLabel(playerid, 476.0, 214.0, "_", 0.2, 0.9, 0x8CC6FFFF);

    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_BTN_STATUS] = TextWars_CreateButton(playerid, 513.0, 232.0, "STATUS");
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_BTN_LAND] = TextWars_CreateButton(playerid, 592.0, 232.0, "GEBIETE");
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_BTN_ATTACK] = TextWars_CreateButton(playerid, 513.0, 252.0, "ANGRIFF");
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_BTN_TROOPS] = TextWars_CreateButton(playerid, 592.0, 252.0, "TRUPPEN");
    gTWDraw[playerid][TW_BTN_CLOSE] = TextWars_CreateButton(playerid, 552.0, 272.0, "SCHLIESSEN");

    for (new d = 0; d < TW_DRAW_COUNT; d++)
    {
        PlayerTextDrawShow(playerid, gTWDraw[playerid][d]);
    }

    gTWVisible[playerid] = 1;
    TextWars_Refresh(playerid);
    TextWars_Select(playerid);
}

// Aktiviert den Mauszeiger auf dem Widget, ESC gibt ihn wieder frei (Widget bleibt als Live-Anzeige).
stock TextWars_Select(playerid)
{
    if (gTWVisible[playerid] == 1)
    {
        SelectTextDraw(playerid, TW_COLOR_SELECT);
        gTWSelecting[playerid] = 1;
    }
}

stock TextWars_Toggle(playerid)
{
    if (gTWVisible[playerid] == 0)
    {
        TextWars_Show(playerid);
    }
    else if (gTWSelecting[playerid] == 0)
    {
        TextWars_Select(playerid);
    }
    else
    {
        TextWars_Hide(playerid);
    }
}

stock TextWars_Refresh(playerid)
{
    if (gTWVisible[playerid] == 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    new stateid = Core_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    new stateShort[8];
    Core_GetStateShortName(stateid, stateShort, sizeof(stateShort));

    new nameA[32], nameB[32];
    new line[96];

    if (GangWarSystem_IsActive(stateid))
    {
        TextWars_GetFactionName(GangWarSystem_GetFactionA(stateid), nameA, sizeof(nameA));
        TextWars_GetFactionName(GangWarSystem_GetFactionB(stateid), nameB, sizeof(nameB));
        format(line, sizeof(line), "Krieg %s: %s %d:%d %s", stateShort, nameA, GangWarSystem_GetScoreA(stateid), GangWarSystem_GetScoreB(stateid), nameB);
    }
    else
    {
        format(line, sizeof(line), "Krieg %s: kein aktiver Gangwar", stateShort);
    }
    PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerid, gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_WAR], line);

    new fightid = GangFightSystem_GetActiveFightForState(stateid);
    if (fightid != -1)
    {
        format(line, sizeof(line), "Fight: %d:%d | %ds", GangFightSystem_GetScoreA(fightid), GangFightSystem_GetScoreB(fightid), GangFightSystem_GetTimeLeft(fightid));
    }
    else
    {
        format(line, sizeof(line), "Fight: keiner aktiv");
    }
    PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerid, gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_FIGHT], line);

    format(line, sizeof(line), "Gebiete LS:%d SF:%d LV:%d", TerritorySystem_GetControlCount(STATE_LOS_SANTOS), TerritorySystem_GetControlCount(STATE_SAN_FIERRO), TerritorySystem_GetControlCount(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS));
    PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerid, gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_LAND], line);

    new factionid = TextWars_GetPlayerFaction(playerid);
    if (factionid == -1)
    {
        format(line, sizeof(line), "Keine Fraktion");
    }
    else
    {
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s | Kasse $%d", gFactionName[factionid], FactionSystem_GetBalance(factionid));
    }
    PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerid, gTWDraw[playerid][TW_DRAW_FACTION], line);
}

public TextWars_Tick()
{
    GangFightSystem_Tick();
    for (new p = 0; p < MAX_PLAYERS; p++)
    {
        if (IsPlayerConnected(p) && gTWVisible[p] == 1)
        {
            TextWars_Refresh(p);
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

stock TextWars_ShowMain(playerid)
{
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_WAR_MAIN, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, "Text-Wars",
        "Kriegs- & Fight-Status\nGebiete\nGangwar erklären\nGangfight starten\nTruppenbewegungen\nLive-Widget umschalten",
        UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock TextWars_ShowStatus(playerid)
{
    new stateid = Core_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    new stateName[32];
    new nameA[32], nameB[32];
    Core_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    new info[512];
    if (GangWarSystem_IsActive(stateid))
    {
        TextWars_GetFactionName(GangWarSystem_GetFactionA(stateid), nameA, sizeof(nameA));
        TextWars_GetFactionName(GangWarSystem_GetFactionB(stateid), nameB, sizeof(nameB));
        format(info, sizeof(info), "Gangwar in %s\n%s  %d : %d  %s\n(Sieg ab 10 Punkten)\n", stateName, nameA, GangWarSystem_GetScoreA(stateid), GangWarSystem_GetScoreB(stateid), nameB);
    }
    else
    {
        format(info, sizeof(info), "Gangwar in %s: keiner aktiv\n", stateName);
    }

    new fightid = GangFightSystem_GetActiveFightForState(stateid);
    new fightText[160];
    if (fightid != -1)
    {
        TextWars_GetFactionName(GangFightSystem_GetFactionA(fightid), nameA, sizeof(nameA));
        TextWars_GetFactionName(GangFightSystem_GetFactionB(fightid), nameB, sizeof(nameB));
        format(fightText, sizeof(fightText), "\nGangfight: %s %d : %d %s (%ds verbleibend)", nameA, GangFightSystem_GetScoreA(fightid), GangFightSystem_GetScoreB(fightid), nameB, GangFightSystem_GetTimeLeft(fightid));
    }
    else
    {
        format(fightText, sizeof(fightText), "\nGangfight: keiner aktiv");
    }
    strcat(info, fightText);
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_WAR_INFO, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Kriegsstatus", info, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock TextWars_ShowTerritories(playerid)
{
    new stateid = Core_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    new list[1536];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Gebiet\tTyp\tWert\tKontrolle\n");
    gTWTerritoryCount[playerid] = 0;

    for (new n = 0; n < MAX_TERRITORIES; n++)
    {
        new tid = TerritorySystem_GetNthForState(stateid, n);
        if (tid == -1)
        {
            break;
        }

        new name[40];
        new ctrl[16];
        TerritorySystem_GetName(tid, name, sizeof(name));
        Core_GetStateShortName(TerritorySystem_GetControl(tid), ctrl, sizeof(ctrl));

        new line[128];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s\t%d\t$%d\t%s\n", name, TerritorySystem_GetType(tid), TerritorySystem_GetValue(tid), ctrl);
        strcat(list, line);
        gTWTerritoryList[playerid][gTWTerritoryCount[playerid]++] = tid;
    }

    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_WAR_TERRITORY_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, "Gebiete deines Staates", list, "Wählen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
}

stock TextWars_ShowFactionPick(playerid, mode)
{
    new own = TextWars_GetPlayerFaction(playerid);
    if (own == -1 || !TextWars_IsFactionLeader(playerid, own))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[TEXT_WARS] Nur Fraktionsleiter können Angriffe koordinieren.");
        return;
    }

    new list[512];
    gTWPickCount[playerid] = 0;
    gTWPickMode[playerid] = mode;
    for (new f = 0; f < MAX_FACTIONS && gTWPickCount[playerid] < TW_MAX_PICK; f++)
    {
        if (f == own || gFactionIsActive[f] != 1)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (gFactionType[f] != FACTION_TYPE_GANG && gFactionType[f] != FACTION_TYPE_LEGAL)
        {
            continue;
        }

        new line[64];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s (Staat %d)\n", gFactionName[f], gFactionState[f]);
        strcat(list, line);
        gTWPickFaction[playerid][gTWPickCount[playerid]++] = f;
    }

    if (gTWPickCount[playerid] == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[TEXT_WARS] Keine angreifbaren Fraktionen vorhanden.");
        return;
    }

    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_WAR_FACTION_PICK, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, (mode == TW_MODE_WAR) ? ("Gangwar erklären gegen...") : ("Gangfight starten gegen..."), list, "Angreifen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
}

stock TextWars_ShowTroops(playerid)
{
    new own = TextWars_GetPlayerFaction(playerid);
    if (own == -1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[TEXT_WARS] Du gehörst keiner Fraktion an.");
        return;
    }

    new list[1024];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Mitglied\tHP\tArmor\tPosition\n");
    for (new p = 0; p < MAX_PLAYERS; p++)
    {
        if (!IsPlayerConnected(p) || !FactionSystem_IsPlayerMember(p, own))
        {
            continue;
        }

        new name[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
        new Float:hp, Float:armor, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z;
        GetPlayerName(p, name, sizeof(name));
        GetPlayerHealth(p, hp);
        GetPlayerArmour(p, armor);
        GetPlayerPos(p, x, y, z);

        new line[96];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s\t%.0f\t%.0f\t%.0f, %.0f\n", name, hp, armor, x, y);
        strcat(list, line);
    }
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_WAR_INFO, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, "Truppenbewegungen", list, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock TextWars_StartAttack(playerid, targetFaction, mode)
{
    new own = TextWars_GetPlayerFaction(playerid);
    if (own == -1 || !TextWars_IsFactionLeader(playerid, own) || targetFaction < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new stateid = FactionSystem_GetState(own);
    new bool:started = false;
    if (mode == TW_MODE_WAR)
    {
        started = GangWarSystem_StartWar(stateid, own, targetFaction);
    }
    else
    {
        started = GangFightSystem_StartFight(stateid, own, targetFaction);
    }

    if (!started)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[TEXT_WARS] Angriff nicht möglich (läuft bereits oder deaktiviert).");
        return false;
    }

    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[TEXT_WARS] %s: %s gegen %s gestartet!", (mode == TW_MODE_WAR) ? ("GANGWAR") : ("GANGFIGHT"), gFactionName[own], gFactionName[targetFaction]);
    TextWars_NotifyFaction(own, 0xFF3333FF, msg);
    TextWars_NotifyFaction(targetFaction, 0xFF3333FF, msg);
    return true;
}

// Punkte für Kills zwischen Kriegsgegnern.
stock TextWars_OnPlayerDeath(playerid, killerid)
{
    if (!IsPlayerConnected(killerid) || killerid == playerid)
    {
        return;
    }

    new killerFaction = TextWars_GetPlayerFaction(killerid);
    new victimFaction = TextWars_GetPlayerFaction(playerid);
    if (killerFaction == -1 || victimFaction == -1 || killerFaction == victimFaction)
    {
        return;
    }

    for (new s = 0; s < STATE_COUNT; s++)
    {
        if (!GangWarSystem_IsActive(s))
        {
            continue;
        }
        new a = GangWarSystem_GetFactionA(s);
        new b = GangWarSystem_GetFactionB(s);
        if ((killerFaction == a && victimFaction == b) || (killerFaction == b && victimFaction == a))
        {
            GangWarSystem_AddScore(s, killerFaction, 1);
        }
    }

    new fightid = GangFightSystem_GetActiveFightForState(FactionSystem_GetState(killerFaction));
    if (fightid != -1)
    {
        new fa = GangFightSystem_GetFactionA(fightid);
        new fb = GangFightSystem_GetFactionB(fightid);
        if ((killerFaction == fa && victimFaction == fb) || (killerFaction == fb && victimFaction == fa))
        {
            GangFightSystem_AddScore(fightid, killerFaction, 1);
        }
    }
}

stock TextWars_ClaimTerritory(playerid, territoryId)
{
    new own = TextWars_GetPlayerFaction(playerid);
    if (own == -1 || !TextWars_IsFactionLeader(playerid, own))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[TEXT_WARS] Nur Fraktionsleiter können Gebiete beanspruchen.");
        return false;
    }

    new newState = FactionSystem_GetState(own);
    if (!FactionSystem_DeductFromBalance(own, TW_CLAIM_COST))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[TEXT_WARS] Die Fraktionskasse reicht nicht ($25000 nötig).");
        return false;
    }
    if (!TerritorySystem_ClaimTerritory(playerid, territoryId, newState))
    {
        FactionSystem_TransferToBalance(own, TW_CLAIM_COST);
        return false;
    }
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(newState, TW_CLAIM_COST / 5);
    return true;
}

stock TextWars_HandleButton(playerid, d)
{
    switch (d)
    {
        case TW_BTN_STATUS: TextWars_ShowStatus(playerid);
        case TW_BTN_LAND: TextWars_ShowTerritories(playerid);
        case TW_BTN_ATTACK: TextWars_ShowMain(playerid);
        case TW_BTN_TROOPS: TextWars_ShowTroops(playerid);
        case TW_BTN_CLOSE: TextWars_Hide(playerid);
    }
}

stock TextWars_OnClickPlayerTextDraw(playerid, PlayerText:playertextid)
{
    for (new d = TW_BTN_STATUS; d < TW_DRAW_COUNT; d++)
    {
        if (gTWDraw[playerid][d] == playertextid && gTWVisible[playerid] == 1)
        {
            // Dialoge brauchen einen freien Mauszeiger.
            if (d != TW_BTN_CLOSE)
            {
                CancelSelectTextDraw(playerid);
                gTWSelecting[playerid] = 0;
            }
            TextWars_HandleButton(playerid, d);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock TextWars_OnClickTextDraw(playerid, Text:clickedid)
{
    // ESC: Zeiger freigeben, Widget bleibt als Live-Anzeige bestehen.
    if (clickedid == Text:INVALID_TEXT_DRAW && gTWSelecting[playerid] == 1)
    {
        gTWSelecting[playerid] = 0;
    }
}

stock TextWars_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, const inputtext[])
{
    #pragma unused inputtext
    if (dialogid < DIALOG_UI_RANGE_WAR_FIRST || dialogid > DIALOG_UI_RANGE_WAR_LAST)
    {
        return false;
    }

    switch (dialogid)
    {
        case DIALOG_WAR_MAIN:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                return true;
            }
            switch (listitem)
            {
                case 0: TextWars_ShowStatus(playerid);
                case 1: TextWars_ShowTerritories(playerid);
                case 2: TextWars_ShowFactionPick(playerid, TW_MODE_WAR);
                case 3: TextWars_ShowFactionPick(playerid, TW_MODE_FIGHT);
                case 4: TextWars_ShowTroops(playerid);
                case 5: TextWars_Toggle(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_WAR_INFO:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                TextWars_ShowMain(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_WAR_TERRITORY_LIST:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                TextWars_ShowMain(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (listitem < 0 || listitem >= gTWTerritoryCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            gTWTerritoryPick[playerid] = gTWTerritoryList[playerid][listitem];

            new name[40];
            TerritorySystem_GetName(gTWTerritoryPick[playerid], name, sizeof(name));
            new text[160];
            format(text, sizeof(text), "%s beanspruchen?\nKosten: $%d aus der Fraktionskasse.\nNur für Fraktionsleiter.", name, TW_CLAIM_COST);
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_WAR_TERRITORY_ACTION, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Gebiet beanspruchen", text, "Beanspruchen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
        }
        case DIALOG_WAR_TERRITORY_ACTION:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                TextWars_ShowTerritories(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            TextWars_ClaimTerritory(playerid, gTWTerritoryPick[playerid]);
        }
        case DIALOG_WAR_FACTION_PICK:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                TextWars_ShowMain(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (listitem < 0 || listitem >= gTWPickCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            TextWars_StartAttack(playerid, gTWPickFaction[playerid][listitem], gTWPickMode[playerid]);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

stock TextWars_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/textwars", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/warmenu", true) == 0)
    {
        TextWars_ShowMain(playerid);
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/warhud", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/gangwar", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/gangfight", true) == 0)
    {
        TextWars_Show(playerid);
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/territories", true) == 0)
    {
        TextWars_ShowTerritories(playerid);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

#if !defined CITY_HALL_SYSTEM_INC
#define CITY_HALL_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_CITY_HALLS 3

new gCityHallState[MAX_CITY_HALLS];
new Float:gCityHallPosX[MAX_CITY_HALLS];
new Float:gCityHallPosY[MAX_CITY_HALLS];
new Float:gCityHallPosZ[MAX_CITY_HALLS];
new gCityHallOpen[MAX_CITY_HALLS];
new gCityHallName[MAX_CITY_HALLS][32];

stock CityHallSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_CITY_HALLS; i++)
    {
        gCityHallState[i] = -1;
        gCityHallPosX[i] = 0.0;
        gCityHallPosY[i] = 0.0;
        gCityHallPosZ[i] = 0.0;
        gCityHallOpen[i] = 1;
        format(gCityHallName[i], 32, "Unbekanntes Rathaus");
    }

    CityHallSystem_RegisterCityHall(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Los Santos Rathaus", 1503.0, -1700.0, 13.0);
    CityHallSystem_RegisterCityHall(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "San Fierro Rathaus", -1914.0, 287.0, 35.0);
    CityHallSystem_RegisterCityHall(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Las Venturas Rathaus", 1603.0, 1810.0, 10.0);

    print("[CITY_HALL] Stadthallen und Rathäuser initialisiert");
}

stock CityHallSystem_RegisterCityHall(stateid, const name[], Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new hallid = stateid;
    if (hallid < 0 || hallid >= MAX_CITY_HALLS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gCityHallState[hallid] = stateid;
    gCityHallPosX[hallid] = x;
    gCityHallPosY[hallid] = y;
    gCityHallPosZ[hallid] = z;
    gCityHallOpen[hallid] = 1;
    format(gCityHallName[hallid], 32, "%s", name);
    return true;
}

stock CityHallSystem_ShowInfo(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[CITY_HALL] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    Core_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[CITY_HALL] %s | %s | offen: %s", stateName, gCityHallName[stateid], (gCityHallOpen[stateid] == 1) ? ("Ja") : ("Nein"));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);
}

stock CityHallSystem_IsNearCityHall(playerid, stateid, Float:radius)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new Float:x, Float:y, Float:z;
    GetPlayerPos(playerid, x, y, z);
    return GetDistanceBetweenPoints3D(x, y, z, gCityHallPosX[stateid], gCityHallPosY[stateid], gCityHallPosZ[stateid]) <= radius;
}

stock CityHallSystem_NotifyNearbyPlayer(playerid)
{
    new stateid = Core_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }

    if (CityHallSystem_IsNearCityHall(playerid, stateid, 30.0))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x33CCFFAA, "[CITY_HALL] Du bist am Rathaus deines Staates. Wahlen, Dienste und Staatsfinanzen verwalten sich hier.");
    }
}

#if !defined STATE_GOVERNANCE_INC
#define STATE_GOVERNANCE_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_GOVERNANCE_OFFICES 8

new gStateGovernmentLevel[STATE_COUNT];
new gStateOfficeCount[STATE_COUNT];
new gStateOfficeName[STATE_COUNT][MAX_GOVERNANCE_OFFICES][32];

#if defined _STATE_BUDGET_SYSTEM_INC
    #undef gStateBudgetAlert
#endif

stock StateGovernance_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < STATE_COUNT; i++)
    {
        gStateGovernmentLevel[i] = 1;
        gStateBudgetAlert[i] = 0;
        gStateOfficeCount[i] = 0;
        StateSystem_SetPolicy(i, "Stabilisierung");
        for (new j = 0; j < MAX_GOVERNANCE_OFFICES; j++)
        {
            format(gStateOfficeName[i][j], 32, "");
        }
    }

    StateGovernance_SetPolicy(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Urban Growth");
    StateGovernance_SetPolicy(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Industrial Growth");
    StateGovernance_SetPolicy(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Tourism Growth");
    StateGovernance_SetLevel(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 3);
    StateGovernance_SetLevel(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, 2);
    StateGovernance_SetLevel(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 3);

    StateGovernance_RegisterOffice(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "City Hall");
    StateGovernance_RegisterOffice(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Harbor Office");
    StateGovernance_RegisterOffice(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Tourism Office");

    print("[STATE_GOVERNANCE] Staatliche Verwaltung jedes Bundesstaates initialisiert");
}

stock StateGovernance_SetPolicy(stateid, const policy[])
{
    StateSystem_SetPolicy(stateid, policy);
}

stock StateGovernance_SetLevel(stateid, level)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    gStateGovernmentLevel[stateid] = level;
}

stock int:StateGovernance_GetLevel(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gStateGovernmentLevel[stateid];
}

stock StateGovernance_RegisterOffice(stateid, const office[])
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gStateOfficeCount[stateid] >= MAX_GOVERNANCE_OFFICES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gStateOfficeName[stateid][gStateOfficeCount[stateid]], 32, "%s", office);
    gStateOfficeCount[stateid]++;
    return true;
}

stock StateGovernance_ApproveBudget(stateid, amount)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    return StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, amount);
}

stock StateGovernance_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[STATE_GOVERNANCE] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    new policy[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    StateSystem_GetPolicy(stateid, policy, sizeof(policy));
    new message[256];
    format(message, sizeof(message), "[GOVERNANCE] %s | Level: %d | Budget: %d | Policy: %s", stateName, gStateGovernmentLevel[stateid], StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid), policy);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, message);

    for (new i = 0; i < gStateOfficeCount[stateid]; i++)
    {
        new line[128];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "- Office: %s", gStateOfficeName[stateid][i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
    }
}

#if !defined ACCESSORY_SYSTEM_INC
#define ACCESSORY_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_PLAYER_ACCESSORIES 8
#define ACCESSORY_NONE 0
#define ACCESSORY_HAT 1
#define ACCESSORY_GLASSES 2
#define ACCESSORY_WATCH 3
#define ACCESSORY_CHAIN 4
#define ACCESSORY_BACKPACK 5

new gAccessoryItem[MAX_PLAYERS][MAX_PLAYER_ACCESSORIES];
new gAccessoryColor[MAX_PLAYERS][MAX_PLAYER_ACCESSORIES];
new gAccessoryLevel[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock AccessorySystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gAccessoryLevel[i] = 0;
        for (new a = 0; a < MAX_PLAYER_ACCESSORIES; a++)
        {
            gAccessoryItem[i][a] = ACCESSORY_NONE;
            gAccessoryColor[i][a] = 0;
        }
    }
    DB_EnsureAccessorySchema();
    print("[ACCESSORY] Accessoire-/Fashion-System initialisiert");
}

stock AccessorySystem_Equip(playerid, accessoryType, color)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (accessoryType < ACCESSORY_NONE || accessoryType > ACCESSORY_BACKPACK)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYER_ACCESSORIES; i++)
    {
        if (gAccessoryItem[playerid][i] == ACCESSORY_NONE)
        {
            gAccessoryItem[playerid][i] = accessoryType;
            gAccessoryColor[playerid][i] = color;
            gAccessoryLevel[playerid]++;
            DB_SaveAccessory(playerid, accessoryType, color, 1);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

stock AccessorySystem_UnEquip(playerid, accessoryType)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYER_ACCESSORIES; i++)
    {
        if (gAccessoryItem[playerid][i] == accessoryType)
        {
            gAccessoryItem[playerid][i] = ACCESSORY_NONE;
            gAccessoryColor[playerid][i] = 0;
            if (gAccessoryLevel[playerid] > 0)
            {
                gAccessoryLevel[playerid]--;
            }
            DB_SaveAccessory(playerid, accessoryType, 0, 0);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

stock int:AccessorySystem_GetCount(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gAccessoryLevel[playerid];
}

stock AccessorySystem_ShowInventory(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }

    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[ACCESSORY] Anzahl: %d | slots: %d", gAccessoryLevel[playerid], MAX_PLAYER_ACCESSORIES);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF99AAFF, msg);
}

#if !defined HOUSE_STORAGE_SYSTEM_INC
#define HOUSE_STORAGE_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#if !defined MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS
#define MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS 12
#endif
#if !defined MAX_HOUSES
#define MAX_HOUSES 50
#endif
#if !defined INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE 0
#endif
#define HOUSE_STORAGE_NONE 0
#define HOUSE_STORAGE_SAFE 1
#define HOUSE_STORAGE_LOCKER 2

new gHouseStorageOwner[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHouseStorageState[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHouseStorageSafe[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHouseStorageMoney[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHouseStorageItem[MAX_HOUSES][MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS];
new gHouseStorageQty[MAX_HOUSES][MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS];
new gHouseStorageMeta[MAX_HOUSES][MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS][32];

stock HouseStorageSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_HOUSES; i++)
    {
        if (gHouseStorageOwner[i] == playerid || gHouseStorageOwner[i] == -1)
        {
            DB_LoadHouseStorage(i);
        }
    }

    return true;
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_HOUSES; i++)
    {
        gHouseStorageOwner[i] = -1;
        gHouseStorageState[i] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
        gHouseStorageSafe[i] = HOUSE_STORAGE_NONE;
        gHouseStorageMoney[i] = 0;
        for (new s = 0; s < MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS; s++)
        {
            gHouseStorageItem[i][s] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
            gHouseStorageQty[i][s] = 0;
            format(gHouseStorageMeta[i][s], 32, "NONE");
        }
    }

    HouseStorageSystem_RegisterHouseStorage(0, STATE_LOS_SANTOS, -1, HOUSE_STORAGE_SAFE, 5000);
    HouseStorageSystem_RegisterHouseStorage(1, STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -1, HOUSE_STORAGE_LOCKER, 3000);
    HouseStorageSystem_RegisterHouseStorage(2, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, -1, HOUSE_STORAGE_SAFE, 8000);

    print("[HOUSE_STORAGE] Haus-Safes und Lagerplätze initialisiert");
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_RegisterHouseStorage(houseid, stateid, ownerid, type, money)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gHouseStorageOwner[houseid] = ownerid;
    gHouseStorageState[houseid] = stateid;
    gHouseStorageSafe[houseid] = type;
    gHouseStorageMoney[houseid] = money;
    return true;
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_AssignOwner(playerid, houseid, ownerid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gHouseStorageOwner[houseid] = ownerid;
    gHouseStorageSafe[houseid] = HOUSE_STORAGE_SAFE;
    return true;
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_StoreItem(playerid, houseid, itemid, quantity, metadata[] = "NONE")
{
    if (!Core_ValidatePlayerSlot(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid <= INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || quantity <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (quantity > 99999)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gHouseStorageItem[houseid][i] == itemid)
        {
            new newQty = gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i] + quantity;
            if (newQty > 99999)
            {
                return false;
            }
            gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i] = newQty;
            format(gHouseStorageMeta[houseid][i], 32, "%s", metadata);
            DB_SaveHouseStorageItem(houseid, itemid, i, gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i], metadata);
            return true;
        }
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gHouseStorageItem[houseid][i] == HOUSE_STORAGE_NONE)
        {
            gHouseStorageItem[houseid][i] = itemid;
            gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i] = quantity;
            format(gHouseStorageMeta[houseid][i], 32, "%s", metadata);
            DB_SaveHouseStorageItem(houseid, itemid, i, quantity, metadata);
            return true;
        }
    }

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[HOUSE] Das Hauslager ist voll.");
    return false;
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_SetItemAtSlot(houseid, slot, itemid, quantity, const metadata[])
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_ValidateHouseStorageSlot(slot))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (quantity < 0 || quantity > 99999)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid < INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || itemid > INVENTORY_ITEM_MEDKIT)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (quantity == 0)
    {
        gHouseStorageItem[houseid][slot] = HOUSE_STORAGE_NONE;
        gHouseStorageQty[houseid][slot] = 0;
        format(gHouseStorageMeta[houseid][slot], 32, "NONE");
        DB_SaveHouseStorageItem(houseid, HOUSE_STORAGE_NONE, slot, 0, "NONE");
        return true;
    }

    gHouseStorageItem[houseid][slot] = itemid;
    gHouseStorageQty[houseid][slot] = quantity;
    format(gHouseStorageMeta[houseid][slot], 32, "%s", metadata);
    DB_SaveHouseStorageItem(houseid, itemid, slot, quantity, metadata);
    return true;
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_TakeItem(playerid, houseid, itemid, quantity)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid <= INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || quantity <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gHouseStorageItem[houseid][i] == itemid)
        {
            if (gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i] < quantity)
            {
                return false;
            }

            gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i] -= quantity;
            if (gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i] <= 0)
            {
                gHouseStorageItem[houseid][i] = HOUSE_STORAGE_NONE;
                gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i] = 0;
                format(gHouseStorageMeta[houseid][i], 32, "NONE");
            }
            DB_SaveHouseStorageItem(houseid, gHouseStorageItem[houseid][i], i, gHouseStorageQty[houseid][i], gHouseStorageMeta[houseid][i]);
            return true;
        }
    }

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[HOUSE] Dieses Item ist im Turmsafe nicht vorhanden.");
    return false;
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_DepositMoney(playerid, houseid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gHouseStorageMoney[houseid] += amount;
    return true;
}

stock HouseStorageSystem_WithdrawMoney(playerid, houseid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount <= 0 || gHouseStorageMoney[houseid] < amount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gHouseStorageMoney[houseid] -= amount;
    return true;
}

stock int:HouseStorageSystem_GetSafeBalance(houseid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gHouseStorageMoney[houseid];
}

#if !defined HOUSE_SYSTEM_INC
#define HOUSE_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_HOUSES 50
#define HOUSE_LOCKED 0
#define HOUSE_UNLOCKED 1

new gHouseState[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHouseOwner[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHousePrice[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHouseInterior[MAX_HOUSES];
new gHouseLocked[MAX_HOUSES];

stock HouseSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_HOUSES; i++)
    {
        gHouseState[i] = -1;
        gHouseOwner[i] = -1;
        gHousePrice[i] = 0;
        gHouseInterior[i] = 0;
        gHouseLocked[i] = HOUSE_LOCKED;
    }

    HouseSystem_CreateHouse(0, 0, 250000, 1, -1);
    HouseSystem_CreateHouse(1, 1, 230000, 2, -1);
    HouseSystem_CreateHouse(2, 2, 260000, 3, -1);

    print("[HOUSE] Dynamisches Haussystem initialisiert");
}

stock HouseSystem_CreateHouse(houseid, stateid, price, interior, ownerid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gHouseState[houseid] = stateid;
    gHouseOwner[houseid] = ownerid;
    gHousePrice[houseid] = price;
    gHouseInterior[houseid] = interior;
    gHouseLocked[houseid] = (ownerid == -1) ? HOUSE_UNLOCKED : HOUSE_LOCKED;
    return true;
}

stock HouseSystem_BuyHouse(playerid, houseid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gHouseOwner[houseid] != -1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[HOUSE] Dieses Haus ist bereits vergeben.");
        return false;
    }

    new price = gHousePrice[houseid];
    if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, -price))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[HOUSE] Du hast nicht genug Geld auf der Bank für dieses Haus.");
        return false;
    }

    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] = Core_GetPlayerBank(playerid);
    gHouseOwner[houseid] = playerid;
    gHouseLocked[houseid] = HOUSE_LOCKED;
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(gHouseState[houseid], price / 12);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[HOUSE] Haus erfolgreich gekauft. Staatseinnahme: %d$", price / 12);
    return true;
}

stock HouseSystem_SetOwner(houseid, ownerid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    gHouseOwner[houseid] = ownerid;
    gHouseLocked[houseid] = HOUSE_LOCKED;
    return true;
}

stock int:HouseSystem_GetOwner(houseid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gHouseOwner[houseid];
}

stock int:HouseSystem_GetState(houseid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gHouseState[houseid];
}

stock int:HouseSystem_GetPrice(houseid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gHousePrice[houseid];
}

stock HouseSystem_ShowInfo(playerid, houseid)
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return;
    }

    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[HOUSE] Haus %d | Staat: %d | Preis: %d | Besitzer: %d | Interior: %d", houseid, gHouseState[houseid], gHousePrice[houseid], gHouseOwner[houseid], gHouseInterior[houseid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFF00AA, msg);

#if defined _INVENTORY_SYSTEM_INCLUDED
    #endinput
#endif
#define _INVENTORY_SYSTEM_INCLUDED

#include <a_samp>

#if !defined MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS
#define MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS 24
#endif
#define INVALID_ITEM_ID -1

#define INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE 0
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_PHONE 1
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_TOOL 2
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_DRUG 3
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_WEAPON 4
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_FOOD 5
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_KEY 6
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_MATERIAL 7
#define INVENTORY_ITEM_MEDKIT 8

#define INVENTORY_MAX_STACK_DEFAULT 10
#define INVENTORY_STACKABLE 1
#define INVENTORY_UNSTACKABLE 0

enum E_ITEM_DATA
{
    item_id,
    item_name[32],
    bool:item_is_stackable,
    item_max_stack
}

new gInventoryItem[MAX_PLAYERS][MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS];
new gInventoryItemQty[MAX_PLAYERS][MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS];
new gInventoryItemMeta[MAX_PLAYERS][MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS][32];
new gInventoryWeight[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gInventoryMoney[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gInventoryInitialized[MAX_PLAYERS];

forward Inventory_Load(playerid);
forward Inventory_Save(playerid);

stock Inventory_GetItemData(itemid, item_name_out[], item_name_len, &bool:is_stackable, &max_stack)
{
    if (itemid <= INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE)
    {
        format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Leer");
        is_stackable = false;
        max_stack = 1;
        return false;
    }

    switch (itemid)
    {
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_PHONE:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Telefon");
            is_stackable = false;
            max_stack = 1;
            return true;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_TOOL:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Werkzeug");
            is_stackable = false;
            max_stack = 1;
            return true;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_DRUG:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Droge");
            is_stackable = true;
            max_stack = 25;
            return true;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_WEAPON:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Waffe");
            is_stackable = false;
            max_stack = 1;
            return true;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_FOOD:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Essen");
            is_stackable = true;
            max_stack = 10;
            return true;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_KEY:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Schluessel");
            is_stackable = false;
            max_stack = 1;
            return true;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_MATERIAL:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Material");
            is_stackable = true;
            max_stack = 50;
            return true;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_MEDKIT:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Medkit");
            is_stackable = true;
            max_stack = 6;
            return true;
        }
        default:
        {
            format(item_name_out, item_name_len, "Unbekannt");
            is_stackable = false;
            max_stack = 1;
            return false;
        }
    }
}

stock InventorySystem_Initialize()
{
    DB_EnsureInventorySchema();
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gInventoryWeight[i] = 0;
        gInventoryMoney[i] = 0;
        gInventoryInitialized[i] = 0;
        for (new s = 0; s < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; s++)
        {
            gInventoryItem[i][s] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
            gInventoryItemQty[i][s] = 0;
            format(gInventoryItemMeta[i][s], 32, "NONE");
        }
    }
    print("[INV] Relationale Inventar-Architektur initialisiert");
}

stock InventorySystem_SetPlayerInventory(playerid, slot, itemid, quantity, const metadata[])
{
    if (!Core_ValidatePlayerSlot(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_ValidateInventorySlot(slot))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (quantity < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid < INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || itemid > INVENTORY_ITEM_MEDKIT)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new bool:isStackable = false;
    new maxStack = INVENTORY_MAX_STACK_DEFAULT;
    new itemName[32];
    if (!Inventory_GetItemData(itemid, itemName, sizeof(itemName), isStackable, maxStack))
    {
        if (itemid != INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (quantity == 0)
    {
        gInventoryItem[playerid][slot] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
        gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot] = 0;
        format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][slot], 32, "NONE");
        return true;
    }

    if (!Core_ValidateItemStack(itemid, quantity, maxStack, isStackable))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gInventoryItem[playerid][slot] = itemid;
    gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot] = quantity;
    format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][slot], 32, "%s", metadata);
    return true;
}

stock InventorySystem_UseItem(playerid, slot)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gInventoryItem[playerid][slot] == INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot] <= 0)
    {
        gInventoryItem[playerid][slot] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
        format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][slot], 32, "NONE");
        return false;
    }

    gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot]--;
    if (gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot] <= 0)
    {
        gInventoryItem[playerid][slot] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
        gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot] = 0;
        format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][slot], 32, "NONE");
    }
    return true;
}

#define INV_USE_FAILED 0
#define INV_USE_CONSUMED 1
#define INV_USE_NO_EFFECT 2
#define INV_USE_OPEN_PHONE 3

// Wendet den Effekt eines Slots an und verbraucht nur verbrauchbare Items (persistent über Inventory_Remove).
stock InventorySystem_UseSlot(playerid, slot)
{
    if (!Core_ValidatePlayerSlot(playerid) || slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS)
    {
        return INV_USE_FAILED;
    }

    new itemid = gInventoryItem[playerid][slot];
    if (itemid == INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot] <= 0)
    {
        return INV_USE_FAILED;
    }

    switch (itemid)
    {
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_PHONE:
        {
            return INV_USE_OPEN_PHONE;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_FOOD:
        {
            new Float:health;
            GetPlayerHealth(playerid, health);
            SetPlayerHealth(playerid, min(100.0, health + 25.0));
            Inventory_Remove(playerid, itemid, 1);
            return INV_USE_CONSUMED;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_MEDKIT:
        {
            SetPlayerHealth(playerid, 100.0);
            Inventory_Remove(playerid, itemid, 1);
            return INV_USE_CONSUMED;
        }
        case INVENTORY_ITEM_TOOL:
        {
            new vehicleid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
            if (vehicleid == 0)
            {
                return INV_USE_FAILED;
            }
            RepairVehicle(vehicleid);
            return INV_USE_NO_EFFECT;
        }
    }
    return INV_USE_NO_EFFECT;
}

stock InventorySystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    gInventoryInitialized[playerid] = 1;
    Inventory_Load(playerid);
}

public Inventory_Load(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 1;
    }

    gInventoryInitialized[playerid] = 1;
    DB_LoadPlayerInventory(playerid);
    return 1;
}

public Inventory_Save(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 1;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gInventoryItem[playerid][i] != INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE && gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] > 0)
        {
            DB_SavePlayerInventoryItem(playerid, gInventoryItem[playerid][i], i, gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i], gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][i]);
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

stock Inventory_Add(playerid, itemid, quantity, metadata[] = "NONE")
{
    if (!Core_ValidatePlayerSlot(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid <= INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || quantity <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new bool:isStackable = false;
    new maxStack = INVENTORY_MAX_STACK_DEFAULT;
    new itemName[32];
    if (!Inventory_GetItemData(itemid, itemName, sizeof(itemName), isStackable, maxStack))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_ValidateItemStack(itemid, quantity, maxStack, isStackable))
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gInventoryItem[playerid][i] == itemid && isStackable)
        {
            new newQty = gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] + quantity;
            if (newQty <= maxStack)
            {
                gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] = newQty;
                format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][i], 32, "%s", metadata);
                DB_SavePlayerInventoryItem(playerid, itemid, i, newQty, metadata);
                gInventoryWeight[playerid] += 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gInventoryItem[playerid][i] == INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE)
        {
            gInventoryItem[playerid][i] = itemid;
            gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] = quantity;
            format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][i], 32, "%s", metadata);
            gInventoryWeight[playerid] += 1;
            DB_SavePlayerInventoryItem(playerid, itemid, i, quantity, metadata);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

stock Inventory_Remove(playerid, itemid, quantity)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid <= INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || quantity <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gInventoryItem[playerid][i] == itemid)
        {
            if (gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] <= quantity)
            {
                gInventoryItem[playerid][i] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
                gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] = 0;
                format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][i], 32, "NONE");
                gInventoryWeight[playerid] = max(0, gInventoryWeight[playerid] - 1);
                DB_RemovePlayerInventoryItem(playerid, itemid, quantity);
                return true;
            }
            else
            {
                gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] -= quantity;
                DB_RemovePlayerInventoryItem(playerid, itemid, quantity);
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock Inventory_HasItem(playerid, itemid, quantity)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid <= INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gInventoryItem[playerid][i] == itemid)
        {
            if (gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] >= quantity)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock InventorySystem_TransferItem(playerid, targetplayerid, itemid, quantity, metadata[] = "NONE")
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS || targetplayerid < 0 || targetplayerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Inventory_HasItem(playerid, itemid, quantity))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Inventory_Add(targetplayerid, itemid, quantity, metadata))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return Inventory_Remove(playerid, itemid, quantity);
}

stock InventorySystem_GetWeight(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gInventoryWeight[playerid];
}

stock InventorySystem_GetFreeSlots(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        if (gInventoryItem[playerid][i] == INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE)
        {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

stock InventorySystem_ShowInventory(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[INV] Gewicht: %d | Freie Slots: %d | Status: %d", gInventoryWeight[playerid], InventorySystem_GetFreeSlots(playerid), gInventoryInitialized[playerid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00CCFFAA, msg);
}

stock InventorySystem_ResetPlayer(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        gInventoryItem[playerid][i] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
        gInventoryItemQty[playerid][i] = 0;
        format(gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][i], 32, "NONE");
    }
    gInventoryWeight[playerid] = 0;
}

#if !defined DYNAMIC_JOB_SYSTEM_INC
#define DYNAMIC_JOB_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_DYNAMIC_JOBS 48
#define JOB_FLAG_ACTIVE 1
#define JOB_FLAG_DISABLED 0

// Job-Typen (JOB_TYPE_*) stammen ausschließlich aus jobs_core.inc.
new gDynamicJobCount = 0;
new gDynamicJobName[MAX_DYNAMIC_JOBS][32];
new gDynamicJobState[MAX_DYNAMIC_JOBS];
new gDynamicJobType[MAX_DYNAMIC_JOBS];
new gDynamicJobActive[MAX_DYNAMIC_JOBS];
new Text:gDynamicJobTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];
new gDynamicJobBasePay[MAX_DYNAMIC_JOBS];

stock DynamicJobSystem_Initialize()
{
    gDynamicJobCount = 0;

    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Zivilist", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, JOB_TYPE_CIVIL);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Truckfahrer", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, JOB_TYPE_TRUCKER);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Polizei", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, JOB_TYPE_POLICE);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Sanitäter", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, JOB_TYPE_MEDIC);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Logistik", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, JOB_TYPE_LOGISTICS);

    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Staatsdienst", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, JOB_TYPE_STATE);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Mechaniker", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, JOB_TYPE_BUSINESS);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Wirtschaft", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, JOB_TYPE_BUSINESS);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Casino", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, JOB_TYPE_BUSINESS);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Service", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, JOB_TYPE_STATE);

    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Casino", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, JOB_TYPE_BUSINESS);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Tourismus", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, JOB_TYPE_CIVIL);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Service", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, JOB_TYPE_STATE);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Logistik", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, JOB_TYPE_LOGISTICS);
    DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob("Transport", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, JOB_TYPE_TRUCKER);

    print("[JOB_DYNAMIC] Dynamisches Job-System initialisiert");
    Core_MarkModuleReady("jobs");
}

stock DynamicJobSystem_AssignPlayerJob(playerid, jobid, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (jobid < 0 || jobid >= gDynamicJobCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gDynamicJobState[jobid] != stateid)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gDynamicJobActive[jobid] != JOB_FLAG_ACTIVE)
    {
        return false;
    }

    JobsCore_SetPlayerJob(playerid, gDynamicJobType[jobid]);
    JobsCore_SetPlayerJobId(playerid, jobid);
    JobsCore_SetPlayerJobState(playerid, stateid);
    return true;
}

stock DynamicJobSystem_GetJobName(jobid, output[], len)
{
    if (jobid < 0 || jobid >= gDynamicJobCount)
    {
        format(output, len, "Kein Job");
        return;
    }
    format(output, len, "%s", gDynamicJobName[jobid]);
}

stock DynamicJobSystem_IsJobActive(jobid)
{
    return jobid >= 0 && jobid < gDynamicJobCount && gDynamicJobActive[jobid] == JOB_FLAG_ACTIVE;
}

// Liefert die n-te (0-basiert) Job-ID eines Staates oder -1.
stock int:DynamicJobSystem_GetStateJobId(stateid, nth)
{
    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < gDynamicJobCount; i++)
    {
        if (gDynamicJobState[i] == stateid)
        {
            if (count == nth)
            {
                return i;
            }
            count++;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

stock int:DynamicJobSystem_GetBasePay(jobid)
{
    if (jobid < 0 || jobid >= gDynamicJobCount)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gDynamicJobBasePay[jobid];
}

stock int:DynamicJobSystem_GetJobType(jobid)
{
    if (jobid < 0 || jobid >= gDynamicJobCount)
    {
        return JOB_TYPE_CIVIL;
    }
    return gDynamicJobType[jobid];
}

stock int:DynamicJobSystem_GetJobState(jobid)
{
    if (jobid < 0 || jobid >= gDynamicJobCount)
    {
        return STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }
    return gDynamicJobState[jobid];
}

stock int:DynamicJobSystem_BasePayForType(type)
{
    switch (type)
    {
        case JOB_TYPE_POLICE, JOB_TYPE_MEDIC: return 900;
        case JOB_TYPE_STATE: return 800;
        case JOB_TYPE_TRUCKER, JOB_TYPE_LOGISTICS: return 700;
        case JOB_TYPE_BUSINESS: return 650;
    }
    return 500;
}

stock DynamicJobSystem_RegisterJob(const name[], stateid, type)
{
    if (gDynamicJobCount >= MAX_DYNAMIC_JOBS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gDynamicJobName[gDynamicJobCount], 32, "%s", name);
    gDynamicJobState[gDynamicJobCount] = stateid;
    gDynamicJobType[gDynamicJobCount] = type;
    gDynamicJobActive[gDynamicJobCount] = JOB_FLAG_ACTIVE;
    gDynamicJobBasePay[gDynamicJobCount] = DynamicJobSystem_BasePayForType(type);
    gDynamicJobCount++;
    return true;
}

stock DynamicJobSystem_SetJobActive(jobid, active)
{
    if (jobid < 0 || jobid >= gDynamicJobCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    gDynamicJobActive[jobid] = active;
    return true;
}

stock DynamicJobSystem_ShowStateJobs(playerid, stateid)
{
    DynamicJobSystem_HideStateJobs(playerid);

    gDynamicJobTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 30.0, "JOB LIST");
    TextDrawAlignment(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][0], 0.55, 1.5);
    TextDrawColor(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][0], 0x33CCFFAA);

    new title[64];
    format(title, sizeof(title), "Staat: %d", stateid);
    gDynamicJobTD[playerid][1] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 55.0, title);
    TextDrawAlignment(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][1], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][1], 0.22, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][1], 0xFFFFFFFF);

    new count = 0;
    new lineY = 82;
    for (new i = 0; i < gDynamicJobCount && count < 6; i++)
    {
        if (gDynamicJobState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new jobLine[64];
            format(jobLine, sizeof(jobLine), "%s [%s]", gDynamicJobName[i], (gDynamicJobActive[i] == JOB_FLAG_ACTIVE) ? ("aktiv") : ("inaktiv"));
            gDynamicJobTD[playerid][2 + count] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, float(lineY), jobLine);
            TextDrawAlignment(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][2 + count], 2);
            TextDrawLetterSize(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][2 + count], 0.20, 0.8);
            TextDrawColor(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][2 + count], 0x99FF99AA);
            lineY += 18;
            count++;
        }
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gDynamicJobTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gDynamicJobTD[playerid][i]);
        }
    }
}

stock DynamicJobSystem_HideStateJobs(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gDynamicJobTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gDynamicJobTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gDynamicJobTD[playerid][i]);
            gDynamicJobTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

stock int:DynamicJobSystem_GetJobCount()
{
    return gDynamicJobCount;
}

#if !defined JOB_CENTER_INC
#define JOB_CENTER_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define JOB_TASK_NONE 0
#define JOB_TASK_PICKUP 1
#define JOB_TASK_DELIVER 2
#define JOB_TASK_COOLDOWN_MS 15000
#define JOB_CENTER_MAX_LIST 16

new gJobTaskStage[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJobTaskStartTick[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJobTaskLastDone[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJobCenterPick[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJobCenterListIds[MAX_PLAYERS][JOB_CENTER_MAX_LIST];
new gJobCenterListCount[MAX_PLAYERS];

// Pickup (0) und Abgabe (1) je Staat.
new Float:gJobTaskPoint[STATE_COUNT][2][3] =
{
    {{2790.0, -2417.0, 13.6}, {1740.0, -1850.0, 13.5}},
    {{-1730.0, 120.0, 3.5}, {-2030.0, 160.0, 28.8}},
    {{1680.0, 1000.0, 10.8}, {2030.0, 1010.0, 10.8}}
};

stock JobCenter_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        JobCenter_Reset(i);
        gJobTaskLastDone[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[JOB_CENTER] Job-Zentrum (Annahme, Aufträge, Fortschritt) initialisiert");
    Core_MarkModuleReady("jobs");
}

stock JobCenter_Reset(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    gJobTaskStage[playerid] = JOB_TASK_NONE;
    gJobTaskStartTick[playerid] = 0;
    gJobCenterPick[playerid] = -1;
    gJobCenterListCount[playerid] = 0;
}

stock JobCenter_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    JobCenter_Reset(playerid);
    gJobTaskLastDone[playerid] = 0;
}

stock JobCenter_OnPlayerDisconnect(playerid)
{
    TransportWorkers_UnregisterWorker(playerid);
    JobCenter_Reset(playerid);
}

stock JobCenter_CancelTask(playerid)
{
    if (gJobTaskStage[playerid] != JOB_TASK_NONE)
    {
        DisablePlayerCheckpoint(playerid);
    }
    gJobTaskStage[playerid] = JOB_TASK_NONE;
}

stock JobCenter_ShowMain(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_AssertLifecycleStage(CORE_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_READY))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[JOBS] Das Job-System startet noch.");
        return;
    }

    new jobName[32];
    DynamicJobSystem_GetJobName(JobsCore_GetPlayerJobId(playerid), jobName, sizeof(jobName));

    new header[64];
    format(header, sizeof(header), "Job-Zentrum | %s", jobName);

    new list[256];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Jobs im Staat ansehen & annehmen\nAuftrag starten\nAuftrag abbrechen\nFortschritt & Lohn\nJob kündigen");
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_JOB_MAIN, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, header, list, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock JobCenter_ShowJobList(playerid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    new list[1024];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Job\tTyp\tGrundlohn\n");
    gJobCenterListCount[playerid] = 0;

    for (new n = 0; n < JOB_CENTER_MAX_LIST; n++)
    {
        new jobid = DynamicJobSystem_GetStateJobId(stateid, n);
        if (jobid == -1)
        {
            break;
        }

        new jobName[32];
        new typeName[32];
        DynamicJobSystem_GetJobName(jobid, jobName, sizeof(jobName));
        JobsCore_GetJobTypeName(DynamicJobSystem_GetJobType(jobid), typeName, sizeof(typeName));

        new line[96];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s%s\t%s\t$%d\n", jobName, DynamicJobSystem_IsJobActive(jobid) ? ("") : (" (inaktiv)"), typeName, DynamicJobSystem_GetBasePay(jobid) * StateJobs_GetPayMultiplier(stateid) / 100);
        strcat(list, line);

        gJobCenterListIds[playerid][gJobCenterListCount[playerid]] = jobid;
        gJobCenterListCount[playerid]++;
    }

    new title[64];
    format(title, sizeof(title), "Jobs in %s", stateName);
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_JOB_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, title, list, "Annehmen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
}

stock JobCenter_ShowStatus(playerid)
{
    new jobName[32];
    new typeName[32];
    DynamicJobSystem_GetJobName(JobsCore_GetPlayerJobId(playerid), jobName, sizeof(jobName));
    JobsCore_GetJobTypeName(JobsCore_GetPlayerJob(playerid), typeName, sizeof(typeName));

    new info[512];
    format(info, sizeof(info), "Job: %s (%s)\nStaat: %d\nJob-XP: %d\nVerdienter Lohn: $%d\nLevel: %d | XP: %d | Rep: %d\nBank: $%d\nAuftrag: %s",
        jobName, typeName, JobsCore_GetPlayerJobState(playerid), JobsCore_GetPlayerJobXP(playerid), JobsCore_GetPlayerJobPay(playerid),
        ProgressionSystem_GetLevel(playerid), ProgressionSystem_GetXP(playerid), ProgressionSystem_GetRep(playerid),
        Core_GetPlayerBank(playerid),
        (gJobTaskStage[playerid] == JOB_TASK_NONE) ? ("keiner") : ((gJobTaskStage[playerid] == JOB_TASK_PICKUP) ? ("Ware abholen") : ("Ware abliefern")));
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_JOB_STATUS, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Job-Fortschritt", info, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock JobCenter_AcceptJob(playerid, jobid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!DynamicJobSystem_AssignPlayerJob(playerid, jobid, stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[JOBS] Dieser Job ist nicht verfügbar.");
        return false;
    }

    JobCenter_CancelTask(playerid);
    TransportWorkers_UnregisterWorker(playerid);

    new type = DynamicJobSystem_GetJobType(jobid);
    if (type == JOB_TYPE_TRUCKER)
    {
        TransportWorkers_RegisterWorker(playerid, stateid, TRANSPORT_ROLE_DRIVER);
    }
    else if (type == JOB_TYPE_LOGISTICS)
    {
        TransportWorkers_RegisterWorker(playerid, stateid, TRANSPORT_ROLE_LOGISTICS);
    }

    new jobName[32];
    DynamicJobSystem_GetJobName(jobid, jobName, sizeof(jobName));
    new msg[96];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[JOBS] Du arbeitest jetzt als %s.", jobName);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, msg);
    return true;
}

stock JobCenter_StartTask(playerid)
{
    if (JobsCore_GetPlayerJob(playerid) == JOB_TYPE_NONE)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[JOBS] Du hast keinen Job. Wähle zuerst einen im Job-Zentrum.");
        return false;
    }

    new stateid = JobsCore_GetPlayerJobState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || stateid != StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[JOBS] Dein Job ist an einen anderen Staat gebunden.");
        return false;
    }
    if (gJobTaskStage[playerid] != JOB_TASK_NONE)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[JOBS] Du hast bereits einen laufenden Auftrag.");
        return false;
    }

    gJobTaskStage[playerid] = JOB_TASK_PICKUP;
    gJobTaskStartTick[playerid] = GetTickCount();
    SetPlayerCheckpoint(playerid, gJobTaskPoint[stateid][0][0], gJobTaskPoint[stateid][0][1], gJobTaskPoint[stateid][0][2], 5.0);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[JOBS] Auftrag gestartet: Hole die Ware am markierten Punkt ab.");
    return true;
}

// Rückgabe true, wenn der Checkpoint zum Job-Auftrag gehörte.
stock JobCenter_OnEnterCheckpoint(playerid)
{
    if (gJobTaskStage[playerid] == JOB_TASK_NONE)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new stateid = JobsCore_GetPlayerJobState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        JobCenter_CancelTask(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    DisablePlayerCheckpoint(playerid);
    if (gJobTaskStage[playerid] == JOB_TASK_PICKUP)
    {
        gJobTaskStage[playerid] = JOB_TASK_DELIVER;
        SetPlayerCheckpoint(playerid, gJobTaskPoint[stateid][1][0], gJobTaskPoint[stateid][1][1], gJobTaskPoint[stateid][1][2], 5.0);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[JOBS] Ware aufgenommen. Liefere sie am nächsten Punkt ab.");
        return true;
    }

    gJobTaskStage[playerid] = JOB_TASK_NONE;
    JobCenter_FinishTask(playerid, stateid);
    return true;
}

stock JobCenter_FinishTask(playerid, stateid)
{
    new now = GetTickCount();
    if (gJobTaskLastDone[playerid] != 0 && now - gJobTaskLastDone[playerid] < JOB_TASK_COOLDOWN_MS)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[JOBS] Zu schnell abgeschlossen - keine Belohnung.");
        return;
    }

    new jobType = JobsCore_GetPlayerJob(playerid);
    new basePay = DynamicJobSystem_GetBasePay(JobsCore_GetPlayerJobId(playerid));
    new xp = 10;
    new rep = 1;
    new itemid = 0;
    new qty = 0;

    switch (jobType)
    {
        case JOB_TYPE_TRUCKER, JOB_TYPE_LOGISTICS:
        {
            // Transportnetzwerk: Routengebühr des Staates erhöht den Lohn, Fracht landet im Inventar.
            basePay += TradeLogistics_GetFee(stateid) / 10;
            itemid = INVENTORY_ITEM_MATERIAL;
            qty = 2;
            xp = 15;
        }
        case JOB_TYPE_MEDIC:
        {
            itemid = INVENTORY_ITEM_MEDKIT;
            qty = 1;
            rep = 2;
        }
        case JOB_TYPE_POLICE, JOB_TYPE_STATE:
        {
            rep = 2;
        }
        case JOB_TYPE_CIVIL:
        {
            itemid = INVENTORY_ITEM_FOOD;
            qty = 1;
        }
    }

    if (JobsCore_CompleteTask(playerid, basePay, xp, rep, itemid, qty) >= 0)
    {
        gJobTaskLastDone[playerid] = now;
    }
}

// Rückgabe true, wenn der Dialog vom Job-Zentrum behandelt wurde.
stock JobCenter_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, const inputtext[])
{
    #pragma unused inputtext
    if (dialogid < DIALOG_UI_RANGE_JOBS_FIRST || dialogid > DIALOG_UI_RANGE_JOBS_LAST)
    {
        return false;
    }

    switch (dialogid)
    {
        case DIALOG_JOB_MAIN:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                return true;
            }
            switch (listitem)
            {
                case 0: JobCenter_ShowJobList(playerid);
                case 1:
                {
                    JobCenter_StartTask(playerid);
                }
                case 2:
                {
                    JobCenter_CancelTask(playerid);
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[JOBS] Auftrag abgebrochen.");
                }
                case 3: JobCenter_ShowStatus(playerid);
                case 4:
                {
                    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_JOB_QUIT, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Job kündigen", "Willst du deinen aktuellen Job wirklich kündigen?", "Kündigen", "Abbrechen");
                }
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_JOB_LIST:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                JobCenter_ShowMain(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (listitem < 0 || listitem >= gJobCenterListCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            gJobCenterPick[playerid] = gJobCenterListIds[playerid][listitem];

            new jobName[32];
            DynamicJobSystem_GetJobName(gJobCenterPick[playerid], jobName, sizeof(jobName));
            new text[128];
            format(text, sizeof(text), "Möchtest du den Job \"%s\" annehmen?", jobName);
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_JOB_CONFIRM, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Job annehmen", text, "Annehmen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
        }
        case DIALOG_JOB_CONFIRM:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                JobCenter_ShowJobList(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            JobCenter_AcceptJob(playerid, gJobCenterPick[playerid]);
        }
        case DIALOG_JOB_STATUS:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                JobCenter_ShowMain(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_JOB_QUIT:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                JobCenter_CancelTask(playerid);
                TransportWorkers_UnregisterWorker(playerid);
                JobsCore_QuitJob(playerid);
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[JOBS] Du hast deinen Job gekündigt.");
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

#endif

{
    return jobType == JOB_TYPE_POLICE || jobType == JOB_TYPE_MEDIC || jobType == JOB_TYPE_STATE;

stock JobsCore_GetJobTypeName(jobType, output[], len)
{
    switch (jobType)
    {
        case JOB_TYPE_NONE: format(output, len, "Kein Job");
        case JOB_TYPE_CIVIL: format(output, len, "Zivilist");
        case JOB_TYPE_POLICE: format(output, len, "Polizei");
        case JOB_TYPE_MEDIC: format(output, len, "Sanitäter");
        case JOB_TYPE_TRUCKER: format(output, len, "Truckfahrer");
        case JOB_TYPE_BUSINESS: format(output, len, "Business");
        case JOB_TYPE_STATE: format(output, len, "Staatsjob");
        case JOB_TYPE_GANG: format(output, len, "Gang/Fraktion");
        case JOB_TYPE_LOGISTICS: format(output, len, "Logistik");
        default: format(output, len, "Unbekannt");
    }
}

// Zentrale Belohnungspipeline: Lohn (Staatskasse/Steuer) -> Bank, XP, Reputation, Güter -> Inventar/Haussafe.
// Gibt den ausgezahlten Nettolohn zurück oder -1, wenn der Abschluss abgelehnt wurde.
stock JobsCore_CompleteTask(playerid, basePay, xp, rep, itemid = 0, itemQty = 0)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS || gPlayerJob[playerid] == JOB_TYPE_NONE)
    {
        return -1;
    }

    new stateid = gPlayerJobState[playerid];
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return -1;
    }

    new gross = basePay * StateJobs_GetPayMultiplier(stateid) / 100;
    new tax = gross * StateSystem_GetTaxRate(stateid) / 100;
    new net = gross - tax;

    if (JobsCore_IsPublicJob(gPlayerJob[playerid]))
    {
        if (!StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, -net))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[JOBS] Die Staatskasse kann den Lohn aktuell nicht zahlen.");
            return -1;
        }
    }
    else if (tax > 0)
    {
        StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, tax);
    }

    if (net > 0 && !JobsCore_PayPlayerJob(playerid, net))
    {
        if (JobsCore_IsPublicJob(gPlayerJob[playerid]))
        {
            StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, net);
        }
        return -1;
    }

    JobsCore_AddPlayerJobXP(playerid, xp);
    ProgressionSystem_AddXP(playerid, max(xp, JOB_REWARD_XP_MIN));
    if (rep > 0)
    {
        ProgressionSystem_AddRep(playerid, rep);
    }
    gPlayerJobTasksDone[playerid]++;

    if (itemid > 0 && itemQty > 0)
    {
        JobsCore_GrantItem(playerid, itemid, itemQty);
    }

    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[JOBS] Auftrag erledigt: +$%d (Steuer $%d) | +%d XP | +%d Rep", net, tax, xp, rep);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, msg);
    return net;
}

// Güter landen zuerst im Spielerinventar, bei vollem Inventar im Haussafe des Spielers.
stock JobsCore_GrantItem(playerid, itemid, quantity)
{
    if (Inventory_Add(playerid, itemid, quantity, "NONE"))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x66CCFFAA, "[JOBS] Gut wurde deinem Inventar hinzugefügt.");
        return true;
    }

    for (new h = 0; h < MAX_HOUSES; h++)
    {
        if (gHouseStorageOwner[h] == playerid && HouseStorageSystem_StoreItem(playerid, h, itemid, quantity))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x66CCFFAA, "[JOBS] Inventar voll - Gut wurde in deinem Haussafe eingelagert.");
            return true;
        }
    }

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[JOBS] Kein Platz für das Gut in Inventar oder Haussafe.");
    return false;
}

#if !defined COURT_SYSTEM_INC
#define COURT_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define COURT_STATE_NONE 0
#define COURT_STATE_OPEN 1
#define COURT_STATE_HEARING 2

new gCourtState[3];
new gCourtFine[3];
new gCourtBail[3];
new gCourtSessionOpen[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock CourtSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    {
        gCourtState[i] = COURT_STATE_NONE;
        gCourtFine[i] = 5000;
        gCourtBail[i] = 15000;
    }

    print("[COURT] Gerichtssystem initialisiert");
}

stock CourtSystem_OpenSession(stateid)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gCourtState[stateid] = COURT_STATE_OPEN;
    gCourtFine[stateid] += 1000;
    return true;
}

stock CourtSystem_IssueFine(playerid, stateid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (amount > 0)
    {
        new cash = GetPlayerMoney(playerid);
        if (cash >= amount)
        {
            GivePlayerMoney(playerid, -amount);
        }
    }

    gCourtFine[stateid] += amount;
    gPrisonBank[stateid] += amount;
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, amount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[COURT] Geldstrafe gezahlt. Die Einnahmen fließen in die Staatskasse.");
    return true;
}

stock CourtSystem_SetBail(playerid, stateid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gCourtBail[stateid] = amount;
    gCourtSessionOpen[playerid] = 1;
    return true;
}

stock CourtSystem_ShowInfo(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[COURT] Staat: %d | Strafe: %d | Kaution: %d | Status: %d", StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid), gCourtFine[StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid)], gCourtBail[StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid)], gCourtState[StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid)]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x99CCFFAA, msg);
}

#if !defined PRISON_SYSTEM_INC
#define PRISON_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_PRISON_STATES 3
#define PRISON_CELL_COUNT 3
#define PRISON_STATUS_FREE 0
#define PRISON_STATUS_INCARCERATED 1

new gPrisonState[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPrisonTimeLeft[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPrisonOriginState[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPrisonCell[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPrisonBail[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPrisonTransferFee[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPrisonFinePaid[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPrisonBank[3];

new gPrisonSpawnX[3][PRISON_CELL_COUNT];
new gPrisonSpawnY[3][PRISON_CELL_COUNT];
new gPrisonSpawnZ[3][PRISON_CELL_COUNT];

stock PrisonSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gPrisonState[i] = PRISON_STATUS_FREE;
        gPrisonTimeLeft[i] = 0;
        gPrisonOriginState[i] = -1;
        gPrisonCell[i] = 0;
        gPrisonBail[i] = 0;
        gPrisonTransferFee[i] = 0;
        gPrisonFinePaid[i] = 0;
    }

    gPrisonBank[STATE_LOS_SANTOS] = 150000;
    gPrisonBank[STATE_SAN_FIERRO] = 120000;
    gPrisonBank[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS] = 135000;

    gPrisonSpawnX[STATE_LOS_SANTOS][0] = 1640; gPrisonSpawnY[STATE_LOS_SANTOS][0] = 1750; gPrisonSpawnZ[STATE_LOS_SANTOS][0] = 10;
    gPrisonSpawnX[STATE_SAN_FIERRO][0] = -1980; gPrisonSpawnY[STATE_SAN_FIERRO][0] = 152; gPrisonSpawnZ[STATE_SAN_FIERRO][0] = 27;
    gPrisonSpawnX[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS][0] = 1760; gPrisonSpawnY[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS][0] = 920; gPrisonSpawnZ[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS][0] = 10;

    print("[PRISON] Justiz- und Haftsystem initialisiert");
}

stock PrisonSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gPrisonState[playerid] = PRISON_STATUS_FREE;
    gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid] = 0;
    gPrisonOriginState[playerid] = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_ACTIVE] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_TIME] = 0;
}

stock PrisonSystem_SendToPrison(playerid, stateid, prisonSeconds)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gPrisonState[playerid] = PRISON_STATUS_INCARCERATED;
    gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid] = prisonSeconds;
    gPrisonOriginState[playerid] = stateid;
    gPrisonCell[playerid] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_ACTIVE] = 1;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_TIME] = prisonSeconds;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE] = stateid;

    SetPlayerPos(playerid, gPrisonSpawnX[stateid][gPrisonCell[playerid]], gPrisonSpawnY[stateid][gPrisonCell[playerid]], gPrisonSpawnZ[stateid][gPrisonCell[playerid]]);
    TogglePlayerControllable(playerid, false);
    gPrisonBank[stateid] += 2500;
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, 2500);

    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[PRISON] Du wurdest in %s inhaftiert. Zeit: %d s", (stateid == STATE_LOS_SANTOS) ? ("Los Santos") : ((stateid == STATE_SAN_FIERRO) ? ("San Fierro") : ("Las Venturas")), prisonSeconds);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, msg);
    return true;
}

stock PrisonSystem_ReleasePlayer(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gPrisonState[playerid] = PRISON_STATUS_FREE;
    gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_ACTIVE] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_TIME] = 0;
    TogglePlayerControllable(playerid, true);

    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (stateid < 0 || stateid >= 3)
    {
        stateid = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    StateSystem_SpawnPlayerForState(playerid, stateid);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[PRISON] Haft beendet. Du wurdest freigelassen.");
    return true;
}

stock PrisonSystem_PayBail(playerid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new money = GetPlayerMoney(playerid);
    if (money < amount)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[PRISON] Du hast nicht genug Geld für die Kaution.");
        return false;
    }

    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        stateid = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    GivePlayerMoney(playerid, -amount);
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, amount);
    gPrisonBank[stateid] += amount;
    PrisonSystem_ReleasePlayer(playerid);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00FF, "[PRISON] Du wurdest auf Kaution freigelassen.");
    return true;
}

stock int:PrisonSystem_GetTimeLeft(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid];
}

stock PrisonSystem_Tick(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gPrisonState[playerid] != PRISON_STATUS_INCARCERATED)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid] > 0)
    {
        gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid]--;
        gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_TIME] = gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid];
        if (gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid] <= 0)
        {
            PrisonSystem_ReleasePlayer(playerid);
            return true;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

stock PrisonSystem_ShowStatus(playerid)
{
    new line[256];
    format(line, sizeof(line), "[PRISON] Status: %d | Zeit: %d | Origin: %d | Staat: %d", gPrisonState[playerid], gPrisonTimeLeft[playerid], gPrisonOriginState[playerid], StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, line);
}
