#if !defined JAIL_SYSTEM_INC
#define JAIL_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_JAIL_LOCATIONS 8
#define JAIL_STATE_NONE 0
#define JAIL_STATE_ACTIVE 1
#define JAIL_STATE_RELEASED 2

new gJailActive[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJailState[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJailTime[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJailCell[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gJailLocationCount = 0;
new Float:gJailLocationX[MAX_JAIL_LOCATIONS];
new Float:gJailLocationY[MAX_JAIL_LOCATIONS];
new Float:gJailLocationZ[MAX_JAIL_LOCATIONS];
new gJailLocationState[MAX_JAIL_LOCATIONS];
new gJailLocationName[MAX_JAIL_LOCATIONS][32];
new Text:gJailTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];

stock JailSystem_Initialize()
{
    gJailLocationCount = 0;

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gJailActive[i] = 0;
        gJailState[i] = JAIL_STATE_RELEASED;
        gJailTime[i] = 0;
        gJailCell[i] = -1;
    }

    JailSystem_RegisterLocation(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "LS Jail", 1662.0, -1710.0, 13.0);
    JailSystem_RegisterLocation(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "SF Jail", -1870.0, 260.0, 27.0);
    JailSystem_RegisterLocation(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "LV Jail", 1780.0, 1180.0, 16.0);

    print("[JAIL] Gefängnis- und Haftsystem initialisiert");
}

stock JailSystem_RegisterLocation(stateid, const name[], Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
{
    if (gJailLocationCount >= MAX_JAIL_LOCATIONS)
        return false;
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
        return false;

    gJailLocationState[gJailLocationCount] = stateid;
    format(gJailLocationName[gJailLocationCount], 32, "%s", name);
    gJailLocationX[gJailLocationCount] = x;
    gJailLocationY[gJailLocationCount] = y;
    gJailLocationZ[gJailLocationCount] = z;
    gJailLocationCount++;
    return true;
}

stock JailSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gJailActive[playerid] = 0;
    gJailState[playerid] = JAIL_STATE_RELEASED;
    gJailTime[playerid] = 0;
    gJailCell[playerid] = -1;
}

stock JailSystem_SendToJail(playerid, stateid, timeMinutes)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return;
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
        return;

    gJailActive[playerid] = 1;
    gJailState[playerid] = JAIL_STATE_ACTIVE;
    gJailTime[playerid] = timeMinutes;

    new jailCell = stateid;
    if (jailCell >= gJailLocationCount)
        jailCell = 0;

    gJailCell[playerid] = jailCell;
    SetPlayerPos(playerid, gJailLocationX[jailCell], gJailLocationY[jailCell], gJailLocationZ[jailCell]);
    SetPlayerHealth(playerid, 100.0);
    TogglePlayerControllable(playerid, false);

    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[JAIL] Du wurdest in %s eingesperrt für %d Minuten.", gJailLocationName[jailCell], timeMinutes);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, msg);
}

stock JailSystem_ReleasePlayer(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return;

    gJailActive[playerid] = 0;
    gJailState[playerid] = JAIL_STATE_RELEASED;
    gJailTime[playerid] = 0;
    gJailCell[playerid] = -1;
    TogglePlayerControllable(playerid, true);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[JAIL] Du bist aus dem Gefängnis entlassen worden.");
}

stock JailSystem_IsInJail(playerid)
{
    return (playerid >= 0 && playerid < MAX_PLAYERS && gJailActive[playerid] == 1);
}

stock JailSystem_Tick()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        if (gJailActive[i] == 1)
        {
            gJailTime[i]--;
            if (gJailTime[i] <= 0)
            {
                JailSystem_ReleasePlayer(i);
            }
        }
    }
}

stock JailSystem_ShowHUD(playerid)
{
    JailSystem_HideHUD(playerid);

    gJailTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 30.0, "JAIL HUD");
    TextDrawAlignment(gJailTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gJailTD[playerid][0], 0.5, 1.5);
    TextDrawColor(gJailTD[playerid][0], 0xFF0000AA);

    new bootText[64];
    format(bootText, sizeof(bootText), "Zeit: %d min | Zelle: %d", gJailTime[playerid], gJailCell[playerid]);
    gJailTD[playerid][1] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 62.0, bootText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gJailTD[playerid][1], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gJailTD[playerid][1], 0.22, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gJailTD[playerid][1], 0xFFFFFFFF);

    for (new i = 0; i < 2; i++)
    {
        if (gJailTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
            TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gJailTD[playerid][i]);
    }
}

stock JailSystem_HideHUD(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gJailTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gJailTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gJailTD[playerid][i]);
            gJailTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

stock JailSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
        return false;

    new cmd[32];
    new idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
        return false;

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/jail", true) == 0)
    {
        if (!AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[JAIL] Kein Zugriff.");
            return true;
        }

        new target, minutes, stateid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]ddd", cmd, target, minutes, stateid) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[JAIL] Syntax: /jail <PlayerID> <Minuten> <StateID>");
            return true;
        }

        JailSystem_SendToJail(target, stateid, minutes);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/release", true) == 0)
    {
        if (!AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[JAIL] Kein Zugriff.");
            return true;
        }

        new target;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", cmd, target) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[JAIL] Syntax: /release <PlayerID>");
            return true;
        }

        JailSystem_ReleasePlayer(target);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

        return;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    new newLevel = gWantedLevel[playerid] + amount;
    if (newLevel > MAX_WANTED_LEVEL)
    {
        newLevel = MAX_WANTED_LEVEL;
    }
    gWantedLevel[playerid] = newLevel;
}

#if !defined TRADE_LOGISTICS_INC
#define TRADE_LOGISTICS_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS 12
#define LOGISTICS_ROUTE_CARGO 1
#define LOGISTICS_ROUTE_SMUGGLE 2
#define LOGISTICS_ROUTE_INTERSTATE 3

new gLogisticsState[MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS];
new gLogisticsType[MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS];
new gLogisticsFee[MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS];
new gLogisticsName[MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS][32];
new gLogisticsCount = 0;

stock TradeLogistics_Initialize()
{
    TradeLogistics_RegisterRoute(0, STATE_LOS_SANTOS, LOGISTICS_ROUTE_CARGO, "LS -> LV Transport", 1500);
    TradeLogistics_RegisterRoute(1, STATE_SAN_FIERRO, LOGISTICS_ROUTE_INTERSTATE, "SF -> LS Handoff", 1800);
    TradeLogistics_RegisterRoute(2, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, LOGISTICS_ROUTE_SMUGGLE, "LV -> LS Schmuggel", 3000);

    print("[LOGISTICS] Inter-State-Logistik und Schmuggelrouten initialisiert");
}

stock TradeLogistics_RegisterRoute(routeid, stateid, type, const name[], fee)
{
    if (routeid < 0 || routeid >= MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gLogisticsState[routeid] = stateid;
    gLogisticsType[routeid] = type;
    gLogisticsFee[routeid] = fee;
    format(gLogisticsName[routeid], 32, "%s", name);
    gLogisticsCount++;
    return true;
}

stock int:TradeLogistics_GetFee(routeid)
{
    if (routeid < 0 || routeid >= MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gLogisticsFee[routeid];
}

stock TradeLogistics_ProcessDelivery(playerid, routeid)
{
    if (routeid < 0 || routeid >= MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS)
    {
        return;
    }

    new fee = gLogisticsFee[routeid];
    new payout = fee + (gLogisticsState[routeid] * 200);
    GivePlayerMoney(playerid, payout);
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(gLogisticsState[routeid], fee / 2);

    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[LOGISTICS] Lieferung abgeschlossen. Gewinn: $%d | Route: %s", payout, gLogisticsName[routeid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, msg);
}

stock TradeLogistics_IsSmugglingRoute(routeid)
{
    return routeid >= 0 && routeid < MAX_LOGISTICS_JOBS && gLogisticsType[routeid] == LOGISTICS_ROUTE_SMUGGLE;
}

#endif

#if !defined AIRPORT_SYSTEM_INC
#define AIRPORT_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_AIRPORTS 12

new gAirportState[MAX_AIRPORTS];
new gAirportName[MAX_AIRPORTS][32];
new gAirportRevenue[MAX_AIRPORTS];
new gAirportTransfer[MAX_AIRPORTS];
new gAirportCount[STATE_COUNT];

stock AirportSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_AIRPORTS; i++)
    {
        gAirportState[i] = -1;
        gAirportRevenue[i] = 0;
        gAirportTransfer[i] = 0;
        format(gAirportName[i], 32, "");
    }

    for (new s = 0; s < STATE_COUNT; s++)
    {
        gAirportCount[s] = 0;
    }

    AirportSystem_RegisterAirport(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Los Santos Airport", 19000, 6);
    AirportSystem_RegisterAirport(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "City Air Hub", 12000, 4);
    AirportSystem_RegisterAirport(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "San Fierro Harbor Terminal", 17000, 5);
    AirportSystem_RegisterAirport(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Mountain Airfield", 11000, 3);
    AirportSystem_RegisterAirport(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Las Venturas Airport", 24000, 8);
    AirportSystem_RegisterAirport(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Strip Air Terminal", 16000, 6);

    print("[AIRPORT] Airport network initialized");
}

stock AirportSystem_RegisterAirport(stateid, const name[], revenue, transfers)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gAirportCount[stateid] >= MAX_AIRPORTS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gAirportCount[stateid];
    new airportId = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_AIRPORTS; i++)
    {
        if (gAirportState[i] == -1)
        {
            airportId = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (airportId == 0 && gAirportState[0] != -1)
    {
        airportId = MAX_AIRPORTS - 1;
    }

    gAirportState[airportId] = stateid;
    gAirportRevenue[airportId] = revenue;
    gAirportTransfer[airportId] = transfers;
    format(gAirportName[airportId], 32, "%s", name);
    gAirportCount[stateid]++;
    return true;
}

stock int:AirportSystem_GetRevenue(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;

    {
        if (gAirportState[i] == stateid)
        {
            total += gAirportRevenue[i];

}

#if !defined MUNICIPAL_SYSTEM_INC
#define MUNICIPAL_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MUNICIPAL_TYPE_POWER 0
#define MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WATER 1
#define MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WASTE 2
#define MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TRANSPORT 3
#define MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TOURISM 4
#define MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES 20

new gMunicipalState[MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES];
new gMunicipalType[MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES];
new gMunicipalRevenue[MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES];
new gMunicipalName[MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES][32];
new gMunicipalCount[STATE_COUNT];

stock MunicipalSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < STATE_COUNT; i++)
    {
        gMunicipalCount[i] = 0;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        gMunicipalState[i] = -1;
        gMunicipalType[i] = MUNICIPAL_TYPE_POWER;
        gMunicipalRevenue[i] = 0;
        format(gMunicipalName[i], 32, "");
    }

    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Power Grid", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_POWER, 14000);
    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Water Supply", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WATER, 8500);
    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Waste & Recycling", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WASTE, 6200);

    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Harbor Utilities", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TRANSPORT, 18000);
    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Industrial Water", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WATER, 10500);
    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Public Logistics", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TRANSPORT, 9000);

    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Tourism Power", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TOURISM, 16500);
    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Resort Water", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WATER, 11500);
    MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Strip Services", MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TOURISM, 9900);

    print("[MUNICIPAL] Municipal service network initialized");
}

stock MunicipalSystem_GetTypeName(typeid, output[], len)
{
    if (len <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    output[0] = '\0';

    if (typeid == MUNICIPAL_TYPE_POWER)
    {
        format(output, len, "Power");
        return;
    }
    if (typeid == MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WATER)
    {
        format(output, len, "Water");
        return;
    }
    if (typeid == MUNICIPAL_TYPE_WASTE)
    {
        format(output, len, "Waste");
        return;
    }
    if (typeid == MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TRANSPORT)
    {
        format(output, len, "Transport");
        return;
    }
    if (typeid == MUNICIPAL_TYPE_TOURISM)
    {
        format(output, len, "Tourism");
        return;
    }
    format(output, len, "Unknown");
}

stock MunicipalSystem_RegisterService(stateid, const name[], type, revenue)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gMunicipalState[i] == stateid && gMunicipalType[i] == type)
        {
            gMunicipalRevenue[i] = revenue;
            format(gMunicipalName[i], 32, "%s", name);
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (gMunicipalCount[stateid] >= MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = -1;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gMunicipalState[i] == -1)
        {
            idx = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (idx == -1)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gMunicipalState[idx] = stateid;
    gMunicipalType[idx] = type;
    gMunicipalRevenue[idx] = revenue;
    format(gMunicipalName[idx], 32, "%s", name);
    gMunicipalCount[stateid]++;
    return true;
}

stock int:MunicipalSystem_GetServiceCount(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new total = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gMunicipalState[i] == stateid)
        {
            total++;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

stock int:MunicipalSystem_GetStateRevenue(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new total = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MUNICIPAL_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gMunicipalState[i] == stateid)
        {
            total += gMunicipalRevenue[i];
        }
    }
    return total;
}

stock MunicipalSystem_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MUNICIPAL] Ungültiger Staat.");

#if !defined STATE_LEDGER_SYSTEM_INC
#define STATE_LEDGER_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES 32
#define STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_TAX 0
#define STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_BIZ 1
#define STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_GOV 2
#define STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_JOB 3
#define STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_ADMIN 4

new gStateLedgerEntryState[MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES];
new gStateLedgerEntryType[MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES];
new gStateLedgerEntryAmount[MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES];
new gStateLedgerEntryTotal = 0;
new gStateLedgerEntryActor[MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES][32];
new gStateLedgerEntryContext[MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES][48];

stock StateLedgerSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES; i++)
    {
        gStateLedgerEntryState[i] = -1;
        gStateLedgerEntryType[i] = STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_ADMIN;
        gStateLedgerEntryAmount[i] = 0;
        format(gStateLedgerEntryActor[i], 32, "SYSTEM");
        format(gStateLedgerEntryContext[i], 48, "boot");
    }

    gStateLedgerEntryTotal = 0;

    StateLedgerSystem_LogTransaction(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_TAX, 1500, "system", "initial_state_tax");
    StateLedgerSystem_LogTransaction(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_BIZ, 1200, "system", "initial_business_fee");
    StateLedgerSystem_LogTransaction(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_GOV, 1800, "system", "initial_budget_transfer");

    print("[STATE_LEDGER] Treasury ledger initialized");
}

stock StateLedgerSystem_LogTransaction(stateid, type, amount, const actor[], const context[])
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gStateLedgerEntryTotal >= MAX_STATE_LEDGER_ENTRIES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gStateLedgerEntryTotal;
    gStateLedgerEntryState[idx] = stateid;
    gStateLedgerEntryType[idx] = type;
    gStateLedgerEntryAmount[idx] = amount;
    format(gStateLedgerEntryActor[idx], 32, "%s", actor);
    format(gStateLedgerEntryContext[idx], 48, "%s", context);
    gStateLedgerEntryTotal++;
    return true;
}

stock StateLedgerSystem_Transfer(stateid, amount, const reason[], const actor[])
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, amount))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new ledgerType = STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_GOV;
    if (amount > 0)
    {
        ledgerType = STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_BIZ;
    }
    else if (amount < 0)
    {
        ledgerType = STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_ADMIN;
    }

    return StateLedgerSystem_LogTransaction(stateid, ledgerType, amount, actor, reason);
}

stock int:StateLedgerSystem_GetEntryCount(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < gStateLedgerEntryTotal; i++)
    {
        if (gStateLedgerEntryState[i] == stateid)
        {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

stock StateLedgerSystem_ShowSummary(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[STATE_LEDGER] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    new summary[256];
    format(summary, sizeof(summary), "[STATE_LEDGER] %s | Treasury: %d | Entries: %d", stateName, StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid), StateLedgerSystem_GetEntryCount(stateid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, summary);

    for (new i = 0; i < gStateLedgerEntryTotal; i++)
    {
        if (gStateLedgerEntryState[i] != stateid)
        {
            continue;
        }

        new line[128];
        new typeName[24];
        switch (gStateLedgerEntryType[i])
        {
            case STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_TAX: format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "TAX");
            case STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_BIZ: format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "BIZ");
            case STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_GOV: format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "GOV");
            case STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_JOB: format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "JOB");
            default: format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "ADMIN");
        }

        format(line, sizeof(line), "- %s | %s | %d | %s", gStateLedgerEntryActor[i], typeName, gStateLedgerEntryAmount[i], gStateLedgerEntryContext[i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
    }
}

#endif

#if !defined AD_SYSTEM_INC

new gAdState[MAX_ADS];
new gAdBudget[MAX_ADS];
new gAdOwner[MAX_ADS];
new gAdText[MAX_ADS][64];
new gAdCount = 0;

stock AdSystem_Initialize()
{
    print("[AD] Werbenetzwerk initialisiert");
}

stock AdSystem_CreateAd(playerid, const text[], stateid, budget)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gAdCount >= MAX_ADS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (GetPlayerMoney(playerid) < budget)
    {
        return false;
    }

    GivePlayerMoney(playerid, -budget);
    gAdState[gAdCount] = stateid;
    gAdBudget[gAdCount] = budget;
    gAdOwner[gAdCount] = playerid;
    format(gAdText[gAdCount], 64, "%s", text);
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, budget);
    gAdCount++;
    return true;
}

stock AdSystem_ShowAds(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[AD] Aktive Anzeigen: %d | Staat: %d", gAdCount, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, msg);
}

#if !defined EMS_HOSPITAL_INC
#define EMS_HOSPITAL_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define HOSPITAL_STATE_NONE 0
#define HOSPITAL_STATE_ACTIVE 1

new gHospitalState[3];
new gHospitalCost[3];
new gHospitalRespawnX[3];
new gHospitalRespawnY[3];
new gHospitalRespawnZ[3];

stock EmsHospital_Initialize()
{
    gHospitalState[STATE_LOS_SANTOS] = HOSPITAL_STATE_ACTIVE;
    gHospitalState[STATE_SAN_FIERRO] = HOSPITAL_STATE_ACTIVE;
    gHospitalState[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS] = HOSPITAL_STATE_ACTIVE;

    gHospitalCost[STATE_LOS_SANTOS] = 3500;
    gHospitalCost[STATE_SAN_FIERRO] = 2900;
    gHospitalCost[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS] = 3100;

    gHospitalRespawnX[STATE_LOS_SANTOS] = 1187; gHospitalRespawnY[STATE_LOS_SANTOS] = -1323; gHospitalRespawnZ[STATE_LOS_SANTOS] = 14;
    gHospitalRespawnX[STATE_SAN_FIERRO] = -2672; gHospitalRespawnY[STATE_SAN_FIERRO] = 410; gHospitalRespawnZ[STATE_SAN_FIERRO] = 7;
    gHospitalRespawnX[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS] = 1421; gHospitalRespawnY[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS] = 1853; gHospitalRespawnZ[STATE_LAS_VENTURAS] = 13;

    print("[EMS] Staatliche Krankenhäuser und Versicherung initialisiert");
}

stock EmsHospital_TreatPlayer(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new cost = gHospitalCost[stateid];
    if (GetPlayerMoney(playerid) < cost)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[EMS] Du hast nicht genug Geld für die Behandlung.");
        return false;
    }

    GivePlayerMoney(playerid, -cost);
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, cost);
    SetPlayerPos(playerid, gHospitalRespawnX[stateid], gHospitalRespawnY[stateid], gHospitalRespawnZ[stateid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[EMS] Behandlung abgeschlossen. Du bist im Staatskrankenhaus wieder aufgewacht.");
    return true;
}

stock EmsHospital_RespawnPlayer(playerid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        stateid = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }
    SetPlayerPos(playerid, gHospitalRespawnX[stateid], gHospitalRespawnY[stateid], gHospitalRespawnZ[stateid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[EMS] Respawn im zuständigen Hospital.");
}

#if !defined MISSION_SYSTEM_INC
#define MISSION_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_MISSIONS 12
#define MISSION_TYPE_DELIVERY 1
#define MISSION_TYPE_ESCORT 2
#define MISSION_TYPE_HIJACK 3
#define MISSION_TYPE_RESCUE 4
#define MISSION_TYPE_GANG 5

new gMissionState[MAX_MISSIONS];
new gMissionType[MAX_MISSIONS];
new gMissionReward[MAX_MISSIONS];
new gMissionActive[MAX_MISSIONS];
new gMissionName[MAX_MISSIONS][24];
new gPlayerMission[MAX_PLAYERS];
new Text:gMissionTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];

stock MissionSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MISSIONS; i++)
    {
        gMissionState[i] = -1;
        gMissionType[i] = 0;
        gMissionReward[i] = 0;
        gMissionActive[i] = 0;
        format(gMissionName[i], 24, "Unbekannt");
    }

    MissionSystem_RegisterMission(0, STATE_LOS_SANTOS, MISSION_TYPE_DELIVERY, 2500, "Downtown Drop");
    MissionSystem_RegisterMission(1, STATE_LOS_SANTOS, MISSION_TYPE_ESCORT, 3800, "Highway Escort");
    MissionSystem_RegisterMission(2, STATE_SAN_FIERRO, MISSION_TYPE_RESCUE, 4200, "Harbor Rescue");
    MissionSystem_RegisterMission(3, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, MISSION_TYPE_GANG, 5500, "Casino Run");

    print("[MISSION] Missions- und Delivery-System initialisiert");
}

stock MissionSystem_RegisterMission(missionid, stateid, type, reward, const name[])
{
    if (missionid < 0 || missionid >= MAX_MISSIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gMissionState[missionid] = stateid;
    gMissionType[missionid] = type;
    gMissionReward[missionid] = reward;
    gMissionActive[missionid] = 1;
    format(gMissionName[missionid], 24, "%s", name);
    return true;
}

stock MissionSystem_AcceptMission(playerid, missionid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (missionid < 0 || missionid >= MAX_MISSIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gMissionActive[missionid] != 1)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gPlayerMission[playerid] = missionid;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[MISSION] Mission angenommen.");
    return true;
}

stock MissionSystem_CompleteMission(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (gPlayerMission[playerid] < 0 || gPlayerMission[playerid] >= MAX_MISSIONS)
    {
        return;
    }

    new reward = gMissionReward[gPlayerMission[playerid]];
    printf("[MISSION] Spieler %d hat Mission %d abgeschlossen und %d$ erhalten.", playerid, gPlayerMission[playerid], reward);
    gPlayerMission[playerid] = -1;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[MISSION] Mission abgeschlossen.");
}

stock MissionSystem_ShowMissionList(playerid)
{
    MissionSystem_HideMissionList(playerid);

    gMissionTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 30.0, "MISSION BOARD");
    TextDrawAlignment(gMissionTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gMissionTD[playerid][0], 0.55, 1.5);
    TextDrawColor(gMissionTD[playerid][0], 0x33CCFFAA);

    new lineY = 60;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MISSIONS && i < 6; i++)
    {
        if (gMissionActive[i] == 1)
        {
            new missionText[64];
            format(missionText, sizeof(missionText), "%s [%d$]", gMissionName[i], gMissionReward[i]);
            gMissionTD[playerid][1 + i] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, float(lineY), missionText);
            TextDrawAlignment(gMissionTD[playerid][1 + i], 2);
            TextDrawLetterSize(gMissionTD[playerid][1 + i], 0.22, 0.9);
            TextDrawColor(gMissionTD[playerid][1 + i], 0xFFFFFFFF);
            lineY += 18;
        }
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gMissionTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gMissionTD[playerid][i]);
        }
    }
}

stock MissionSystem_HideMissionList(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gMissionTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gMissionTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gMissionTD[playerid][i]);
            gMissionTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

stock FactoryNetwork_RegisterFactory(stateid, type, const product[], output)

stock FactoryNetwork_ShowFactories(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[FACTORY_NETWORK] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[FACTORY_NETWORK] %s | Fabriken: %d", stateName, gFactoryCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gFactoryCount; i++)
    {
        if (gFactoryState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new typeName[24];
            if (gFactoryType[i] == FACTORY_TYPE_LOGISTICS)
                format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "Logistics");
            else if (gFactoryType[i] == FACTORY_TYPE_CHEMICAL)
                format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "Chemical");
            else
                format(typeName, sizeof(typeName), "Refinery");

            new line[220];
            format(line, sizeof(line), "- %s | Type: %s | Output: $%d", gFactoryProduct[i], typeName, gFactoryOutput[i]);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
        }

#if !defined PROGRESSION_SYSTEM_INC
#define PROGRESSION_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define PROGRESSION_BASE_XP 1000

new gPlayerLevel[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPlayerXP[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPlayerRep[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock ProgressionSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gPlayerLevel[i] = 1;
        gPlayerXP[i] = 0;
        gPlayerRep[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[PROGRESSION] Levelsystem und Spielerfortschritt initialisiert");
}

stock ProgressionSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gPlayerLevel[playerid] = 1;
    gPlayerXP[playerid] = 0;
    gPlayerRep[playerid] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_LEVEL] = 1;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_XP] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_REP] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] = 2500;
    GivePlayerMoney(playerid, 2500);
}

stock ProgressionSystem_SyncBank(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }

    Core_SetPlayerBank(playerid, gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK]);
}

stock ProgressionSystem_AddXP(playerid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    gPlayerXP[playerid] += amount;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_XP] = gPlayerXP[playerid];
    while (gPlayerXP[playerid] >= PROGRESSION_BASE_XP)
    {
        gPlayerXP[playerid] -= PROGRESSION_BASE_XP;
        gPlayerLevel[playerid]++;
        gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_LEVEL] = gPlayerLevel[playerid];
    }
}

stock ProgressionSystem_AddRep(playerid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    gPlayerRep[playerid] += amount;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_REP] = gPlayerRep[playerid];
}

stock int:ProgressionSystem_GetLevel(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    return gPlayerLevel[playerid];
}

stock int:ProgressionSystem_GetXP(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gPlayerXP[playerid];
}

stock int:ProgressionSystem_GetRep(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gPlayerRep[playerid];
}

stock ProgressionSystem_ShowStats(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[PROGRESSION] Level: %d | XP: %d | Reputation: %d | Bank: %d", gPlayerLevel[playerid], gPlayerXP[playerid], gPlayerRep[playerid], Core_GetPlayerBank(playerid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x99CC00AA, msg);
}

#if !defined SHOP_SYSTEM_INC
#define SHOP_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_SHOPS 12
#define SHOP_TYPE_GUN 1
#define SHOP_TYPE_FOOD 2
#define SHOP_TYPE_GARAGE 3
#define SHOP_TYPE_DRUG 4
#define SHOP_TYPE_SERVICE 5

new gShopState[MAX_SHOPS];
new gShopType[MAX_SHOPS];
new gShopStock[MAX_SHOPS];
new gShopPrice[MAX_SHOPS];
new gShopOpen[MAX_SHOPS];
new gShopName[MAX_SHOPS][24];
new Text:gShopTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];

stock ShopSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_SHOPS; i++)
    {
        gShopState[i] = -1;
        gShopType[i] = 0;
        gShopStock[i] = 0;
        gShopPrice[i] = 0;
        gShopOpen[i] = 0;
        format(gShopName[i], 24, "Unbekannt");
    }

    ShopSystem_RegisterShop(0, STATE_LOS_SANTOS, SHOP_TYPE_GUN, "Cobra Arms", 15, 1500);
    ShopSystem_RegisterShop(1, STATE_LOS_SANTOS, SHOP_TYPE_FOOD, "Burger Spot", 30, 250);
    ShopSystem_RegisterShop(2, STATE_SAN_FIERRO, SHOP_TYPE_GARAGE, "SF Garage", 8, 8000);
    ShopSystem_RegisterShop(3, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, SHOP_TYPE_SERVICE, "LV Service", 12, 1200);

    print("[SHOP] Laden- und Shop-System initialisiert");
}

stock ShopSystem_RegisterShop(shopid, stateid, type, const name[], stockCount, price)
{
    if (shopid < 0 || shopid >= MAX_SHOPS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gShopState[shopid] = stateid;
    gShopType[shopid] = type;
    gShopStock[shopid] = stockCount;
    gShopPrice[shopid] = price;
    gShopOpen[shopid] = 1;
    format(gShopName[shopid], 24, "%s", name);
    return true;
}

stock ShopSystem_BuyItem(playerid, shopid, quantity)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (shopid < 0 || shopid >= MAX_SHOPS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gShopOpen[shopid] != 1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[SHOP] Dieses Geschäft ist derzeit geschlossen.");
        return false;
    }

    new totalCost = gShopPrice[shopid] * quantity;
    if (gShopStock[shopid] < quantity)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[SHOP] Nicht genug Lagerbestand.");
        return false;
    }

    gShopStock[shopid] -= quantity;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[SHOP] Einkauf abgeschlossen.");
    printf("[SHOP] Spieler %d kaufte %d Einheiten aus Laden %d, Kosten: %d", playerid, quantity, shopid, totalCost);
    return true;
}

stock ShopSystem_ShowShopInfo(playerid, shopid)
{
    if (shopid < 0 || shopid >= MAX_SHOPS)
    {
        return;
    }

    new msg[192];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[SHOP] %s | Staat: %d | Typ: %d | Lager: %d | Preis: %d | Status: %s", gShopName[shopid], gShopState[shopid], gShopType[shopid], gShopStock[shopid], gShopPrice[shopid], (gShopOpen[shopid] == 1) ? ("offen") : ("geschlossen"));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);
}

stock ShopSystem_ShowStateShops(playerid, stateid)
{
    ShopSystem_HideStateShops(playerid);

    gShopTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 30.0, "SHOP OVERVIEW");
    TextDrawAlignment(gShopTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gShopTD[playerid][0], 0.52, 1.5);
    TextDrawColor(gShopTD[playerid][0], 0xFFCC66AA);

    new count = 0;
    new lineY = 60;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_SHOPS && count < 6; i++)
    {
        if (gShopState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new shopText[64];
            format(shopText, sizeof(shopText), "%s [%d]", gShopName[i], gShopStock[i]);
            gShopTD[playerid][1 + count] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, float(lineY), shopText);
            TextDrawAlignment(gShopTD[playerid][1 + count], 2);
            TextDrawLetterSize(gShopTD[playerid][1 + count], 0.22, 0.9);
            TextDrawColor(gShopTD[playerid][1 + count], 0xFFFFFFFF);
            lineY += 18;
            count++;
        }
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < 7; i++)
    {
        if (gShopTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gShopTD[playerid][i]);
        }
    }
}

stock ShopSystem_HideStateShops(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gShopTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gShopTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gShopTD[playerid][i]);
            gShopTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

#endif

#if !defined WEAPON_SHOP_SYSTEM_INC
#define WEAPON_SHOP_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_WEAPON_SHOP_ITEMS 12

new gWeaponShopCount = 0;
new gWeaponShopState[MAX_WEAPON_SHOP_ITEMS];
new gWeaponShopWeapon[MAX_WEAPON_SHOP_ITEMS];
new gWeaponShopPrice[MAX_WEAPON_SHOP_ITEMS];
new gWeaponShopName[MAX_WEAPON_SHOP_ITEMS][32];

stock WeaponShopSystem_Initialize()
{
    gWeaponShopCount = 0;

    WeaponShopSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, WEAPON_COLT45, 500, "Pistole");
    WeaponShopSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, WEAPON_SHOTGUN, 1500, "Shotgun");
    WeaponShopSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, WEAPON_MP5, 2200, "MP5");
    WeaponShopSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, WEAPON_SAWEDOFF, 1700, "Sawed-Off");
    WeaponShopSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, WEAPON_DEAGLE, 2500, "Desert Eagle");
    WeaponShopSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, WEAPON_RIFLE, 3500, "Rifle");

    print("[WEAPONSHOP] Waffenladen-System initialisiert");
}

stock WeaponShopSystem_RegisterItem(stateid, weaponid, price, const name[])
{
    if (gWeaponShopCount >= MAX_WEAPON_SHOP_ITEMS)
        return false;
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
        return false;

    gWeaponShopState[gWeaponShopCount] = stateid;
    gWeaponShopWeapon[gWeaponShopCount] = weaponid;
    gWeaponShopPrice[gWeaponShopCount] = price;
    format(gWeaponShopName[gWeaponShopCount], 32, "%s", name);
    gWeaponShopCount++;
    return true;
}

stock WeaponShopSystem_ShowCatalog(playerid, stateid)
{
    new count = 0;
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[WEAPONSHOP] Waffenmarkt für Staat %d", stateid);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC00AA, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gWeaponShopCount; i++)
    {
        if (gWeaponShopState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new itemMsg[128];
            format(itemMsg, sizeof(itemMsg), "%s | %d$ | Waffe: %d", gWeaponShopName[i], gWeaponShopPrice[i], gWeaponShopWeapon[i]);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, itemMsg);
            count++;
        }
    }

    if (count == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[WEAPONSHOP] Keine Waffen im aktuellen Staat verfügbar.");
    }
}

stock WeaponShopSystem_BuyWeapon(playerid, weaponid, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return false;

    for (new i = 0; i < gWeaponShopCount; i++)
    {
        if (gWeaponShopState[i] == stateid && gWeaponShopWeapon[i] == weaponid)
        {
            if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, -gWeaponShopPrice[i]))
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[WEAPONSHOP] Nicht genug Geld auf der Bank.");
                return false;
            }

            StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, gWeaponShopPrice[i] / 5);
            GivePlayerWeapon(playerid, weaponid, 100);
            new buyMsg[96];
            format(buyMsg, sizeof(buyMsg), "[WEAPONSHOP] Kauf erfolgreich. Staatseinnahme: %d$", gWeaponShopPrice[i] / 5);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, buyMsg);
            return true;
        }
    }

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[WEAPONSHOP] Waffe im aktuellen Staat nicht verfügbar.");
    return false;
}

stock WeaponShopSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
        return false;

    new cmd[32], idx;
    idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
        return false;

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/weapons", true) == 0)
    {
        WeaponShopSystem_ShowCatalog(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/buyweapon", true) == 0)
    {
        new weaponid, stateid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]dd", cmd, weaponid, stateid) != 0)
        {
            stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
            if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", cmd, weaponid) != 0)
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[WEAPONSHOP] Syntax: /buyweapon <WeaponID> [StateID]");
                return true;
            }
        }
        WeaponShopSystem_BuyWeapon(playerid, weaponid, stateid);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#endif

#if !defined ROLEPLAY_COMMAND_SYSTEM_INC
#define ROLEPLAY_COMMAND_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

stock RoleplayCommandSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
    {
        return false;
    }

    new cmd[32], idx;
    idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/me", true) == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x99CCFFFF, "[ME] Du führst eine RP-Aktion aus.");
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/do", true) == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xCCFF99FF, "[DO] Du beschreibst die Umgebung im Spiel.");
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/pm", true) == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xD9B3FFFF, "[PM] Privatnachricht-Logik bereit.");
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/report", true) == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666FF, "[REPORT] Report verarbeitet. Bitte Details an Support/Moderator senden.");
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/gang", true) == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[GANG] Fraktions- und Gangsystem aktiv. Nutze staatliche Fraktions- und Gangwar-Interfaces.");
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/factions", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmd, "/factioninfo", true) == 0)
    {
        new stateid = Core_GetPlayerState(playerid);
        new found = 0;
        for (new i = 0; i < MAX_FACTIONS; i++)
        {
            if (gFactionIsActive[i] == 1 && gFactionState[i] == stateid)
            {
                FactionSystem_ShowInfo(playerid, i);
                found = 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!found)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666FF, "[FACTION] In deinem Staat sind aktuell keine aktiven Fraktionen oder Gangs gelistet.");
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/war", true) == 0)
    {
        GangWarSystem_ShowStatus(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/fight", true) == 0)
    {
        GangFightSystem_ShowStatus(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/job", true) == 0)
    {
        JobsCore_ShowPlayerJobInfo(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#endif

#if !defined SOCIAL_SYSTEM_INC
#define SOCIAL_SYSTEM_INC

stock SocialSystem_SendMe(playerid, const text[])
{
    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "* %s %s", GetPlayerName(playerid), text);
    SendClientMessageToAll(0xC0C0C0AA, msg);
}

stock SocialSystem_SendDo(playerid, const text[])
{
    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "* %s", text);
    SendClientMessageToAll(0xB0E0E6AA, msg);
}

stock SocialSystem_SendReport(playerid, const text[])
{
    new name[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
    GetPlayerName(playerid, name, sizeof(name));

    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[REPORT] %s: %s", name, text);
    SendClientMessageToAll(0xFFB000AA, msg);
}

stock SocialSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
        return false;

    new cmd[32], idx;
    idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
        return false;

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/me", true) == 0)
    {
        new action[64];
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]s[64]", cmd, action) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[SOCIAL] Syntax: /me <Aktivität>");
            return true;
        }
        SocialSystem_SendMe(playerid, action);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/do", true) == 0)
    {
        new action[64];
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]s[64]", cmd, action) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[SOCIAL] Syntax: /do <Beschreibung>");
            return true;
        }
        SocialSystem_SendDo(playerid, action);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/report", true) == 0)
    {
        new text[64];
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]s[64]", cmd, text) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[SOCIAL] Syntax: /report <Grund>");
            return true;
        }
        SocialSystem_SendReport(playerid, text);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/help", true) == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x33CCFFAA, "[HELP] /jobs /wanted /crime /garage /weapons /events /me /do /report /gov");
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#if !defined DISTRICT_SYSTEM_INC

}

stock DistrictSystem_RegisterDistrict(stateid, const name[], const type[], Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gDistrictCount >= MAX_DISTRICTS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gDistrictCount;
    gDistrictState[idx] = stateid;
    format(gDistrictName[idx], 32, "%s", name);
    format(gDistrictType[idx], 16, "%s", type);
    gDistrictX[idx] = x;
    gDistrictY[idx] = y;
    gDistrictZ[idx] = z;
    gDistrictCount++;
    return true;
}

stock int:DistrictSystem_GetCountForState(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < gDistrictCount; i++)
    {
        if (gDistrictState[i] == stateid)
        {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

stock DistrictSystem_ShowDistricts(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[DISTRICT] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[DISTRICT] %s | Bezirke: %d", stateName, DistrictSystem_GetCountForState(stateid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gDistrictCount; i++)
    {
        if (gDistrictState[i] != stateid)
        {
            continue;
        }

        new entry[128];
        format(entry, sizeof(entry), "- %s (%s) | %.0f %.0f %.0f", gDistrictName[i], gDistrictType[i], gDistrictX[i], gDistrictY[i], gDistrictZ[i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, entry);
    }
}

stock DistrictSystem_IsNearDistrict(playerid, stateid, Float:radius)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new Float:x, Float:y, Float:z;
    GetPlayerPos(playerid, x, y, z);

    for (new i = 0; i < gDistrictCount; i++)
    {
        if (gDistrictState[i] != stateid)
        {
            continue;
        }

        if (GetDistanceBetweenPoints3D(x, y, z, gDistrictX[i], gDistrictY[i], gDistrictZ[i]) <= radius)
        {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

stock StateIdentitySystem_RegisterStateIdentity(stateid, const name[], const shortName[], const capital[], const focus[], taxRate, treasury)

    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gStateIdentityName[stateid], 32, "%s", name);
    format(gStateIdentityShort[stateid], 8, "%s", shortName);
    format(gStateIdentityCapital[stateid], 32, "%s", capital);

    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))

    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    format(output, len, "%s | %s | Hauptstadt: %s | Fokus: %s | Steuer: %d%% | Kasse: $%d", stateName, gStateIdentityShort[stateid], gStateIdentityCapital[stateid], gStateIdentityFocus[stateid], gStateIdentityTaxRate[stateid], gStateIdentityTreasury[stateid]);

stock StateIdentitySystem_ApplyRevenue(stateid, amount)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new nextBalance = gStateIdentityTreasury[stateid] + amount;
    if (nextBalance < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gStateIdentityTreasury[stateid] = nextBalance;
    return StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, amount);
}

#if !defined STATE_SERVICES_INC

#define STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_CITY_HALL 0
#define STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_AMMU 1

stock StateServices_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_SERVICES; i++)

        gStateServiceState[i] = -1;

    StateServices_RegisterService(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Las Venturas Rathaus", STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_CITY_HALL, 1);
    StateServices_RegisterService(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Ammu Nations LV", STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_AMMU, 2);
    StateServices_RegisterService(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Las Venturas Hospital", STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_HOSPITAL, 3);

    print("[STATE_SERVICES] Staatliche Service-Infrastruktur initialisiert");

stock StateServices_GetTypeName(serviceType, output[], len)
{
    if (len <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    output[0] = '\0';

    if (serviceType == STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_CITY_HALL)
    {
        format(output, len, "City Hall");
        return;
    }
    if (serviceType == STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_AMMU)
    {
        format(output, len, "Ammu");
        return;
    }
    if (serviceType == STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_HOSPITAL)
    {
        format(output, len, "Hospital");
        return;
    }
    if (serviceType == STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_LANDMARK)
    {
        format(output, len, "Landmark");
        return;
    }
    if (serviceType == STATE_SERVICE_TYPE_GOVERNMENT)
    {
        format(output, len, "Government");
        return;
    }
    format(output, len, "Unknown");
}

stock StateServices_RegisterService(stateid, const name[], serviceType, priority)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gStateServiceState[i] == stateid && gStateServiceType[i] == serviceType)
        {
            gStateServicePriority[i] = priority;
            format(gStateServiceName[i], 32, "%s", name);
            gStateServiceOpen[i] = 1;
            return true;
        }
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gStateServiceState[i] == -1)
        {
            gStateServiceState[i] = stateid;
            gStateServiceType[i] = serviceType;
            gStateServiceOpen[i] = 1;
            gStateServicePriority[i] = priority;
            format(gStateServiceName[i], 32, "%s", name);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

stock int:StateServices_GetStateServiceCount(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gStateServiceState[i] == stateid)
        {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

stock StateServices_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[STATE_SERVICES] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    new services[256];
    format(services, sizeof(services), "[STATE_SERVICES] %s: ", stateName);

    new first = 1;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gStateServiceState[i] != stateid)
        {
            continue;
        }

        if (!first)
        {
            strcat(services, " | ");
        }
        strcat(services, gStateServiceName[i]);
        first = 0;
    }

    if (first)
    {
        strcat(services, "Keine Services registriert");
    }

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, services);
}

stock StateServices_ShowPlayerServices(playerid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    StateServices_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid);
}

    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))

        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gStateServiceState[i] == stateid && gStateServiceType[i] == serviceType)
        {
            return gStateServiceOpen[i] == 1;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock StateServices_SetServiceStatus(stateid, serviceType, bool:open)

    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))

        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_SERVICES; i++)
    {
        if (gStateServiceState[i] == stateid && gStateServiceType[i] == serviceType)
        {
            gStateServiceOpen[i] = open ? 1 : 0;
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

#if !defined STATE_SPAWN_SYSTEM_INC
#define STATE_SPAWN_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_STATE_SPAWN_POINTS 3

new gStateSpawnXByState[STATE_COUNT][MAX_STATE_SPAWN_POINTS];
new gStateSpawnYByState[STATE_COUNT][MAX_STATE_SPAWN_POINTS];
new gStateSpawnZByState[STATE_COUNT][MAX_STATE_SPAWN_POINTS];
new gStateSpawnHeadingByState[STATE_COUNT][MAX_STATE_SPAWN_POINTS];
new gStateSpawnCount[STATE_COUNT];

stock StateSpawnSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new stateid = 0; stateid < STATE_COUNT; stateid++)
    {
        gStateSpawnCount[stateid] = 0;
        for (new slot = 0; slot < MAX_STATE_SPAWN_POINTS; slot++)
        {
            gStateSpawnXByState[stateid][slot] = 0.0;
            gStateSpawnYByState[stateid][slot] = 0.0;
            gStateSpawnZByState[stateid][slot] = 0.0;
            gStateSpawnHeadingByState[stateid][slot] = 0.0;
        }
    }

    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1500.0, -1710.0, 13.0, 0.0);
    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1464.0, -1788.0, 13.0, 90.0);
    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1568.0, -1680.0, 13.0, 180.0);

    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -1930.0, 120.0, 27.0, 90.0);
    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -1938.0, 160.0, 27.0, 180.0);
    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -1885.0, 80.0, 27.0, 270.0);

    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1700.0, 1210.0, 16.0, 0.0);
    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1765.0, 1288.0, 16.0, 180.0);
    StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1630.0, 1170.0, 16.0, 90.0);

    print("[STATE_SPAWN] Staatliche Spawns für LS/SF/LV initialisiert");
}

stock StateSpawnSystem_RegisterSpawn(stateid, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, Float:heading)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gStateSpawnCount[stateid] >= MAX_STATE_SPAWN_POINTS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new slot = gStateSpawnCount[stateid];
    gStateSpawnXByState[stateid][slot] = x;
    gStateSpawnYByState[stateid][slot] = y;
    gStateSpawnZByState[stateid][slot] = z;
    gStateSpawnHeadingByState[stateid][slot] = heading;
    gStateSpawnCount[stateid]++;
    return true;
}

stock int:StateSpawnSystem_GetSpawnCount(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gStateSpawnCount[stateid];
}

stock StateSpawnSystem_Apply(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gStateSpawnCount[stateid] <= 0)
    {
        StateSystem_SpawnPlayerForState(playerid, stateid);
        return true;
    }

    new slot = gStateSpawnCount[stateid] - 1;
    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    SetPlayerPos(playerid,
        gStateSpawnXByState[stateid][slot],
        gStateSpawnYByState[stateid][slot],
        gStateSpawnZByState[stateid][slot]);
    SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid, gStateSpawnHeadingByState[stateid][slot]);
    Core_SetPlayerState(playerid, stateid);
    Core_SetPlayerHomeState(playerid, stateid);

    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[STATE] Spawn gesetzt: %s", stateName);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, msg);
    return true;
}

stock StateSpawnSystem_SetPlayerHomeSpawn(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    Core_SetPlayerHomeState(playerid, stateid);
    Core_SetPlayerState(playerid, stateid);
    return StateSpawnSystem_Apply(playerid, stateid);
}

stock StateSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return;
    }

    DB_EnsurePlayerRecord(playerid, STATE_LOS_SANTOS);
    DB_LoadPlayerState(playerid);
    new stateid = DB_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        stateid = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    Core_SetPlayerState(playerid, stateid);
    Core_SetPlayerHomeState(playerid, stateid);
    Core_SetPlayerCash(playerid, DB_GetPlayerCash(playerid));
    DB_SavePlayerState(playerid, stateid);
}

stock StateSystem_OnPlayerDisconnect(playerid, reason)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return;
    }

    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        stateid = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    Core_SetPlayerState(playerid, stateid);
    Core_SetPlayerHomeState(playerid, stateid);
    Core_SetPlayerCash(playerid, gPlayerCash[playerid]);
    DB_SavePlayerState(playerid, stateid);
}

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[STATE] Aktueller Staat:");
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, stateName);
}

    {

    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    Core_SetPlayerState(playerid, stateid);
    DB_SetPlayerState(playerid, stateid);
    return true;
}

stock StateSystem_SpawnPlayerForState(playerid, stateid)
{
    new normalizedState = StateSystem_NormalizeStateId(stateid);

    if (!Core_IsValidState(normalizedState))
    {
        return;
    }

    SetPlayerPos(playerid, gStateSpawnX[normalizedState], gStateSpawnY[normalizedState], gStateSpawnZ[normalizedState]);
    SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid, 0.0);
    Core_SetPlayerState(playerid, normalizedState);
    Core_SetPlayerHomeState(playerid, normalizedState);
}

stock int:StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid)
{
    if (stateid < 0 || stateid >= STATE_COUNT)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gStateBankCash[stateid];
}

stock StateSystem_SetTreasuryBalance(stateid, amount)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (amount < 0)
    {
        amount = 0;
    }

    gStateBankCash[stateid] = amount;
    gStateBank[stateid] = amount;
    gGovernmentBudget[stateid] = amount;

    DB_SetStateTreasury(stateid, amount);
    return true;
}

stock StateSystem_TransferToBank(stateid, amount)
{
    if (stateid < 0 || stateid >= STATE_COUNT)
    {
        return false;
    }

    return StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, amount);
}

stock int:StateSystem_AbsInt(value)
{
    return value < 0 ? -value : value;
}

stock StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, delta)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new nextBalance = gStateBankCash[stateid] + delta;
    if (nextBalance < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (delta > 0)
    {
        gStateTaxRevenue[stateid] += delta;
    }
    else if (delta < 0)
    {
        gStateInfrastructureRevenue[stateid] += (StateSystem_AbsInt(delta) / 2);
    }

    return StateSystem_SetTreasuryBalance(stateid, nextBalance);
}

stock int:StateSystem_GetTaxRate(stateid)
{
    if (stateid < 0 || stateid >= STATE_COUNT)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gStateTaxRate[stateid];
}

stock StateSystem_SetTaxRate(stateid, rate)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid) || rate < 0 || rate > 30)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gStateTaxRate[stateid] = rate;
    new stateName[32];
    new shortName[8];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    StateSystem_GetStateShortName(stateid, shortName, sizeof(shortName));
    return DB_RegisterState(stateid, stateName, shortName, gStateBankCash[stateid], rate);
}

stock int:StateSystem_GetTaxRevenue(stateid)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gStateTaxRevenue[stateid];
}

stock int:StateSystem_GetInfrastructureRevenue(stateid)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gStateInfrastructureRevenue[stateid];
}

stock StateSystem_SetLeaderName(stateid, const name[])
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    format(gStateLeaderName[stateid], 24, "%s", name);
}

stock StateSystem_GetLeaderName(stateid, output[], len)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        format(output, len, "Unbekannt");
        return;
    }
    format(output, len, "%s", gStateLeaderName[stateid]);
}

stock StateSystem_SetPolicy(stateid, const policy[])
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    format(gStatePolicy[stateid], 24, "%s", policy);
}

stock StateSystem_GetPolicy(stateid, output[], len)
{
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        format(output, len, "Unbekannt");
        return;
    }
    format(output, len, "%s", gStatePolicy[stateid]);
}

stock StateSystem_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[STATE] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    new leaderName[24];
    new policy[24];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    StateSystem_GetLeaderName(stateid, leaderName, sizeof(leaderName));
    StateSystem_GetPolicy(stateid, policy, sizeof(policy));

    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[STATE] %s | Budget: $%d | Steuer: %d%% | Leader: %s | Policy: %s | Einnahmen: $%d", stateName, StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid), StateSystem_GetTaxRate(stateid), leaderName, policy, StateSystem_GetTaxRevenue(stateid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);
}

#if !defined TAXI_SYSTEM_INC
#define TAXI_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_TAXI_STANDS 10

new gTaxiStandState[MAX_TAXI_STANDS];
new gTaxiStandName[MAX_TAXI_STANDS][32];
new gTaxiStandCount = 0;
new gPlayerTaxiState[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPlayerTaxiOnDuty[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock TaxiSystem_Initialize()
{
    gTaxiStandCount = 0;

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_TAXI_STANDS; i++)
    {
        gTaxiStandState[i] = -1;
        format(gTaxiStandName[i], 32, "");
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gPlayerTaxiState[i] = -1;
        gPlayerTaxiOnDuty[i] = 0;
    }

    TaxiSystem_RegisterStand(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Downtown Taxi");
    TaxiSystem_RegisterStand(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Harbor Taxi");
    TaxiSystem_RegisterStand(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Strip Taxi");

    print("[TAXI] Taxi-und Transportnetzwerk initialisiert");
}

stock TaxiSystem_RegisterStand(stateid, const name[])
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gTaxiStandCount >= MAX_TAXI_STANDS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gTaxiStandState[gTaxiStandCount] = stateid;
    format(gTaxiStandName[gTaxiStandCount], 32, "%s", name);
    gTaxiStandCount++;
    return true;
}

stock TaxiSystem_StartShift(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gPlayerTaxiState[playerid] = stateid;
    gPlayerTaxiOnDuty[playerid] = 1;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[TAXI] Dienst gestartet. Fahrten sind jetzt aktiv.");
    return true;
}

stock TaxiSystem_EndShift(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gPlayerTaxiState[playerid] = -1;
    gPlayerTaxiOnDuty[playerid] = 0;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[TAXI] Dienst beendet.");
    return true;
}

stock TaxiSystem_ShowNetwork(playerid)
{
    new stateName[32];
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    new message[256];
    format(message, sizeof(message), "[TAXI] %s | Stands: %d", stateName, gTaxiStandCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, message);

    for (new i = 0; i < gTaxiStandCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTaxiStandState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new line[128];
            format(line, sizeof(line), "- %s", gTaxiStandName[i]);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
        }
    }
}

#if !defined TRANSPORT_SYSTEM_INC
#define TRANSPORT_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define TRANSPORT_TYPE_NONE 0
#define TRANSPORT_TYPE_TAXI 1
#define TRANSPORT_TYPE_BUS 2
#define TRANSPORT_TYPE_TRUCK 3
#define MAX_TRANSPORT_ROUTES 12

new gTransportRouteName[3][MAX_TRANSPORT_ROUTES][32];
new gTransportRouteCount[3];
new gPlayerTransportType[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPlayerTransportRoute[MAX_PLAYERS];
new Text:gTransportTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];

stock TransportSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new stateIndex = 0; stateIndex < 3; stateIndex++)
    {
        gTransportRouteCount[stateIndex] = 0;
        for (new i = 0; i < MAX_TRANSPORT_ROUTES; i++)
        {
            format(gTransportRouteName[stateIndex][i], 32, "");
        }
    }

    TransportSystem_RegisterRoute(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Downtown Loop");
    TransportSystem_RegisterRoute(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Beach Run");
    TransportSystem_RegisterRoute(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "City Center");
    TransportSystem_RegisterRoute(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Harbor Route");
    TransportSystem_RegisterRoute(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Strip Tour");
    TransportSystem_RegisterRoute(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Airport Link");

    print("[TRANSPORT] Taxi-, Bus- und Truck-System initialisiert");
}

stock TransportSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gPlayerTransportType[playerid] = TRANSPORT_TYPE_NONE;
    gPlayerTransportRoute[playerid] = -1;
}

stock TransportSystem_RegisterRoute(stateid, const route[])
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gTransportRouteCount[stateid] >= MAX_TRANSPORT_ROUTES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gTransportRouteName[stateid][gTransportRouteCount[stateid]], 32, "%s", route);
    gTransportRouteCount[stateid]++;
    return true;
}

stock TransportSystem_StartRoute(playerid, type, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (type < TRANSPORT_TYPE_TAXI || type > TRANSPORT_TYPE_TRUCK)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gPlayerTransportType[playerid] = type;
    gPlayerTransportRoute[playerid] = stateid;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x66CCFFAA, "[TRANSPORT] Route gestartet.");
    return true;
}

stock TransportSystem_ShowRoutes(playerid)
{
    TransportSystem_HideRoutes(playerid);

    gTransportTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 30.0, "TRANSPORT ROUTES");
    TextDrawAlignment(gTransportTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gTransportTD[playerid][0], 0.52, 1.5);
    TextDrawColor(gTransportTD[playerid][0], 0x00CCFFFF);

    new stateText[64];
    format(stateText, sizeof(stateText), "Staat: %d | Typ: %d", StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid), gPlayerTransportType[playerid]);
    gTransportTD[playerid][1] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 60.0, stateText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gTransportTD[playerid][1], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gTransportTD[playerid][1], 0.22, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gTransportTD[playerid][1], 0xFFFFFFFF);

    new routeText[128];
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (stateid >= 0 && stateid < 3)
    {
        new list[128];
        for (new i = 0; i < gTransportRouteCount[stateid]; i++)
        {
            if (strlen(list) > 0)
            {
                strcat(list, " | ");
            }
            strcat(list, gTransportRouteName[stateid][i]);
        }
        format(routeText, sizeof(routeText), "Routen: %s", list);
    }
    else
    {
        format(routeText, sizeof(routeText), "Routen: Keine");
    }

    gTransportTD[playerid][2] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 84.0, routeText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gTransportTD[playerid][2], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gTransportTD[playerid][2], 0.20, 0.8);
    TextDrawColor(gTransportTD[playerid][2], 0xCCFFCCFF);

    for (new i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    {
        if (gTransportTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gTransportTD[playerid][i]);
        }
    }
}

stock TransportSystem_HideRoutes(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gTransportTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gTransportTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gTransportTD[playerid][i]);
            gTransportTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

stock RoleplayUI_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
    {
        return false;
    }

    new cmd[32];
    new idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/hud", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmd, "/dashboard", true) == 0)
    {
        RoleplayUI_ShowDashboard(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/hudhide", true) == 0)
    {
        RoleplayUI_Hide(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#define STATE_CONTROL_UI_INC

// Leitstand für das 3-Staaten-System (Los Santos, San Fierro, Las Venturas).
#define STATE_CONTROL_MAX_TAX 30
#define STATE_CONTROL_POLICY_LEN 23

new gStateControlTarget[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gStateControlTransferDir[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock StateControl_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gStateControlTarget[i] = -1;
        gStateControlTransferDir[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[STATE_CONTROL] Klickbarer State-Leitstand initialisiert");
    Core_MarkModuleReady("government");
}

stock StateControl_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gStateControlTarget[playerid] = -1;
    gStateControlTransferDir[playerid] = 0;
}

// State-Admins steuern ihren Staat, State-Leader und höher alle Staaten.
stock StateControl_CanManage(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_STATE_LEADER))
    {
        return true;
    }
    return Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_STATE_ADMIN) && Core_GetPlayerAdminState(playerid) == stateid;
}

stock StateControl_ShowMain(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_AssertLifecycleStage(CORE_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_READY))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Der Leitstand startet noch.");
        return;
    }

    new stateid = gStateControlTarget[playerid];
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
        gStateControlTarget[playerid] = stateid;
    }
    if (!StateControl_CanManage(playerid, stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Keine Berechtigung für diesen Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new title[64];
    format(title, sizeof(title), "Staats-Leitstand | %s", stateName);

    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_MAIN, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title,
        "Staat wechseln\nÜbersicht & Kasse\nSteuersatz ändern\nTreasury-Transfer\nPolitik setzen\nJob-Lohnfaktor\nBudget genehmigen\nText-Wars öffnen\nGangwar-System an/aus\nRegierungsinfo (Chat)",
        UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock StateControl_ShowPick(playerid)
{
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_PICK, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, "Staat wählen", "Los Santos\nSan Fierro\nLas Venturas", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
}

stock StateControl_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid)
{
    new stateName[32];
    new leaderName[24];
    new policy[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    StateSystem_GetLeaderName(stateid, leaderName, sizeof(leaderName));
    StateSystem_GetPolicy(stateid, policy, sizeof(policy));

    new info[512];
    format(info, sizeof(info), "Staat: %s\nLeiter: %s\nStaatskasse: $%d\nSteuersatz: %d%%\nSteuereinnahmen: $%d\nInfrastruktur: $%d\nPolitik: %s\nRegierungslevel: %d\nJob-Lohnfaktor: %d%%\nTransportarbeiter: %d",
        stateName, leaderName, StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid), StateSystem_GetTaxRate(stateid), StateSystem_GetTaxRevenue(stateid), StateSystem_GetInfrastructureRevenue(stateid),
        policy, StateGovernance_GetLevel(stateid), StateJobs_GetPayMultiplier(stateid), TransportWorkers_GetStateWorkerCount(stateid));
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_ACTION, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Übersicht & Kasse", info, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock StateControl_ShowInput(playerid, dialogid, title[], prompt[])
{
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, dialogid, DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, title, prompt, "Anwenden", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
}

stock StateControl_DoTransfer(playerid, stateid, direction, amount)
{
    if (amount <= 0 || amount > 10000000)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Ungültiger Betrag.");
        return false;
    }

    new actor[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
    GetPlayerName(playerid, actor, sizeof(actor));

    if (direction == 0)
    {
        // Einzahlung aus der eigenen Bank: keine Geldschöpfung.
        if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, -amount))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Dein Bankguthaben reicht nicht.");
            return false;
        }
        if (!StateBudgetSystem_Transfer(stateid, amount, "ui_deposit", actor))
        {
            Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, amount);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Transfer abgelehnt.");
            return false;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if (!Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_STATE_LEADER))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Auszahlungen sind State-Leadern vorbehalten.");
            return false;
        }
        if (!StateBudgetSystem_Transfer(stateid, -amount, "ui_withdraw", actor))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Die Staatskasse reicht nicht.");
            return false;
        }
        Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, amount);
    }

    new msg[96];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[STATE_CONTROL] Transfer ausgeführt. Staatskasse: $%d", StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, msg);
    return true;
}

stock StateControl_ApproveBudget(playerid, stateid, amount)
{
    new actor[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
    GetPlayerName(playerid, actor, sizeof(actor));
    return StateGovernance_ApproveBudget(stateid, amount) && StateLedgerSystem_LogTransaction(stateid, STATE_LEDGER_TYPE_GOV, amount, actor, "ui_budget_approval");
}

stock StateControl_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, const inputtext[])
{
    if (dialogid < DIALOG_UI_RANGE_STATE_FIRST || dialogid > DIALOG_UI_RANGE_STATE_LAST)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new stateid = gStateControlTarget[playerid];
    if (!StateControl_CanManage(playerid, stateid))
    {
        return true;
    }

    switch (dialogid)
    {
        case DIALOG_STATE_MAIN:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                return true;
            }
            switch (listitem)
            {
                case 0: StateControl_ShowPick(playerid);
                case 1: StateControl_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid);
                case 2: StateControl_ShowInput(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_TAX_INPUT, "Steuersatz", "Neuer Steuersatz in Prozent (0-30):");
                case 3:
                {
                    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_TRANSFER_DIR, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, "Treasury-Transfer", "Einzahlen (aus eigener Bank)\nAuszahlen (auf eigene Bank, nur Leader)", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
                }
                case 4: StateControl_ShowInput(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_POLICY_INPUT, "Staatspolitik", "Neue Politik (max. 23 Zeichen, ohne Sonderzeichen):");
                case 5: StateControl_ShowInput(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_WAGE_INPUT, "Job-Lohnfaktor", "Lohnfaktor in Prozent (50-300):");
                case 6: StateControl_ShowInput(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_BUDGET_INPUT, "Budget genehmigen", "Betrag, der aus dem Landeshaushalt der Staatskasse gutgeschrieben wird:");
                case 7: TextWars_ShowMain(playerid);
                case 8:
                {
                    GangWarSystem_Toggle();
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Gangwar-System umgeschaltet.");
                    StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
                }
                case 9: StateGovernance_ShowOverview(playerid, stateid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_PICK:
        {
            if (response && listitem >= 0 && listitem < STATE_COUNT)
            {
                if (StateControl_CanManage(playerid, listitem))
                {
                    gStateControlTarget[playerid] = listitem;
                }
                else
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Keine Berechtigung für diesen Staat.");
                }
            }
            StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_ACTION:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_TAX_INPUT:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (!StateSystem_SetTaxRate(stateid, strval(inputtext)))
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Steuersatz muss zwischen 0 und 30 liegen.");
            }
            else
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Steuersatz aktualisiert.");
            }
            StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_TRANSFER_DIR:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            gStateControlTransferDir[playerid] = listitem;
            StateControl_ShowInput(playerid, DIALOG_STATE_TRANSFER_INPUT, "Treasury-Transfer", "Betrag in Dollar:");
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_TRANSFER_INPUT:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                StateControl_DoTransfer(playerid, stateid, gStateControlTransferDir[playerid], strval(inputtext));
            }
            StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_POLICY_INPUT:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                if (strlen(inputtext) == 0 || strlen(inputtext) > STATE_CONTROL_POLICY_LEN || !UiDialog_IsSafeText(inputtext))
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Ungültige Politik-Bezeichnung.");
                }
                else
                {
                    StateGovernance_SetPolicy(stateid, inputtext);
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Politik gesetzt.");
                }
            }
            StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_WAGE_INPUT:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                if (!StateJobs_SetPayMultiplier(stateid, strval(inputtext)))
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Lohnfaktor muss zwischen 50 und 300 liegen.");
                }
                else
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Job-Lohnfaktor aktualisiert.");
                }
            }
            StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_STATE_BUDGET_INPUT:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                new amount = strval(inputtext);
                if (!Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_STATE_LEADER))
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Budgetfreigaben sind State-Leadern vorbehalten.");
                }
                else if (amount <= 0 || amount > 1000000 || !StateControl_ApproveBudget(playerid, stateid, amount))
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Betrag ungültig (1 - 1000000).");
                }
                else
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[STATE_CONTROL] Budget genehmigt.");
                }
            }
            StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

#endif

// Eingaben landen in SQL-/format-Strings, daher Sonderzeichen konsequent abweisen.
stock UiDialog_IsSafeText(const text[])
{
    for (new i = 0; text[i] != 0; i++)
    {
        if (text[i] == '%' || text[i] == '\'' || text[i] == '"' || text[i] == '\\' || text[i] == '|' || text[i] == '`' || text[i] == ';')
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
