#if !defined UI_HUB_INC
#define UI_HUB_INC

#include <a_samp>

// UI-Hub: dialoggesteuerte Oberflächen für Inventar, Handy, Business, Ammu-Nation, Mission-Board, Garage und Tuning.
// Jede Funktion ist ohne Chat-Befehl erreichbar: Taste Y oder /menu öffnen das Hauptmenü.
#define UI_AMMU_RADIUS 40.0
#define UI_MAX_PICK 24
#define UI_TUNE_COUNT 6

new gUiInvSlotMap[MAX_PLAYERS][MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS];
new gUiInvSlotCount[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gUiInvSlot[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gUiInvItem[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gUiInvGiveTarget[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gUiPick[MAX_PLAYERS][UI_MAX_PICK];
new gUiPickCount[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gUiSelected[MAX_PLAYERS];

new const gUiTuneName[UI_TUNE_COUNT][24] = {"Nitro 2x", "Nitro 5x", "Nitro 10x", "Hydraulik", "Stereo", "Wheels Shadow"};
new const gUiTuneComponent[UI_TUNE_COUNT] = {1009, 1008, 1010, 1087, 1086, 1073};
new const gUiTuneSlot[UI_TUNE_COUNT] = {5, 5, 5, VEHICLE_MOD_HYDRAULICS, 6, VEHICLE_MOD_WHEELS};
new const gUiTunePrice[UI_TUNE_COUNT] = {2000, 3500, 5000, 3500, 800, 1800};

stock UiHub_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        UiHub_OnPlayerConnect(i);
    }

    print("[UI_HUB] Dialog-First Menüsystem initialisiert");
    Core_MarkModuleReady("ui");
}

stock UiHub_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gUiInvSlotCount[playerid] = 0;
    gUiInvSlot[playerid] = -1;
    gUiInvItem[playerid] = 0;
    gUiInvGiveTarget[playerid] = INVALID_PLAYER_ID;
    gUiPickCount[playerid] = 0;
    gUiSelected[playerid] = -1;
}

stock UiHub_Ready(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_AssertLifecycleStage(CORE_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_READY))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[UI] Der Server startet noch, bitte kurz warten.");
        return false;
    }
    if (!LoginSystem_IsActive(playerid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[UI] Bitte zuerst einloggen.");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

stock UiHub_ShowMain(playerid)
{
    if (!UiHub_Ready(playerid))
    {
        return;
    }

    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_MAIN, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, "Nexus Core | Hauptmenü",
        "Inventar\nHandy\nBusiness\nAmmu-Nation\nMission-Board\nGarage\nFahrzeug-Tuning\nJob-Zentrum\nText-Wars\nStaats-Leitstand\nSpieler-Dashboard",
        UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock UiHub_ShowText(playerid, title[], text[])
{
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_NONE, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, title, text, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE, "");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Inventar

stock UiHub_GetItemName(itemid, output[], len)
{
    new bool:stackable = false;
    new maxStack = 0;
    Inventory_GetItemData(itemid, output, len, stackable, maxStack);
}

stock UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid)
{
    if (!UiHub_Ready(playerid))
    {
        return;
    }

    new list[1536];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Slot\tItem\tMenge\n");
    gUiInvSlotCount[playerid] = 0;

    for (new s = 0; s < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; s++)
    {
        if (gInventoryItem[playerid][s] == INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE || gInventoryItemQty[playerid][s] <= 0)
        {
            continue;
        }

        new name[32];
        UiHub_GetItemName(gInventoryItem[playerid][s], name, sizeof(name));
        new line[64];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%d\t%s\t%dx\n", s + 1, name, gInventoryItemQty[playerid][s]);
        strcat(list, line);
        gUiInvSlotMap[playerid][gUiInvSlotCount[playerid]++] = s;
    }

    if (gUiInvSlotCount[playerid] == 0)
    {
        UiHub_ShowText(playerid, "Inventar", "Dein Inventar ist leer.");
        return;
    }

    new title[64];
    format(title, sizeof(title), "Inventar | Freie Slots: %d", InventorySystem_GetFreeSlots(playerid));
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_INV_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, title, list, "Aktion", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock UiHub_SlotStillValid(playerid)
{
    new slot = gUiInvSlot[playerid];
    return slot >= 0 && slot < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS && gInventoryItem[playerid][slot] == gUiInvItem[playerid] && gInventoryItemQty[playerid][slot] > 0;
}

stock int:UiHub_FindHouseSafe(playerid)
{
    for (new h = 0; h < MAX_HOUSES; h++)
    {
        if (gHouseStorageOwner[h] == playerid && Core_IsValidState(gHouseStorageState[h]))
        {
            return h;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

stock UiHub_ShowInventoryAction(playerid)
{
    new name[32];
    UiHub_GetItemName(gUiInvItem[playerid], name, sizeof(name));
    new title[64];
    format(title, sizeof(title), "%s (%dx)", name, gInventoryItemQty[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]]);
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_INV_ACTION, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title,
        "Benutzen\n1 wegwerfen\nAlle wegwerfen\nAn Spieler übertragen\nIn Haussafe legen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
}

stock UiHub_InventoryUse(playerid)
{
    new result = InventorySystem_UseSlot(playerid, gUiInvSlot[playerid]);
    switch (result)
    {
        case INV_USE_OPEN_PHONE: UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
        case INV_USE_CONSUMED: SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[INV] Item benutzt.");
        case INV_USE_NO_EFFECT: SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[INV] Dieses Item hat aktuell keinen Effekt.");
        default: SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Item kann gerade nicht benutzt werden.");
    }
}

stock UiHub_InventoryDrop(playerid, bool:all)
{
    new qty = all ? gInventoryItemQty[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]] : 1;
    if (Inventory_Remove(playerid, gUiInvItem[playerid], qty))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[INV] Item weggeworfen.");
    }
}

stock UiHub_InventoryToSafe(playerid)
{
    new house = UiHub_FindHouseSafe(playerid);
    if (house == -1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Du besitzt keinen Haussafe.");
        return;
    }

    new qty = gInventoryItemQty[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]];
    new meta[32];
    format(meta, sizeof(meta), "%s", gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]]);
    if (HouseStorageSystem_StoreItem(playerid, house, gUiInvItem[playerid], qty, meta))
    {
        Inventory_Remove(playerid, gUiInvItem[playerid], qty);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[INV] Item im Haussafe eingelagert.");
    }
    else
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Haussafe voll oder nicht erreichbar.");
    }
}

stock UiHub_InventoryGive(playerid, const inputtext[], bool:askQuantity)
{
    new target = INVALID_PLAYER_ID;
    if (askQuantity)
    {
        if (sscanf(inputtext, "u", target) != 0 || target == INVALID_PLAYER_ID || target == playerid || !IsPlayerConnected(target))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Spieler nicht gefunden.");
            return;
        }

        new Float:x, Float:y, Float:z;
        GetPlayerPos(target, x, y, z);
        if (GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerid, x, y, z) > 6.0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Der Spieler ist zu weit entfernt.");
            return;
        }
        gUiInvGiveTarget[playerid] = target;

        if (gInventoryItemQty[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]] > 1)
        {
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_INV_GIVE_QTY, DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, "Menge übertragen", "Wie viele Stück übertragen?", "Senden", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
            return;
        }
        UiHub_InventoryTransfer(playerid, 1);
        return;
    }

    UiHub_InventoryTransfer(playerid, strval(inputtext));
}

stock UiHub_InventoryTransfer(playerid, quantity)
{
    new target = gUiInvGiveTarget[playerid];
    if (!IsPlayerConnected(target) || quantity <= 0 || quantity > gInventoryItemQty[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]])
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Ungültige Menge oder Ziel.");
        return;
    }

    new meta[32];
    format(meta, sizeof(meta), "%s", gInventoryItemMeta[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]]);
    if (InventorySystem_TransferItem(playerid, target, gUiInvItem[playerid], quantity, meta))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, "[INV] Item übertragen.");
        SendClientMessage(target, 0x00FF99AA, "[INV] Du hast ein Item erhalten.");
    }
    else
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Übertragung fehlgeschlagen (Inventar des Ziels voll?).");
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Handy

stock UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid)
{
    new title[48];
    format(title, sizeof(title), "Handy | Nummer %d", gPhoneNumber[playerid]);
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_PHONE_MAIN, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title,
        "Kontakte ansehen\nKontakt hinzufügen\nSMS verfassen\nNachrichten lesen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock UiHub_ShowPhoneContacts(playerid)
{
    new list[1024];
    for (new i = 0; i < gPhoneContactCount[playerid]; i++)
    {
        strcat(list, gPhoneContacts[playerid][i]);
        strcat(list, "\n");
    }
    if (gPhoneContactCount[playerid] == 0)
    {
        format(list, sizeof(list), "Keine Kontakte gespeichert.");
    }
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_PHONE_MAIN + 3, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Kontakte", list, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock UiHub_ShowPhoneMessages(playerid)
{
    new list[2048];
    for (new i = 0; i < gPhoneMessageCount[playerid]; i++)
    {
        strcat(list, gPhoneMessages[playerid][i]);
        strcat(list, "\n");
    }
    if (gPhoneMessageCount[playerid] == 0)
    {
        format(list, sizeof(list), "Keine Nachrichten.");
    }
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_PHONE_MAIN + 3, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Nachrichten", list, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Business

stock UiHub_ShowBusinessList(playerid)
{
    new list[1536];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Business\tStaat\tWert\tStatus\n");
    gUiPickCount[playerid] = 0;

    for (new b = 0; b < MAX_BUSINESSES && gUiPickCount[playerid] < UI_MAX_PICK; b++)
    {
        if (gBizActive[b] != 1 || !Core_IsValidState(gBizState[b]))
        {
            continue;
        }

        new stateShort[8];
        Core_GetStateShortName(gBizState[b], stateShort, sizeof(stateShort));
        new line[96];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s\t%s\t$%d\t%s\n", gBizName[b], stateShort, gBizValue[b], (gBizOwner[b] == -1) ? ("frei") : ((gBizOwner[b] == playerid) ? ("dein Besitz") : ("vergeben")));
        strcat(list, line);
        gUiPick[playerid][gUiPickCount[playerid]++] = b;
    }

    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_BIZ_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, "Business-Verwaltung", list, "Öffnen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock UiHub_ShowBusinessAction(playerid, bizid)
{
    new title[48];
    format(title, sizeof(title), "%s", gBizName[bizid]);
    if (gBizOwner[bizid] == -1)
    {
        ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_BIZ_ACTION, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, "Informationen\nKaufen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
    }
    else if (gBizOwner[bizid] == playerid)
    {
        ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_BIZ_ACTION, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, "Informationen\nEinkommen auszahlen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
    }
    else
    {
        ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_BIZ_ACTION, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, "Informationen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Ammu-Nation

stock UiHub_ShowAmmu(playerid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!AmmuSystem_IsNearShop(playerid, stateid, UI_AMMU_RADIUS))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[AMMU] Du musst bei einer Ammu-Nation deines Staates sein.");
        return;
    }

    new list[512];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Waffe\tPreis\n");
    gUiPickCount[playerid] = 0;

    for (new i = 0; i < gWeaponShopCount && gUiPickCount[playerid] < UI_MAX_PICK; i++)
    {
        if (gWeaponShopState[i] != stateid)
        {
            continue;
        }
        new line[64];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s\t$%d\n", gWeaponShopName[i], gWeaponShopPrice[i]);
        strcat(list, line);
        gUiPick[playerid][gUiPickCount[playerid]++] = i;
    }

    if (gUiPickCount[playerid] == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[AMMU] Keine Waffen im aktuellen Staat verfügbar.");
        return;
    }
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_AMMU_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, "Ammu-Nation", list, "Kaufen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Mission-Board

stock UiHub_ShowMissions(playerid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    new list[768];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Aufgabe\tBelohnung\n");
    gUiPickCount[playerid] = 0;

    for (new m = 0; m < gMissionBoardCount && gUiPickCount[playerid] < UI_MAX_PICK; m++)
    {
        if (gMissionBoardState[m] != stateid || gMissionBoardActive[m] != 1)
        {
            continue;
        }
        new line[80];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s\t$%d\n", gMissionBoardName[m], gMissionBoardReward[m]);
        strcat(list, line);
        gUiPick[playerid][gUiPickCount[playerid]++] = m;
    }

    if (gUiPickCount[playerid] == 0)
    {
        UiHub_ShowText(playerid, "Mission-Board", "Aktuell sind keine Aufgaben verfügbar.");
        return;
    }
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_MISSION_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, "Mission-Board", list, "Annehmen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Garage & Tuning

stock UiHub_ShowGarages(playerid)
{
    new list[512];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Garage\tStaat\tFahrzeuge\n");
    gUiPickCount[playerid] = 0;

    for (new g = 0; g < gGarageCount && gUiPickCount[playerid] < UI_MAX_PICK; g++)
    {
        new stateShort[8];
        Core_GetStateShortName(gGarageState[g], stateShort, sizeof(stateShort));
        new line[80];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s\t%s\t%d\n", gGarageName[g], stateShort, gGarageVehicleCount[g]);
        strcat(list, line);
        gUiPick[playerid][gUiPickCount[playerid]++] = g;
    }
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_GARAGE_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, "Garagen", list, "Öffnen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock UiHub_ShowTuning(playerid)
{
    new vehicleid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
    if (vehicleid == 0 || GetPlayerState(playerid) != PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[TUNING] Du musst Fahrer eines Fahrzeugs sein.");
        return;
    }

    new list[512];
    format(list, sizeof(list), "Modifikation\tPreis\n");
    for (new t = 0; t < UI_TUNE_COUNT; t++)
    {
        new line[64];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "%s\t$%d\n", gUiTuneName[t], gUiTunePrice[t]);
        strcat(list, line);
    }
    ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_TUNING_LIST, DIALOG_STYLE_TABLIST_HEADERS, "Fahrzeug-Tuning", list, "Einbauen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLOSE);
}

stock UiHub_BuyTuning(playerid, option)
{
    new vehicleid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
    if (vehicleid == 0 || GetPlayerState(playerid) != PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER || option < 0 || option >= UI_TUNE_COUNT)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[TUNING] Du musst Fahrer eines Fahrzeugs sein.");
        return;
    }
    if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, -gUiTunePrice[option]))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[TUNING] Nicht genug Geld auf der Bank.");
        return;
    }
    if (!TuningSystem_AddMod(playerid, vehicleid, gUiTuneSlot[option], gUiTuneComponent[option]))
    {
        Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, gUiTunePrice[option]);
        return;
    }
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid), gUiTunePrice[option] / 5);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Routing

stock UiHub_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, const inputtext[])
{
    if (dialogid < DIALOG_UI_RANGE_HUB_FIRST || dialogid > DIALOG_UI_RANGE_HUB_LAST)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!UiHub_Ready(playerid))
    {
        return true;
    }

    switch (dialogid)
    {
        case DIALOG_UI_MAIN:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                return true;
            }
            switch (listitem)
            {
                case 0: UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid);
                case 1: UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
                case 2: UiHub_ShowBusinessList(playerid);
                case 3: UiHub_ShowAmmu(playerid);
                case 4: UiHub_ShowMissions(playerid);
                case 5: UiHub_ShowGarages(playerid);
                case 6: UiHub_ShowTuning(playerid);
                case 7: JobCenter_ShowMain(playerid);
                case 8: TextWars_ShowMain(playerid);
                case 9: StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
                case 10: RoleplayUI_ShowDashboard(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_INV_LIST:
        {
            if (!response || listitem < 0 || listitem >= gUiInvSlotCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            gUiInvSlot[playerid] = gUiInvSlotMap[playerid][listitem];
            gUiInvItem[playerid] = gInventoryItem[playerid][gUiInvSlot[playerid]];
            UiHub_ShowInventoryAction(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_INV_ACTION:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (!UiHub_SlotStillValid(playerid))
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[INV] Der Slot hat sich geändert.");
                UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            switch (listitem)
            {
                case 0: UiHub_InventoryUse(playerid);
                case 1:
                {
                    UiHub_InventoryDrop(playerid, false);
                    UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid);
                }
                case 2:
                {
                    UiHub_InventoryDrop(playerid, true);
                    UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid);
                }
                case 3: ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_INV_GIVE_TARGET, DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, "Übertragen", "Spieler-ID oder Name (in deiner Nähe):", "Weiter", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
                case 4:
                {
                    UiHub_InventoryToSafe(playerid);
                    UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid);
                }
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_INV_GIVE_TARGET:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowInventoryAction(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (UiHub_SlotStillValid(playerid))
            {
                UiHub_InventoryGive(playerid, inputtext, true);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_INV_GIVE_QTY:
        {
            if (response && UiHub_SlotStillValid(playerid))
            {
                UiHub_InventoryGive(playerid, inputtext, false);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_PHONE_MAIN:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                return true;
            }
            switch (listitem)
            {
                case 0: UiHub_ShowPhoneContacts(playerid);
                case 1: ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_PHONE_ADD, DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, "Kontakt hinzufügen", "Name des Kontakts:", "Speichern", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
                case 2: ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_PHONE_SMS, DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, "SMS verfassen", "Nachricht (max. 63 Zeichen):", "Senden", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
                case 3: UiHub_ShowPhoneMessages(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_PHONE_MAIN + 3:
        {
            if (response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_PHONE_ADD:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (strlen(inputtext) == 0 || strlen(inputtext) > 31 || !UiDialog_IsSafeText(inputtext))
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[PHONE] Ungültiger Kontaktname.");
            }
            else
            {
                PhoneSystem_AddContact(playerid, inputtext);
            }
            UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_PHONE_SMS:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (strlen(inputtext) == 0 || strlen(inputtext) > 63 || !UiDialog_IsSafeText(inputtext))
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[PHONE] Ungültige Nachricht.");
            }
            else
            {
                PhoneSystem_SendSMS(playerid, inputtext);
            }
            UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_BIZ_LIST:
        {
            if (!response || listitem < 0 || listitem >= gUiPickCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            gUiSelected[playerid] = gUiPick[playerid][listitem];
            UiHub_ShowBusinessAction(playerid, gUiSelected[playerid]);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_BIZ_ACTION:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowBusinessList(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            new bizid = gUiSelected[playerid];
            if (listitem == 0)
            {
                BusinessSystem_ShowInfo(playerid, bizid);
            }
            else if (gBizOwner[bizid] == -1)
            {
                BusinessSystem_BuyBusiness(playerid, bizid);
            }
            else
            {
                new paid = BusinessSystem_PayoutToOwner(playerid, bizid);
                if (paid > 0)
                {
                    new msg[64];
                    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[BIZ] $%d Einkommen ausgezahlt.", paid);
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF99AA, msg);
                }
                else
                {
                    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[BIZ] Kein Einkommen zum Auszahlen.");
                }
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_AMMU_LIST:
        {
            if (!response || listitem < 0 || listitem >= gUiPickCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            gUiSelected[playerid] = gUiPick[playerid][listitem];
            new text[128];
            format(text, sizeof(text), "%s für $%d kaufen?", gWeaponShopName[gUiSelected[playerid]], gWeaponShopPrice[gUiSelected[playerid]]);
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_AMMU_CONFIRM, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Kauf bestätigen", text, "Kaufen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_AMMU_CONFIRM:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowAmmu(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
            if (AmmuSystem_IsNearShop(playerid, stateid, UI_AMMU_RADIUS) && gUiSelected[playerid] >= 0 && gWeaponShopState[gUiSelected[playerid]] == stateid)
            {
                WeaponShopSystem_BuyWeapon(playerid, gWeaponShopWeapon[gUiSelected[playerid]], stateid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_MISSION_LIST:
        {
            if (!response || listitem < 0 || listitem >= gUiPickCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            gUiSelected[playerid] = gUiPick[playerid][listitem];
            new text[128];
            format(text, sizeof(text), "Aufgabe \"%s\" annehmen? Belohnung: $%d", gMissionBoardName[gUiSelected[playerid]], gMissionBoardReward[gUiSelected[playerid]]);
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_MISSION_CONFIRM, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Mission annehmen", text, "Annehmen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_MISSION_CONFIRM:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowMissions(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            if (gUiSelected[playerid] >= 0 && gMissionBoardState[gUiSelected[playerid]] == StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid) && MissionBoard_Accept(playerid, gUiSelected[playerid]))
            {
                ProgressionSystem_AddXP(playerid, 20);
                ProgressionSystem_AddRep(playerid, 1);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_GARAGE_LIST:
        {
            if (!response || listitem < 0 || listitem >= gUiPickCount[playerid])
            {
                return true;
            }
            gUiSelected[playerid] = gUiPick[playerid][listitem];
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_GARAGE_ACTION, DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, gGarageName[gUiSelected[playerid]],
                "Zur Garage teleportieren\nAktuelles Fahrzeug einlagern\nTuning öffnen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_OK, UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_GARAGE_ACTION:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowGarages(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            switch (listitem)
            {
                case 0: GarageSystem_SpawnVehicle(playerid, gUiSelected[playerid]);
                case 1:
                {
                    new vehicleid = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
                    if (vehicleid == 0)
                    {
                        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[GARAGE] Du sitzt in keinem Fahrzeug.");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        GarageSystem_StoreVehicle(playerid, vehicleid);
                    }
                }
                case 2: UiHub_ShowTuning(playerid);
            }
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_TUNING_LIST:
        {
            if (!response || listitem < 0 || listitem >= UI_TUNE_COUNT)
            {
                return true;
            }
            gUiSelected[playerid] = listitem;
            new text[96];
            format(text, sizeof(text), "%s für $%d einbauen?", gUiTuneName[listitem], gUiTunePrice[listitem]);
            ShowPlayerDialog(playerid, DIALOG_UI_TUNING_CONFIRM, DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, "Tuning bestätigen", text, "Einbauen", UI_DIALOG_BUTTON_BACK);
        }
        case DIALOG_UI_TUNING_CONFIRM:
        {
            if (!response)
            {
                UiHub_ShowTuning(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            UiHub_BuyTuning(playerid, gUiSelected[playerid]);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

stock UiHub_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/menu", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/m", true) == 0)
    {
        UiHub_ShowMain(playerid);
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/inv", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/inventory", true) == 0)
    {
        UiHub_ShowInventory(playerid);
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/handy", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/phone", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            UiHub_ShowPhone(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/biz", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/business", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            UiHub_ShowBusinessList(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/ammu", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/weapons", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            UiHub_ShowAmmu(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/missions", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            UiHub_ShowMissions(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/garage", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            UiHub_ShowGarages(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/tuning", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            UiHub_ShowTuning(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/jobs", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/jobcenter", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            JobCenter_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/statemenu", true) == 0 || strcmp(cmdtext, "/leitstand", true) == 0)
    {
        if (UiHub_Ready(playerid))
        {
            StateControl_ShowMain(playerid);
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

#if !defined MISSION_BOARD_INC
#define MISSION_BOARD_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_MISSION_BOARD_ITEMS 20

new gMissionBoardState[MAX_MISSION_BOARD_ITEMS];
new gMissionBoardActive[MAX_MISSION_BOARD_ITEMS];
new gMissionBoardReward[MAX_MISSION_BOARD_ITEMS];
new gMissionBoardName[MAX_MISSION_BOARD_ITEMS][48];
new gMissionBoardCount = 0;

stock MissionBoard_Initialize()
{
    gMissionBoardCount = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MISSION_BOARD_ITEMS; i++)
    {
        gMissionBoardState[i] = -1;
        gMissionBoardActive[i] = 0;
        gMissionBoardReward[i] = 0;
        format(gMissionBoardName[i], 48, "");
    }

    MissionBoard_RegisterMission(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "City Sweep", 1500);
    MissionBoard_RegisterMission(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Harbor Security", 2200);
    MissionBoard_RegisterMission(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Bridge Patrol", 1800);
    MissionBoard_RegisterMission(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Casino Escort", 2600);

    print("[MISSION_BOARD] Mission Board und Aufgabenliste initialisiert");
}

stock MissionBoard_RegisterMission(stateid, const name[], reward)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gMissionBoardCount >= MAX_MISSION_BOARD_ITEMS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gMissionBoardCount;
    gMissionBoardState[idx] = stateid;
    gMissionBoardActive[idx] = 1;
    gMissionBoardReward[idx] = reward;
    format(gMissionBoardName[idx], 48, "%s", name);
    gMissionBoardCount++;
    return true;
}

stock MissionBoard_Show(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MISSION_BOARD] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[MISSION_BOARD] %s | Aufgaben: %d", stateName, gMissionBoardCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gMissionBoardCount; i++)
    {
        if (gMissionBoardState[i] == stateid && gMissionBoardActive[i] == 1)
        {
            new line[160];
            format(line, sizeof(line), "- %s | Reward: $%d", gMissionBoardName[i], gMissionBoardReward[i]);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
        }
    }
}

stock MissionBoard_Accept(playerid, missionId)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || missionId < 0 || missionId >= gMissionBoardCount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gMissionBoardActive[missionId] == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[MISSION_BOARD] Aufgabe bereits abgeschlossen.");
        return false;
    }

    if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, gMissionBoardReward[missionId]))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MISSION_BOARD] Bankfehler beim Aufgabenabschluss.");
        return false;
    }

    gMissionBoardActive[missionId] = 0;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[MISSION_BOARD] Aufgabe angenommen und abgearbeitet.");
    return true;
}

#endif

#if !defined FUEL_STATION_SYSTEM_INC
#define FUEL_STATION_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_FUEL_STATIONS 12
#define FUEL_STATION_TYPE_GAS 0
#define FUEL_STATION_TYPE_DIESEL 1

new gFuelStationState[MAX_FUEL_STATIONS];
new Float:gFuelStationX[MAX_FUEL_STATIONS];
new Float:gFuelStationY[MAX_FUEL_STATIONS];
new Float:gFuelStationZ[MAX_FUEL_STATIONS];
new gFuelStationPrice[MAX_FUEL_STATIONS];
new gFuelStationCount = 0;

stock FuelStationSystem_Initialize()
{
    DB_EnsureFuelStationSchema();
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_FUEL_STATIONS; i++)
    {
        gFuelStationState[i] = -1;
        gFuelStationPrice[i] = 10;
        gFuelStationX[i] = 0.0;
        gFuelStationY[i] = 0.0;
        gFuelStationZ[i] = 0.0;
    }

    FuelStationSystem_RegisterStation(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1500.0, -1700.0, 13.0, 12);
    FuelStationSystem_RegisterStation(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -1900.0, 120.0, 27.0, 11);
    FuelStationSystem_RegisterStation(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1705.0, 1215.0, 10.0, 13);

    print("[FUEL] Tankstellen- und Benzinpreise initialisiert");
}

stock FuelStationSystem_RegisterStation(stateid, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, price)
{
    if (gFuelStationCount >= MAX_FUEL_STATIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gFuelStationState[gFuelStationCount] = stateid;
    gFuelStationX[gFuelStationCount] = x;
    gFuelStationY[gFuelStationCount] = y;
    gFuelStationZ[gFuelStationCount] = z;
    gFuelStationPrice[gFuelStationCount] = price;
    DB_Execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fuel_stations (state_id, x, y, z, price, updated_at) VALUES (-1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0, datetime('now'))");
    gFuelStationCount++;
    return true;
}

stock int:FuelStationSystem_GetPrice(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < gFuelStationCount; i++)
    {
        if (gFuelStationState[i] == stateid)
        {
            return gFuelStationPrice[i];
        }
    }

    return 10;
}

stock FuelStationSystem_RefuelPlayer(playerid, stateid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new cost = FuelStationSystem_GetPrice(stateid) * amount;
    if (GetPlayerMoney(playerid) < cost)
    {
        return false;
    }

    GivePlayerMoney(playerid, -cost);
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, cost);
    return true;
}

#if !defined GARAGE_SYSTEM_INC
#define GARAGE_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_GARAGES 12
#define MAX_GARAGE_VEHICLES 8

new gGarageCount = 0;
new gGarageState[MAX_GARAGES];
new gGarageVehicleCount[MAX_GARAGES];
new Float:gGarageX[MAX_GARAGES];
new Float:gGarageY[MAX_GARAGES];
new Float:gGarageZ[MAX_GARAGES];
new gGarageName[MAX_GARAGES][32];
new gGarageVehicleModel[MAX_GARAGES][MAX_GARAGE_VEHICLES];
new gGarageVehiclePrice[MAX_GARAGES][MAX_GARAGE_VEHICLES];

stock GarageSystem_Initialize()
{
    gGarageCount = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_GARAGES; i++)
    {
        gGarageState[i] = -1;
        gGarageVehicleCount[i] = 0;
        gGarageX[i] = 0.0;
        gGarageY[i] = 0.0;
        gGarageZ[i] = 0.0;
        gGarageName[i][0] = 0;
        for (new j = 0; j < MAX_GARAGE_VEHICLES; j++)
        {
            gGarageVehicleModel[i][j] = 0;
            gGarageVehiclePrice[i][j] = 0;
        }
    }

    GarageSystem_RegisterGarage(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "LS City Garage", 1520.0, -1675.0, 13.0);
    GarageSystem_RegisterGarage(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "SF Depot", -1875.0, 155.0, 26.0);
    GarageSystem_RegisterGarage(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "LV Marina Garage", 1699.0, 1190.0, 10.0);

    print("[GARAGE] Garagen- und Fahrzeuglager initialisiert");
}

stock GarageSystem_RegisterGarage(stateid, const name[], Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
{
    if (gGarageCount >= MAX_GARAGES)
        return false;
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
        return false;

    gGarageState[gGarageCount] = stateid;
    format(gGarageName[gGarageCount], 32, "%s", name);
    gGarageX[gGarageCount] = x;
    gGarageY[gGarageCount] = y;
    gGarageZ[gGarageCount] = z;
    gGarageVehicleCount[gGarageCount] = 0;
    gGarageCount++;
    return true;
}

stock GarageSystem_AddVehicleToGarage(garageid, modelid, price)
{
    if (garageid < 0 || garageid >= gGarageCount)
        return false;
    if (gGarageVehicleCount[garageid] >= MAX_GARAGE_VEHICLES)
        return false;

    new idx = gGarageVehicleCount[garageid];
    gGarageVehicleModel[garageid][idx] = modelid;
    gGarageVehiclePrice[garageid][idx] = price;
    gGarageVehicleCount[garageid]++;
    return true;
}

stock GarageSystem_ShowGarageList(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[GARAGE] Verfügbare Garagen: %d", gGarageCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x33CCFFAA, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gGarageCount; i++)
    {
        new garageMsg[128];
        format(garageMsg, sizeof(garageMsg), "%s | Staat %d | Fahrzeuge: %d | Pos: %.0f %.0f %.0f", gGarageName[i], gGarageState[i], gGarageVehicleCount[i], gGarageX[i], gGarageY[i], gGarageZ[i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, garageMsg);
    }
}

stock GarageSystem_StoreVehicle(playerid, vehicleid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return;

    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[GARAGE] Fahrzeug im Staatsslot gespeichert.");
    printf("[GARAGE] Spieler %d hat Fahrzeug %d in Staat %d eingelagert.", playerid, vehicleid, stateid);
}

stock GarageSystem_SpawnVehicle(playerid, garageid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return;
    if (garageid < 0 || garageid >= gGarageCount)
        return;

    SetPlayerPos(playerid, gGarageX[garageid], gGarageY[garageid], gGarageZ[garageid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x66CCFFAA, "[GARAGE] Du wurdest zur Garage teleportiert.");
}

stock GarageSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
        return false;

    new cmd[32], idx;
    idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
        return false;

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/garage", true) == 0)
    {
        GarageSystem_ShowGarageList(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/spawngarage", true) == 0)
    {
        new garageid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", cmd, garageid) != 0)
        {
            garageid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
        }
        if (garageid < 0 || garageid >= gGarageCount)
        {
            garageid = 0;
        }
        GarageSystem_SpawnVehicle(playerid, garageid);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#endif

#if !defined TUNING_SYSTEM_INC
#define TUNING_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_VEHICLE_MODS 16
#define VEHICLE_MOD_NONE 0
#define VEHICLE_MOD_SPOILER 1
#define VEHICLE_MOD_WHEELS 2
#define VEHICLE_MOD_PAINT 3
#define VEHICLE_MOD_HYDRAULICS 4

new gVehicleMods[MAX_VEHICLES][MAX_VEHICLE_MODS];
new gVehiclePaint[MAX_VEHICLES];

stock TuningSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_VEHICLES; i++)
    {
        gVehiclePaint[i] = 0;
        for (new m = 0; m < MAX_VEHICLE_MODS; m++)
        {
            gVehicleMods[i][m] = VEHICLE_MOD_NONE;
        }
    }
    print("[TUNING] Fahrzeug-Tuning und Modifikationen initialisiert");
}

stock TuningSystem_SaveVehicleMod(vehicleid, componentid, modid, value)
{
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_VEHICLES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (componentid < 0 || componentid >= MAX_VEHICLE_MODS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gVehicleMods[vehicleid][componentid] = modid;
    gVehiclePaint[vehicleid] = value;
    DB_SaveVehicleMod(vehicleid, componentid, modid, value);
    return true;
}

stock TuningSystem_ApplyVehicleMods(vehicleid)
{
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_VEHICLES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_VEHICLE_MODS; i++)
    {
        if (gVehicleMods[vehicleid][i] != VEHICLE_MOD_NONE)
        {
            AddVehicleComponent(vehicleid, gVehicleMods[vehicleid][i]);
        }
    }

    if (gVehiclePaint[vehicleid] != 0)
    {
        ChangeVehicleColor(vehicleid, gVehiclePaint[vehicleid], gVehiclePaint[vehicleid]);
    }
    return true;
}

stock TuningSystem_AddMod(playerid, vehicleid, componentid, modid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_VEHICLES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gVehicleMods[vehicleid][componentid] = modid;
    AddVehicleComponent(vehicleid, modid);
    DB_SaveVehicleMod(vehicleid, componentid, modid, 1);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[TUNING] Modifikation auf das Fahrzeug angewendet.");
    return true;
}

stock TuningSystem_ShowInfo(playerid, vehicleid)
{
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_VEHICLES)
    {
        return;
    }

    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[TUNING] Fahrzeug %d | Paint: %d | Mods: %d", vehicleid, gVehiclePaint[vehicleid], gVehicleMods[vehicleid][0]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, msg);
}

#if !defined UBB_VEHICLE_SYSTEM_INC
#define UBB_VEHICLE_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#if !defined MAX_UBB_VEHICLES
#define MAX_UBB_VEHICLES 100
#endif
#define UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_FREE 0
#define UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_LOCKED 1
#define UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_IN_USE 2

new gUbbVehicleModel[MAX_UBB_VEHICLES];
new gUbbVehicleOwner[MAX_UBB_VEHICLES];
new gUbbVehicleState[MAX_UBB_VEHICLES];
new gUbbVehicleFuel[MAX_UBB_VEHICLES];
new gUbbVehiclePrice[MAX_UBB_VEHICLES];
new gUbbVehicleCount = 0;

stock UBBVehicleSystem_Initialize()
{
     DB_EnsureUBBVehicleSchema();
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_UBB_VEHICLES; i++)
    {
        gUbbVehicleModel[i] = 0;
        gUbbVehicleOwner[i] = -1;
        gUbbVehicleState[i] = UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_FREE;
        gUbbVehicleFuel[i] = 100;
        gUbbVehiclePrice[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[UBB_VEHICLE] Fahrzeug- und Besitzsystem für UBB/Portal-Integration initialisiert");
}

stock UBBVehicleSystem_RegisterVehicle(vehicleid, modelid, ownerid, stateid, price)
{
    if (!Core_ValidateVehicleIndex(vehicleid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (modelid <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gUbbVehicleModel[vehicleid] != 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (price < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gUbbVehicleModel[vehicleid] = modelid;
    gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid] = ownerid;
    gUbbVehicleState[vehicleid] = UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_LOCKED;
    gUbbVehicleFuel[vehicleid] = 100;
    gUbbVehiclePrice[vehicleid] = price;
    DB_SaveUBBVehicle(vehicleid, modelid, ownerid, stateid, 100, price, UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_LOCKED);
    gUbbVehicleCount++;
    return true;
}

stock UBBVehicleSystem_SetVehicleState(vehicleid, newState)
{
    if (!Core_ValidateVehicleIndex(vehicleid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gUbbVehicleModel[vehicleid] == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (newState != UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_FREE && newState != UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_LOCKED && newState != UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_IN_USE)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gUbbVehicleState[vehicleid] = newState;
    return true;
}

stock UBBVehicleSystem_LockVehicle(vehicleid)
{
    if (!Core_ValidateVehicleIndex(vehicleid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gUbbVehicleModel[vehicleid] == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gUbbVehicleState[vehicleid] = UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_LOCKED;
    if (gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid] >= 0 && gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid] < MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        DB_SaveUBBVehicle(vehicleid, gUbbVehicleModel[vehicleid], gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid], StateSystem_GetPlayerState(gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid]), gUbbVehicleFuel[vehicleid], gUbbVehiclePrice[vehicleid], UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_LOCKED);
    }
    return true;
}

stock UBBVehicleSystem_UnlockVehicle(vehicleid)
{
    if (!Core_ValidateVehicleIndex(vehicleid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gUbbVehicleModel[vehicleid] == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gUbbVehicleState[vehicleid] = UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_FREE;
    if (gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid] >= 0 && gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid] < MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        DB_SaveUBBVehicle(vehicleid, gUbbVehicleModel[vehicleid], gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid], StateSystem_GetPlayerState(gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid]), gUbbVehicleFuel[vehicleid], gUbbVehiclePrice[vehicleid], UBB_VEHICLE_STATUS_FREE);
    }
    return true;
}

stock int:UBBVehicleSystem_GetOwner(vehicleid)
{
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_UBB_VEHICLES)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid];
}

stock UBBVehicleSystem_SetOwner(vehicleid, ownerid)
{
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_UBB_VEHICLES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    gUbbVehicleOwner[vehicleid] = ownerid;
    return true;
}

stock UBBVehicleSystem_Refuel(vehicleid, amount)
{
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_UBB_VEHICLES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gUbbVehicleFuel[vehicleid] += amount;
    if (gUbbVehicleFuel[vehicleid] > 100)
    {
        gUbbVehicleFuel[vehicleid] = 100;
    }
    return true;
}

stock int:UBBVehicleSystem_GetFuel(vehicleid)
{
    if (vehicleid < 0 || vehicleid >= MAX_UBB_VEHICLES)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gUbbVehicleFuel[vehicleid];
}

stock UBBVehicleSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_ValidatePlayerSlot(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_UBB_VEHICLES; i++)
    {
        if (gUbbVehicleOwner[i] == playerid)
        {
            DB_SaveUBBVehicle(i, gUbbVehicleModel[i], playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid), gUbbVehicleFuel[i], gUbbVehiclePrice[i], gUbbVehicleState[i]);
        }
    }

    return true;
}

        gUcpTicketCount[i] = 0;

stock WebBridge_SyncAccount(playerid, const username[], const hash[])
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (strlen(username) <= 0 || strlen(hash) <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    GetPlayerName(playerid, playerName, sizeof(playerName));

    gUcpAuthState[playerid] = UCP_AUTH_SYNCED;
    new query[256];
    format(query, sizeof(query), "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO web_account_sync (player_name, ucp_username, password_hash, synced_at) VALUES ('%s', '%s', '%s', datetime('now'))", playerName, username, hash);
    DB_Execute(query);
    return true;
}

#define TRANSPORT_ROLE_LOGISTICS 3

new gTransportWorkerState[MAX_TRANSPORT_WORKERS];
new gTransportWorkerPlayer[MAX_TRANSPORT_WORKERS];
new gTransportWorkerRole[MAX_TRANSPORT_WORKERS];
new gTransportWorkerActive[MAX_TRANSPORT_WORKERS];
new gTransportWorkerCount = 0;

stock TransportWorkers_Initialize()
{
    gTransportWorkerCount = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_TRANSPORT_WORKERS; i++)
    {
        gTransportWorkerState[i] = -1;
        gTransportWorkerPlayer[i] = -1;
        gTransportWorkerRole[i] = 0;
        gTransportWorkerActive[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[TRANSPORT_WORKERS] Transport-Arbeiter und Logistiknetzwerk initialisiert");
}

stock TransportWorkers_RegisterWorker(playerid, stateid, role)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !Core_IsValidState(stateid) || role < TRANSPORT_ROLE_DRIVER || role > TRANSPORT_ROLE_LOGISTICS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    // Bestehenden Eintrag aktualisieren oder freien Slot wiederverwenden, damit Slots nicht auslaufen.
    new idx = -1;
    for (new i = 0; i < gTransportWorkerCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTransportWorkerPlayer[i] == playerid)
        {
            idx = i;
            break;
        }
        if (idx == -1 && gTransportWorkerActive[i] == 0)
        {
            idx = i;
        }
    }

    if (idx == -1)
    {
        if (gTransportWorkerCount >= MAX_TRANSPORT_WORKERS)
        {
            return false;
        }
        idx = gTransportWorkerCount++;
    }

    gTransportWorkerPlayer[idx] = playerid;
    gTransportWorkerState[idx] = stateid;
    gTransportWorkerRole[idx] = role;
    gTransportWorkerActive[idx] = 1;
    return true;
}

stock TransportWorkers_UnregisterWorker(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < gTransportWorkerCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTransportWorkerPlayer[i] == playerid)
        {
            gTransportWorkerActive[i] = 0;
            gTransportWorkerPlayer[i] = -1;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock int:TransportWorkers_GetStateWorkerCount(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < gTransportWorkerCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTransportWorkerState[i] == stateid && gTransportWorkerActive[i] == 1)
        {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

stock TransportWorkers_ShowWorkers(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[TRANSPORT_WORKERS] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new message[256];
    format(message, sizeof(message), "[TRANSPORT_WORKERS] %s | Fahrer: %d", stateName, TransportWorkers_GetStateWorkerCount(stateid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, message);

    for (new i = 0; i < gTransportWorkerCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTransportWorkerState[i] == stateid && gTransportWorkerActive[i] == 1)
        {
            new roleName[24];
            if (gTransportWorkerRole[i] == TRANSPORT_ROLE_DRIVER)
                format(roleName, sizeof(roleName), "Driver");
            else if (gTransportWorkerRole[i] == TRANSPORT_ROLE_COURIER)
                format(roleName, sizeof(roleName), "Courier");
            else
                format(roleName, sizeof(roleName), "Logistics");

            new line[128];
            format(line, sizeof(line), "- Player: %d | Rolle: %s", gTransportWorkerPlayer[i], roleName);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
        }
    }
}

new gLandmarkState[MAX_LANDMARKS];

new Float:gLandmarkZ[MAX_LANDMARKS];

stock LandmarksSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_LANDMARKS; i++)
    {
        gLandmarkState[i] = -1;
        gLandmarkX[i] = 0.0;
        gLandmarkY[i] = 0.0;
        gLandmarkZ[i] = 0.0;
        format(gLandmarkType[i], 24, "unknown");
        format(gLandmarkName[i], 48, "Landmark");
    }

    LandmarksSystem_RegisterLandmark(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Alhambra", "landmark", 1194.0, 1024.0, 10.0);
    LandmarksSystem_RegisterLandmark(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Vinewood Sign", "landmark", 1339.0, 1030.0, 12.0);
    LandmarksSystem_RegisterLandmark(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "San Fierro Airport", "airport", -1318.0, -123.0, 14.0);
    LandmarksSystem_RegisterLandmark(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Bayside Marina", "harbor", -1903.0, 157.0, 12.0);
    LandmarksSystem_RegisterLandmark(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Las Venturas Strip", "casino", 2034.0, 1118.0, 10.0);
    LandmarksSystem_RegisterLandmark(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Alhambra", "landmark", 1968.0, 1207.0, 11.0);

    print("[LANDMARKS] Stadtmarken und Landmarken initialisiert");
}

stock LandmarksSystem_RegisterLandmark(stateid, const name[], const type[], Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_LANDMARKS; i++)
    {
        if (gLandmarkState[i] == -1)
        {
            gLandmarkState[i] = stateid;
            format(gLandmarkName[i], 48, "%s", name);
            format(gLandmarkType[i], 24, "%s", type);
            gLandmarkX[i] = x;
            gLandmarkY[i] = y;
            gLandmarkZ[i] = z;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock LandmarksSystem_GetNearestLandmark(playerid, stateid, landmarkName[], landmarkNameLen, Float:radius)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new Float:px, Float:py, Float:pz;
    GetPlayerPos(playerid, px, py, pz);

    new closestIndex = -1;
    new Float:closestDistance = radius + 1.0;

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_LANDMARKS; i++)
    {
        if (gLandmarkState[i] != stateid)
        {
            continue;
        }

        new Float:dist = GetDistanceBetweenPoints3D(px, py, pz, gLandmarkX[i], gLandmarkY[i], gLandmarkZ[i]);
        if (dist < closestDistance)
        {
            closestIndex = i;
            closestDistance = dist;
        }
    }

    if (closestIndex == -1)
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(landmarkName, landmarkNameLen, "%s", gLandmarkName[closestIndex]);
    return true;
}

stock LandmarksSystem_NotifyNearbyLandmarks(playerid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }

    new landmarkName[48];
    if (LandmarksSystem_GetNearestLandmark(playerid, stateid, landmarkName, sizeof(landmarkName), 30.0))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xD6D6D6AA, "[LANDMARK] In deiner Nähe: %s", landmarkName);
    }
}

#endif

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/include/MD5.inc

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
					===========================
					Y Sever Includes - MD5 Core
					===========================
Description:
	Provides an implementation of the MD5 hashing algorithmfor PAWN, either for
	efficient and progressive hashing of chunks of data or just a straight hash
	of a single string.
Legal:
	The algorithm is due to Ron Rivest.  This code was
	written by Colin Plumb in 1993, no copyright is claimed.
	This code is in the public domain; do with it what you wish.
	
	Equivalent code is available from RSA Data Security, Inc.
	This code has been tested against that, and is equivalent,
	except that you don't need to include two pages of legalese
	with every copy.
	
	Converted to PAWN by Alex "Y_Less" Cole.
Version:
	0.1
Changelog:
	26/12/07:
		First version.
Functions:
	Public:
		-
	Core:
		-
	Stock:
		MD5_Hash - Takes a string and returns a 16 cell hash.
		MD5_Init - Initialises a hash structure.
		MD5_Update - Appends data to the hash in progress.
		MD5_Copy - Custom pack function.
		MD5_Final - Finalises a hash.
		MD5_File - Hashes a file incrementally.
		MD5_Data - Hashes binary data, not just strings.
	Static:
		MD5_Transform - Does the data mixing.
	Inline:
		MD5_Step - Does a single hash step.
	API:
		-
Callbacks:
	-
Definitions:
	-
Enums:
	E_MD5_CONTEXT - Data structure for an in progress hashing.
Macros:
	MD5_F1 - First hash part.
	MD5_F2 - Second hash part.
	MD5_F3 - Third hash part.
	MD5_F4 - Fourth hash part.
Tags:
	-
Variables:
	Global:
		-
	Static:
		-
Commands:
	-
Compile options:
	-
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

enum E_MD5_CONTEXT
{
	E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF[4],
	E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS[2],
	E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN[64 char]
}

#define MD5_F1(%1,%2,%3) (%3 ^ (%1 & (%2 ^ %3)))
#define MD5_F2(%1,%2,%3) MD5_F1(%3, %1, %2)
#define MD5_F3(%1,%2,%3) (%1 ^ %2 ^ %3)
#define MD5_F4(%1,%2,%3) (%2 ^ (%1 | ~%3))

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Hash
Params:
	str[] - String to hash.
	lowercase - Returns a lowercase hash if true
Return:
	String representation of the hash.
Notes:
	The simplest way to hash a string, simply pass a string and get a 4 cell
	hash returned.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

stock MD5_Hash(str[], bool:lowercase = false)
{
	new
		md5Data[E_MD5_CONTEXT],
		done,
		digest[33],
		len = strlen(str);
	MD5_Init(md5Data);
	len -= 64;
	while (done < len)
	{
		MD5_Update(md5Data, str[done], 64);
		done += 64;
	}
	len = (len + 64) - done;
	if (len)
	{
		MD5_Update(md5Data, str[done], len);
	}
	digest = MD5_Final(md5Data, true);

	if (lowercase)
	{
		new i, j;
		
		while ((j = digest[i]))
			digest[i++] = tolower(j);
			
		digest[i] = '\0';
	}

	return digest;
}

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Data
Params:
	data[] - Binary data to hash.
	len - Length of data to hash.
Return:
	String representation of the hash.
Notes:
	Hashes binary data, not just strings.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

stock MD5_Data(data[], len)
{
	new
		md5Data[E_MD5_CONTEXT],
		done,
		digest[33];
	MD5_Init(md5Data);
	len -= 64;
	while (done < len)
	{
		MD5_Update(md5Data, data[done], 64);
		done += 64;
	}
	len = (len + 64) - done;
	if (len)
	{
		MD5_Update(md5Data, data[done], len);
	}
	digest = MD5_Final(md5Data, true);
	return digest;
}

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_File
Params:
	filename[] - File to hash.
Return:
	-
Notes:
	Hashes the file incrementally, not in one huge chunk.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

stock MD5_File(filename[])
{
	
	new
		digest[33],
		File:fHnd = fopen(filename, io_read);
	if (fHnd)
	{
		new
			md5Data[E_MD5_CONTEXT],
			data[64],
			len;
		MD5_Init(md5Data);
		MD5_File_loop:
		len = fblockread(fHnd, data);
		if (len)
		{
			MD5_Update(md5Data, data, len);
			goto MD5_File_loop;
		}
		digest = MD5_Final(md5Data, true);
		fclose(fHnd);
	}
	return digest;
}

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Init
Params:
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT] - Hash data.
Return:
	-
Notes:
	Sets up the data for hashing.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

stock MD5_Init(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT])
{
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF][0] = 0x67452301;
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF][1] = 0xEFCDAB89;
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF][2] = 0x98BADCFE;
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF][3] = 0x10325476;
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][0] = 0;
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][1] = 0;
}

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Update
Params:
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT] - Hash data.
	data[] - String to append.
	len - Length of string to append.
Return:
	-
Notes:
	Adds data to the current hash.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

stock MD5_Update(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT], data[], len)
{
	new
		t = ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][0],
		s,
		buf = 0;
	if ((ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][0] = t + (len << 3)) < t)
	{
		ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][1]++;
	}
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][1] += len >>> 29;
	t = (t >>> 3) & 0x3F;
	if (t)
	{
		s = 64 - t;
		if (len < s)
		{
			MD5_Copy(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN], data, t, len);
			return;
		}
		MD5_Copy(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN], data, t, s);
		MD5_Transform(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF], ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN]);
		buf += s;
		len -= s;
	}
	while (len >= 64)
	{
		MD5_Copy(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN], data[buf], 0, 64);
		MD5_Transform(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF], ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN]);
		buf += 64;
		len -= 64;
	}
	MD5_Copy(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN], data[buf], 0, len);
}

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Copy
Params:
	dest[] - Packed destination array.
	src[] - Unpacked source array.
	start - Start BYTE in the dest array.
	len - Length of data to copy.
Return:
	-
Notes:
	Custom strpack implementation allowing offset starts.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

stock MD5_Copy(dest[], src[], start, len)
{
	new
		i = start >>> 2,
		j = 0,
		ch;
	while (j < len)
	{
		ch = src[j++] & 0xFF;
		switch (start++ & 0x03)
		{
			case 0:
			{
				dest[i] = ch;
			}
			case 1:
			{
				dest[i] |= ch << 8;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				dest[i] |= ch << 16;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				dest[i++] |= ch << 24;
			}
		}
	}
}

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Final
Params:
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT] - Hash data.
	string - Wehter or not to create a string version of the hash.
Return:
	-
Notes:
	Terminates the pending data, appends the length and finishes hashing.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

stock MD5_Final(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT], string = false)
{
	new
		count,
		index,
		digest[33];
	count = (ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][0] >>> 3) & 0x3F;
	if (!(count & 0x03))
	{
		ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN][count / 4] = 0;
	}
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN][count / 4] |= (0x80 << (8 * (count & 0x03)));
	index = (count / 4) + 1;
	count = 64 - 1 - count;
	if (count < 8)
	{
		while (index < 64 char)
		{
			ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN][index++] = 0;
		}
		MD5_Transform(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF], ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN]);
		index = 0;
		while (index < 56 char)
		{
			ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN][index++] = 0;
		}
	}
	else
	{
		while (index < 56 char)
		{
			ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN][index++] = 0;
		}
	}
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN][14] = ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][0];
	ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN][15] = ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BITS][1];
	MD5_Transform(ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF], ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_IN]);
	if (string)
	{
		index = 0;
		do
		{
			format(digest, sizeof (digest), "%s%02x", digest, (ctx[E_MD5_CONTEXT_BUF][index / 4] >> ((index & 0x03) * 8)) & 0xFF);
		}
		while (++index < 16);
	}
	return digest;
}

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Step
Params:
	func - Hash function to use.
	a - Data cell 1.
	b - Data cell 2.
	c - Data cell 3.
	d - Data cell 4.
	data - New input.
	s - Seed.
Return:
	-
Notes:
	Does a single hash step.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

#define MD5_Step(%1,%2,%3,%4,%5,%6,%7) \
	%2 += %1(%3, %4, %5) + %6, %2 = %2 << %7 | %2 >>> (32 - %7), %2 += %3

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*-
Function:
	MD5_Transform
Params:
	buf[] - Current hash.
	in[] - New data.
Return:
	-
Notes:
	Does the hashing steps on the current data.
-*----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

static stock MD5_Transform(buf[], in[])
{
	new
		a = buf[0],
		b = buf[1],
		c = buf[2],
		d = buf[3];
	#pragma tabsize 4
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, a, b, c, d, in[0]  + 0xD76AA478, 7);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, d, a, b, c, in[1]  + 0xE8C7B756, 12);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, c, d, a, b, in[2]  + 0x242070DB, 17);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, b, c, d, a, in[3]  + 0xC1BDCEEE, 22);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, a, b, c, d, in[4]  + 0xF57C0FAF, 7);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, d, a, b, c, in[5]  + 0x4787C62A, 12);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, c, d, a, b, in[6]  + 0xA8304613, 17);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, b, c, d, a, in[7]  + 0xFD469501, 22);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, a, b, c, d, in[8]  + 0x698098D8, 7);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, d, a, b, c, in[9]  + 0x8B44F7AF, 12);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, c, d, a, b, in[10] + 0xFFFF5BB1, 17);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, b, c, d, a, in[11] + 0x895CD7BE, 22);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, a, b, c, d, in[12] + 0x6B901122, 7);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, d, a, b, c, in[13] + 0xFD987193, 12);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, c, d, a, b, in[14] + 0xA679438E, 17);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F1, b, c, d, a, in[15] + 0x49B40821, 22);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, a, b, c, d, in[1]  + 0xF61E2562, 5);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, d, a, b, c, in[6]  + 0xC040B340, 9);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, c, d, a, b, in[11] + 0x265E5A51, 14);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, b, c, d, a, in[0]  + 0xE9B6C7AA, 20);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, a, b, c, d, in[5]  + 0xD62F105D, 5);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, d, a, b, c, in[10] + 0x02441453, 9);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, c, d, a, b, in[15] + 0xD8A1E681, 14);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, b, c, d, a, in[4]  + 0xE7D3FBC8, 20);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, a, b, c, d, in[9]  + 0x21E1CDE6, 5);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, d, a, b, c, in[14] + 0xC33707D6, 9);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, c, d, a, b, in[3]  + 0xF4D50D87, 14);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, b, c, d, a, in[8]  + 0x455A14ED, 20);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, a, b, c, d, in[13] + 0xA9E3E905, 5);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, d, a, b, c, in[2]  + 0xFCEFA3F8, 9);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, c, d, a, b, in[7]  + 0x676F02D9, 14);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F2, b, c, d, a, in[12] + 0x8D2A4C8A, 20);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, a, b, c, d, in[5]  + 0xFFFA3942, 4);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, d, a, b, c, in[8]  + 0x8771F681, 11);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, c, d, a, b, in[11] + 0x6D9D6122, 16);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, b, c, d, a, in[14] + 0xFDE5380C, 23);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, a, b, c, d, in[1]  + 0xA4BEEA44, 4);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, d, a, b, c, in[4]  + 0x4BDECFA9, 11);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, c, d, a, b, in[7]  + 0xF6BB4B60, 16);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, b, c, d, a, in[10] + 0xBEBFBC70, 23);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, a, b, c, d, in[13] + 0x289B7EC6, 4);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, d, a, b, c, in[0]  + 0xEAA127FA, 11);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, c, d, a, b, in[3]  + 0xD4EF3085, 16);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, b, c, d, a, in[6]  + 0x04881D05, 23);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, a, b, c, d, in[9]  + 0xD9D4D039, 4);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, d, a, b, c, in[12] + 0xE6DB99E5, 11);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, c, d, a, b, in[15] + 0x1FA27CF8, 16);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F3, b, c, d, a, in[2]  + 0xC4AC5665, 23);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, a, b, c, d, in[0]  + 0xF4292244, 6);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, d, a, b, c, in[7]  + 0x432AFF97, 10);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, c, d, a, b, in[14] + 0xAB9423A7, 15);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, b, c, d, a, in[5]  + 0xFC93A039, 21);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, a, b, c, d, in[12] + 0x655B59C3, 6);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, d, a, b, c, in[3]  + 0x8F0CCC92, 10);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, c, d, a, b, in[10] + 0xFFEFF47D, 15);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, b, c, d, a, in[1]  + 0x85845DD1, 21);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, a, b, c, d, in[8]  + 0x6FA87E4F, 6);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, d, a, b, c, in[15] + 0xFE2CE6E0, 10);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, c, d, a, b, in[6]  + 0xA3014314, 15);
	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, b, c, d, a, in[13] + 0x4E0811A1, 21);

	MD5_Step(MD5_F4, b, c, d, a, in[9]  + 0xEB86D391, 21);
	#pragma tabsize 4
	buf[0] += a;
	buf[1] += b;
	buf[2] += c;
	buf[3] += d;
}

	Function: file_copy(file[], destination[]);
	Description: Copies a specified file to the specified destination.

			file[] - The name of the file to be copied.

	Returns: True if success, false if not.
*/

/* Float arithmetic
 *
 * (c) Copyright 1999, Artran, Inc.
 * Written by Greg Garner (gmg@artran.com)
 * Modified in March 2001 to include user defined
 * operators for the floating point functions.
 *
 * This file is provided as is (no warranties).
 */
#if defined _Float_included
  #endinput
#endif
#define _Float_included
#pragma library Float

/* Different methods of rounding */
enum floatround_method {
  floatround_round,
  floatround_floor,
  floatround_ceil,
  floatround_tozero,
  floatround_unbiased
}
enum anglemode {
  radian,
  degrees,
  grades
}

/**************************************************/
/* Convert an integer into a floating point value */
native Float:float(value);

/**************************************************/
/* Convert a string into a floating point value */
native Float:floatstr(const string[]);

/**************************************************/
/* Multiple two floats together */
native Float:floatmul(Float:oper1, Float:oper2);

/**************************************************/
/* Divide the dividend float by the divisor float */
native Float:floatdiv(Float:dividend, Float:divisor);

/**************************************************/
/* Add two floats together */
native Float:floatadd(Float:oper1, Float:oper2);

/**************************************************/
/* Subtract oper2 float from oper1 float */
native Float:floatsub(Float:oper1, Float:oper2);

/**************************************************/
/* Return the fractional part of a float */
native Float:floatfract(Float:value);

/**************************************************/
/* Round a float into a integer value */
native floatround(Float:value, floatround_method:method=floatround_round);

/**************************************************/
/* Compare two integers. If the two elements are equal, return 0.
   If the first argument is greater than the second argument, return 1,
   If the first argument is less than the second argument, return -1. */
native floatcmp(Float:oper1, Float:oper2);

/**************************************************/
/* Return the square root of the input value, same as floatpower(value, 0.5) */
native Float:floatsqroot(Float:value);

/**************************************************/
/* Return the value raised to the power of the exponent */
native Float:floatpower(Float:value, Float:exponent);

/**************************************************/
/* Return the logarithm */
native Float:floatlog(Float:value, Float:base=10.0);

/**************************************************/
/* Return the sine, cosine or tangent. The input angle may be in radian,
   degrees or grades. */
native Float:floatsin(Float:value, anglemode:mode=radian);
native Float:floatcos(Float:value, anglemode:mode=radian);
native Float:floattan(Float:value, anglemode:mode=radian);

/**************************************************/
/* Return the absolute value */
native Float:floatabs(Float:value);


/**************************************************/
#pragma rational Float

/* user defined operators */
native Float:operator*(Float:oper1, Float:oper2) = floatmul;
native Float:operator/(Float:oper1, Float:oper2) = floatdiv;
native Float:operator+(Float:oper1, Float:oper2) = floatadd;
native Float:operator-(Float:oper1, Float:oper2) = floatsub;
native Float:operator=(oper) = float;

stock Float:operator++(Float:oper)
    return oper+1.0;

stock Float:operator--(Float:oper)
    return oper-1.0;

stock Float:operator-(Float:oper)
    return oper^Float:cellmin;                  /* IEEE values are sign/magnitude */

stock Float:operator*(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatmul(oper1, float(oper2));       /* "*" is commutative */

stock Float:operator/(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatdiv(oper1, float(oper2));

stock Float:operator/(oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatdiv(float(oper1), oper2);

stock Float:operator+(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatadd(oper1, float(oper2));       /* "+" is commutative */

stock Float:operator-(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatsub(oper1, float(oper2));

stock Float:operator-(oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatsub(float(oper1), oper2);

stock bool:operator==(Float:oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, oper2) == 0;

stock bool:operator==(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, float(oper2)) == 0;  /* "==" is commutative */

stock bool:operator!=(Float:oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, oper2) != 0;

stock bool:operator!=(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, float(oper2)) != 0;  /* "!=" is commutative */

stock bool:operator>(Float:oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, oper2) > 0;

stock bool:operator>(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, float(oper2)) > 0;

stock bool:operator>(oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(float(oper1), oper2) > 0;

stock bool:operator>=(Float:oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, oper2) >= 0;

stock bool:operator>=(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, float(oper2)) >= 0;

stock bool:operator>=(oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(float(oper1), oper2) >= 0;

stock bool:operator<(Float:oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, oper2) < 0;

stock bool:operator<(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, float(oper2)) < 0;

stock bool:operator<(oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(float(oper1), oper2) < 0;

stock bool:operator<=(Float:oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, oper2) <= 0;

stock bool:operator<=(Float:oper1, oper2)
    return floatcmp(oper1, float(oper2)) <= 0;

stock bool:operator<=(oper1, Float:oper2)
    return floatcmp(float(oper1), oper2) <= 0;

stock bool:operator!(Float:oper)
    return (_:oper & cellmax) == 0;

/* forbidden operations */
forward operator%(Float:oper1, Float:oper2);
forward operator%(Float:oper1, oper2);
forward operator%(oper1, Float:oper2);



================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/include/formatnumber.inc
================================================================================

/*
	FormatNumber by Slice.
	-------------------------
	Usage:
		FormatNumber( number, decimals, thousand seperator, decimal point )
		
		number - This can be any variable type (float, integer, bool, etc.)
			If you want the value to be printed as HEX, tag the variable with hex. Example:
				new myvariable = 5312851;
				
				FormatNumber( hex:myvariable ); // gives 0x00511153
				
				Additionaly, you can print out the bits of either the first byte or the whole cell by using the following tags: bit:, bit_byte:
			
			If you get a type error, tag the variable with _. Example:
				new omgomg:specialVariable = omgomg:5;
				
				FormatNumber( _:specialVariable ); // gives 5
		
		decimals - The number of decimals to show
			new mynumber = 50;
			
			FormatNumber( mynumber, 2 ); // gives 50.00
			
			new Float:myfloat = 123.456;
			
			FormatNumber( myfloat, 0 ); // gives 123
		
		thousand seperator - char between thousands
			new mynumber = 5000000000;
			
			FormatNumber( myfloat ); // gives 5 000 000 000
			FormatNumber( myfloat, 0, ',' ); // gives 5,000,000,000
			FormatNumber( myfloat, 0, 0 ); // gives 5000000000
		
		decimal point - duh
			new myfloat = 50.0;
			
			FormatNumber( myfloat, 2, ' ', ',' ); // gives 50,00
			FormatNumber( myfloat, 2, ' ', '~' ); // gives 50~00
		
		You can set these constants __before__ including this file:
		
		HEX_PREFIX - default value "0x". Example:
			#define HEX_PREFIX "#"
			
			#include <formatnumber.inc>
			
			FormatNumber( hex:50000 ); // gives #0000C350
		
		BIT_PREFIX - default value: "0b"
		
		DEFAULT_DECIMAL_COUNT - default value: 8
		
		DEFAULT_THOUSAND_SEP - default value: ' '
		
		DEFAULT_DECIMAL_POINT - default value: '.'
*/

#if defined _formatnumber_included
	#endinput
#else
	#define _formatnumber_included
#endif

#if !defined HEX_PREFIX
	#define HEX_PREFIX  "0x"
#endif

#if !defined BIT_PREFIX
	#define BIT_PREFIX  "0b"
#endif

#if !defined DEFAULT_DECIMAL_COUNT
	#define DEFAULT_DECIMAL_COUNT  8
#endif

#if !defined DEFAULT_THOUSAND_SEP
	#define DEFAULT_THOUSAND_SEP  '.'
#endif

#if !defined DEFAULT_DECIMAL_POINT
	#define DEFAULT_DECIMAL_POINT  ','
#endif

stock FormatNumber( { _, Float, Text3D, Menu, Text, DB, DBResult, bool, File, hex, bit, bit_byte, Bit }:xVariable, iDecimals = -1, iThousandSeparator = DEFAULT_THOUSAND_SEP, iDecimalPoint = DEFAULT_DECIMAL_POINT, iTag = tagof( xVariable ) )
{
	static
		s_szReturn[ 32 ],
		s_szThousandSeparator[ 2 ] = { ' ', EOS },
		s_iDecimalPos,
		s_iChar,
		s_iSepPos
	;
	
	if ( iTag == tagof( bool: ) )
	{
		if ( xVariable )
			memcpy( s_szReturn, "true", 0, 5 * ( cellbits / 8 ) );
		else
			memcpy( s_szReturn, "false", 0, 6 * ( cellbits / 8 ) );
		
		return s_szReturn;
	}
	else if ( iTag == tagof( Float: ) )
	{
		if ( iDecimals == -1 )
			iDecimals = DEFAULT_DECIMAL_COUNT;
		
		format( s_szReturn, sizeof( s_szReturn ), "%.*f", iDecimals, xVariable );
	}
	else if ( iTag == tagof( hex: ) || iTag == tagof( Hex: ) )
	{
		format( s_szReturn, sizeof( s_szReturn ), HEX_PREFIX "%04h%04h", ( xVariable & ( 0xFFFF0000 ) ) >>> 16, xVariable & ( 0x0000FFFF ) );
		
		return s_szReturn;
	}
	else if ( iTag == tagof( bit: ) || iTag == tagof( Bit: ) )
	{
		format( s_szReturn, sizeof( s_szReturn ), BIT_PREFIX "%08b%08b%08b%08b", ( xVariable & 0xFF000000 ) >>> 24, ( xVariable & 0x00FF0000 ) >>> 16, ( xVariable & 0x0000FF00 ) >>> 8, ( xVariable & 0x000000FF ) );
		
		return s_szReturn;
	}
	else if ( iTag == tagof( bit_byte: ) )
	{
		format( s_szReturn, sizeof( s_szReturn ), BIT_PREFIX "%08b", ( xVariable & 0x000000FF ) );
		
		return s_szReturn;
	}
	else
	{
		format( s_szReturn, sizeof( s_szReturn ), "%d", xVariable );
		
		if ( iDecimals > 0 )
		{
			strcat( s_szReturn, "." );
			
			while ( iDecimals-- )
				strcat( s_szReturn, "0" );
		}
	}
	
	s_iDecimalPos = strfind( s_szReturn, "." );
	
	if ( s_iDecimalPos == -1 )
		s_iDecimalPos = strlen( s_szReturn );
	else
		s_szReturn[ s_iDecimalPos ] = iDecimalPoint;
	
	if ( s_iDecimalPos >= 4 && iThousandSeparator )
	{
		s_szThousandSeparator[ 0 ] = iThousandSeparator;
		
		s_iChar = s_iDecimalPos;
		s_iSepPos = 0;
		
		while ( --s_iChar > 0 )
		{
			if ( ++s_iSepPos == 3 )
			{
				strins( s_szReturn, s_szThousandSeparator, s_iChar );
				
				s_iSepPos = 0;
			}
		}
	}
	
	return s_szReturn;
}

stock LoadStaticVehiclesFromFile(const filename[])
{
	new File:file_ptr;
	new line[256];
	new var_from_line[64];
	new vehicletype;
	new Float:SpawnX;
	new Float:SpawnY;
	new Float:SpawnZ;
	new Float:SpawnRot;
    new Color1, Color2;
	new index;
	new vehicles_loaded;

	file_ptr = fopen(filename,filemode:io_read);
	if(!file_ptr) return 0;

	vehicles_loaded = 0;

	while(fread(file_ptr,line,256) > 0)
	{
	    index = 0;

	    // Read type
  		index = token_by_delim(line,var_from_line,',',index);
  		if(index == (-1)) continue;
  		vehicletype = strval(var_from_line);
   		if(vehicletype < 400 || vehicletype > 611) continue;

  		// Read X, Y, Z, Rotation
  		index = token_by_delim(line,var_from_line,',',index+1);
  		if(index == (-1)) continue;
  		SpawnX = floatstr(var_from_line);

  		index = token_by_delim(line,var_from_line,',',index+1);
  		if(index == (-1)) continue;
  		SpawnY = floatstr(var_from_line);

  		index = token_by_delim(line,var_from_line,',',index+1);
  		if(index == (-1)) continue;
  		SpawnZ = floatstr(var_from_line);

  		index = token_by_delim(line,var_from_line,',',index+1);
  		if(index == (-1)) continue;
  		SpawnRot = floatstr(var_from_line);

  		// Read Color1, Color2
  		index = token_by_delim(line,var_from_line,',',index+1);
  		if(index == (-1)) continue;
  		Color1 = strval(var_from_line);

  		index = token_by_delim(line,var_from_line,';',index+1);
  		Color2 = strval(var_from_line);

  		//printf("%d,%d,%f,%f,%f,%f,%d,%d",total_vehicles_from_files+vehicles_loaded+1,vehicletype,SpawnX,SpawnY,SpawnZ,SpawnRot,Color1,Color2);

		AddStaticVehicleEx(vehicletype,SpawnX,SpawnY,SpawnZ,SpawnRot,Color1,Color2,(30*60)); // respawn 30 minutes
		vehicles_loaded++;
	}

	fclose(file_ptr);
	printf("Loaded %d vehicles from: %s",vehicles_loaded,filename);
	return vehicles_loaded;
}

//----------------------------------------------------------

stock strtok(const string[], &index)
{
	new length = strlen(string);
	while ((index < length) && (string[index] <= ' '))
	{
		index++;
	}

	new offset = index;
	new result[20];
	while ((index < length) && (string[index] > ' ') && ((index - offset) < (sizeof(result) - 1)))
	{
		result[index - offset] = string[index];
		index++;
	}
	result[index - offset] = EOS;
	return result;
}

//------------------------------------------------

stock strrest(const string[], &index)
{
	new length = strlen(string);
	while ((index < length) && (string[index] <= ' '))
	{
		index++;
	}
	new offset = index;
	new result[128];
	while ((index < length) && ((index - offset) < (sizeof(result) - 1)))
	{
		result[index - offset] = string[index];
		index++;
	}
	result[index - offset] = EOS;
	return result;
}

//----------------------------------------------------------
// Tokenise by a delimiter
// Return string and index of the end determined by the
// provided delimiter in delim

stock token_by_delim(const string[], return_str[], delim, start_index)
{
	new x=0;
	while(string[start_index] != EOS && string[start_index] != delim) {
	    return_str[x] = string[start_index];
	    x++;
	    start_index++;
	}
	return_str[x] = EOS;
	if(string[start_index] == EOS) start_index = (-1);
	return start_index;
}

//----------------------------------------------------------

stock isNumeric(const string[])
{
  new length=strlen(string);
  if (length==0) return false;
  for (new i = 0; i < length; i++)
    {
      if (
            (string[i] > '9' || string[i] < '0' && string[i]!='-' && string[i]!='+') // Not a number,'+' or '-'
             || (string[i]=='-' && i!=0)                                             // A '-' but not at first.
             || (string[i]=='+' && i!=0)                                             // A '+' but not at first.
         ) return false;
    }
  if (length==1 && (string[0]=='-' || string[0]=='+')) return false;
  return true;
}

//----------------------------------------------------------

stock IsKeyJustDown(key, newkeys, oldkeys)
{
	if((newkeys & key) && !(oldkeys & key)) return 1;
	return 0;
}
