================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/CheckSpeedCamera.inc
================================================================================

CheckSpeedCamera(playerID)
{
	new closestSpeedCamera = -1;
	new Float:closestObjectDistance;
	Foreach(arrayIndex, speedCameras)
	{
		if (speedCameras[arrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID] && IsValidDynamicObject(speedCameras[arrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID]))
		{
			new Float:position[3];
			GetDynamicObjectPos(speedCameras[arrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID], position[0], position[1], position[2]);
			new Float:distance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, position[0], position[1], position[2]);
			if (distance < closestObjectDistance || closestSpeedCamera == -1)
			{
				closestSpeedCamera = arrayIndex;
				closestObjectDistance = distance;
			}
		}
	}

	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);

	if (!vehicleID || closestSpeedCamera == -1 || closestObjectDistance > SPEEDCAMERA_DISTANCE)
	{
		PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED] = false;
		return false;
	}

	if (vehicleID && VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED] > speedCameras[closestSpeedCamera][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT] + SPEEDCAMERA_TOLERANCE)
	{
		if (!PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED])
		{
			new speedDifference = VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED] - speedCameras[closestSpeedCamera][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT];
			new Float:price = float(speedDifference);
			new vehicleType[STRINGLENGTH_VEHICLETYPE];
			strcat(vehicleType, vehicleModels[GetVehicleModel(vehicleID) - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE]);
			PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED] = true;
			PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS]++;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:453("You are driving too fast and have to pay %m! (%d km/h; Max: %d km/h)"), price, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED], speedCameras[closestSpeedCamera][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT]);
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:39("Your speed limit points were increased to %d points!"), PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS]);
			GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_CASH, -price);
			if (PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS] >= MAX_SPEEDLIMITPOINTS && HasLicense(playerID, vehicleType))
			{
				MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `licenses` WHERE `userId` = '%d' AND `type` = '%s'", PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(vehicleType));
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:44("You now have reached the limit of %d speed limit points and lost your driving license!"), MAX_SPEEDLIMITPOINTS);
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED] = false;
	}

	return true;
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/CheckVehiclePermission.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Checks if the player has the permission to use the vehicle.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player.

 *

 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item name="true">The player has the permission to use the vehicle</item>
 *	<item name="false">The player has not the permission to use the vehicle</item>
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	<title>The following is checked:</title>
 *	<item>Is the vehicle not a saved vehicle and the player has the permission "Mapper"?</item>
 *	<item>Does the job ID of the player match the job ID of the vehicle?</item>
 *	<item>Does the vehicle have a price?</item>
 *	<item>Is the vehicle already owned and is the player the owner of the vehicle?</item>
 * </remarks>
 */

CheckVehiclePermission(playerID, vehicleID, showBuyDialog)
{
	if (!VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
	{
		if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE])
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:129("You have not the permission to use this vehicle!"), GetPermissionName(PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID])
	{
		if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] == VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID])
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:327("This vehicle is reserved for a job!"));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID])
	{
		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] == PVar:playerID[USERID])
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:130("This vehicle is already owned by another player!"));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE])
	{
		if (showBuyDialog)
		{
			ShowDialog:BuyVehicle(playerID, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE]);
		}
		return false;
	}
	if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE])
	{
		return true;
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:129("You have not the permission to use this vehicle!"), GetPermissionName(PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE));
	return false;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/CreateVehicleEx.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Create a new vehicle at the specified position and with the specified properties.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="modelID">
 *	The ID of the vehicle model which should be spawned.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posX">
 *	The X-coordinate for the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posY">
 *	The Y-coordinate for the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posZ">
 *	The Z-coordinate for the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="angle">
 *	The facing angle (Z rotation) of the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color1">
 *	The primary color ID.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color2">
 *	The secondary color ID.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="isStatic">
 *	<item name="true">Use AddStaticVehicleEx for creating the vehicle (Only possible in OnGameModeInit and OnFilterScriptInit)</item>
 *	<item name="false">Use CreateVehicle for creating the vehicle (Can not spawn some trains)</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	Vehicles with model ID 537 (Freight) and 538 (Streak) are only created if isStatic is set to true!
 * </remarks>
 */

CreateVehicleEx(modelID, Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:angle, color1, color2, isStatic)
{
	if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
	{
		new vehicleID;
		new newColor1 = color1;
		new newColor2 = color2;
		if (color1 == -1 || color2 == -1)
		{
			GetVehicleColor(modelID, newColor1, newColor2);
		}
		if (isStatic)
		{
			vehicleID = AddStaticVehicle(modelID, posX, posY, posZ, angle, newColor1, newColor2);
		}
		else
		{
			if (modelID == 537 || modelID == 538)// We can not spawn Freight and Streak using CreateVehicle
			{
				return 0;
			}
			vehicleID = CreateVehicle(modelID, posX, posY, posZ, angle, newColor1, newColor2, -1);
		}
		if (!vehicleID)
		{
			return 0;
		}
		SetVehicleParamsEx(vehicleID, false, false, false, false, false, false, false);
		Count(vehiclePropertyID, sizeof(vehicles[]))
		{
			vehicles[vehicleID][enum_vehicle:vehiclePropertyID] = 0;
		}
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR1] = color1;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR2] = color2;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR1] = newColor1;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR2] = newColor2;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] = vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_MAXFUEL];
		return vehicleID;
	}
	return 0;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ExecuteCommand.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Execute a player command (e.g. spawnvehicle Infernus)
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which executes the command
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="command">
 *	Name of the command to execute (e.g. spawnvehicle)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="parameters">
 *	The parameters passed to the command (e.g. Infernus)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="isAlias">
 *	<title>Defines whether the command has been called by a player or by an alias (Passed to OnPlayerCommandPerformed)</title>
 *	<item>true if the command has been called by an alias</item>
 *	<item>false if the command has been called by a player</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	Return true if the command has been progressed or false if an error occured
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	Currently only invalid return codes are handled as errors (return false)!
 * </remarks>
 */

ExecuteCommand(playerID, command[], parameters[], isAlias)
{
	FormatNew:functionName[MAX_FUNCTION_NAME]("cmd_%s", command);
	new returnCode = COMMAND_NOT_FOUND;
	if (funcidx(functionName) != -1)
	{
		if (StrNotNull(parameters))
		{
			returnCode = CallLocalFunction(functionName, "ds", playerID, parameters);
		}
		else
		{
			returnCode = CallLocalFunction(functionName, "ds", playerID, "\1");
		}
	}
	return OnPlayerCommandPerformed(playerID, command, parameters, returnCode, isAlias);
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/FormatDate.inc
================================================================================

FormatDate(sqlDateString[], showTime = true)
{
	new string[STRINGLENGTH_DATETIME + 2];
	new time[10];
	new day;
	new month;
	new year;
	sscanf(sqlDateString, "s[" #STRINGLENGTH_DATETIME + 2 "s[10]", string, time);
	sscanf(string, "p<->ddd", year, month, day);
	Format:string("%02d.%02d.%d", day, month, year);
	if (showTime)
	{
		Format:string("%s - %s", string, time);
	}
	return string;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/FormatTime.inc
================================================================================

FormatTime(seconds)
{
	new days = seconds / 60 / 60 / 24;
	seconds -= days * 60 * 60 * 24;
	new hours = seconds / 60 / 60;
	seconds -= hours * 60 * 60;
	new minutes = seconds / 60;
	seconds -= minutes * 60;
	FormatNew:string[20]("%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds);
	if (days)
	{
		Format:string("%dd, %s", days, string);
	}
	return string;
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetClosestGate.inc
================================================================================

GetClosestGate(playerID, &Float:closestObjectDistance)
{
	new closestObjectID;
	new objects = CountDynamicObjects();

	Count1(objectID, objects)
	{
		if (IsValidDynamicObject(objectID) && IsGateObject(Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID)))
		{
			new Float:position[3];
			Streamer_GetFloatData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_X, position[0]);
			Streamer_GetFloatData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_Y, position[1]);
			Streamer_GetFloatData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_Z, position[2]);
			new Float:distance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, position[0], position[1], position[2]);

			if ((distance < closestObjectDistance || !closestObjectID) && dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_MOVESPEED])// This distance is lower than the last one and move speed has been defined
			{
				closestObjectID = objectID;
				closestObjectDistance = distance;
			}
		}
	}

	return closestObjectID;
}

================================================================================

GetClosestPickup(playerID, type[], &Float:distance = 0.0)
{
	new pickupID;
	distance = 6000.0;
	Count(checkPickupID, MAX_PICKUPS)
	{
		if (IsStr(pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_TYPE], type))
		{
			new Float:checkDistance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_POSX], pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_POSY], pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_POSZ]);
			if (checkDistance < distance)
			{
				distance = checkDistance;
				pickupID = checkPickupID;
			}
		}
	}
	return pickupID;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetClosestVehicleInRange.inc
================================================================================

GetClosestVehicleInRange(Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:range, excludeVehicleID = 0, excludeOccupied = false, jobID = -1, type[STRINGLENGTH_VEHICLETYPE] = "")
{
	new Float:distance;
	new Float:lastDistance = range + 1;// Keep last distance high enought (Check if last distance was BIGGER) -> If lastDistance would be 0 -> There is never a closer vehicle (must be < 0 to find one which would never occur)
	new closestVehicleID;
	Count1(vehicleID, MAX_VEHICLES)
	{
		new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
		if (vehicleID != excludeVehicleID && (jobID == -1 || VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID] == jobID) && modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611 && (!StrNotNull(type) || IsStr(type, vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE])))
		{
			if (excludeOccupied)
			{
				PlayerLoop(playerID)
				{
					if (IsPlayerInVehicle(playerID, vehicleID))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
			}
			distance = GetVehicleDistanceFromPoint(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
			if (distance <= range && distance < lastDistance)
			{
				lastDistance = distance;
				closestVehicleID = vehicleID;
			}
		}
	}
	return closestVehicleID;
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetConnectedPlayers.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Get the number of connected players or NPCs.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="countPlayers">
 *	Defines whether normal players should be counted.
 *	<item name="true">Count normal players</item>
 *	<item name="false">Do not count normal players</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="countNPCs">
 *	Defines whether NPCs should be counted.
 *	<item name="true">Count NPCs</item>
 *	<item name="false">Do not count NPCs</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	The number of connected players and/or NPCs.
 * </returns>
 */

GetConnectedPlayers(countPlayers, countNPCs)
{
	new players;
	PlayerLoop(playerID)
	{
		new iscountable;
		if (countPlayers)
		{
			iscountable = !IsPlayerNPC(playerID);
		}
		if (countNPCs)
		{
			iscountable = IsPlayerNPC(playerID);
		}
		if (iscountable)
		{
			players++;
		}
	}
	return players;
}

}

GetNavigationLocationTypeByName(playerID, name[])
{
	new typeID;

	mysql_store_result();
	if (mysql_num_rows())
	{
		typeID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!typeID)
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `navigationlocationtypes` WHERE `name` LIKE 'L:%%'");

		while (FetchMySQLRow())
		{
			new checkCharacter;
			new languageStringID;
			sscanf(GetMySQLField("name"), "p<:>cd", checkCharacter, languageStringID);
			if (IsStr(name, LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID)))
			{
				typeID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
				break;
			}
		}
		mysql_free_result();
	}
	return typeID;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetPermissionByName.inc
================================================================================

GetPermissionByName(permissionName[])
{
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "Admin", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_ADMIN;
	}
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "Mapper", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_MAPPER;
	}
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "Moderator", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_MODERATOR;
	}
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "Navi", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_NAVI;
	}
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "NPCAdmin", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_NPCADMIN;
	}
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "ServerAdmin", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_SERVERADMIN;
	}
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "SpawnVehicle", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE;
	}
	if (!strcmp(permissionName, "Teleport", true))
	{
		return PERMISSION_TELEPORT;
	}
	return -1;
}

GetPlayerZone(playerID, checkZ)
{
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	Count(zone, sizeof(zones))
	{
		if (posX >= zones[zone][ZONE_STARTX] && posX <= zones[zone][ZONE_ENDX] && posY >= zones[zone][ZONE_STARTY] && posY <= zones[zone][ZONE_ENDY])
		{
			if (!checkZ || (posZ >= zones[zone][ZONE_STARTZ] && posZ <= zones[zone][ZONE_ENDZ]))
			{
				return zone;
			}
		}
	}
	return -1;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetVehicleColor.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Gets the color combination for the given vehicle model ID.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="modelID">
 *	The ID of the vehicle model.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color1">
 *	The first color.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color2">
 *	The second color.
 * </param>
 */

GetVehicleColor(modelID, &color1, &color2)
{
	if (modelID < 400 || modelID > 611)
	{
		return false;
	}

	new arrayIndex = modelID - 400;
	new maxColorIndex = -1;
	Count(colorIndex, MAX_VEHICLE_COLORS)
	{
		if (vehicleColors[arrayIndex][colorIndex][0] == -1 || vehicleColors[arrayIndex][colorIndex][1] == -1)
		{
			break;
		}
		maxColorIndex = colorIndex;
	}

	if (maxColorIndex < 0)
	{
		return false;
	}

	new randomColorIndex = random(maxColorIndex + 1);// random returns a value between 0 and max (Excluding the max value) -> maxColorIndex + 1 will return a value between 0 and maxColorIndex

	color1 = vehicleColors[arrayIndex][randomColorIndex][0];
	color2 = vehicleColors[arrayIndex][randomColorIndex][1];

	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetXYFromAngle.inc
================================================================================

GetXYFromAngle(&Float:posX, &Float:posY, Float:angle, Float:distance)
{
	posX += (distance * floatsin(-angle, degrees));
	posY += (distance * floatcos(-angle, degrees));
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetXYZFromAngle.inc
================================================================================

GetXYZFromAngle(&Float:posX, &Float:posY, &Float:posZ, Float:angle, Float:elevation, Float:distance)
{
	posX += (distance * floatsin(angle, degrees) * floatcos(elevation, degrees));
	posY += (distance * floatcos(angle, degrees) * floatcos(elevation, degrees));
	posZ += (distance * floatsin(elevation, degrees));
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GiveLicense.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Give or revoke a license
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="giverPlayerID">
 *	The ID of the player wich gives the license
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player you want to give or revoke the license
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="type">
 *	The license type string
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="newState">
 *	<title>The new state</title>
 *	<item name="true">Give the license</item>
 *	<item name="false">Revoke the license</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item>true if successful</item>
 *	<item>false if failed</item>
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	<title>This function returns false if you try to...</title>
 *	<item>...give a license to a player which already owns the license</item>
 *	<item>...revoke a license from a player which does not own the license</item>
 * </remarks>
 */

GiveLicense(giverPlayerID, playerID, type[], newState)
{
	new currentState = HasLicense(playerID, type);
	if (newState && !currentState)
	{
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `licenses` (`giverUserId`, `userId`, `type`, `date`) VALUES('%d', '%d', '%s', NOW())", PVar:giverPlayerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(type));
		return true;
	}
	if (!newState && currentState)
	{
		MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `licenses` WHERE `userId` = '%d' AND `type` = '%s'", PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(type));
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/IsBanned.inc
================================================================================

IsBanned(playerID, showMessage)
{
	new ip[16];
	GetPlayerIp(playerID, ip, sizeof(ip));
	new userID;
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `username` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(GetPlayerNameEx(playerID)));
	mysql_store_result();
	userID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!userID)
	{
		userID = -1;
	}
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `bans` WHERE `ip` = '%s' OR `userId` = '%d'", ip, userID);
	mysql_store_result();
	new rows = mysql_num_rows();
	if (rows)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:473("Sorry, but you got banned from this server!"));
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:474("Reason for the ban: %s"), GetMySQLField("reason"));
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:475("You got banned by mistake? In this case, please contact us on http://www.grgserver.net."));
		}
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	return rows;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/LoadNPCs.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Load and connect all NPCs.
 * </summary>
 */

LoadNPCs()
{
	print("* Loading NPCs...");
	new arrayIndex;
	new XMLNode:xml = XML_LoadDocument(FILE_NPCS);
	xml = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "npcs");
	new XMLNode:npcNode = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "npc");
	while (npcNode)
	{
		if (arrayIndex >= MAX_NPCS)
		{
			printf("  MAX_NPCS (%d) reached!", MAX_NPCS);
			break;
		}

		new value[100];

		// Basic NPC data
		XML_GetAttribute(npcNode, "name", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME], MAX_PLAYER_NAME);
		XML_GetAttribute(npcNode, "skin", value);
		npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SKIN] = strval(value);

		// Recording if specified
		new XMLNode:recordingNode = XML_GetFirstChild(npcNode, "recording");
		if (recordingNode)
		{
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "name", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDING], STRINGLENGTH_NPCRECORDINGNAME);
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "startDelay", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_STARTDELAY] = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "autoStart", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOSTART] = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "autoRepeat", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOREPEAT] = strval(value);
		}

		// Vehicle if specified
		new XMLNode:vehicleNode = XML_GetFirstChild(npcNode, "vehicle");
		if (vehicleNode)
		{
			XML_GetAttribute(vehicleNode, "model", value);
			new modelID = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(vehicleNode, "color1", value);
			new color1 = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(vehicleNode, "color2", value);
			new color2 = strval(value);
			if (color1 == -1 || color2 == -1)
			{
				GetVehicleColor(modelID, color1, color2);
			}
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLECOLORS][0] = color1;
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLECOLORS][1] = color2;
			new vehicleID = AddStaticVehicle(modelID, 0, 0, -100, 0, color1, color2);
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[NPC_ONLY] = true;
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLEID] = vehicleID;
		}

		// Spawn position if specified
		new XMLNode:spawnNode = XML_GetFirstChild(npcNode, "spawn");
		if (spawnNode)
		{
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "posX", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "posY", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "posZ", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "angle", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE] = floatstr(value);
		}

		SetTimerEx("Timer_ConnectNPC", arrayIndex * NPC_CONNECT_DELAY, false, "d", arrayIndex);

		npcNode = XML_GetNextSibling(npcNode, "npc");
		arrayIndex++;
	}
	XML_UnloadDocument(xml);
	printf("  %d NPCs loaded", arrayIndex);
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/LoadObjectsFromFile.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Load all objects from the given XML file
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="filename">
 *	The name of the file in scriptfiles directory
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	The XML file must have the following structure:
 *	<objects>
 *		<object id="The internal ID" model="ID of the model" posX="0" posY="0" posZ="0" rotX="0" rotY="0" rotZ="0" interior="0">
 *			<move posX="0" posY="0" posZ="0" rotX="0" rotY="0" rotZ="0" speed="0.1" timeout="1000"/>
 *			<speedcamera speedLimit="50"/>
 *		</object>
 *	</objects>
 *	The move-element is optional (Required if you want to move the object using MoveObjectEx)
 *	The speedcamera-Element is only used and required for speed camera objects (Model 18880)
 * </remarks>
 */

LoadObjectsFromFile(filename[])
{
	new count;
	new value[100];

	FormatNew:filePath[100]("objects/%s", filename);

	new XMLNode:xml = XML_LoadDocument(filePath);
	xml = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "objects");
	new XMLNode:objectNode = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "object");
	while (objectNode)
	{
		// Arrays holding X, Y, Z for position and rotation
		new Float:position[3];
		new Float:rotation[3];

		// Arrays holding X, Y, Z for position and rotation of move target
		new Float:movePosition[3];
		new Float:moveRotation[3];

		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "id", value);
		new id = strval(value);

		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "model", value);
		new modelID = strval(value);

		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "interior", value);
		new interior = strval(value);

		// Read position
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "posX", value);
		position[0] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "posY", value);
		position[1] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "posZ", value);
		position[2] = floatstr(value);

		// Read rotation
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "rotX", value);
		rotation[0] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "rotY", value);
		rotation[1] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "rotZ", value);
		rotation[2] = floatstr(value);

		new XMLNode:moveNode = XML_GetFirstChild(objectNode, "move");

		new Float:moveSpeed;
		new moveTimeout;

		if (moveNode)
		{
			// Read move target position
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "posX", value);
			movePosition[0] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "posY", value);
			movePosition[1] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "posZ", value);
			movePosition[2] = floatstr(value);

			// Read move target rotation
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "rotX", value);
			moveRotation[0] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "rotY", value);
			moveRotation[1] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "rotZ", value);
			moveRotation[2] = floatstr(value);

			// Read move speed
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "speed", value);
			moveSpeed = floatstr(value);

			// Read move timeout
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "timeout", value);
			moveTimeout = strval(value);
		}

		new objectID = CreateDynamicObject(modelID, position[0], position[1], position[2], rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2], -1, interior, -1, STREAMER_OBJECTDISTANCE);
		Streamer_SetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID, OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL);

		new arrayIndex = objectID - 1;// The first object created with CreateDynamicObject gets ID 1, but the first array index in dynamicObjects array is 0

		// Basic object data
		strmid(dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_FILENAME], filename, 0, strlen(filename) - 4, STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME);
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ID] = id;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS] = position;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT] = rotation;

		// Moveable objects data
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS] = movePosition;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT] = moveRotation;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED] = moveSpeed;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVETIMEOUT] = moveTimeout;

		if (modelID == SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTMODEL)// This object has the speed camera model
		{
			new XMLNode:speedcameraNode = XML_GetFirstChild(objectNode, "speedcamera");
			if (speedcameraNode)
			{
				XML_GetAttribute(speedcameraNode, "speedLimit", value);
				new speedLimit = strval(value);

				Foreach(speedCamerasArrayIndex, speedCameras)
				{
					if (!speedCameras[speedCamerasArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID])
					{
						speedCameras[speedCamerasArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID] = objectID;
						speedCameras[speedCamerasArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT] = speedLimit;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				printf("Missing speedcamera element for object %d!", id);
			}
		}

		if (id >= nextDynamicObjectID)
		{
			nextDynamicObjectID = id + 1;
		}

		objectNode = XML_GetNextSibling(objectNode, "object");

		count++;
	}

	return count;
}

LoadPlayer(playerID)
{
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	
	SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE](GetMySQLField("chatMode"));
	PVar:playerID[CHATMODE_USERID] = strval(GetMySQLField("chatModeUserId"));
	PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID] = strval(GetMySQLField("currentPropertyId"));
	PVar:playerID[DEATHS] = strval(GetMySQLField("deaths"));
	PVar:playerID[GODMODE] = strval(GetMySQLField("godMode"));
	PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL] = strval(GetMySQLField("inTutorial"));
	PVar:playerID[JOBID] = strval(GetMySQLField("jobId"));
	PVar:playerID[LANGUAGE] = GetLanguageID(GetMySQLField("language"));
	PVar:playerID[LASTNEWSID] = strval(GetMySQLField("lastNewsId"));
	PVar:playerID[LASTPAYDAY] = strval(GetMySQLField("lastPayDay"));
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("bladder"));
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("energy"));
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("hunger"));
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("thirst"));
	PVar:playerID[ONLINESINCE] = gettime();
	PVar:playerID[ONLINETIME] = strval(GetMySQLField("onlineTime"));
	PVar:playerID[SKIN] = strval(GetMySQLField("skin"));
	PVar:playerID[SHOWCLOCK] = strval(GetMySQLField("showClock"));
	PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS] = strval(GetMySQLField("speedLimitPoints"));
	SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_CASH, floatstr(GetMySQLField("money")));

	// Bank stuff
	PVar:playerID[BANK_ID] = strval(GetMySQLField("bankId"));
	PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN] = strval(GetMySQLField("bankPin"));
	PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] = strval(GetMySQLField("bankPinAttempts"));
	SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_BANK, floatstr(GetMySQLField("bankMoney")));

	SetPlayerSkin(playerID, PVar:playerID[SKIN]);
	SetPlayerWantedLevel(playerID, strval(GetMySQLField("wantedLevel")));

	new Float:health = floatstr(GetMySQLField("health"));
	if (!health)
	{
		health = 100;
	}
	SetPlayerHealth(playerID, health);

	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER] = 0;
	}

	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY] = 0;
	}

	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER] = 0;
	}

	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST] = 0;
	}

	mysql_free_result();

	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `permissions` WHERE `userId` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID]);
	mysql_store_result();

	if (mysql_num_rows())
	{
		LoadPlayerPermissions(playerID);
	}

	mysql_free_result();

	TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerID, decimalPoint);
}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Move an object
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="objectID">
 *	The ID of the object
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="newState">
 *	<title>The new state</title>
 *	<item name="true">Move the object to the move target</item>
 *	<item name="false">Move the object back to the original position</item>
 * </param>
 */

MoveObjectEx(objectID, newState)
{
	StopDynamicObject(objectID);

	new arrayIndex = objectID - 1;

	if (newState)
	{
		MoveDynamicObject(objectID, dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS][0], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS][1], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS][2], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT][0], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT][1], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT][2]);
	}
	else
	{
		MoveDynamicObject(objectID, dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT][0], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT][1], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT][2]);
	}

	return true;
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/MySQLBan.inc
================================================================================

MySQLBan(playerID, targetPlayerID, reason[], kick)
{
	new executorUserID;
	new ip[16];
	GetPlayerIp(targetPlayerID, ip, sizeof(ip));
	if (playerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
	{
		executorUserID = PVar:playerID[USERID];
	}
	MySQLQuery("REPLACE INTO `bans` (`userId`, `ip`, `executorUserId`, `time`, `reason`) VALUES('%d', '%s', '%d', NOW(), '%s')", PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], ip, executorUserID, MySQLEscapeString(reason));
	if (playerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
	{
		printf("%s has been banned, Reason: %s", GetPlayerNameEx(targetPlayerID), reason);
	}
	else
	{
		printf("%s has been banned by %s, Reason: %s", GetPlayerNameEx(targetPlayerID), GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), reason);
	}
	if (kick)
	{
		Kick(targetPlayerID);
	}
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/NextMissionCheckpoint.inc

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Show the next checkpoint for the current mission.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="reuseCurrent">
 *	If set to true, do not search for the next checkpoint. Instead use the current checkpoint again.
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	OnCheckpointMissionFinished gets triggered as soon as there are no more checkpoints in the current mission.
 * </remarks>
 */

NextMissionCheckpoint(playerID, reuseCurrent = false)
{
	if (reuseCurrent)
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `missioncheckpoints` WHERE `missionId` = '%d' AND `checkpointId` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_ID], PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_CHECKPOINTID]);
	}
	else
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `missioncheckpoints` WHERE `missionId` = '%d' AND `checkpointId` > '%d' LIMIT 1", PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_ID], PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_CHECKPOINTID]);
	}
	mysql_store_result();
	PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_CHECKPOINTID] = strval(GetMySQLField("checkpointId"));
	new rows = mysql_num_rows();
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:nextPosX;
	new Float:nextPosY;
	new Float:nextPosZ;
	if (rows)
	{
		posX = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX"));
		posY = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY"));
		posZ = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (rows)
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `missioncheckpoints` WHERE `missionId` = '%d' AND `checkpointId` > '%d' LIMIT 1", PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_ID], PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_CHECKPOINTID]);
		mysql_store_result();
		nextPosX = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX"));
		nextPosY = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY"));
		nextPosZ = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ"));
		mysql_free_result();
		SetPlayerRaceCheckpointEx(playerID, CHECKPOINT_MISSION, posX, posY, posZ, nextPosX, nextPosY, nextPosZ, 5);
	}
	else
	{
		OnCheckpointMissionFinished(playerID);
	}
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/PayDay.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Do PayDay for the given player.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 */

PayDay(playerID)
{
	if (IsLoggedIn(playerID))
	{
		if (PVar:playerID[BANK_ID])
		{
			new Float:vehicleTax;
			Count1(vehicleID, MAX_VEHICLES)
			{
				if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] == PVar:playerID[USERID])
				{
					new modelIndex = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID) - 400;
					if (modelIndex >= 0 && modelIndex < sizeof(vehicleModels))
					{
						vehicleTax = floatadd(vehicleTax, vehicleModels[modelIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_TAX]);
					}
				}
			}
			vehicleTax = floatsub(vehicleTax, 12);// Tax is stored per year, but this should be the per month value

			new Float:salaryWithTax;
			new Float:salaryWithoutTax;
			new powerTax = 50 + random(50);
			new Float:tax = floatadd(vehicleTax, float(powerTax));

			MySQLQuery("SELECT `ownerUserId`, `employerSalary`, `employeeSalary` FROM `users` LEFT JOIN `jobs` ON `jobs`.`id` = `users`.`jobId` WHERE `users`.`id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID]);
			mysql_store_result();
			if (strval(GetMySQLField("ownerUserId")) == PVar:playerID[USERID])
			{
				salaryWithTax = floatstr(GetMySQLField("employerSalary"));
			}
			else
			{
				salaryWithTax = floatstr(GetMySQLField("employeeSalary"));
			}
			mysql_free_result();

			salaryWithoutTax = floatsub(salaryWithTax, tax);

			SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_BANK, salaryWithoutTax, true);

			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:133("It's pay day! You get %m deposited into your bank account."), salaryWithoutTax);
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:625("See /payday for more details"));
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:225("It's pay day but you can't receive money because you don't have a bank account! Get a bank account!"));
		}
	}
}

}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Start or stop to peefor the specified player
 * </summary>

 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="newState">
 *	<title>The new state</title>

 *	<item name="false">Stop peeing if not already done</item>

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ReloadLanguageStrings.inc
================================================================================

ReloadLanguageStrings(playerID = INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
{
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Unloading language strings...");
	Count(stringID, MAX_LANGUAGE_STRINGS)
	{
		strdel(languageStrings[stringID][LANGUAGESTRING_ENGLISH], 0, STRINGLENGTH_LANGUAGESTRING);
		strdel(languageStrings[stringID][LANGUAGESTRING_GERMAN], 0, STRINGLENGTH_LANGUAGESTRING);
	}
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Loading language strings...");
	new count;
	new highestStringID;
	new XMLNode:xml = XML_LoadDocument(FILE_LANGUAGESTRINGS);
	xml = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "languagestrings");
	new XMLNode:stringNode = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "string");
	while (stringNode)
	{
		new value[256];
		new stringIDstr[16];
		XML_GetAttribute(stringNode, "id", stringIDstr);
		new stringID = strval(stringIDstr);
		if (stringID < MAX_LANGUAGE_STRINGS)
		{
			new XMLNode:translationNode;
			translationNode = XML_GetFirstChild(stringNode, "en");
			if (translationNode)
			{
				new XMLNode:textNode = XML_GetFirstChild(translationNode);
				if (textNode)
				{
					XML_GetValue(textNode, value);
					value = str_replace("\\n", "\n", value);
					value = str_replace("\\t", "\t", value);
					strcat(languageStrings[stringID][LANGUAGESTRING_ENGLISH], value, STRINGLENGTH_LANGUAGESTRING);
				}
				else
				{
					AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Missing English language string for string %d", stringID);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Missing English language string for string %d", stringID);
			}
			translationNode = XML_GetFirstChild(stringNode, "de");
			if (translationNode)
			{
				new XMLNode:textNode = XML_GetFirstChild(translationNode);
				if (textNode)
				{
					XML_GetValue(textNode, value);
					value = str_replace("\\n", "\n", value);
					value = str_replace("\\t", "\t", value);
					strcat(languageStrings[stringID][LANGUAGESTRING_GERMAN], value, STRINGLENGTH_LANGUAGESTRING);
				}
				else
				{
					AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Missing German language string for string %d", stringID);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Missing German language string for string %d", stringID);
			}
			if (stringID > highestStringID)
			{
				highestStringID = stringID;
			}
			count++;
		}
		else
		{
			AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Language string ID %d is greater than language array size (%d)", stringID, MAX_LANGUAGE_STRINGS);
			break;
		}
		stringNode = XML_GetNextSibling(stringNode, "string");
	}
	XML_UnloadDocument(xml);
	Count(stringID, highestStringID + 1)
	{
		if (!strlen(languageStrings[stringID][LANGUAGESTRING_ENGLISH]) && !strlen(languageStrings[stringID][LANGUAGESTRING_GERMAN]))
		{
			AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Unused language string ID %d", stringID);
		}
	}
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  %d language strings loaded", count);
}

================================================================================

ReloadObjects(playerID = INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
{
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Destroying objects...");
	DestroyAllDynamicObjects();

	// Unset all objects
	Count(objectID, sizeof(dynamicObjects))
	{
		Count(enumField, sizeof(dynamicObjects[]))
		{
			dynamicObjects[objectID][enum_object:enumField] = 0;
		}
	}

	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Loading objects...");
	new item[100];
	new type;
	new dir:dirHandle = dir_open("scriptfiles/objects");
	while (dir_list(dirHandle, item, type))
	{
		if (type == FM_FILE)
		{
			AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  Loading objects from '%s'...", item);
			new count = LoadObjectsFromFile(item);
			AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  %d objects loaded", count);
		}
	}

	UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ReloadPermissions.inc
================================================================================

ReloadPermissions(playerID = INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
{
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Reloading permissions...");
	mysql_query("SELECT * FROM `permissions`");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new userID = strval(GetMySQLField("userId"));
		if (userID)
		{
			new currentPlayerID = GetPlayerByUserID(userID);
			if (currentPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
			{
				LoadPlayerPermissions(currentPlayerID);
			}
		}
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  done");
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ReloadPickup.inc
================================================================================

ReloadPickup(pickupID)
{
	Count(internalPickupID, MAX_PICKUPS)
	{
		if (pickups[internalPickupID][PICKUP_ID] == pickupID)
		{
			DestroyPickup(internalPickupID);
			pickups[internalPickupID][PICKUP_ID] = 0;
			pickups[internalPickupID][PICKUP_TYPE] = 0;
			break;
		}
	}
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `pickups` WHERE `id` = '%d'", pickupID);
	mysql_store_result();
	if (!AddPickup(strval(GetMySQLField("id")), GetMySQLField("type"), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ"))))
	{
		printf("Invalid pickup type: %s", GetMySQLField("type"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ReloadPickups.inc
================================================================================

ReloadPickups(playerID = INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
{
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Destroying pickups...");
	for (new pickupID = 0; pickupID < MAX_PICKUPS; pickupID++)
	{
		DestroyPickup(pickupID);
		pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID] = 0;
		pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_TYPE] = 0;
	}
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Loading pickups...");
	for (new pickupID = 0; pickupID < MAX_PICKUPS; pickupID++)
	{
		pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_TYPE] = 0;
	}
	mysql_query("SELECT * FROM `pickups`");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new pickupID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
		format(pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_TYPE], STRINGLENGTH_PICKUPTYPE, GetMySQLField("type"));
		pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_POSX] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX"));
		pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_POSY] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY"));
		pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_POSZ] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Creating pickups...");
	new count;
	for (new pickupID = 0; pickupID < MAX_PICKUPS; pickupID++)
	{
		if (strlen(pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_TYPE]))
		{
			if (!AddPickup(pickupID, pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_TYPE], pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_POSX], pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_POSY], pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_POSZ]))
			{
				AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "Invalid pickup type: %s", pickupLoader[pickupID][PICKUPLOADER_TYPE]);
			}
			else
			{
				count++;
			}
		}
	}
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  %d pickups created", count);
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ReloadVehicleModels.inc
================================================================================

ReloadVehicleModels(playerID = INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
{
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Unloading vehicle model colors...");
	Foreach(arrayIndex, vehicleColors)
	{
		Count(colorIndex, MAX_VEHICLE_COLORS)
		{
			vehicleColors[arrayIndex][colorIndex] = {-1, -1};
		}
	}

	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Loading vehicle models...");
	new count;
	new XMLNode:xml = XML_LoadDocument(FILE_VEHICLEMODELS);
	xml = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "vehiclemodels");
	new XMLNode:modelNode = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "model");
	while (modelNode)
	{
		new value[100];
		XML_GetAttribute(modelNode, "id", value);
		new modelID = strval(value);

		if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
		{
			new arrayIndex = modelID - 400;// First array element starts with 0, vehicle models are starting with 400 (400 - 400 = 0, 401 - 400 = 1, ...)

			XML_GetAttribute(modelNode, "name", vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME], STRINGLENGTH_VEHICLENAME);
			XML_GetAttribute(modelNode, "type", vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], STRINGLENGTH_VEHICLETYPE);

			XML_GetAttribute(modelNode, "fuelUsage", value);
			vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_FUELUSAGE] = floatstr(value);

			XML_GetAttribute(modelNode, "maxFuel", value);
			vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_MAXFUEL] = floatstr(value);

			new colorIndex = 0;
			new XMLNode:colorNode = XML_GetFirstChild(modelNode, "color");
			if (colorNode)
			{
				while (colorNode)
				{
					if (colorIndex >= MAX_VEHICLE_COLORS)
					{
						printf("Vehicle model ID %d reached maximum number of colors (%d)", modelID, MAX_VEHICLE_COLORS);
						break;
					}

					XML_GetAttribute(colorNode, "color1", value);
					vehicleColors[arrayIndex][colorIndex][0] = strval(value);

					XML_GetAttribute(colorNode, "color2", value);
					vehicleColors[arrayIndex][colorIndex][1] = strval(value);

					colorNode = XML_GetNextSibling(colorNode, "color");

					colorIndex++;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				printf("Missing color elements for vehicle model ID %d", modelID);
			}

			count++;
		}
		else
		{
			printf("Invalid vehicle model ID: %d", modelID);
		}

		modelNode = XML_GetNextSibling(modelNode, "model");
	}
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  %d vehicle models loaded", count);
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ReloadVehicles.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Destroyes all vehicles, creates the vehicles saved in the database, adds vehicle components and puts the NPCs in the vehicles if the ID of the vehicle is linked to a NPC.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="isStatic">
 *	<item name="true">Use AddStaticVehicleEx for creating the vehicle (Only possible in OnGameModeInit and OnFilterScriptInit)</item>
 *	<item name="false">Use CreateVehicle for creating the vehicle (Can not spawn some trains)</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which executes a command which reloads the vehicles (Optional).
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	Vehicles with model ID 537 (Freight) and 538 (Streak) are only destroyed if isStatic is set to true!
 * </remarks>
 */

ReloadVehicles(isStatic, playerID = !INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
{
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Destroying vehicles...");
	Count1(vehicleID, MAX_VEHICLES)
	{
		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[NPC_ONLY])// We should not remove NPC vehicles
		{
			continue;
		}
		new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
		if (modelID)
		{
			if (isStatic || (modelID != 537 && modelID != 538))// We are unable to respawn Freight and Streak using CreateVehicle... so only remove them if isStatic is true
			{
				DestroyVehicle(vehicleID);
			}
		}
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] = 0;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID] = 0;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID] = 0;
	}

	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Loading vehicles...");
	new count;
	mysql_query("SELECT * FROM `vehicles`");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new vehicleID = CreateVehicleEx(strval(GetMySQLField("modelId")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("angle")), strval(GetMySQLField("color1")), strval(GetMySQLField("color2")), isStatic);
		if (vehicleID)
		{
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID] = strval(GetMySQLField("frontLightId"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[HASNAVI] = strval(GetMySQLField("hasNavi"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID] = strval(GetMySQLField("jobId"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[MILEAGE] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("mileAge"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[NEONLIGHTID] = strval(GetMySQLField("neonLightId"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PAINTJOBID] = strval(GetMySQLField("paintjobId"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("price"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID] = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
			SetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("health")));
			LinkVehicleToInterior(vehicleID, strval(GetMySQLField("interior")));
			LockVehicle(vehicleID, strval(GetMySQLField("locked")));
			ChangeVehiclePaintjob(vehicleID, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PAINTJOBID]);
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("currentFuel"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] = strval(GetMySQLField("ownerUserId"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID] = strval(GetMySQLField("radioStationId"));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID] = strval(GetMySQLField("sellerUserId"));
			SetVehicleNumberPlate(vehicleID, GetMySQLField("numberplate"));
			count++;
		}
		else
		{
			AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Can not create vehicle '%d' (ModelID %d)!", strval(GetMySQLField("id")), strval(GetMySQLField("modelId")));
		}
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  %d vehicles loaded", count);

	count = 0;
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "* Adding vehicle components...");
	mysql_query("SELECT * FROM `vehiclecomponents`");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new foundVehicle;
		Count1(vehicleID, MAX_VEHICLES)
		{
			if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID] == strval(GetMySQLField("vehicleId")))
			{
				AddVehicleComponentEx(vehicleID, strval(GetMySQLField("component")));
				count++;
				foundVehicle = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (!foundVehicle)
		{
			AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, "  Vehicle not found: %d", strval(GetMySQLField("vehicleId")));
		}
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AdminPrint(playerID, COLOR_INFO, "  %d vehicle components added", count);
}

================================================================================

RemoveNewLine(string[])
{
	new length = strlen(string);
	while (length-- && string[length] <= ' ')
	{
		string[length] = '\0';
	}
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/RestartGameMode.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Restart the game mode.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player executing the restart.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="reason">
 *	The reason why the gamemode will be restarted.
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	All logged in players will be saved and receive a message containing the reason.
 * </remarks>
 */

RestartGameMode(playerID, reason[])
{
	PlayerLoop(currentPlayerID)
	{
		SavePlayer(currentPlayerID);
		if (currentPlayerID != playerID)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(currentPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:43("%p has restarted the game mode: %s"), playerID, reason);
		}
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:42("You have restarted the game mode: %s"), reason);
	printf("%s has restarted the gamemode: %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), reason);
	SendRconCommand("gmx");
}

RotatePlayer(playerID, Float:rotation)
{
	new Float:angle;
	GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
	angle = floatsub(angle, rotation);
	if (angle < 0)
	{
		angle = floatsub(360, angle);
	}
	SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/SaveNPCs.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Save all NPCs
 * </summary>
 */

SaveNPCs()
{
	new XMLNode:document = XML_CreateDocument(FILE_NPCS);
	new XMLNode:rootNode = XML_CreateNode(document, "npcs");

	Foreach(arrayIndex, npcs)
	{
		new XMLNode:npcNode = XML_CreateNode(rootNode, "npc");

		XML_SetAttribute(npcNode, "name", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME]);
		XML_SetAttribute(npcNode, "skin", val2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SKIN]));

		if (StrNotNull(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDING]))
		{
			new XMLNode:recordingNode = XML_CreateNode(npcNode, "recording");

			XML_SetAttribute(recordingNode, "name", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDING]);
			XML_SetAttribute(recordingNode, "startDelay", val2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_STARTDELAY]));
			XML_SetAttribute(recordingNode, "autoStart", val2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOSTART]));
			XML_SetAttribute(recordingNode, "autoRepeat", val2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOREPEAT]));
		}

		if (npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLEID])
		{
			new XMLNode:vehicleNode = XML_CreateNode(npcNode, "vehicle");

			XML_SetAttribute(vehicleNode, "model", val2str(GetVehicleModel(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLEID])));
			XML_SetAttribute(vehicleNode, "color1", val2str(GetVehicleModel(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLECOLORS][0])));
			XML_SetAttribute(vehicleNode, "color2", val2str(GetVehicleModel(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLECOLORS][1])));
		}

		if (npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0] || npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1] || npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2])
		{
			new XMLNode:spawnNode = XML_CreateNode(npcNode, "spawn");

			XML_SetAttribute(spawnNode, "posX", float2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0]));
			XML_SetAttribute(spawnNode, "posY", float2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1]));
			XML_SetAttribute(spawnNode, "posZ", float2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2]));
			XML_SetAttribute(spawnNode, "angle", float2str(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE]));
		}
	}

	XML_SaveDocument(document);
}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Save the specified objects file
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="filename">
 *	The name of the file in scriptfiles directory
 * </param>
 */

SaveObjects(filename[])
{
	new value[100];

	FormatNew:filePath[STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME]("objects/%s.xml", filename);

	new XMLNode:document = XML_CreateDocument(filePath);
	new XMLNode:rootNode = XML_CreateNode(document, "objects");

	new count = CountDynamicObjects();
	Count(arrayIndex, count)
	{
		new objectID = arrayIndex + 1;
		if (Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID) == OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL && !strcmp(filename, dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_FILENAME], true))
		{
			new XMLNode:objectNode = XML_CreateNode(rootNode, "object");

			Format:value("%d", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ID]);
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "id", value);

			Format:value("%d", Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID));
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "model", value);

			new objectInteriors[5];
			Streamer_GetArrayData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_INTERIOR_ID, objectInteriors, sizeof(objectInteriors));// Interiors are stored in an array (An object can be visible in multiple interiors)
			Format:value("%d", objectInteriors[0]);// We only use one interior for each object, so element 0 has the correct interior ID
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "interior", value);

			Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0]);
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "posX", value);

			Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1]);
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "posY", value);

			Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2]);
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "posZ", value);

			Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT][0]);
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "rotX", value);

			Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT][1]);
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "rotY", value);

			Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT][2]);
			XML_SetAttribute(objectNode, "rotZ", value);

			if (dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED])
			{
				new XMLNode:moveNode = XML_CreateNode(objectNode, "move");

				Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS][0]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "posX", value);

				Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS][1]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "posY", value);

				Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS][2]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "posZ", value);

				Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT][0]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "rotX", value);

				Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT][1]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "rotY", value);

				Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT][2]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "rotZ", value);

				Format:value("%f", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "speed", value);

				Format:value("%d", dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVETIMEOUT]);
				XML_SetAttribute(moveNode, "timeout", value);
			}

			if (Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID) == SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTMODEL)// This object has the speed camera model
			{
				new XMLNode:speedcameraNode = XML_CreateNode(objectNode, "speedcamera");

				Foreach(speedCameraArrayIndex, speedCameras)
				{
					if (speedCameras[speedCameraArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID] == objectID)
					{
						Format:value("%d", speedCameras[speedCameraArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT]);
						XML_SetAttribute(speedcameraNode, "speedLimit", value);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	XML_SaveDocument(document);
}

SavePlayer(playerID)
{
	if (IsLoggedIn(playerID))
	{
		// Bank
		Format:sqlQuery("`bankId` = '%d', `bankMoney` = '%f', `bankPin` = '%d', `bankPinAttempts` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[BANK_ID], PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY], PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN], PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS]);

		// Needs
		Format:sqlQuery("%s, `bladder` = '%f', `energy` = '%f', `hunger` = '%f', `thirst` = '%f'", sqlQuery, PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER], PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY], PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER], PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST]);

		// Misc
		Format:sqlQuery("%s, `money` = '%f', `language` = '%s', `jobId` = '%d', `lastNewsId` = '%d', `chatMode` = '%s', `chatModeUserId` = '%d', `godMode` = '%d'", sqlQuery, PVar:playerID[MONEY], GetLanguageName(PVar:playerID[LANGUAGE]), PVar:playerID[JOBID], PVar:playerID[LASTNEWSID], PVar:playerID[CHATMODE], PVar:playerID[CHATMODE_USERID], PVar:playerID[GODMODE]);
		Format:sqlQuery("%s, `currentPropertyId` = '%d', `onlineTime` = '%d', `lastPayDay` = '%d', `skin` = '%d', `showClock` = '%d', `inTutorial` = '%d', `deaths` = '%d'", sqlQuery, PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID], GetOnlineTime(playerID), PVar:playerID[LASTPAYDAY], PVar:playerID[SKIN], PVar:playerID[SHOWCLOCK], PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL], PVar:playerID[DEATHS]);
		Format:sqlQuery("%s, `wantedLevel` = '%d', `speedLimitPoints` = '%d'", sqlQuery, GetPlayerWantedLevel(playerID), PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS]);

		MySQLQuery("UPDATE `users` SET %s WHERE `id` = '%d'", sqlQuery, PVar:playerID[USERID]);

		new Float:health;
		new Float:posX;
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		new Float:angle;
		GetPlayerHealth(playerID, health);
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
		GetPlayerWantedLevel(playerID);

		if (posX != 0 && posY != 0 && posZ != 0)
		{
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `users` SET `health` = '%f', `posX` = '%f', `posY` = '%f', `posZ` = '%f', `angle` = '%f', `interior` = '%d' WHERE `id` = '%d'", health, posX, posY, posZ, angle, GetPlayerInterior(playerID), PVar:playerID[USERID]);
		}
	}
}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Update all properties of the specified vehicle in the database.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="vehicleID">
 *	The ID of the vehicle which should be saved.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="interior">
 *	The interior where the vehicle should be spawned on load.
 * </param>
 */

SaveVehicle(vehicleID, interior)
{
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
	{
		new Float:health;
		new Float:posX; 
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		new Float:angle;
		GetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, health);
		GetVehiclePos(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
		GetVehicleZAngle(vehicleID, angle);

		Format:sqlQuery("UPDATE `vehicles` SET");

		// Position
		Format:sqlQuery("%s `posX` = '%f', `posY` = '%f', `posZ` = '%f', `angle` = '%f', `interior` = '%d',", sqlQuery, posX, posY, posZ, angle, interior);

		// Visual
		Format:sqlQuery("%s `color1` = '%d', `color2` = '%d', `paintjobId` = '%d', `frontLightId` = '%d', `neonLightId` = '%d',", sqlQuery, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR1], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR2], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PAINTJOBID], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[NEONLIGHTID]);

		// Other properties
		Format:sqlQuery("%s `health` = '%f', `mileAge` = '%f', `hasNavi` = '%d', `locked` = '%d', `price` = '%f',", sqlQuery, health, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[MILEAGE], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[HASNAVI], IsVehicleLocked(vehicleID), VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE]);
		Format:sqlQuery("%s `currentFuel` = '%f', `sellerUserId` = '%d', `ownerUserId` = '%d', `radioStationId` = '%d'", sqlQuery, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID]);

		Format:sqlQuery("%s WHERE `id` = '%d'", sqlQuery, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID]);

		MySQLQuery(sqlQuery);
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/SendClientMessageEx.inc
================================================================================

SendClientMessageEx(playerID, color, languageStringID, { _, Float, Text3D, Menu, Text, DB, DBResult, bool, File, hex, bit, bit_byte, Bit }:...)
{
	if (playerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
	{
		return;
	}
	new targetString[256];
	new message[256];
	strcat(message, LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID));
	new length = strlen(message);
	new argumentIndex = 2;
	for (new character = 0; character < length; character++)
	{
		new isFormatChar;
		if (message[character] == '%')
		{
			if (character + 1 < length)
			{
				switch (message[character + 1])
				{
					case '%':
					{
						strcat(targetString, "%");
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
					case 'c':
					{
						argumentIndex++;
						Format:targetString("%s%c", targetString, getarg(argumentIndex));
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
					case 'd':
					{
						argumentIndex++;
						Format:targetString("%s%d", targetString, getarg(argumentIndex));
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
					case 'f':
					{
						argumentIndex++;
						Format:targetString("%s%f", targetString, getarg(argumentIndex));
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
					case 'l':
					{
						argumentIndex++;
						strcat(targetString, LanguageString(playerID, getarg(argumentIndex)));
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
					case 'm':
					{
						argumentIndex++;
						Format:targetString("%s$%s", targetString, FormatMoney(getarg(argumentIndex)));
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
					case 'p':
					{
						argumentIndex++;
						strcat(targetString, GetPlayerNameEx(getarg(argumentIndex)));
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
					case 's':
					{
						argumentIndex++;
						new string[256];
						GetStringArg(argumentIndex, string);
						strcat(targetString, string);
						isFormatChar = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (isFormatChar)
		{
			character++;
		}
		else
		{
			Format:targetString("%s%c", targetString, message[character]);
		}
	}
	SendClientMessage(playerID, color, targetString);
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/SendMessageToChannel.inc
================================================================================

SendMessageToChannel(playerID, channel[], message[], targetPlayerID = INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
{
	new string[256];
	new targetUserID;
	if (targetPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
	{
		targetUserID = PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID];
	}
	MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `chatlog` (`userId`, `targetUserId`, `channel`, `time`, `text`) VALUES('%d', '%d', '%s', NOW(), '%s')", PVar:playerID[USERID], targetUserID, channel, MySQLEscapeString(message));
	if (IsStr(channel, "ADMINS"))
	{
		Format:string("[%s@Admins] %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), message);
		PlayerLoop(loopPlayerID)
		{
			if (permissions[loopPlayerID][PERMISSION_ADMIN] || loopPlayerID == playerID)
			{
				SendClientMessage(loopPlayerID, COLOR_CHAT_ADMINS, string);
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(channel, "ALL"))
	{
		PlayerLoop(loopPlayerID)
		{
			Format:string("[%s@%s] %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), LanguageString(loopPlayerID, StringID:310("All")), message);
			SendClientMessage(loopPlayerID, COLOR_CHAT_ALL, string);
		}
		Format:string("[%s] %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), message);
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(channel, "INRANGE"))
	{
		new Float:posX;
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		Format:string("[%s] %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), message);
		PlayerLoop(loopPlayerID)
		{
			new Float:distance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(loopPlayerID, posX, posY, posZ);
			if (distance <= CHAT_MAXDISTANCE)
			{
				SendClientMessage(loopPlayerID, COLOR_CHAT_INRANGE, string);
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(channel, "JOB"))
	{
		Format:string("[%s@Job] %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), message);
		PlayerLoop(loopPlayerID)
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] == PVar:loopPlayerID[JOBID])
			{
				SendClientMessage(loopPlayerID, COLOR_CHAT_JOB, string);
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(channel, "PLAYER"))
	{
		if (targetPlayerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:147("Player not found!"));
			return false;
		}
		Format:string("[%s -> %s] %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), GetPlayerNameEx(targetPlayerID), message);
		SendClientMessage(targetPlayerID, COLOR_CHAT_PLAYER, string);
		SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_CHAT_PLAYER, string);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/SetPlayerMoney.inc
================================================================================

SetPlayerMoney(playerID, type, Float:amount, add = false)
{
	switch (type)
	{
		case MONEY_BANK:// Money on bank account
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[BANK_ID])
			{
				if (add)
				{
					PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] = PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] + amount;
				}
				else
				{
					PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] = amount;
				}
				return true;
			}
			else
			{
				PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] = 0;
			}
		}
		case MONEY_CASH:// Directly usable money (Shown on the player's screen)
		{
			if (add)
			{
				PVar:playerID[MONEY] = PVar:playerID[MONEY] + amount;
			}
			else
			{
				PVar:playerID[MONEY] = amount;
			}
			if (PVar:playerID[MONEY] > MAX_MONEY)
			{
				PVar:playerID[MONEY] = MAX_MONEY;
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:492("You have exceeded the cash limit of %m!"), MAX_MONEY);
				printf("%s reached MAX_MONEY (%2f)", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), MAX_MONEY);
			}
			ResetPlayerMoney(playerID);
			GivePlayerMoney(playerID, floatround(PVar:playerID[MONEY] * 100, floatround_tozero));
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/SetPlayerProgressBar3ColorState.inc

/*
 * <summary>
 *	Set the state of a progress bar and change the color if the value is bellow the warning or critical value
 *	If the new value is above the warning value COLOR_BAR_OK will be used as color
 *	If the new value is above the critical value but bellow or equal to the warning value COLOR_BAR_WARNING will be used as color
 *	If the new value is bellow or equal to the critical value COLOR_BAR_CRITICAL will be used as color
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="barId">
 *	The ID of the progress bar (Return value of CreatePlayerProgressBar)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="warningValue">
 *	The warning value
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="criticalValue">
 *	The critical value
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="value">
 *	The new value of the progress bar
 * </param>
 */

SetPlayerBar3ColorState(playerID, PlayerBar:barId, Float:warningValue, Float:criticalValue, Float:value)
{
	new color = COLOR_BAR_OK;
	if (value <= criticalValue)
	{
		color = COLOR_BAR_CRITICAL;
	}
	else
	{
		if (value <= warningValue)
		{
			color = COLOR_BAR_WARNING;
		}
	}

	SetPlayerProgressBarColor(playerID, barId, color);
	SetPlayerProgressBarValue(playerID, barId, value);
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/SetVehicleLightsState.inc
================================================================================

SetVehicleLightsState(vehicleID, newState)
{
	new engine;
	new lights;
	new alarm;
	new doors;
	new bonnet;
	new boot;
	new objective;
	GetVehicleParamsEx(vehicleID, engine, lights, alarm, doors, bonnet, boot, objective);
	if (lights != newState)
	{
		SetVehicleParamsEx(vehicleID, engine, newState, alarm, doors, bonnet, boot, objective);
		if (newState)
		{
			if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID])
			{
				AddNeonLight(vehicleID, NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID] - 1);
				AddNeonLight(vehicleID, NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID] - 1);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Count(colorID, LIGHTOBJECT_MAXCOLORS)
			{
				if (vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT][colorID])
				{
					DestroyDynamicObject(vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT][colorID]);
					vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT][colorID] = 0;
				}
				if (vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT][colorID])
				{
					DestroyDynamicObject(vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT][colorID]);
					vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT][colorID] = 0;
				}
			}
			UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ShowGPSCheckpoint.inc
================================================================================

ShowGPSCheckpoint(playerID, id)
{
	new nextNodeID;
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:nextPosX;
	new Float:nextPosY;
	new Float:nextPosZ;
	if (id >= PVar:playerID[GPS_NODESCOUNT])
	{
		PVar:playerID[GPS_ENABLED] = false;
		return false;
	}
	PVar:playerID[GPS_ID] = id;
	GetNodePos(PVar:playerID[GPS_NODES][id], posX, posY, posZ);
	if (GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, posX, posY, posZ) < 30 && id < PVar:playerID[GPS_NODESCOUNT] - 1)
	{
		return ShowGPSCheckpoint(playerID, id + 1);
	}
	for (nextNodeID = id + 1; nextNodeID < PVar:playerID[GPS_NODESCOUNT]; nextNodeID++)
	{
		GetNodePos(PVar:playerID[GPS_NODES][nextNodeID], nextPosX, nextPosY, nextPosZ);
		if (GetDistanceBetweenPoints(posX, posY, posZ, nextPosX, nextPosY, nextPosZ) >= 30)
		{
			break;
		}
	}
	SetPlayerRaceCheckpointEx(playerID, CHECKPOINT_NAVIGPS, Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:nextPosX, Float:nextPosY, Float:nextPosZ, 5);
	return true;
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ShowNews.inc
================================================================================

ShowNews(playerID, lastID)
{
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `date`, LEFT(`text_%s`, 255) AS `text` FROM `news` WHERE `id` > '%d' ORDER BY `date` DESC LIMIT %d", GetLanguageName(PVar:playerID[LANGUAGE]), lastID, NEWS_MAXIMUM);
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new id = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
		if (id > lastID)
		{
			lastID = id;
		}
		FormatNew:string[NEWS_LINELENGTH + 30](GetMySQLField("text"));
		if (strlen(string) > NEWS_LINELENGTH + 3)
		{
			strmid(string, string, 0, NEWS_LINELENGTH, sizeof(string));
			Format:string("%s...", string);
		}
		Format:string("[%s] %s", FormatDate(GetMySQLField("date"), false), string);
		SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, string);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	PVar:playerID[LASTNEWSID] = lastID;
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:135("See all news on grgserver.net."));
}

================================================================================
DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/SpawnVehicle.inc
================================================================================

SpawnVehicle(playerID, modelID, color1, color2, showMessage)
{
	if (!modelID)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:64("The vehicle was not found!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	if (modelID < 400 || modelID > 611)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:65("The model ID must be between 400 and 611!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	if (color1 < -1 || color1 > 127 || color2 < -1 || color2 > 127)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:63("The color must be between 0 and 127!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:angle;
	GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
	new vehicleID = CreateVehicleEx(modelID, posX, posY, posZ, angle, color1, color2, false);
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:461("The vehicle could not be spawned!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[HASNAVI] = true;
	LinkVehicleToInterior(vehicleID, GetPlayerInterior(playerID));
	SetVehicleVirtualWorld(vehicleID, GetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerID));
	PutPlayerInVehicle(playerID, vehicleID, 0);
	if (showMessage)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:62("The vehicle has been spawned"));
	}
	return true;
}

Str2Val(string[])
{
	new index;
	new length = strlen(string);
	new number[30];
	Count(character, length)
	{
		if (string[character] >= 48 && string[character] <= 57)
		{
			number[index] = string[character];
			index++;
		}
	}
	return strval(number);
}

DATEI: Compiler/samp03/includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/TeleportTo.inc
================================================================================

TeleportTo(playerID, Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:angle, interior, virtualWorld)
{
	switch (GetPlayerState(playerID))
	{
		case PLAYER_STATE_ONFOOT:
		{
			SetPlayerPosEx(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
			SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
			SetPlayerInterior(playerID, interior);
			SetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerID, virtualWorld);
			return true;
		}
		case PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER, PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER:
		{
			new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
			SetVehiclePos(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
			LinkVehicleToInterior(vehicleID, interior);
			SetVehicleVirtualWorld(vehicleID, virtualWorld);
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

TeleportToInterior(playerID, interiorID)
{
	new result;
	if (interiorID > 0 && interiorID < sizeof(interiors))
	{
		SetPlayerPosEx(playerID, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_POS][0], interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_POS][1], interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_POS][2]);
		SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_ANGLE]);
		SetPlayerInterior(playerID, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_ID]);
		SetCameraBehindPlayer(playerID);
		PVar:playerID[CURRENTINTERIOR] = interiorID;
		result = true;
	}
	return result;
}
