public OnPlayerEditDynamicObject(playerid, objectid, response, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, Float:rx, Float:ry, Float:rz)
{
	MoveDynamicObject(objectid, x, y, z, 10.0, rx, ry, rz);
	switch (response)
	{
		case EDIT_RESPONSE_CANCEL:
		{
			MoveDynamicObject(objectid, PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_LASTPOSX], PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_LASTPOSY], PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_LASTPOSZ], 10.0, PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_LASTROTX], PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_LASTROTY], PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_LASTROTZ]);
			PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] = 0;
			SelectObject(playerid);
		}
		case EDIT_RESPONSE_FINAL:
		{
			if (Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectid, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID) == OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL)
			{
				GetDynamicObjectPos(objectid, dynamicObjects[objectid - 1][OBJECT_POS][0], dynamicObjects[objectid - 1][OBJECT_POS][1], dynamicObjects[objectid - 1][OBJECT_POS][2]);
				GetDynamicObjectRot(objectid, dynamicObjects[objectid - 1][OBJECT_ROT][0], dynamicObjects[objectid - 1][OBJECT_ROT][1], dynamicObjects[objectid - 1][OBJECT_ROT][2]);
				SaveObjects(dynamicObjects[objectid - 1][OBJECT_FILENAME]);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:199("The changes have been saved"));
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:200("The object is not a streamed object or is already used in another way!"));
			}

			PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] = 0;
			PlaySound(playerid, SOUND_OBJECTPLACED);
			SelectObject(playerid);
		}
	}
}

public OnPlayerEnterCheckpoint(playerid)
{
	switch (PVar:playerid[CURRENTCHECKPOINT])

		{
			DisablePlayerCheckpoint(playerid);
			new Float:posX;
			new Float:posY;
			new Float:posZ;
			new type[STRINGLENGTH_VEHICLETYPE];
			new missionID;
			GetPlayerPos(playerid, posX, posY, posZ);
			switch (PVar:playerid[DRIVINGSCHOOL_TYPE])

				case DRIVINGSCHOOL_BIKE:

					strcat(type, "Bike");

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Callbacks/OnPlayerEnterRaceCheckpoint.inc
================================================================================

public OnPlayerEnterRaceCheckpoint(playerid)
{
	switch (PVar:playerid[CURRENTRACECHECKPOINT])
	{
		case CHECKPOINT_MISSION:
		{
			if (PVar:playerid[CPMISSION_VEHICLEID] != -1)// Require a vehicle if vehicleID is not -1
			{
				new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
				if (!vehicleID)// Do not allow to enter the checkpoint if the player is not in any vehicle
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:612("You have to be in a vehicle to use this checkpoint!"));
					return false;
				}
				if (vehicleID != PVar:playerid[CPMISSION_VEHICLEID])// Do not allow to enter the checkpoint if the vehicleID does not match the current vehicle ID
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:613("You are not in the required vehicle!"));
					return false;
				}
			}
			DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid);
			NextMissionCheckpoint(playerid);
		}
		case CHECKPOINT_NAVIGPS:
		{
			DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid);
			ShowGPSCheckpoint(playerid, PVar:playerid[GPS_ID] + 1);
		}
	}
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Callbacks/OnPlayerEnteredVehicle.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	This callback gets called every time a player entered a vehicle.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which entered the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="vehicleID">
 *	The ID of the vehicle which was entered by the player.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="isPassenger">
 *	<item name="true">The player entered the vehicle as a passenger</item>
 *	<item name="false">The player entered the vehicle as the driver</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	<title>Difference between OnPlayerEnterVehicle and OnPlayerEnteredVehicle:</title>
 *	<item name="OnPlayerEnterVehicle">The player is while entering the vehicle (Not already in the vehicle)</item>
 *	<item name="OnPlayerEnteredVehicle">The player is already in the vehicle</item>
 * </remarks>
 */

OnPlayerEnteredVehicle(playerID, vehicleID, isPassenger)
{
	if (IsPlayerNPC(playerID))
	{
		return true;
	}
	new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
	if (!isPassenger)
	{
		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[NPC_ONLY])
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:16("You are not allowed to drive this vehicle!"));
			return false;
		}
		if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
		{
			if (IsStr(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], "Monster Truck"))
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:545("Remember: Monster trucks are prohibited on the street!"));
			}
			else
			{
				if (!HasLicense(playerID, vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE]) && !(PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_ID] && strfind(GetCheckpointMissionNameByID(PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_ID]), "DrivingSchool", true, 0) == 0))
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:514("You do not have a %l!"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE]));
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:544("Do not get caught by the police!"));
				}
			}
		}
		if (PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_ID] && (!PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_VEHICLEID] || PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_VEHICLEID] == vehicleID))
		{
			DisablePlayerCheckpoint(playerID);
			NextMissionCheckpoint(playerID, true);
		}
	}
	if (!isPassenger && !GetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID))
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:424("Use /engine to start the engine of your vehicle."));
	}
	SetVehicleParamsForPlayer(vehicleID, playerID, false, false);
	return true;
}

public OnPlayerExitVehicle(playerid, vehicleid)
{
	SaveVehicle(vehicleid, GetPlayerInterior(playerid));
	StopRadioStation(playerid);
	PVar:playerid[OLDVEHICLEID] = vehicleid;
	if (PVar:playerid[GPS_ENABLED])
	{
		PVar:playerid[GPS_ENABLED] = false;
		DisablePlayerRaceCheckpoint(playerid);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:460("The navigation system has been turned off"));
	}
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Callbacks/OnPlayerKeyStateChange.inc
================================================================================

public OnPlayerKeyStateChange(playerid, newkeys, oldkeys)
{
	if (IsKeyPressed(KEY_JUMP) && GetPlayerSpecialAction(playerid) == SPECIAL_ACTION_CUFFED)
	{
		ApplyAnimation(playerid, "GYMNASIUM", "gym_jog_falloff", 4.1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0);// Prevent player from jumping while cuffed
		return true;
	}

	if (IsKeyPressed(KEY_ANALOG_DOWN))
	{
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
		if (vehicleID)
		{
			if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID] <= 1)
			{
				VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID] = sizeof(radioStations) - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID]--;
			}
			PlayRadioStation(playerid, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID]);
			return true;
		}
	}

	if (IsKeyPressed(KEY_ANALOG_UP))
	{
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
		if (vehicleID)
		{
			if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID] >= sizeof(radioStations) - 1)
			{
				VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID] = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID]++;
			}
			PlayRadioStation(playerid, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID]);
			return true;
		}
	}

	if (IsKeyPressed(KEY_ACTION))
	{
		if (IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerid))
		{
			TogglePlayerVehicleEngine(playerid);
			return true;
		}
	}

	if (IsKeyPressed(KEY_NO))
	{
		if (PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID])
		{
			CancelEdit(playerid);

			new arrayIndex = PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] - 1;

			new modelID = Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID);
			DestroyDynamicObject(PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID]);

			new fileName[STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME];
			new objectID = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ID];
			strcat(fileName, dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_FILENAME]);

			// Unset all enum variables in the object element
			Count(enumField, sizeof(dynamicObjects[]))
			{
				dynamicObjects[PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] - 1][enum_object:enumField] = 0;
			}

			SaveObjects(fileName);

			UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();
			SelectObject(playerid);

			SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:203("The object %d (%s) has been removed"), objectID, objectModels[modelID]);

			PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] = 0;

			return true;
		}
	}

	if (IsKeyPressed(KEY_WALK))
	{
		if (PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID])
		{
			AddObject(playerid, Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID), dynamicObjects[PVar:playerid[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] - 1][OBJECT_FILENAME], true);
			return true;
		}

		if (permissions[playerid][PERMISSION_MAPPER])
		{
			new pickupID = IsPlayerInPickup(playerid);
			if (pickupID != -1)
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` WHERE `pickupId` = '%d'", pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				if (mysql_num_rows())
				{
					PVar:playerid[SELECTEDPROPERTYID] = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
					SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:142("Property '%s' selected"), GetMySQLField("name"));
				}
				else
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:337("This pickup is not linked to a property!"));
				}
				mysql_free_result();

				return true;
			}
		}
	}

	if (IsKeyPressed(KEY_YES))
	{
		new pickupID = IsPlayerInPickup(playerid);
		if (pickupID != -1)
		{
			PickupEvent(playerid, pickupID, PICKUPEVENT_KEYPRESS);
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

OnPlayerLeftVehicle(playerID, vehicleID, isPassenger)

	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Callbacks/OnPlayerSpawn.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	This callback is called when a player spawns.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerid">
 *	The ID of the player which was spawned.
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	Returning false will force the player to enter class selection at the next respawn.
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	<title>The following task are done in this callback:</title>
 *	<item>If the player is a NPC: Set all required information like recording, teleporting place, etc.</item>
 *	<item>If the player spawns after login: Spawn the player at the save position and show the latest news</item>
 *	<item>If the player spawns after death: Spawn the player at the next hospital</item>
 *	<item>If nothing applies: Spawn the player at the default spawn</item>
 * </remarks>
 */

public OnPlayerSpawn(playerid)
{
	if (IsPlayerNPC(playerid))// The player is a NPC
	{
		new playerName[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
		GetPlayerName(playerid, playerName, sizeof(playerName));
		Foreach(arrayIndex, npcs)
		{
			if (!IsStr(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME], playerName))
			{
				continue;// This is not the connected NPC -> Jump to the next one in the array
			}

			SetPlayerSkin(playerid, npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SKIN]);

			new recordingType;
			if (npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLEID])
			{
				recordingType = PLAYER_RECORDING_TYPE_DRIVER;
				PutPlayerInVehicle(playerid, npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLEID], 0);
				SetVehicleEngineState(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLEID], true);
			}
			else
			{
				recordingType = PLAYER_RECORDING_TYPE_ONFOOT;
			}

			if (StrNotNull(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDING]))// Check if a recording is defined
			{
				FormatNew:command[100]("setrec %s %d %d %d %d", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDING], recordingType, npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOREPEAT], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOSTART], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_STARTDELAY]);
				SendNPCCommand(playerid, command);
			}

			if (npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0] || npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1] || npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2])// Check if a spawn position is defined
			{
				FormatNew:command[100]("teleport %f %f %f %f", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE]);
				SendNPCCommand(playerid, command);
			}

			break;
		}
		return true;
	}

	SetPlayerSkin(playerid, PVar:playerid[SKIN]);
	if (PVar:playerid[SHOWCLOCK])
	{
		TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, textDrawClock);
	}
	if (PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERLOGIN])// The player spawns after login
	{
		PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERLOGIN] = false;
		MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerid[USERID]);
		mysql_store_result();
		SetPlayerPosEx(playerid, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")), strval(GetMySQLField("interior")));
		SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid, floatstr(GetMySQLField("angle")));
		mysql_free_result();
		ShowNews(playerid, PVar:playerid[LASTNEWSID]);
		MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `friends` WHERE `userId2` = '%d' AND `accepted` = '0'", PVar:playerid[USERID]);
		mysql_store_result();
		new rows = mysql_num_rows();
		mysql_free_result();
		if (rows)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:498("There are %d friendship requests. Use /friendrequests to see them."), rows);
		}
		StartScreenFader(playerid, 0, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_LOGIN, 1);
		return true;
	}
	if (PVar:playerid[INTUTORIAL])// The player is currently in the tutorial
	{
		if (PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERTUTORIALSTART])// We have already seen the FADE_TUTORIAL_START screen fader
		{
			PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERTUTORIALSTART] = false;
			TogglePlayerControllable(playerid, false);
			TeleportToInterior(playerid, 138);
			InterpolateCameraPos(playerid, 315.8, 825.206, 1981.83, 315.075, 1035.86, 1939.33, 5000, CAMERA_CUT);
			InterpolateCameraLookAt(playerid, 313.852, 976.442, 1959.13, 316.852, 1082.44, 1925.13, 5000, CAMERA_CUT);
			StartScreenFader(playerid, 0, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_START_INPLANE1, 1);
			SetTimerEx("Timer_ScreenFader", 5000, false, "dddddddd", playerid, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_START_INPLANE2, 0);
		}
		return true;
	}
	if (PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERDEATH] != -1)// The player spawned after death
	{
		SetPlayerPosEx(playerid, pickups[PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERDEATH]][PICKUP_POSX], pickups[PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERDEATH]][PICKUP_POSY], pickups[PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERDEATH]][PICKUP_POSZ]);
		SetCameraBehindPlayer(playerid);
		PVar:playerid[SPAWNAFTERDEATH] = -1;
		PVar:playerid[CURRENTPROPERTYID] = 0;
		StartScreenFader(playerid, 100, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_DEATH, 1);
		return true;
	}
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Callbacks/OnPlayerStateChange.inc
================================================================================

public OnPlayerStateChange(playerid, newstate, oldstate)
{
	if (newstate != PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER && newstate != PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER && (oldstate == PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER || oldstate == PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER))
	{
		new isPassenger;
		if (oldstate == PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER)
		{
			isPassenger = true;
		}
		OnPlayerLeftVehicle(playerid, PVar:playerid[OLDVEHICLEID], isPassenger);
	}
	if (oldstate != PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER && oldstate != PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER && (newstate == PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER || newstate == PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER))
	{
		new isPassenger;
		if (newstate == PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER)
		{
			isPassenger = true;
		}
		if (!OnPlayerEnteredVehicle(playerid, GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid), isPassenger))
		{
			RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerid);
		}
	}
}

public OnPlayerUpdate(playerid)
{
	if (PVar:playerid[GODMODE])
	{
		SetPlayerHealth(playerid, 100);
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerid);
		if (vehicleID)
		{
			SetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, 1000);
		}
	}
	new Float:money = floatdiv(GetPlayerMoney(playerid), 100);
	if (money < PVar:playerid[MONEY])
	{
		PVar:playerid[MONEY] = money;
	}
	if (!IsAllowedWeapon(GetPlayerWeapon(playerid)))
	{
		MySQLBan(INVALID_PLAYER_ID, playerid, "Use not allowed weapon", true);
	}
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Callbacks/OnScreenFadeStop.inc
================================================================================

forward OnScreenFadeStop(playerID, extraID, subID, isTimer);
public OnScreenFadeStop(playerID, extraID, subID, isTimer)
{
	if (isTimer)
	{
		switch (extraID)
		{
			case FADE_START_INPLANE2:
			{
				if (!subID)
				{
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_START_INPLANE2, 1);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		switch (extraID)
		{
			case FADE_DEATH:
			{
				if (subID)
				{
					TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, true);
				}
				else
				{
					if (PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL])
					{
						PVar:playerID[SPAWNAFTERTUTORIALSTART] = true;
					}
					TogglePlayerSpectating(playerID, false);// Triggers OnPlayerSpawn
				}
			}
			case FADE_DRVSCHOOL_END1:
			{
				if (subID)
				{
					GameTextForPlayer(playerID, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:617("~y~Congratulation!~n~~n~You have finished the ~g~practical driving test~y~")), 5000, 3);
					SetTimerEx("Timer_ScreenFader", 3000, false, "dddddddd", playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_DRVSCHOOL_END2, 0);
				}
				else
				{
					RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerID);
					TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, false);
					SetPlayerCameraPos(playerID, -2011.800415, -75.216079, 43.945693);
					SetPlayerCameraLookAt(playerID, -2063.461914, -118.374504, 35.326580);
					SetVehicleToRespawn(PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_VEHICLEID]);
					PVar:playerID[CPMISSION_ID] = 0;
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_DRVSCHOOL_END1, 1);
				}
			}
			case FADE_DRVSCHOOL_END2:
			{
				if (subID)
				{
					TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, true);
				}
				else
				{
					SetCameraBehindPlayer(playerID);
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_DRVSCHOOL_END2, 1);
				}
			}
			case FADE_DRVSCHOOL_ENTER:
			{
				if (subID)
				{
					ShowMessage(playerID, 21, 3000);
				}
				else
				{
					SetPlayerPosEx(playerID, -2033.434570, -118.057067, 1035.171875, 3);
					SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, 91.393058);
					SetPlayerCameraPos(playerID, -2033.146972, -115.889007, 1035.516235);
					SetPlayerCameraLookAt(playerID, -2034.402221, -119.476028, 1035.278808);
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_DRVSCHOOL_ENTER, 1);
				}
			}
			case FADE_DRVSCHOOL_EXIT:
			{
				if (subID)
				{
					TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, true);
				}
				else
				{
					SetPlayerPosEx(playerID, -2026.202636, -100.276840, 35.164062, 0);
					SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, 360.0);
					SetCameraBehindPlayer(playerID);
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, -5, 0, FADE_DRVSCHOOL_EXIT, 1);
				}
			}
			case FADE_DRVSCHOOL_STARTDRIVING:
			{
				if (subID)
				{
					switch (PVar:playerID[DRIVINGSCHOOL_TYPE])
					{
						case DRIVINGSCHOOL_BIKE:
						{
							SetPlayerCheckpointEx(playerID, CHECKPOINT_DRVSCHOOL_VEHICLE, -2079.003417, -89.092414, 35.164062, 1.5);
						}
						case DRIVINGSCHOOL_CAR:
						{
							SetPlayerCheckpointEx(playerID, CHECKPOINT_DRVSCHOOL_VEHICLE, -2067.854492, -88.841735, 35.164062, 1.5);
						}
						case DRIVINGSCHOOL_TRUCK:
						{

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Callbacks/OnServerTimeChange.inc
================================================================================

OnServerTimeChange(hour, minute, changeType)
{
	switch (changeType)
	{
		case TIMECHANGE_HOUR:
		{
			SetWorldTime(hour);
			gasPrice = float(GASSTATION_MINPRICE + random(GASSTATION_MAXDIFFERENCE)) / 100;
			printf("Updated gas price to $%s", FormatMoney(gasPrice));
		}
		case TIMECHANGE_MINUTE:
		{
			FormatNew:string[16]("%02d:%02d", hour, minute);
			TextDrawSetString(textDrawClock, string);
			Format:string("worldtime %s", string);
			SendRconCommand(string);
		}
	}
}

public OnVehicleDeath(vehicleid, killerid)
{
	RemoveVehicleLightObjects(vehicleid);
	DestroyVehicle(vehicleid);
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleid[SAVEID])
	{
		MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `vehicles` WHERE `id` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleid[SAVEID]);
		MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `vehiclecomponents` WHERE `vehicleId` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleid[SAVEID]);
	}
	Foreach(enumIndex, vehicles[])
	{
		vehicles[vehicleid - 1][enum_vehicle:enumIndex] = 0;
	}
}

public OnVehicleMod(playerid, vehicleid, componentid)

}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Add the specified player as a friend or accept a friend request from the specified player.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which called the command.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="params">
 *	<title>The parameters passed to this command.</title>
 *	<item>ID or name of the player which should be added or accepted</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item>COMMAND_ERROR</item>
 *	<item>COMMAND_OK</item>
 *	<item>COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND</item>
 *	<item>COMMAND_USAGE</item>
 * </returns>
 */

CMD:addfriend(playerID, params[], StringID:439("Add a player to your friend list"))
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	if (sscanf(params, "u", targetPlayerID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "addfriend", "Playername/ID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	if (targetPlayerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID || !IsLoggedIn(targetPlayerID))
	{
		return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
	}
	if (playerID == targetPlayerID)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:445("You can not add yourself as a friend!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	new alreadyInList;
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `friends` WHERE (`userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d') OR (`userId2` = '%d' AND `userId1` = '%d')", PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	alreadyInList = mysql_num_rows();
	mysql_free_result();
	if (alreadyInList)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:440("%p is already in your friend list!"), targetPlayerID);
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `friends` (`userId1`, `userId2`) VALUES('%d', '%d')", PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
	SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:443("%p wants to add you to his/her friend list. Use /friendrequests to accept or decline."), playerID, playerID);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:444("The friend request has been sent to %p"), targetPlayerID);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/addhotelroom.inc

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Add a room to the current property.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which called the command.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="params">
 *	<title>The parameters passed to this command.</title>
 *	<item>The price for the room</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item>COMMAND_ERROR</item>
 *	<item>COMMAND_OK</item>
 *	<item>COMMAND_USAGE</item>
 * </returns>
 */

PCMD:addhotelroom[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:323("Add a new hotel room to the current hotel"))
{
	new validHotel;
	if (PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID])
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` LEFT JOIN `pickups` ON `properties`.`pickupId` = `pickups`.`id` WHERE `properties`.`id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID]);
		mysql_store_result();
		validHotel = !strcmp(GetMySQLField("type"), "HOTEL", true);
		mysql_free_result();
	}
	if (!validHotel)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:324("You are not in a hotel!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	new Float:price;
	if (sscanf(params, "f", price))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "addhotelroom", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:298("Price")));
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	MySQLQuery("SELECT IFNULL(MAX(roomId), 0) AS `highestRoomId` FROM `hotelrooms` WHERE `propertyId` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	new roomID = strval(GetMySQLField("highestRoomId")) + 1;
	mysql_free_result();
	MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `hotelrooms` (`propertyId`, `roomId`, `price`) VALUES('%d', '%d', '%f')", PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID], roomID, price);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:325("The hotel room (%d) has been created"), roomID);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

PCMD:addinfopickup[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:588("Add an info pickup"))
{
	new stringID;
	if (sscanf(params, "d", stringID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "addinfopickup", "StringID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	if (stringID <= 0)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:587("The ID must be positive!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `pickups` (`posX`, `posY`, `posZ`, `type`) VALUES('%f', '%f', '%f', 'INFO')", posX, posY, posZ);
	new pickupID = mysql_insert_id();
	if (pickupID)
	{
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `infopickups` (`pickupId`, `stringId`) VALUES('%d', '%d')", pickupID, stringID);
		if (AddPickup(pickupID, "INFO", posX, posY, posZ))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:57("The pickup %s has been saved with ID %d"), "INFO", pickupID);
			return COMMAND_OK;
		}
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:6("Error while creating the pickup!"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/addmissioncheckpoint.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Add a new mission checkpoint to a mission group.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="params">
 *	The name of the mission group
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item name="COMMAND_ERROR">An error occured while processing the command (e.g. unable to insert record to database)</item>
 *	<item name="COMMAND_OK">The checkpoint has been added successfully</item>
 *	<item name="COMMAND_USAGE">Usage message has been shown to the player</item>
 * </returns>
 */

PCMD:addmissioncheckpoint[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:614("Add a new mission checkpoint to a mission group"))
{
	if (!StrNotNull(params))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "addmissioncheckpoint", "MissionGroup");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	new missionID;
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `missioncheckpointgroups` WHERE `name` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(params));
	mysql_store_result();
	if (mysql_num_rows())
	{
		missionID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!missionID)
	{
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `missioncheckpointgroups` (`name`) VALUES('%s')", MySQLEscapeString(params));
		missionID = mysql_insert_id();
	}
	if (!missionID)
	{
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	MySQLQuery("SELECT MAX(`checkpointId`) AS `maxId` FROM `missioncheckpoints` WHERE `missionId` = '%d'", missionID);
	mysql_store_result();
	new checkpointID = strval(GetMySQLField("maxId")) + 1;
	mysql_free_result();
	MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `missioncheckpoints` (`missionId`, `checkpointId`, `posX`, `posY`, `posZ`) VALUES('%d', '%d', '%f', '%f', '%f')", missionID, checkpointID, posX, posY, posZ);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:615("Checkpoint %d has been added to the mission group '%s'"), checkpointID, params);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/addobject.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:addobject[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:202("Add a new object"))
{
	new modelID;
	new filename[STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME];
	if (!sscanf(params, "ds[" #STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME "]", modelID, filename))
	{
		if (modelID >= 0 && modelID < sizeof(objectModels) && StrNotNull(objectModels[modelID]))
		{
			AddObject(playerID, modelID, filename);
			return COMMAND_OK;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:427("Object not found!"));
			return COMMAND_ERROR;
		}
	}

	new modelName[100];
	if (sscanf(params, "s[100]s[" #STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME "]", modelName, filename))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "addobject", "modelID/ModelName", "Filename");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	new count;
	new objectList[2048];
	Foreach(currentModelID, objectModels)
	{
		if (strfind(objectModels[currentModelID], modelName, true) != -1)
		{
			if (strlen(objectList))
			{
				strcat(objectList, "\n");
			}
			Format:objectList("%s%d\t%s", objectList, currentModelID, objectModels[currentModelID]);
			modelID = currentModelID;

			count++;
			if (count >= 50)// Only show max 50 objects
			{
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	if (!count)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:427("Object not found!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	if (count > 1)
	{
		format(PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_FILENAME], PVAR_OBJEDITOR_FILENAME, "%s", filename);
		CreateDialog(playerID, "AddObject", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:202("Add a new object")), objectList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:170("Create")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
	}
	else
	{
		AddObject(playerID, modelID, filename);
	}

	return COMMAND_OK;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/addpickup.inc

PCMD:addpickup[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:96("Create a pickup"))
{
	new type[256];
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	if (sscanf(params, "s[256]", type))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "addpickup", "Type");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	type = strtoupper(type);
	if (IsValidPickupType(type))
	{
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `pickups` (`posX`, `posY`, `posZ`, `type`) VALUES('%f', '%f', '%f', '%s')", posX, posY, posZ, type);
		new pickupID = mysql_insert_id();
		if (pickupID)
		{
			if (AddPickup(pickupID, type, posX, posY, posZ))
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:57("The pickup %s has been saved with ID %d"), type, pickupID);
				return COMMAND_OK;
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:6("Error while creating the pickup!"));
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:6("Error while creating the pickup!"));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:58("Invalid type!"));
	}
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

PCMD:addspeedcam[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:486("Add a speed camera"))
{
	new speedLimit;
	if (sscanf(params, "d", speedLimit))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "addspeedcam", "SpeedLimit");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	new speedCamerasSlot = -1;
	Foreach(arrayIndex, speedCameras)
	{
		if (!speedCameras[arrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID])
		{
			speedCamerasSlot = arrayIndex;
			break;
		}
	}

	if (speedCamerasSlot == -1)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:633("Limit of %d speed cameras reached! Increase MAX_SPEEDCAMERAS to add more speed cameras."), sizeof(speedCameras));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	new objectID = AddObject(playerID, SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTMODEL, "speedcameras");
	if (objectID)
	{
		speedCameras[speedCamerasSlot][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID] = objectID;
		speedCameras[speedCamerasSlot][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT] = speedLimit;

		SaveObjects("speedcameras");

		return COMMAND_OK;
	}

	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

		ConnectNPC(npcName, NPC_SCRIPTNAME);
		SaveNPCs();

		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:2("The NPC has been added"));
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:4("No more free NPC slots available! Increase MAX_NPCS and try again"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/alias.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Create or remove an user command alias.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which executed the command.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="params">
 *	<title>The passed parameters</title>
 *	<item name="Name">The name for the alias</item>
 *	<item name="Command">The command which should be aliased (Omit to remove the alias)</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	An already existing alias will be replaced with the new alias (If the command parameter was not omitted).
 * </remarks>
 */

CMD:alias(playerID, params[], StringID:515("Create or remove a command alias"))
{
	new name[32];
	new command[256];
	if (sscanf(params, "s[32]s[256]", name, command))
	{
		if (sscanf(params, "s[32]", name))
		{
			CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "alias", "Name", "Command");
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:540("Command is the command without the slash ( / )!"));
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:541("Example usage: %s"), "/alias inf spawnvehicle infernus");
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:516("Use /alias <name> to remove an alias."));
			return COMMAND_USAGE;
		}
		MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `cmdaliases` WHERE `userId` = '%d' AND `name` = '%s'", PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(name));
		if (mysql_affected_rows())
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:518("The alias /%s has been removed"), name);
			return COMMAND_OK;
		}
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:519("Alias /%s not found!"), name);
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	MySQLQuery("REPLACE INTO `cmdaliases` (`userId`, `name`, `command`) VALUES('%d', '%s', '%s')", PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(name), MySQLEscapeString(command));
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:517("The alias /%s has been created"), name);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

PCMD:checkpermissions[ADMIN](playerid, params[], StringID:99("Show the permissions of yourself or another player"))
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	new string[1024];
	if (sscanf(params, "u", targetPlayerID))
	{
		targetPlayerID = playerid;
	}
	if (IsPlayerConnected(targetPlayerID))
	{
		for (new permission = 0; permission < sizeof(permissions[]); permission++)
		{
			if (permissions[targetPlayerID][enum_permission:permission])
			{
				if (strlen(string))
				{
					Format:string("%s, ", string);
				}
				strcat(string, GetPermissionName(permission));
			}
		}
		if (targetPlayerID == playerid)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:59("You have the following permissions: %s"), string);
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerid, COLOR_INFO, StringID:60("%p has the following permissions: %s"), targetPlayerID, string);
		}
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	else
	{
		return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/cmds.inc
================================================================================

CMD:cmds(playerID, params[], StringID:93("Show a list with command"))
{
	if (fexist(FILE_COMMANDS))
	{
		new string[256];
		new File:file = fopen(FILE_COMMANDS, io_read);
		while (fread(file, string))
		{
			new command[MAX_FUNCTION_NAME];
			new languageStringID;
			new permission[30];
			RemoveNewLine(string);
			if (sscanf(string, "p<\t>s[" #MAX_FUNCTION_NAME "]s[30]d", command, permission, languageStringID))
			{
				if (sscanf(string, "p<\t>s[" #MAX_FUNCTION_NAME "]d", command, languageStringID))
				{
					continue;
				}
			}
			new showCommand;
			if (strlen(permission))
			{
				new permissionID = GetPermissionByName(permission);
				if (permissionID != -1)
				{
					if (permissions[playerID][enum_permission:permissionID])
					{
						showCommand = true;
						Format:command("{A00000}/%s", command);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				showCommand = true;
				Format:command("{00FF00}/%s", command);
			}
			if (showCommand)
			{
				Format:string("%s{FF8C55} - %s", command, LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID));
				SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, string);
			}
		}
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:522("Tip: Use /alias to create an alias of a command"));
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	else
	{
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/cuff.inc
================================================================================

CMD:cuff(playerID, params[], StringID:554("Cuff a player"))
{
	if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] == JOB_POLICE || PVar:playerID[JOBID] == JOB_GOVERMENT || PVar:playerID[JOBID] == JOB_ARMEE)
	{
		new targetPlayerID;
		if (sscanf(params, "u", targetPlayerID))
		{
			CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "cuff", "playerID/Name");
			return COMMAND_USAGE;
		}
		if (targetPlayerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
		{
			return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
		}
		new Float:posX;
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		if (IsPlayerInRangeOfPoint(targetPlayerID, 1, posX, posY, posZ))
		{
			if (GetPlayerSpecialAction(targetPlayerID) == SPECIAL_ACTION_CUFFED)
			{
				SetPlayerSpecialAction(targetPlayerID, SPECIAL_ACTION_NONE);
				RemovePlayerAttachedObject(targetPlayerID, 0);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:557("%p has been released"), targetPlayerID);
			}
			else
			{
				SetPlayerSpecialAction(targetPlayerID, SPECIAL_ACTION_CUFFED);
				SetPlayerAttachedObject(targetPlayerID, 0, 19418, 6, -0.011000, 0.028000, -0.022000, -15.600012, -33.699977, -81.700035, 0.891999, 1.000000, 1.168000);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:555("%p has been cuffed"), targetPlayerID);
			}
			return COMMAND_OK;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:556("%p is not in range!"), targetPlayerID);
			return COMMAND_ERROR;
		}
	}
	return COMMAND_PERMISSION_DENIED;
}

PCMD:editobject[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:201("Edit an object"))
{
	new objectID;
	if (sscanf(params, "d", objectID))
	{
		SelectObject(playerID);
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}

	if (objectID <= 0 || objectID > CountDynamicObjects() || Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID) != OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:427("Object not found!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	GetDynamicObjectPos(objectID, posX, posY, posZ);
	OnPlayerSelectDynamicObject(playerID, objectID, Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID), posX, posY, posZ);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/givelicense.inc
================================================================================

CMD:givelicense(playerID, params[], StringID:511("Give license to a player"))// TODO: No permission check!
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	new licenseString[256];
	if (sscanf(params, "us[256]", targetPlayerID, licenseString))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "givelicense", "PlayerID/Name", "Bike|Boat|Car|Plane|Truck");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	new licenseArray[30][30];
	new license[30];
	explode(licenseString, licenseArray, ',', sizeof(licenseArray));
	for (new licenseIndex = 0; licenseIndex < sizeof(licenseArray); licenseIndex++)
	{
		license = licenseArray[licenseIndex];
		new newState = true;
		if (license[0] == '-')
		{
			strdel(license, 0, 1);
			newState = false;
		}
		if (strlen(license))
		{
			if (GiveLicense(playerID, targetPlayerID, license, newState))
			{
				if (newState)
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:513("You got a %l!"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:535("You gave a %l to %p"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license), targetPlayerID);
				}
				else
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:537("Your %l has been revoked!"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:536("You revoked the %l from %p!"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license), targetPlayerID);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (newState)
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:512("%p already owns that license (%l)!"), targetPlayerID, GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
				}
				else
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:538("%p does not own a %l!"), targetPlayerID, GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/givepermission.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:givepermission[SERVERADMIN](playerID, params[], StringID:103("Give permissions to a player"))
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	new permissionString[16];
	if (sscanf(params, "us[16]", targetPlayerID, permissionString))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "givepermission", "PlayerID/Name", "Admin|Mapper|Moderator|Navi|NPCAdmin|ServerAdmin|SpawnVehicle|Teleport");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	if (IsPlayerConnected(targetPlayerID))
	{
		new permissionsArray[30][30];
		new permission[30];
		explode(permissionString, permissionsArray, ',', sizeof(permissionsArray));
		for (new permissionIndex = 0; permissionIndex < sizeof(permissionsArray); permissionIndex++)
		{
			permission = permissionsArray[permissionIndex];
			if (strcmp(permission, "userId", true))
			{
				new newState = true;
				if (permission[0] == '-')
				{
					strdel(permission, 0, 1);
					newState = false;
				}
				new permissionID = GetPermissionByName(permission);
				if (permissionID == -1)
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:381("Invalid permission: %s"), permission);
				}
				else
				{
					if (permissions[targetPlayerID][enum_permission:permissionID] == newState)
					{
						if (newState)
						{
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:70("%p already has the permission '%s'!"), targetPlayerID, permission);
						}
						else
						{
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:71("%p does not have the permission '%s' so it can not be removed!"), targetPlayerID, permission);
						}
						return COMMAND_ERROR;
					}
					MySQLQuery("SELECT `userId` FROM `permissions` WHERE `userId` = '%d'", PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
					mysql_store_result();
					new rows = mysql_num_rows();
					mysql_free_result();
					if (rows)
					{
						MySQLQuery("UPDATE `permissions` SET `%s` = '%d' WHERE `userId` = '%d'", MySQLEscapeString(permission), newState, PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
					}
					else
					{
						MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `permissions` (`userId`, `%s`) VALUES('%d', '%d')", MySQLEscapeString(permission), PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], newState);
					}
					permissions[targetPlayerID][enum_permission:permissionID] = newState;
					if (newState)
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:72("You got the permission '%s' from %p"), permission, playerID);
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:73("You gave the permission '%s' to %p"), permission, targetPlayerID);
						printf("%s got permission %s by %s", GetPlayerNameEx(targetPlayerID), permission, GetPlayerNameEx(playerID));
					}
					else
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:74("%p has revoked the permission '%s' from you"), playerID, permission);
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:75("You have revoked the permission '%s' from %p"), permission, targetPlayerID);
						printf("%s has revoked the permission %s of %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), permission, GetPlayerNameEx(targetPlayerID));
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	else
	{
		return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
	}
}

CMD:lockvehicle(playerID, params[], StringID:483("Lock or unlock a vehicle"))
{
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		new Float:posX;
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		vehicleID = GetClosestVehicleInRange(posX, posY, posZ, 5);
		if (!vehicleID)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:288("There is no vehicle in range!"));
			return COMMAND_ERROR;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
	{
		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] != PVar:playerID[USERID])
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:487("You are not the owner of this vehicle!"));
			return COMMAND_ERROR;
		}
	}
	else
	{
		if (!permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_MAPPER])
		{
			return COMMAND_PERMISSION_DENIED;
		}
	}
	if (IsVehicleLocked(vehicleID))
	{
		LockVehicle(vehicleID, false);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:485("The vehicle has been unlocked!"));
	}
	else
	{
		LockVehicle(vehicleID, true);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:484("The vehicle has been locked!"));
	}
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

PCMD:markobject[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:426("Mark an object on your map"))
{
	new objectID;
	if (sscanf(params, "d", objectID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "markobject", "objectID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	if (objectID <= 0 || objectID > CountDynamicObjects() || Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID) != OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:427("Object not found!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	SetPlayerMapIcon(playerID, 0, dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_POS][0], dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_POS][1], dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_POS][2], 0, COLOR_MARKER_OBJECT, MAPICON_GLOBAL);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/markobjects.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:markobjects[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:482("Mark up to 100 objects on your map"))
{
	new modelID;
	if (sscanf(params, "d", modelID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "markobjects", "ModelID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	new count;
	new dynamicObjectsCount = CountDynamicObjects();
	new Float:foundObjects[100][3];
	Count(arrayIndex, dynamicObjectsCount)
	{
		if (Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, arrayIndex + 1, E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID) == modelID)
		{
			foundObjects[count][0] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0];
			foundObjects[count][1] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1];
			foundObjects[count][2] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2];
			count++;
			if (count >= 100)
			{
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	if (count)
	{
		Count(iconID, 100)
		{
			RemovePlayerMapIcon(playerID, iconID);
		}

		Count(iconID, count)
		{
			SetPlayerMapIcon(playerID, iconID, foundObjects[iconID][0], foundObjects[iconID][1], foundObjects[iconID][2], 0, COLOR_MARKER_OBJECT, MAPICON_GLOBAL);
		}

		return COMMAND_OK;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:425("No object found!"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/moveobjects.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:moveobjects[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:636("Move all objects by the given coordinates in the given objects file"))
{
	new fileName[STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME];
	new Float:x;
	new Float:y;
	new Float:z;

	if (sscanf(params, "s[" #STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME "]fff", fileName, x, y, z))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "moveobjects", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:634("Filename")), "X", "Y", "Z");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	new count;
	Foreach(arrayIndex, dynamicObjects)
	{
		if (!strcmp(dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_FILENAME], fileName, true))
		{
			dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0] + x;
			dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1] + y;
			dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2] + z;
			SetDynamicObjectPos(arrayIndex + 1, dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2]);
			count++;
		}
	}

	UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:635("%d objects were moved"), count);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

PCMD:nextinterior[TELEPORT](playerID, params[], StringID:402("Teleport to the next interior"))
{
	new interiorID;
	sscanf(params, "d", interiorID);
	if (interiorID)
	{
		PVar:playerID[CURRENTINTERIOR] = interiorID;
	}
	else
	{
		PVar:playerID[CURRENTINTERIOR]++;
	}
	if (!TeleportToInterior(playerID, PVar:playerID[CURRENTINTERIOR]))
	{
		TeleportToInterior(playerID, 1);
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:405("You are now in interior %d"), PVar:playerID[CURRENTINTERIOR]);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

PCMD:nocamproperty[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:350("Teleport you to the next property without camera position"))
{
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` LEFT JOIN `pickups` ON `properties`.`pickupId` = `pickups`.`id` WHERE `cameraPosX` = '0' AND `cameraPosY` = '0' AND `cameraPosZ` = '0'");
	mysql_store_result();
	new rows = mysql_num_rows();
	if (rows)
	{
		SetPlayerPos(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")));
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:351("You got teleported to the next property (%s). There are %d properties without a camera position."), GetMySQLField("name"), rows);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (rows)
	{
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:352("There are no more properties without camera position!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/npccmd.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Command which gets called by a NPC if something changed.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which called the command.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="params">
 *	The parameters passed to this command.
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item>COMMAND_OK if the command is valid</item>
 *	<item>COMMAND_ERROR if the command is invalid</item>
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	This command can only be called by NPCs!
 * </remarks>
 */

NCMD:npccmd(playerID, params[], StringID:9("Report status to the server"))
{
	new command[256];
	new parameters[256];
	sscanf(params, "s[256]s[256]", command, parameters);

	new npcName[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
	GetPlayerName(playerID, npcName, sizeof(npcName));

	Foreach(arrayIndex, npcs)
	{
		if (IsStr(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME], npcName))
		{
			if (IsStr(command, "reclength"))
			{
				npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDINGLENGTH] = strval(parameters);
				return COMMAND_OK;
			}
			break;
		}
	}

	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

CMD:relogin(playerID, params[], StringID:507("Relogin with your current name or a new name"))
{
	if (!StrNotNull(params))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "relogin", "Playername");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	new checkPlayerID = GetPlayerID(params);
	if (checkPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID && checkPlayerID != playerID)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:508("Another player with this name is already connected!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	OnPlayerDisconnect(playerID, 3);
	if (SetPlayerName(playerID, params) == -1)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:509("Your name could not be changed! Your old name will be used."));
	}
	ForceClassSelection(playerID);
	TogglePlayerSpectating(playerID, true);
	TogglePlayerSpectating(playerID, false);
	OnPlayerConnect(playerID);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

CMD:removefriend(playerID, params[], StringID:446("Remove a player from your friend list"))
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	if (sscanf(params, "u", targetPlayerID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "removefriend", "Playername/ID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	if (targetPlayerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID || !IsLoggedIn(targetPlayerID))
	{
		return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
	}
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `friends` WHERE (`userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d') OR (`userId2` = '%d' AND `userId1` = '%d')", PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	new isInList = mysql_num_rows();
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!isInList)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:447("%p is not in your friendlist!"), targetPlayerID);
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `friends` WHERE (`userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d') OR (`userId2` = '%d' AND `userId1` = '%d')", PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:448("%p has been removed from your friend list"), targetPlayerID);
	SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:449("%p has removed you from his/her friend list"), playerID);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

PCMD:removevehicle[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:455("Remove the current vehicle from the database"))
{
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		return COMMAND_NOT_IN_VEHICLE;
	}
	if (!VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:456("This vehicle is not a saved vehicle!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `vehiclecomponents` WHERE `vehicleId` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID]);
	MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `vehicles` WHERE `id` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID]);

	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID] = 0;
	DestroyVehicle(vehicleID);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:457("The vehicle has been removed"));
	return COMMAND_OK;

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/saveinfo.inc
================================================================================

CMD:saveinfo(playerID, params[], StringID:450("Save information like your current position, skin or vehicle model ID"))
{
	new File:file;
	new lines[2048];
	new year;
	new month;
	new day;
	new hour;
	new minute;
	new second;
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:angle;
	new Float:frontVectorX;
	new Float:frontVectorY;
	new Float:frontVectorZ;
	getdate(year, month, day);
	gettime(hour, minute, second);
	AddLine:lines("Player: %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID));
	AddLine:lines("Date: %d/%02d/%02d %02d:%02d:%02d", year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
	GetPlayerCameraPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	GetPlayerCameraFrontVector(playerID, frontVectorX, frontVectorY, frontVectorZ);
	new Float:lookX = floatadd(posX, frontVectorX);
	new Float:lookY = floatadd(posY, frontVectorY);
	new Float:lookZ = floatadd(posZ, frontVectorZ);
	AddLine:lines("Camera Position: %f x %f x %f", posX, posY, posZ);
	AddLine:lines("Camera Look: %f x %f x %f", lookX, lookY, lookZ);
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (vehicleID)
	{
		AddLine(lines, "Mode: Vehicle");
		AddLine:lines("ModelID: %d", GetVehicleModel(vehicleID));
		GetVehiclePos(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
		GetVehicleZAngle(vehicleID, angle);
		AddLine:lines("Vehicle Position: %f x %f x %f", posX, posY, posZ);
		AddLine:lines("Z Angle: %f", angle);
	}
	else
	{
		AddLine(lines, "Mode: On Foot");
		AddLine:lines("Skin: %d", GetPlayerSkin(playerID));
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
		AddLine:lines("Player Position: %f x %f x %f", posX, posY, posZ);
		AddLine:lines("Facing Angle: %f", angle);
	}
	if (StrNotNull(params))
	{
		AddLine:lines("Comment: %s", params);
	}
	file = fopen(FILE_SAVEINFO, io_readwrite);
	if (file)
	{
		if (flength(file))
		{
			Format:lines("\n\n%s", lines);
		}
		fseek(file, 0, seek_end);
		fwrite(file, lines);
		fclose(file);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:451("The information has been saved to the file '%s' on the server"), FILE_SAVEINFO);
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:452("Error while writing the file!"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		return COMMAND_NOT_IN_VEHICLE;
	}
	if (!CheckVehiclePermission(playerID, vehicleID, false))
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:487("You are not the owner of this vehicle!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	ShowDialog:SellVehicle(playerID);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================

PCMD:setnpcspawn[NPCADMIN](playerID, params[], StringID:282("Set the spawn position of a NPC"))
{
	new npcName[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
	if (sscanf(params, "s[" #MAX_PLAYER_NAME "]", npcName))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "setnpcspawn", "Name");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	Foreach(arrayIndex, npcs)
	{
		if (!IsStr(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME], npcName))
		{
			continue;
		}

		GetPlayerPos(playerID, npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2]);
		if (IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerID))
		{
			GetVehicleZAngle(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID), npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE]);
		}
		else
		{
			GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE]);
		}

		SaveNPCs();

		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:283("The spawn position of the NPC has been changed"));
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:284("NPC not found!"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

================================================================================

PCMD:setobjectmovepos[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:463("Set the position and rotation for the current selected object to move to"))
{
	if (!PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID])
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:464("No object selected! Select the object using /editobject and move it to the position you want."));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	if (Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID) != OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:200("The object is not a streamed object or is already used in another way!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	new Float:speed;
	new timeout;
	if (sscanf(params, "fd", speed, timeout))
	{
		if (sscanf(params, "f", speed))
		{
			CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "setobjectmovepos", "Speed", "[Timeout]");
			return COMMAND_USAGE;
		}
	}

	new arrayIndex = PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] - 1;
	new Float:position[3];
	new Float:rotation[3];
	GetDynamicObjectPos(PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], position[0], position[1], position[2]);
	GetDynamicObjectRot(PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2]);

	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS] = position;
	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT] = rotation;
	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED] = speed;
	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVETIMEOUT] = timeout;

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:465("The target position has been saved. You can test the movement using /moveobject %d 1."), PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID]);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/spawnvehicle.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:spawnvehicle[SPAWNVEHICLE](playerID, params[], StringID:505("Spawn a vehicle"))
{
	new vehicleName[20];
	new modelID;
	new color1;
	new color2;
	if (sscanf(params, "ddd", modelID, color1, color2))
	{
		if (!sscanf(params, "d", modelID))
		{
			color1 = -1;
			color2 = -1;
		}
		else
		{
			if (sscanf(params, "s[20]dd", vehicleName, color1, color2))
			{
				if (sscanf(params, "s[20]", vehicleName))
				{
					CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "spawnvehicle", "ModelID/Name/t:Type", "[Color1]", "[Color2]");
					return COMMAND_USAGE;
				}
				else
				{
					color1 = -1;
					color2 = -1;
				}
			}
			new type;
			new parameter[16];
			new vehicleList[2048];
			new foundVehicles;
			if (sscanf(vehicleName, "p<:>cs[16]", type, parameter))
			{
				Foreach(arrayIndex, vehicleModels)
				{
					if (strfind(vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME], vehicleName, true) != -1)
					{
						AddLine:vehicleList("%d\t%s", arrayIndex + 400, vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
						foundVehicles++;
						modelID = arrayIndex + 400;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (type)
				{
					case 't':
					{
						Foreach(arrayIndex, vehicleModels)
						{
							if (IsStr(vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], parameter))
							{
								AddLine:vehicleList("%d\t%s", arrayIndex + 400, vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
								foundVehicles++;
								modelID = arrayIndex + 400;
							}
						}
					}
					default:
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:58("Invalid type!"));
						return COMMAND_ERROR;
					}
				}
			}
			if (foundVehicles > 1)
			{
				PVar:playerID[SPAWNVEHICLE_COLOR1] = color1;
				PVar:playerID[SPAWNVEHICLE_COLOR2] = color2;
				FormatNew:title[64](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:122("Spawn a vehicle [%s]")), vehicleName);
				CreateDialog(playerID, "SpawnVehicle", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, vehicleList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:205("Spawn")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
				modelID = -1;
			}
		}
	}
	if (modelID == -1)
	{
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	if (SpawnVehicle(playerID, modelID, color1, color2, true))
	{
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Commands/tow.inc
================================================================================

CMD:tow(playerID, params[], StringID:285("Tow vehicle"))
{
	if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] == JOB_ADAC)
	{
		if (IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerID))
		{
			new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
			if (GetVehicleModel(vehicleID) == 525)
			{
				if (IsTrailerAttachedToVehicle(vehicleID))
				{
					DetachTrailerFromVehicle(vehicleID);
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:289("Vehicle dettached"));
					return COMMAND_OK;
				}
				else
				{
					new Float:posX;
					new Float:posY;
					new Float:posZ;
					GetVehiclePos(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
					new trailerVehicleID = GetClosestVehicleInRange(posX, posY, posZ, 10.0, vehicleID);
					if (trailerVehicleID == INVALID_VEHICLE_ID)
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:288("There is no vehicle in range!"));
						return COMMAND_ERROR;
					}
					else
					{
						AttachTrailerToVehicle(trailerVehicleID, vehicleID);
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:290("Vehicle attached"));
						return COMMAND_OK;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:286("You have to be in a TowTruck!"));
				return COMMAND_ERROR;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			return COMMAND_NOT_IN_VEHICLE;
		}
	}
	else 
	{
		return COMMAND_PERMISSION_DENIED;
	}
}

ShowDialog:ADAC_Options(playerID)
{
	new options[1024];
	if (PVar:playerID[ATWORK])
	{
		AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:356("End work")));
	}
	else
	{
		AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work")));
	}
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("Order Vehicle")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "ADAC_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:353("Vehicle dealer")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:ADAC_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:356("End work"))))// End work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = false;
			new time = gettime() - PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME];
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:360("You have ended your working day. Worked hours: %d"), time / 60 / 60);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work"))))// Start work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = true;
			PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME] = gettime();
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, 187);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job"))))// Cancel job
		{
			PVar:playerID[JOBID] = JOB_UNEMPLOYED;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:359("You have cancelled your job"));
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, PVar:playerID[SKIN]);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("OrderVehicle"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:OrderVehicle(playerID);
		}
	}
}

ShowDialog:AddNaviLocation_Type(playerID)
{
	new options[2048];
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `navigationlocationtypes`");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new string[256];
		strcat(string, GetMySQLField("name"));
		new checkCharacter;
		new languageStringID;
		if (!sscanf(string, "p<:>cd", checkCharacter, languageStringID))
		{
			if (checkCharacter == 'L')
			{
				Format:string(LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID));
			}
		}
		AddLine(options, string);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:378("Add new type")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "AddNaviLocation_Type", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:377("Select location type")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:AddNaviLocation_Type(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:378("Add new type"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:AddNaviLocation_NewType(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			new typeID = GetNavigationLocationTypeByName(playerID, inputText);
			if (typeID)
			{
				new Float:posX;
				new Float:posY;
				new Float:posZ;
				GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
				MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `navigationlocations` (`type`, `posX`, `posY`, `posZ`) VALUES('%d', '%f', '%f', '%f')", typeID, posX, posY, posZ);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:383("The location has been added"));
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:143("An error occurred while processing the command!"));
			}
		}
	}
}

================================================================================

ShowDialog:AddProperty_Name(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "AddProperty_Name", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:168("Enter name")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:169("Enter the name for the property.")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:170("Create")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:AddProperty_Name(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new Float:posX;
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `pickups` (`posX`, `posY`, `posZ`, `type`) VALUES('%f', '%f', '%f', '%s')", posX, posY, posZ, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE]);
		new pickupID = mysql_insert_id();
		if (pickupID)
		{
			if (AddPickup(pickupID, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], posX, posY, posZ))
			{
				MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `properties` (`pickupId`, `interiorId`, `name`, `price`) VALUES ('%d', '%d', '%s', '%f')", pickupID, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_INTERIORID], MySQLEscapeString(inputText), PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_PRICE]);
				new propertyID = mysql_insert_id();
				if (IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "BANK"))
				{
					MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `bankbranches` (`propertyId`, `bankId`) SELECT '%d', `id` FROM `banks` ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1", propertyID);
				}
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:10("The property %s (Price: %m) has been saved with ID %d. Remember to set the camera position using /setpropertycam!"), inputText, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_PRICE], propertyID);
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:6("Error while creating the pickup!"));
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:6("Error while creating the pickup!"));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		if (IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "BANK") || IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "HOTEL") || IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "PLACE"))
		{
			ShowDialog:AddProperty_Type(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			ShowInteriorDialog(playerID, INTERIORDIALOG_ADDPROPERTY);
		}
	}
}

	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:175("House")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:397("Place")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:176("Police")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:17("Shop")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "AddProperty_Type", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:172("Select property type")), options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:AddProperty_Type(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new type[STRINGLENGTH_PROPERTYTYPE];
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:173("Bank"))))
		{
			type = "BANK";
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:174("Hotel"))))
		{
			type = "HOTEL";
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:175("House"))))
		{
			type = "HOUSE";
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:397("Place"))))
		{
			type = "PLACE";
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:176("Police"))))
		{
			type = "POLICE";
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:17("Shop"))))
		{
			type = "SHOP";
		}
		SetPVarStr:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE][STRINGLENGTH_PROPERTYTYPE](type);
		if (IsStr(type, "BANK") || IsStr(type, "HOTEL") || IsStr(type, "PLACE"))
		{
			PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_INTERIORID] = 0;
			ShowDialog:AddProperty_Name(playerID);
			return true;
		}
		ShowInteriorDialog(playerID, INTERIORDIALOG_ADDPROPERTY);
	}
	return true;
}

ShowDialog:Army_Options(playerID)

	new options[1024];

	{
		AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:356("End work")));
	}
	else
	{
		AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work")));
	}
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("Order Vehicle")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Army_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:353("Vehicle dealer")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Army_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:356("End work"))))// End work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = false;
			new time = gettime() - PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME];
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:360("You have ended your working day. Worked hours: %d"), time / 60 / 60);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work"))))// Start work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = true;
			PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME] = gettime();
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, 287);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job"))))// Cancel job
		{
			PVar:playerID[JOBID] = JOB_UNEMPLOYED;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:359("You have cancelled your job"));
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, PVar:playerID[SKIN]);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("OrderVehicle"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:OrderVehicle(playerID);
		}
	}
}

				ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);

		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
	}

DialogResponse:Bank_HasAccount(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{

	{
		switch (listItem)
		{
			case 0:// Bank balance
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:23("Your current bank balance is %m"), PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY]);
				ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
			}
			case 1:// Withdraw money
			{
				ShowDialog:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID);
			}

			{

				}

		}

	}

ShowDialog:Bank_NewAccount(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Bank_NewAccount", DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:210("New bank account")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:211("You do not own a bank account yet.\nDo you want to create a new one?")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:166("Yes")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:167("No")));
}

DialogResponse:Bank_NewAccount(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	new bankName[100];
	PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN] = RandomEx(BANK_PIN_MIN, BANK_PIN_MAX);

	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `banks` LEFT JOIN `bankbranches` ON `bankbranches`.`bankId` = `banks`.`id` WHERE `bankbranches`.`propertyId` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	strcat(bankName, GetMySQLField("name"));
	PVar:playerID[BANK_ID] = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	mysql_free_result();

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:216("You now have a bank account at the %s"), bankName);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:579("Your new PIN for your bank account is %d"), PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN]);

	if (PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL])
	{
		TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, false);
		StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_TUTORIAL_BANK_LEAVE, 0);
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
	}

	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Bank_PIN.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Bank_PIN(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Bank_PIN", DIALOG_STYLE_PASSWORD, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:580("Enter PIN")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:581("Enter the PIN of your bank account.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Bank_PIN(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	new pin = strval(inputText);
	if (pin < BANK_PIN_MIN || pin > BANK_PIN_MAX)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:582("The PIN must be between %d and %d!"), BANK_PIN_MIN, BANK_PIN_MAX);
		ShowDialog:Bank_PIN(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] >= BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:585("You have reached the maximum number of wrong tries! Your bank account has been blocked!"));
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN] == pin)
	{
		PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] = 0;
		ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
		return true;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:583("The entered PIN is not correct!"));
	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] >= BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:585("You have reached the maximum number of wrong tries! Your bank account has been blocked!"));
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS]++;
	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] >= BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:585("You have reached the maximum number of wrong tries! Your bank account has been blocked!"));
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:584("You have %d more tries"), BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS - PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS]);
	ShowDialog:Bank_PIN(playerID);
	return false;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Bank_WithdrawMoney.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Bank_WithdrawMoney", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:207("Withdraw money")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:213("Enter the amount how much money you want to withdraw from your account.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (!strlen(inputText))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:19("You have to enter the amount!"));
			ShowDialog:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			new Float:money = floatstr(inputText);
			if(money > PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY])
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:25("You don't have enough money at your bank!"));
				ShowDialog:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID);
			}
			else
			{
				new Float:newMoney = floatadd(PVar:playerID[MONEY], money);
				if (newMoney > MAX_MONEY)
				{
					newMoney = MAX_MONEY;
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:492("You have exceeded the cash limit of %m!"), MAX_MONEY);
				}
				money = floatsub(newMoney, PVar:playerID[MONEY]);
				SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_BANK, -money, true);
				SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_CASH, money, true);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:26("You got %m from your bank account"), money);
				ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
	}
}
