ShowDialog:BuyHouse(playerID, Float:price)
{
	FormatNew:title[64](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:236("Buy house - %s")), GetMySQLValue("properties", "name", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID])));
	FormatNew:string[100](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:235("This house can be bought.\n\nPrice: $%s")), FormatMoney(price));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "BuyHouse", DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, title, string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:237("Buy")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:BuyHouse(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new propertyID = PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID];
		new Float:price = floatstr(GetMySQLValue("properties", "price", "id", val2str(propertyID)));
		if (price <= PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY])
		{
			TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, false);
			PlayAudio(playerID, "property_bought.ogg");
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` LEFT JOIN `pickups` ON `properties`.`pickupId` = `pickups`.`id` WHERE `properties`.`id` = '%d'", propertyID);
			mysql_store_result();
			SetPlayerCameraPos(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("cameraPosX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("cameraPosY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("cameraPosZ")));
			SetPlayerCameraLookAt(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")));
			mysql_free_result();
			GameTextForPlayer(playerID, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:28("Property bought")), 8000, 1);
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `ownerUserId` = '%d' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID], propertyID);
			SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_BANK, -price, true);
			ReloadPickup(strval(GetMySQLValue("properties", "pickupId", "id", val2str(propertyID))));
			SetTimerEx("Timer_ScreenFader", 8000, false, "ddddddd", playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_PROPERTYBOUGHT, 0);
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:22("You need %m to buy this property! But you only have %m at you bank account."), price, PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY]);
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_BuyVehicle.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:BuyVehicle(playerID, Float:price)
{
	FormatNew:string[100](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:244("Do you want to buy this vehicle?\n\nPrice: $%s")), FormatMoney(price));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "BuyVehicle", DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:245("Buy vehicle")), string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:166("Yes")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:167("No")));
}

DialogResponse:BuyVehicle(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
		if (!vehicleID)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (!VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE] <= PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY])
		{
			GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_BANK, -VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE]);
			if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID])
			{
				new sellerID = GetPlayerByUserID(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID]);
				if (sellerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
				{
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `users` SET `money` = `money` + '%f' WHERE `id` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID]);
				}
				else
				{
					GivePlayerMoneyEx(sellerID, MONEY_BANK, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE]);
					SendClientMessageEx(sellerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:494("%p has bought your vehicle"), playerID);
				}
			}

			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] = PVar:playerID[USERID];
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID] = 0;
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR1] = VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR1];
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR2] = VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR2];

			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:493("You have bought a vehicle"));
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:27("You need %m to buy this vehicle! But you only have %m at your bank account."), VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE], PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY]);
		}
	}
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_ChangePassword_Step1.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:ChangePassword_Step1(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "ChangePassword_Step1", DIALOG_STYLE_PASSWORD, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:98("Change account password")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:241("Enter your current password.")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:ChangePassword_Step1(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `users` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `password` = '%s'", PVar:playerID[USERID], MD5(inputText));
		mysql_store_result();
		new rows = mysql_num_rows();
		mysql_free_result();
		if (rows)
		{
			ShowDialog:ChangePassword_Step2(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:30("The entered password is wrong!"));

ShowDialog:ChatMode(playerID)
{
	new options[1024];
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:311("In range (max 100m)")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:310("All")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:504("Friend")));
	AddLine(options, "Job");
	AddLine(options, "Admins");
	CreateDialog(playerID, "ChatMode", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:312("Change chat channel")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:ChatMode(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new oldChatMode[STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE];
		strcat(oldChatMode, PVar:playerID[CHATMODE]);
		if (IsStr(inputText, "Admins"))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("ADMINS");
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:310("All"))))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("ALL");
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:504("Friend"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:ChatMode_FriendList(playerID);
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:311("In range (max 100m)"))))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("INRANGE");
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, "Job"))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("JOB");
		}
		if (!IsStr(oldChatMode, PVar:playerID[CHATMODE]))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:313("Chat channel changed to '%s'"), GetChatModeName(playerID, PVar:playerID[CHATMODE]));
		}
	}
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_ChatMode_FriendList.inc

ShowDialog:ChatMode_FriendList(playerID)
{
	new list[2048];
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `users`.`username` FROM `friends` LEFT JOIN `users` ON (`users`.`id` = `friends`.`userId1` OR `users`.`id` = `friends`.`userId2`) WHERE (`friends`.`userId1` = '%d' OR `friends`.`userId2` = '%d') AND `friends`.`accepted` AND `users`.`id` != '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	new rows = mysql_num_rows();
	if (rows)
	{
		while (FetchMySQLRow())
		{
			AddLine(list, GetMySQLField("username"));
		}
		CreateDialog(playerID, "ChatMode_FriendList", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:502("Select friend")), list, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!rows)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:503("You have no players in your friend list! You can add players using /addfriend."));
		ShowDialog:ChatMode(playerID);
	}
}

DialogResponse:ChatMode_FriendList(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new friendUserID = strval(GetMySQLValue("users", "id", "username", inputText));
		if (friendUserID)
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("PLAYER");
			PVar:playerID[CHATMODE_USERID] = friendUserID;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:313("Chat channel changed to '%s'"), GetChatModeName(playerID, PVar:playerID[CHATMODE]));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:ChatMode(playerID);
	}
}

	}
	else
	{
		AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work")));
	}
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("Order Vehicle")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "EstateAgents_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:353("Vehicle dealer")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:EstateAgents_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:356("End work"))))// End work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = false;
			new time = gettime() - PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME];
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:360("You have ended your working day. Worked hours: %d"), time / 60 / 60);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work"))))// Start work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = true;
			PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME] = gettime();
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, 187);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job"))))// Cancel job
		{
			PVar:playerID[JOBID] = JOB_UNEMPLOYED;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:359("You have cancelled your job"));
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, PVar:playerID[SKIN]);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("OrderVehicle"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:OrderVehicle(playerID);
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_FriendRequests_Options.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:FriendRequests_Options(playerID, friendUserID)
{
	new list[2048];
	AddLine(list, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")));// Accept
	AddLine(list, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:499("Decline")));// Decline
	PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID] = friendUserID;
	CreateDialog(playerID, "FriendRequests_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:496("Options")), list, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:FriendRequests_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept"))))// Accept
		{
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `friends` SET `accepted` = '1' WHERE `userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID], PVar:playerID[USERID]);
			new friendPlayerID = GetPlayerByUserID(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID]);
			if (friendPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(friendPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:441("%p has confirmed your friend request"), playerID);
			}
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:442("%s has been added to your friend list"), GetMySQLValue("users", "username", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID])));
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:499("Decline"))))// Decline
		{
			MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `friends` WHERE `userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID], PVar:playerID[USERID]);
			new friendPlayerID = GetPlayerByUserID(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID]);
			if (friendPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(friendPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:500("%p has declined your friend request!"), playerID);
			}
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:501("You have declined the friend request of %s!"), GetMySQLValue("users", "username", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID])));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:FriendRequests(playerID);
	}
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_House.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:House(playerID)
{
	FormatNew:title[64](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:329("Your house - %s")), GetMySQLValue("properties", "name", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID])));
	new options[1024];
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:268("Enter")));// Item 0
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:328("Sell")));// Item 1
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:476("Lock/Unlock")));// Item 2
	CreateDialog(playerID, "House", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:House(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		switch (listItem)
		{
			case 0:// Enter
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:481("This house is locked!")));
				}
				else
				{
					TeleportToProperty(playerID, PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
			}
			case 1:// Sell
			{
				MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `ownerUserId` = '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new Float:price = floatstr(GetMySQLField("price"));
				new pickupID = strval(GetMySQLField("pickupId"));
				mysql_free_result();
				GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_BANK, price);
				ReloadPickup(pickupID);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:330("Your house has been sold!"));
			}
			case 2:// Lock
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:477("You have unlocked your house")));
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked`= '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
				else
				{
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked` = '1' WHERE `id`= '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:478("You have locked your house")));
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

ShowDialog:Login(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Login", DIALOG_STYLE_PASSWORD, "Login", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:262("Please enter the password of your account.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Login(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (strlen(inputText))
		{
			MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `users` WHERE `username` = '%s' AND `password` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(GetPlayerNameEx(playerID)), MD5(inputText));
			mysql_store_result();
			if (mysql_num_rows())
			{
				PVar:playerID[USERID] = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:30("The entered password is wrong!"));
				ShowDialog:Login(playerID);
			}
			mysql_free_result();
			if (PVar:playerID[USERID])
			{
				MySQLQuery("UPDATE `users` SET `loginTime` = NOW(), `clientVersion` = '%s' WHERE `id` = '%d'", GetPlayerVersionEx(playerID), PVar:playerID[USERID]);
				printf("Player logged in: %s (UserID: %d)", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), PVar:playerID[USERID]);
				PlayerLoop(currentPlayerID)
				{
					if (currentPlayerID != playerID)
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(currentPlayerID, COLOR_JOINLEAVE, StringID:7("%p logged in"), playerID);
					}
				}
				LoadPlayer(playerID);
				ReloadTextDraws(playerID);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:35("You have been logged in successfully"));
				PVar:playerID[PLAYRANDOMCAMERACUTS] = false;
				if (PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL])// The player is still in the tutorial (e.g. Quit game while in tutorial)
				{
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_TUTORIAL_START, 0);
				}
				else
				{
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_LOGIN, 0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:36("You have to enter your password!"));
				ShowDialog:Login(playerID);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:36("You have to enter your password!"));
			ShowDialog:Login(playerID);
		}
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:37("You can now quit the game"));
		Kick(playerID);
	}
	return true;
}

ShowDialog:Missions(playerID)
{
	new missionList[2048];

	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `type`, `data` FROM `missions` WHERE `jobId` = '%d' AND `acceptUserId` = '0' ORDER BY `id` ASC", PVar:playerID[JOBID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new missionTitle[100];
		new type[100];
		new missionData[20][2][32];
		new validType;
		new missionID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
		strcat(type, GetMySQLField("type"));
		GetMissionData(GetMySQLField("data"), missionData);

		if (IsStr(type, "GetOrderedCar"))
		{
			new modelID;
			Foreach(arrayIndex, missionData)
			{
				if (IsStr(missionData[arrayIndex][0], "modelId"))
				{
					modelID = strval(missionData[arrayIndex][1]);
				}
			}
			if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
			{
				if (IsStr(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], "Car"))
				{
					Format:missionTitle(LanguageString(playerID, StringID:586("Pickup an ordered car (%s)")), vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
				}
				else
				{
					printf("WARNING: %s is not a car!", vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				printf("WARNING: Invalid vehicle model ID (%d) for mission %d!", modelID, missionID);
			}
			validType = true;
		}

		if (validType)
		{
			AddLine:missionList("%d\t%s", missionID, missionTitle);
		}
		else
		{
			printf("Invalid mission type '%s' for mission %d", type, missionID);
		}
	}
	mysql_free_result();

	if (strlen(missionList))
	{
		CreateDialog(playerID, "Missions", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:163("Accept order")), missionList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:134("There are currently no missions available for your job!"));
	}
}

DialogResponse:Missions(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new accepted;
		new missionID;
		new text[100];
		sscanf(inputText, "p<\t>ds[100]", missionID, text);
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `creatorUserId`, `acceptUserId`, `type`, `data` FROM `missions` WHERE `id` = '%d'", missionID);
		mysql_store_result();
		if (strval(GetMySQLField("acceptUserId")))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:12("This job has been already accepted by another player!"));
		}
		else
		{
			new type[100];
			new missionData[20][2][32];

			strcat(type, GetMySQLField("type"));
			GetMissionData(GetMySQLField("data"), missionData);

			if (IsStr(type, "GetOrderedCar"))
			{
				new modelID;
				Foreach(arrayIndex, missionData)
				{
					if (IsStr(missionData[arrayIndex][0], "modelId"))
					{
						modelID = strval(missionData[arrayIndex][1]);
					}
				}
				if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
				{
					if (IsStr(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], "Car"))
					{
						if (GetClosestVehicleInRange(ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSX, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSY, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSZ, ORDER_CAR_MINDISTANCE))
						{
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:46("Another vehicle has been already spawned!"));
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:47("Please try again later"));
						}
						else
						{
							new vehicleID = CreateVehicleEx(modelID, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSX, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSY, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSZ, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_ANGLE, -1, -1, false);
							SetVehicleParamsForPlayer(vehicleID, playerID, true, false);
							accepted = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						printf("WARNING: %s is not a car!", vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					printf("WARNING: Invalid vehicle model ID (%d) for mission %d!", modelID, missionID);
				}
			}
		}
		mysql_free_result();

		if (accepted)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:15("You have accepted the job"));
			SendClientMessageEx(GetPlayerByUserID(strval(GetMySQLField("creatorUserId"))), COLOR_INFO, StringID:1("%p has accepted your job (Order ID: %d)"), playerID, missionID);
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `missions` SET `acceptUserId` = '%d', `acceptTime` = NOW() WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID], missionID);
		}
	}
}

ShowDialog:NaviTarget(playerID)
{
	new targets[2048];
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:173("Bank")));// Bank
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:384("Gas station")));// Gas station
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:411("Hospital")));// Hospital
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:174("Hotel")));// Hotel
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:175("House")));// House
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:437("Vehicle upgrader")));// Vehicle upgrader
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `name` FROM `navigationlocationtypes` ORDER BY `name` ASC");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new string[256];
		strcat(string, GetMySQLField("name"));
		new checkCharacter;
		new languageStringID;
		if (!sscanf(string, "p<:>cd", checkCharacter, languageStringID))
		{
			if (checkCharacter == 'L')
			{
				Format:string(LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID));
			}
		}
		AddLine(targets, string);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:342("Target on map")));// Target on map
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:417("Name of a property")));// Name of a property
	CreateDialog(playerID, "NaviTarget", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:247("Select target")), targets, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:NaviTarget(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		return false;
	}
	Count(index, MAX_DISTANCECALCELEMENTS)
	{
		distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE] = 6000.0;
	}
	new pickupType[STRINGLENGTH_PICKUPTYPE];
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:173("Bank"))))// Bank
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "BANK");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:384("Gas station"))))// Gas station
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "GASSTATION");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:411("Hospital"))))// Hospital
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "HOSPITAL");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:174("Hotel"))))// Hotel
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "HOTEL");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:175("House"))))// House
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "HOUSE");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:437("Vehicle upgrader"))))// Vehicle upgrader
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "UPGRADEVEHICLE");
	}
	if (strlen(pickupType))
	{
		Count(pickupID, MAX_PICKUPS)
		{
			if (IsStr(pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_TYPE], pickupType))
			{
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE] = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSX], pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSY], pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSZ]);
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_POSX] = pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSX];
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_POSY] = pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSY];
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_POSZ] = pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSZ];
			}
		}
		SortDeepArray(distanceCalcArray, DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE);
		Count(index, MAX_NAVITARGETS)
		{
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_DISTANCE] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE];
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_POSX] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSX];
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_POSY] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSY];
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_POSZ] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSZ];
		}
		ShowDialog:NaviTarget_TargetList(playerID);
		return true;
	}
	new Float:target[3];
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:342("Target on map"))))// Target on map
	{
		if (PVar:playerID[MAP_POSX] && PVar:playerID[MAP_POSY] && PVar:playerID[MAP_POSZ])
		{
			target[0] = PVar:playerID[MAP_POSX];
			target[1] = PVar:playerID[MAP_POSY];
			target[2] = PVar:playerID[MAP_POSZ];
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:264("You have not selected the target on your map!"));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:417("Name of a property"))))// Name of a property
	{
		ShowDialog:NaviTarget_PropertyName(playerID);
		return true;
	}
	if (!target[0] && !target[1] && !target[2])
	{
		new typeID = GetNavigationLocationTypeByName(playerID, inputText);
		if (typeID)
		{
			new index;
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `navigationlocations` WHERE `type` = '%d'", typeID);
			mysql_store_result();
			while (FetchMySQLRow())
			{
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE]= GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")));
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSX] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX"));
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSY] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY"));
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSZ] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ"));
				index++;
				if (index >= MAX_DISTANCECALCELEMENTS)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			mysql_free_result();
			SortDeepArray(distanceCalcArray, DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE);
			Count(targetIndex, MAX_NAVITARGETS)
			{
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_DISTANCE] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE];
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_POSX] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_POSX];
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_POSY] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_POSY];
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_POSZ] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_POSZ];
			}
			ShowDialog:NaviTarget_TargetList(playerID);
			return true;
		}
	}
	if (target[0] || target[1] || target[2])
	{
		if (CalculateRoute(playerID, target[0], target[1], target[2]))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:414("Calculating route"));
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:415("No GPS!"));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:343("No target found!"));
	}
	return true;
}

	else

		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:415("No GPS!"));
		}
	}
	return true;
}

ShowDialog:Police_Options(playerID)
{
	FormatNew:title[20](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:553("Trucker missions")));
	new options[1024];
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:268("Enter")));// Item 1
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:328("Sell")));// Item 2
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:476("Lock/Unlock")));// Item 3
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("Order Vehcle")));// Item 4
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Police Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Police_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		switch (listItem)
		{
			case 0:
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:481("This house is locked!")));
				}
				else
				{
					TeleportToProperty(playerID, PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
			}
			case 1:
			{
				MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `ownerUserId` = '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new Float:price = floatstr(GetMySQLField("price"));
				new pickupID = strval(GetMySQLField("pickupId"));
				mysql_free_result();
				GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_BANK, price);
				ReloadPickup(pickupID);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:330("Your house has been sold!"));
			}
			case 2:
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:477("You have unlocked your house")));
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked`= '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
				else
				{
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked` = '1' WHERE `id`= '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:478("You have locked your house")));
				}
			}
			case 3: 
			{
				ShowDialog:OrderVehicle(playerID);
			}
		}
	}
}

ShowDialog:Refuel(playerID)
{
	new string[80];
	GetStringArg(2, string);
	PVar:playerID[CURRENTGASPRICE] = gasPrice;
	Format:string(LanguageString(playerID, StringID:238("How much do you want to fill up (0 - %s)?\n\nCurrent price: $%s/Liter")), FormatNumber(PVar:playerID[REFUEL_MAXIMUM], 2, '.', ','), FormatMoney(gasPrice));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Refuel", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:239("Refuel")), string, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Refuel(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response && strlen(inputText))
	{
		new Float:amount = floatstr(inputText);
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
		new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
		if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
		{
			new Float:maximum = floatsub(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_MAXFUEL], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL]);
			if (amount > maximum)
			{
				amount = maximum;
			}
			TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, false);
			SetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID, false);
			GameTextForPlayer(playerID, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:265("Your vehicle gets filled up. Please wait...")), 3000, 4);
			Timer_RefuelVehicle(playerID, amount);
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:146("You are not in a vehicle!"));
		}
	}
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Register_Birthdate.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Register_Birthdate(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Register_Birthdate", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:253("Enter birthdate")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:254("Enter your birthdate in the format DD.MM.YYYY.\n\nExample: 05.02.1990")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:Register_Birthdate(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new day;
		new month;
		new year;
		if (sscanf(inputText, "p<.>ddd", day, month, year))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:40("Please use the format DD.MM.YYYY!"));
			ShowDialog:Register_Birthdate(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			if (day > 0 && day <= 31 && month > 0 && month <=12 && year > 1900 && year < 2100)
			{
				SetPVarStr:playerID[BIRTHDATE][STRINGLENGTH_DATETIME]("%d-%02d-%02d", year, month, day);
				ShowDialog:Register_Location(playerID);
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:41("Invalid date!"));
				ShowDialog:Register_Birthdate(playerID);
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Register_Gender(playerID);
	}
}

	if (response)
	{
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `users` (`username`, `password`, `gender`, `birthDate`, `location`) VALUES('%s', '%s', '%c', '%s', '%s')", MySQLEscapeString(GetPlayerNameEx(playerID)), MD5(PVar:playerID[REGISTERPASSWORD]), PVar:playerID[GENDER], PVar:playerID[BIRTHDATE], MySQLEscapeString(inputText));
		PVar:playerID[USERID] = mysql_insert_id();

		PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL] = true;

		SavePlayer(playerID);
		LoadPlayer(playerID);
		ReloadTextDraws(playerID);
		printf("Player registered: %s (UserID: %d)", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), PVar:playerID[USERID]);
		PlayerLoop(currentPlayerID)
		{
			if (currentPlayerID != playerID)
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(currentPlayerID, COLOR_JOINLEAVE, StringID:7("%p logged in"), playerID);
			}
		}
		PVar:playerID[SPAWNAFTERTUTORIALSTART] = false;
		PlayerPlaySound(playerID, 1063, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		PVar:playerID[PLAYRANDOMCAMERACUTS] = false;
		StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, FADE_TUTORIAL_START, 0);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:139("You were registered successfully and are now logged in."));
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Register_Gender(playerID);
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_SelectInterior.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:SelectInterior(playerID, dialogID, firstPage = true)
{
	new interiorList[2048];
	new firstItem;
	new lastItem;

	if (firstPage)
	{
		firstItem = 1;// The first (0) item is the world which is not a real interior
		lastItem = sizeof(interiors) / 2 - 1;
	}
	else
	{
		firstItem = sizeof(interiors) / 2;
		lastItem = sizeof(interiors) - 1;
	}

	for (new interiorID = firstItem; interiorID <= lastItem; interiorID++)
	{
		if (strlen(interiorList))
		{
			Format:interiorList("%s\n", interiorList);
		}
		Format:interiorList("%s%s", interiorList, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_NAME]);
	}

	if (firstPage)
	{
		Format:interiorList("%s\n%s", interiorList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next")));
	}
	else
	{
		Format:interiorList("%s\n%s", interiorList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
	}

	FormatNew:string[30]("%s", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:247("Select target")));
	PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID] = dialogID;
	CreateDialog(playerID, "SelectInterior", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, string, interiorList, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:SelectInterior(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		OnInteriorDialogSelect(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], 0);
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back"))))
	{
		ShowDialog:SelectInterior(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], true);
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next"))))
	{
		ShowDialog:SelectInterior(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], false);
		return true;
	}

	Foreach(interiorID, interiors)
	{
		if (!strcmp(interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_NAME], inputText))
		{
			OnInteriorDialogSelect(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], interiorID);
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_SellVehicle.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:SellVehicle(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "SellVehicle", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:488("Sell your vehicle")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:489("Enter the sale price.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:SellVehicle(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (!response)
	{
		return true;
	}
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:146("You are not in a vehicle!"));
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] != PVar:playerID[USERID])
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:487("You are not the owner of this vehicle!"));
		return true;
	}
	new Float:price = floatstr(inputText);
	if (price <= 0)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:490("The price must be positive!"));
		return true;
	}
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] = 0;
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE] = price;
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID] = PVar:playerID[USERID];
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:491("You have released your vehicle for sale"), inputText);
	RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerID);
	return true;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_SetVehicleJob.inc

ShowDialog:SetVehicleJob(playerID)
{
	new jobs[2048];
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `jobs` ORDER BY `name` ASC");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		AddLine:jobs("%s\t%s", GetMySQLField("id"), GetMySQLField("name"));

	mysql_free_result();

	}

	sscanf(inputText, "p<\t>ds[" #STRINGLENGTH_JOBNAME "]", jobID, jobName);
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID] = jobID;
	return true;
}

ShowDialog:Trucker_Options(playerID)
{
	new missionList[2048];
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `missions`.`id` FROM `missions` LEFT JOIN `jobs` ON `jobs`.`id` = `missions`.`jobId` WHERE `missions`.`jobId` = '%d' AND `missions`.`acceptUserId` = '0' ORDER BY `jobs`.`name`, `missions`.`id` ASC", PVar:playerID[JOBID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		if (strlen(missionList))
		{
			Format:missionList("%s\n", missionList);
		}
		//Format:missionList("%s%s: %s", missionList, GetMySQLField("id"), LanguageString(playerID, GetMissionName(strval(GetMySQLField("id")))));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (strlen(missionList))
	{
		CreateDialog(playerID, "Trucker_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:163("Accept order")), missionList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:134("There are currently no orders available for your job!"));
	}
}

DialogResponse:Trucker_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new missionID;
		new text[100];
		sscanf(inputText, "p<:>ds[100]", missionID, text);
		if (strval(GetMySQLValue("missions", "acceptUserId", "id", val2str(missionID))))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:12("This job has been already accepted by another player!"));
		}
		else
		{
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `missions` SET `acceptUserId` = '%d' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID], missionID);
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:15("You have accepted the job"));
			SendClientMessageEx(GetPlayerByUserID(strval(GetMySQLValue("missions", "creatorUserId", "id", val2str(missionID)))), COLOR_INFO, StringID:1("%p has accepted your job (Order ID: %d)"), playerID, missionID);
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `missiondata` WHERE `missionId` = '%d' AND `name` = 'VehicleModelID'", missionID);
			mysql_store_result();
			// TODO: Missing code?
			mysql_free_result();
		}
	}
}

ShowDialog:VehicleDealer_Options(playerID)
{
	new options[1024];
	if (PVar:playerID[ATWORK])

		AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:356("End work")));
	}
	else
	{
		AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work")));

	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "VehicleDealer_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:353("Vehicle dealer")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));

DialogResponse:VehicleDealer_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:356("End work"))))// End work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = false;
			new time = gettime() - PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME];
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:360("You have ended your working day. Worked hours: %d"), time / 60 / 60);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work"))))// Start work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = true;
			PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME] = gettime();
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, 187);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job"))))// Cancel job
		{
			PVar:playerID[JOBID] = JOB_UNEMPLOYED;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:359("You have cancelled your job"));
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, PVar:playerID[SKIN]);
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/AddNeonLight.inc
================================================================================

AddNeonLight(vehicleID, type, neonID)
{
	new color[LIGHTOBJECT_MAXCOLORS];
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:rotX;
	new Float:rotY;
	new Float:rotZ;
	switch (type)
	{
		case NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT:
		{
			posX = -1.0;
			posY = 7.0;
			posZ = -0.6;
		}
		case NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT:
		{
			posX = 1.0;
			posY = 7.0;
			posZ = -0.6;
		}
		case NEONTYPE_LEFT:
		{
			posX = -0.8;
			posZ = -1.0;
		}
		case NEONTYPE_RIGHT:
		{
			posX = 0.8;
			posZ = -1.0;
		}
		default:
		{
			printf("Invalid neon light type: %d", type);
			return false;
		}
	}
	switch (neonID)
	{
		case NEON_DARKBLUE:
		{
			color[0] = 18648;
		}
		case NEON_GOLD:
		{
			color[0] = 18652;
			color[1] = 18650;
		}
		case NEON_GREEN:
		{
			color[0] = 18649;
		}
		case NEON_LIGHTBLUE:
		{
			color[0] = 18648;
			color[1] = 18652;
		}
		case NEON_LIGHTGREEN:
		{
			color[0] = 18649;
			color[1] = 18652;
		}
		case NEON_ORANGE:
		{
			color[0] = 18647;
			color[1] = 18650;
		}
		case NEON_PINK:
		{
			color[0] = 18647;
			color[1] = 18652;
		}
		case NEON_PURPLE:
		{
			color[0] = 18651;
		}
		case NEON_RED:
		{
			color[0] = 18647;
		}
		case NEON_TURQUOISE:
		{
			color[0] = 18648;
			color[1] = 18649;
		}
		case NEON_WHITE:
		{
			color[0] = 18652;
		}
		case NEON_YELLOW:
		{
			color[0] = 18650;
		}
	}
	Count(colorID, LIGHTOBJECT_MAXCOLORS)
	{
		if (vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][enum_neonType:type][colorID])
		{
			DestroyDynamicObject(vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][enum_neonType:type][colorID]);
			vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][enum_neonType:type][colorID] = 0;
		}
		if (color[colorID])
		{
			new objectID = CreateDynamicObject(color[colorID], 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, -1, -1, STREAMER_OBJECTDISTANCE);
			AttachDynamicObjectToVehicle(objectID, vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ);
			Streamer_SetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID, OBJECTTYPE_NEONLIGHT);
			vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][enum_neonType:type][colorID] = objectID;
		}
	}
	UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/AddObject.inc
================================================================================

AddObject(playerID, modelID, filename[], copyFromCurrent = false)
{
	new Float:position[3];
	new Float:rotation[3];
	new interior = GetPlayerInterior(playerID);

	if (copyFromCurrent)
	{
		GetDynamicObjectPos(PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], position[0], position[1], position[2]);
		GetDynamicObjectRot(PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2]);
	}
	else
	{
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, position[0], position[1], position[2]);
	}

	new objectID = CreateDynamicObject(modelID, position[0], position[1], position[2], rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2], -1, interior, -1, STREAMER_OBJECTDISTANCE);
	Streamer_SetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID, OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL);

	format(dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_FILENAME], STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME, "%s", filename);
	dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_ID] = nextDynamicObjectID;
	dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_POS] = position;
	dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_ROT] = rotation;

	nextDynamicObjectID++;

	UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();

	PlaySound(playerID, SOUND_OBJECTPLACED);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:396("The object %d (%s) has been added and selected for editing"), dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_ID], objectModels[modelID]);

	OnPlayerSelectDynamicObject(playerID, objectID, modelID, position[0], position[1], position[2]);

	return objectID;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/AddPickup.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Spawns a pickup
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="pickupID">
 *	ID from pickups table in database
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="type">
 *	Type of the pickup as string (See  for details)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posX">
 *	The X position as float
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posY">
 *	The Y position as float
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posZ">
 *	The Z position as float
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item>true if the pickup has been spawned</item>
 *	<item>false if the pickup could not be spawned (e.g. model ID not assigned in PickupModelID function)</item>
 * </returns>
 */

AddPickup(pickupID, type[], Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ)
{
	new modelID;
	new pickup;
	FormatNew:functionName[MAX_FUNCTION_NAME]("PUMID_%s", type);// PUMID = PickUpModelID
	modelID = CallLocalFunction(functionName, "d", pickupID);
	if (!modelID)
	{
		return false;
	}
	pickup = CreatePickup(modelID, 23, posX, posY, posZ, -1);
	pickups[pickup][PICKUP_ID] = pickupID;
	pickups[pickup][PICKUP_POSX] = posX;
	pickups[pickup][PICKUP_POSY] = posY;
	pickups[pickup][PICKUP_POSZ] = posZ;
	format(pickups[pickup][PICKUP_TYPE], STRINGLENGTH_PICKUPTYPE, type);
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/CalculateRoute.inc
================================================================================

CalculateRoute(playerID, Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ)
{
	new currentNodeID = NearestPlayerNode(playerID);
	if (currentNodeID == -1)
	{
		return false;
	}
	new targetNodeID = NearestNodeFromPoint(posX, posY, posZ);
	if (targetNodeID == -1)
	{
		return false;
	}
	PVar:playerID[GPS_ENABLED] = true;
	PVar:playerID[GPS_TARGETNODEID] = targetNodeID;
	PVar:playerID[GPS_ISCALCULATING] = true;
	CalculatePath(currentNodeID, targetNodeID, playerID);
	return true;
}

CheckGatePermission(playerID, objectID)
{
	switch (objectID)
	{
		case 310:// Los Santos Police Department area
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] != JOB_POLICE)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		case 1647:// Las Venturas ADAC vehicle area
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] != JOB_ADAC)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		case 1686:// Las Venturas trucker area
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] != JOB_TRUCKER)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		case 1691:// Los Santos Police Department garage
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] != JOB_POLICE)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		case 1766:// Los Santos Airport gate
		{
			return true;// TODO: Currently allowed for all players (Need job?)
		}
	}
	return true;// Set default to let the player enter this area
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/CheckSpeedCamera.inc
================================================================================

CheckSpeedCamera(playerID)
{
	new closestSpeedCamera = -1;
	new Float:closestObjectDistance;
	Foreach(arrayIndex, speedCameras)
	{
		if (speedCameras[arrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID] && IsValidDynamicObject(speedCameras[arrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID]))
		{
			new Float:position[3];
			GetDynamicObjectPos(speedCameras[arrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID], position[0], position[1], position[2]);
			new Float:distance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, position[0], position[1], position[2]);
			if (distance < closestObjectDistance || closestSpeedCamera == -1)
			{
				closestSpeedCamera = arrayIndex;
				closestObjectDistance = distance;
			}
		}
	}

	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);

	if (!vehicleID || closestSpeedCamera == -1 || closestObjectDistance > SPEEDCAMERA_DISTANCE)
	{
		PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED] = false;
		return false;
	}

	if (vehicleID && VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED] > speedCameras[closestSpeedCamera][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT] + SPEEDCAMERA_TOLERANCE)
	{
		if (!PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED])
		{
			new speedDifference = VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED] - speedCameras[closestSpeedCamera][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT];
			new Float:price = float(speedDifference);
			new vehicleType[STRINGLENGTH_VEHICLETYPE];
			strcat(vehicleType, vehicleModels[GetVehicleModel(vehicleID) - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE]);
			PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED] = true;
			PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS]++;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:453("You are driving too fast and have to pay %m! (%d km/h; Max: %d km/h)"), price, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED], speedCameras[closestSpeedCamera][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT]);
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:39("Your speed limit points were increased to %d points!"), PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS]);
			GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_CASH, -price);
			if (PVar:playerID[SPEEDLIMITPOINTS] >= MAX_SPEEDLIMITPOINTS && HasLicense(playerID, vehicleType))
			{
				MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `licenses` WHERE `userId` = '%d' AND `type` = '%s'", PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(vehicleType));
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:44("You now have reached the limit of %d speed limit points and lost your driving license!"), MAX_SPEEDLIMITPOINTS);
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		PVar:playerID[SPEEDCAM_LIMITREACHED] = false;
	}

	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/CheckVehiclePermission.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Checks if the player has the permission to use the vehicle.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="vehicleID">
 *	The ID of the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="showBuyDialog">
 *	<item name="true">Show the buy dialog if the player has not bought the vehicle yet and can buy it</item>
 *	<item name="false">Do not show the buy dialog</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item name="true">The player has the permission to use the vehicle</item>
 *	<item name="false">The player has not the permission to use the vehicle</item>
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	<title>The following is checked:</title>
 *	<item>Is the vehicle not a saved vehicle and the player has the permission "Mapper"?</item>
 *	<item>Does the job ID of the player match the job ID of the vehicle?</item>
 *	<item>Does the vehicle have a price?</item>
 *	<item>Is the vehicle already owned and is the player the owner of the vehicle?</item>
 * </remarks>
 */

CheckVehiclePermission(playerID, vehicleID, showBuyDialog)
{
	if (!VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
	{
		if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE])
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:129("You have not the permission to use this vehicle!"), GetPermissionName(PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID])
	{
		if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] == VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID])
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:327("This vehicle is reserved for a job!"));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID])
	{
		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] == PVar:playerID[USERID])
		{
			return true;
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:130("This vehicle is already owned by another player!"));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE])
	{
		if (showBuyDialog)
		{
			ShowDialog:BuyVehicle(playerID, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE]);
		}
		return false;
	}
	if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE])
	{
		return true;
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:129("You have not the permission to use this vehicle!"), GetPermissionName(PERMISSION_SPAWNVEHICLE));
	return false;
}

CreateUniqueNumberplateText()
{
	new string[STRINGLENGTH_NUMBERPLATE];
	new found;
	do
	{
		Format:string("%c%c-%d", 65 + random(25), 65 + random(25), random(9999));
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `vehicles` WHERE `numberplate` = '%s'", string);
		mysql_store_result();
		if (mysql_num_rows())
		{
			found = true;
		}
		mysql_free_result();
	}
	while (found);
	return string;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/CreateVehicleEx.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Create a new vehicle at the specified position and with the specified properties.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="modelID">
 *	The ID of the vehicle model which should be spawned.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posX">
 *	The X-coordinate for the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posY">
 *	The Y-coordinate for the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="posZ">
 *	The Z-coordinate for the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="angle">
 *	The facing angle (Z rotation) of the vehicle.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color1">
 *	The primary color ID.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color2">
 *	The secondary color ID.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="isStatic">
 *	<item name="true">Use AddStaticVehicleEx for creating the vehicle (Only possible in OnGameModeInit and OnFilterScriptInit)</item>
 *	<item name="false">Use CreateVehicle for creating the vehicle (Can not spawn some trains)</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	Vehicles with model ID 537 (Freight) and 538 (Streak) are only created if isStatic is set to true!
 * </remarks>
 */

CreateVehicleEx(modelID, Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:angle, color1, color2, isStatic)
{
	if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
	{
		new vehicleID;
		new newColor1 = color1;
		new newColor2 = color2;
		if (color1 == -1 || color2 == -1)
		{
			GetVehicleColor(modelID, newColor1, newColor2);
		}
		if (isStatic)
		{
			vehicleID = AddStaticVehicle(modelID, posX, posY, posZ, angle, newColor1, newColor2);
		}
		else
		{
			if (modelID == 537 || modelID == 538)// We can not spawn Freight and Streak using CreateVehicle
			{
				return 0;
			}
			vehicleID = CreateVehicle(modelID, posX, posY, posZ, angle, newColor1, newColor2, -1);
		}
		if (!vehicleID)
		{
			return 0;
		}
		SetVehicleParamsEx(vehicleID, false, false, false, false, false, false, false);
		Count(vehiclePropertyID, sizeof(vehicles[]))
		{
			vehicles[vehicleID][enum_vehicle:vehiclePropertyID] = 0;
		}
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR1] = color1;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR2] = color2;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR1] = newColor1;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR2] = newColor2;
		VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] = vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_MAXFUEL];
		return vehicleID;
	}
	return 0;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/ExecuteCommand.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Execute a player command (e.g. spawnvehicle Infernus)
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which executes the command
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="command">
 *	Name of the command to execute (e.g. spawnvehicle)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="parameters">
 *	The parameters passed to the command (e.g. Infernus)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="isAlias">
 *	<title>Defines whether the command has been called by a player or by an alias (Passed to OnPlayerCommandPerformed)</title>
 *	<item>true if the command has been called by an alias</item>
 *	<item>false if the command has been called by a player</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	Return true if the command has been progressed or false if an error occured
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	Currently only invalid return codes are handled as errors (return false)!
 * </remarks>
 */

ExecuteCommand(playerID, command[], parameters[], isAlias)
{
	FormatNew:functionName[MAX_FUNCTION_NAME]("cmd_%s", command);
	new returnCode = COMMAND_NOT_FOUND;
	if (funcidx(functionName) != -1)
	{
		if (StrNotNull(parameters))
		{
			returnCode = CallLocalFunction(functionName, "ds", playerID, parameters);
		}
		else
		{
			returnCode = CallLocalFunction(functionName, "ds", playerID, "\1");
		}
	}
	return OnPlayerCommandPerformed(playerID, command, parameters, returnCode, isAlias);
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/FormatDate.inc
================================================================================

FormatDate(sqlDateString[], showTime = true)
{
	new string[STRINGLENGTH_DATETIME + 2];
	new time[10];
	new day;
	new month;
	new year;
	sscanf(sqlDateString, "s[" #STRINGLENGTH_DATETIME + 2 "s[10]", string, time);
	sscanf(string, "p<->ddd", year, month, day);
	Format:string("%02d.%02d.%d", day, month, year);
	if (showTime)
	{
		Format:string("%s - %s", string, time);
	}
	return string;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/FormatTime.inc
================================================================================

FormatTime(seconds)
{
	new days = seconds / 60 / 60 / 24;
	seconds -= days * 60 * 60 * 24;
	new hours = seconds / 60 / 60;
	seconds -= hours * 60 * 60;
	new minutes = seconds / 60;
	seconds -= minutes * 60;
	FormatNew:string[20]("%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds);
	if (days)
	{
		Format:string("%dd, %s", days, string);
	}
	return string;
}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Get the ID of a checkpoint mission.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="name">
 *	The mission name
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="randomLike">
 *	Use LIKE to search in the database and return a random ID from the result
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	The ID of the mission or 0 if the mission does not exist
 * </returns>
 */

GetCheckpointMissionByName(name[], randomLike = false)
{
	new missionID;
	if (randomLike)
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `missioncheckpointgroups` WHERE `name` LIKE '%s' ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1", MySQLEscapeString(name));
	}
	else
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `missioncheckpointgroups` WHERE `name` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(name));
	}
	mysql_store_result();
	if (mysql_num_rows())
	{
		missionID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	return missionID;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetClosestGate.inc
================================================================================

GetClosestGate(playerID, &Float:closestObjectDistance)
{
	new closestObjectID;
	new objects = CountDynamicObjects();

	Count1(objectID, objects)
	{
		if (IsValidDynamicObject(objectID) && IsGateObject(Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID)))
		{
			new Float:position[3];
			Streamer_GetFloatData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_X, position[0]);
			Streamer_GetFloatData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_Y, position[1]);
			Streamer_GetFloatData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_Z, position[2]);
			new Float:distance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, position[0], position[1], position[2]);

			if ((distance < closestObjectDistance || !closestObjectID) && dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_MOVESPEED])// This distance is lower than the last one and move speed has been defined
			{
				closestObjectID = objectID;
				closestObjectDistance = distance;
			}
		}
	}

	return closestObjectID;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetClosestPickup.inc
================================================================================

GetClosestPickup(playerID, type[], &Float:distance = 0.0)
{
	new pickupID;
	distance = 6000.0;
	Count(checkPickupID, MAX_PICKUPS)
	{
		if (IsStr(pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_TYPE], type))
		{
			new Float:checkDistance = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_POSX], pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_POSY], pickups[checkPickupID][PICKUP_POSZ]);
			if (checkDistance < distance)
			{
				distance = checkDistance;
				pickupID = checkPickupID;
			}
		}
	}
	return pickupID;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetClosestVehicleInRange.inc
================================================================================

GetClosestVehicleInRange(Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:range, excludeVehicleID = 0, excludeOccupied = false, jobID = -1, type[STRINGLENGTH_VEHICLETYPE] = "")
{
	new Float:distance;
	new Float:lastDistance = range + 1;// Keep last distance high enought (Check if last distance was BIGGER) -> If lastDistance would be 0 -> There is never a closer vehicle (must be < 0 to find one which would never occur)
	new closestVehicleID;
	Count1(vehicleID, MAX_VEHICLES)
	{
		new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
		if (vehicleID != excludeVehicleID && (jobID == -1 || VehicleProperty:vehicleID[JOBID] == jobID) && modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611 && (!StrNotNull(type) || IsStr(type, vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE])))
		{
			if (excludeOccupied)
			{
				PlayerLoop(playerID)
				{
					if (IsPlayerInVehicle(playerID, vehicleID))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
			}
			distance = GetVehicleDistanceFromPoint(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
			if (distance <= range && distance < lastDistance)
			{
				lastDistance = distance;
				closestVehicleID = vehicleID;
			}
		}
	}
	return closestVehicleID;
}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Get the number of connected players or NPCs.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="countPlayers">
 *	Defines whether normal players should be counted.
 *	<item name="true">Count normal players</item>
 *	<item name="false">Do not count normal players</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="countNPCs">
 *	Defines whether NPCs should be counted.
 *	<item name="true">Count NPCs</item>
 *	<item name="false">Do not count NPCs</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	The number of connected players and/or NPCs.
 * </returns>
 */

GetConnectedPlayers(countPlayers, countNPCs)
{
	new players;
	PlayerLoop(playerID)
	{
		new iscountable;
		if (countPlayers)
		{
			iscountable = !IsPlayerNPC(playerID);
		}
		if (countNPCs)
		{
			iscountable = IsPlayerNPC(playerID);
		}
		if (iscountable)
		{
			players++;
		}
	}
	return players;
}

================================================================================

Float:GetDistanceBetweenPoints(Float:pos1X, Float:pos1Y, Float:pos1Z, Float:pos2X, Float:pos2Y, Float:pos2Z)
{
	return floatadd(floatadd(floatsqroot(floatpower(floatsub(pos1X, pos2X), 2)), floatsqroot(floatpower(floatsub(pos1Y, pos2Y), 2))), floatsqroot(floatpower(floatsub(pos1Z, pos2Z), 2)));
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetNavigationLocationTypeByName.inc
================================================================================

GetNavigationLocationTypeByName(playerID, name[])
{
	new typeID;
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `navigationlocationtypes` WHERE `name` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(name));
	mysql_store_result();
	if (mysql_num_rows())
	{
		typeID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!typeID)
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `navigationlocationtypes` WHERE `name` LIKE 'L:%%'");
		mysql_store_result();
		while (FetchMySQLRow())
		{
			new checkCharacter;
			new languageStringID;
			sscanf(GetMySQLField("name"), "p<:>cd", checkCharacter, languageStringID);
			if (IsStr(name, LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID)))
			{
				typeID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
				break;
			}
		}
		mysql_free_result();
	}
	return typeID;
}

GetPlayerZone(playerID, checkZ)
{
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	Count(zone, sizeof(zones))
	{
		if (posX >= zones[zone][ZONE_STARTX] && posX <= zones[zone][ZONE_ENDX] && posY >= zones[zone][ZONE_STARTY] && posY <= zones[zone][ZONE_ENDY])
		{
			if (!checkZ || (posZ >= zones[zone][ZONE_STARTZ] && posZ <= zones[zone][ZONE_ENDZ]))
			{
				return zone;
			}
		}
	}
	return -1;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetVehicleColor.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Gets the color combination for the given vehicle model ID.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="modelID">
 *	The ID of the vehicle model.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color1">
 *	The first color.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="color2">
 *	The second color.
 * </param>
 */

GetVehicleColor(modelID, &color1, &color2)
{
	if (modelID < 400 || modelID > 611)
	{
		return false;
	}

	new arrayIndex = modelID - 400;
	new maxColorIndex = -1;
	Count(colorIndex, MAX_VEHICLE_COLORS)
	{
		if (vehicleColors[arrayIndex][colorIndex][0] == -1 || vehicleColors[arrayIndex][colorIndex][1] == -1)
		{
			break;
		}
		maxColorIndex = colorIndex;
	}

	if (maxColorIndex < 0)
	{
		return false;
	}

	new randomColorIndex = random(maxColorIndex + 1);// random returns a value between 0 and max (Excluding the max value) -> maxColorIndex + 1 will return a value between 0 and maxColorIndex

	color1 = vehicleColors[arrayIndex][randomColorIndex][0];
	color2 = vehicleColors[arrayIndex][randomColorIndex][1];

	return true;
}

GetXYFromAngle(&Float:posX, &Float:posY, Float:angle, Float:distance)
{
	posX += (distance * floatsin(-angle, degrees));

}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GetXYZFromAngle.inc

GetXYZFromAngle(&Float:posX, &Float:posY, &Float:posZ, Float:angle, Float:elevation, Float:distance)
{
	posX += (distance * floatsin(angle, degrees) * floatcos(elevation, degrees));
	posY += (distance * floatcos(angle, degrees) * floatcos(elevation, degrees));
	posZ += (distance * floatsin(elevation, degrees));
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/GiveLicense.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Give or revoke a license
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="giverPlayerID">
 *	The ID of the player wich gives the license
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player you want to give or revoke the license
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="type">
 *	The license type string
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="newState">
 *	<title>The new state</title>
 *	<item name="true">Give the license</item>
 *	<item name="false">Revoke the license</item>
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item>true if successful</item>
 *	<item>false if failed</item>
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	<title>This function returns false if you try to...</title>
 *	<item>...give a license to a player which already owns the license</item>
 *	<item>...revoke a license from a player which does not own the license</item>
 * </remarks>
 */

GiveLicense(giverPlayerID, playerID, type[], newState)
{
	new currentState = HasLicense(playerID, type);
	if (newState && !currentState)
	{
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `licenses` (`giverUserId`, `userId`, `type`, `date`) VALUES('%d', '%d', '%s', NOW())", PVar:giverPlayerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(type));
		return true;
	}
	if (!newState && currentState)
	{
		MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `licenses` WHERE `userId` = '%d' AND `type` = '%s'", PVar:playerID[USERID], MySQLEscapeString(type));
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/IsBanned.inc
================================================================================

IsBanned(playerID, showMessage)
{
	new ip[16];
	GetPlayerIp(playerID, ip, sizeof(ip));
	new userID;
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `username` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(GetPlayerNameEx(playerID)));
	mysql_store_result();
	userID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!userID)
	{
		userID = -1;
	}
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `bans` WHERE `ip` = '%s' OR `userId` = '%d'", ip, userID);
	mysql_store_result();
	new rows = mysql_num_rows();
	if (rows)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:473("Sorry, but you got banned from this server!"));
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:474("Reason for the ban: %s"), GetMySQLField("reason"));
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:475("You got banned by mistake? In this case, please contact us on http://www.grgserver.net."));
		}
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	return rows;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/LoadNPCs.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Load and connect all NPCs.
 * </summary>
 */

LoadNPCs()
{
	print("* Loading NPCs...");
	new arrayIndex;
	new XMLNode:xml = XML_LoadDocument(FILE_NPCS);
	xml = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "npcs");
	new XMLNode:npcNode = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "npc");
	while (npcNode)
	{
		if (arrayIndex >= MAX_NPCS)
		{
			printf("  MAX_NPCS (%d) reached!", MAX_NPCS);
			break;
		}

		new value[100];

		// Basic NPC data
		XML_GetAttribute(npcNode, "name", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME], MAX_PLAYER_NAME);
		XML_GetAttribute(npcNode, "skin", value);
		npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SKIN] = strval(value);

		// Recording if specified
		new XMLNode:recordingNode = XML_GetFirstChild(npcNode, "recording");
		if (recordingNode)
		{
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "name", npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDING], STRINGLENGTH_NPCRECORDINGNAME);
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "startDelay", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_STARTDELAY] = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "autoStart", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOSTART] = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(recordingNode, "autoRepeat", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_AUTOREPEAT] = strval(value);
		}

		// Vehicle if specified
		new XMLNode:vehicleNode = XML_GetFirstChild(npcNode, "vehicle");
		if (vehicleNode)
		{
			XML_GetAttribute(vehicleNode, "model", value);
			new modelID = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(vehicleNode, "color1", value);
			new color1 = strval(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(vehicleNode, "color2", value);
			new color2 = strval(value);
			if (color1 == -1 || color2 == -1)
			{
				GetVehicleColor(modelID, color1, color2);
			}
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLECOLORS][0] = color1;
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLECOLORS][1] = color2;
			new vehicleID = AddStaticVehicle(modelID, 0, 0, -100, 0, color1, color2);
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[NPC_ONLY] = true;
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_VEHICLEID] = vehicleID;
		}

		// Spawn position if specified
		new XMLNode:spawnNode = XML_GetFirstChild(npcNode, "spawn");
		if (spawnNode)
		{
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "posX", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "posY", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "posZ", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(spawnNode, "angle", value);
			npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE] = floatstr(value);
		}

		SetTimerEx("Timer_ConnectNPC", arrayIndex * NPC_CONNECT_DELAY, false, "d", arrayIndex);

		npcNode = XML_GetNextSibling(npcNode, "npc");
		arrayIndex++;
	}
	XML_UnloadDocument(xml);
	printf("  %d NPCs loaded", arrayIndex);
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/SAMP-master/includes/grgserver/Functions/LoadObjectsFromFile.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Load all objects from the given XML file
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="filename">
 *	The name of the file in scriptfiles directory
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	The XML file must have the following structure:
 *	<objects>
 *		<object id="The internal ID" model="ID of the model" posX="0" posY="0" posZ="0" rotX="0" rotY="0" rotZ="0" interior="0">
 *			<move posX="0" posY="0" posZ="0" rotX="0" rotY="0" rotZ="0" speed="0.1" timeout="1000"/>
 *			<speedcamera speedLimit="50"/>
 *		</object>
 *	</objects>
 *	The move-element is optional (Required if you want to move the object using MoveObjectEx)
 *	The speedcamera-Element is only used and required for speed camera objects (Model 18880)
 * </remarks>
 */

LoadObjectsFromFile(filename[])
{
	new count;
	new value[100];

	FormatNew:filePath[100]("objects/%s", filename);

	new XMLNode:xml = XML_LoadDocument(filePath);
	xml = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "objects");
	new XMLNode:objectNode = XML_GetFirstChild(xml, "object");
	while (objectNode)
	{
		// Arrays holding X, Y, Z for position and rotation
		new Float:position[3];
		new Float:rotation[3];

		// Arrays holding X, Y, Z for position and rotation of move target
		new Float:movePosition[3];
		new Float:moveRotation[3];

		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "id", value);
		new id = strval(value);

		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "model", value);
		new modelID = strval(value);

		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "interior", value);
		new interior = strval(value);

		// Read position
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "posX", value);
		position[0] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "posY", value);
		position[1] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "posZ", value);
		position[2] = floatstr(value);

		// Read rotation
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "rotX", value);
		rotation[0] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "rotY", value);
		rotation[1] = floatstr(value);
		XML_GetAttribute(objectNode, "rotZ", value);
		rotation[2] = floatstr(value);

		new XMLNode:moveNode = XML_GetFirstChild(objectNode, "move");

		new Float:moveSpeed;
		new moveTimeout;

		if (moveNode)
		{
			// Read move target position
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "posX", value);
			movePosition[0] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "posY", value);
			movePosition[1] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "posZ", value);
			movePosition[2] = floatstr(value);

			// Read move target rotation
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "rotX", value);
			moveRotation[0] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "rotY", value);
			moveRotation[1] = floatstr(value);
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "rotZ", value);
			moveRotation[2] = floatstr(value);

			// Read move speed
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "speed", value);
			moveSpeed = floatstr(value);

			// Read move timeout
			XML_GetAttribute(moveNode, "timeout", value);
			moveTimeout = strval(value);
		}

		new objectID = CreateDynamicObject(modelID, position[0], position[1], position[2], rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2], -1, interior, -1, STREAMER_OBJECTDISTANCE);
		Streamer_SetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID, OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL);

		new arrayIndex = objectID - 1;// The first object created with CreateDynamicObject gets ID 1, but the first array index in dynamicObjects array is 0

		// Basic object data
		strmid(dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_FILENAME], filename, 0, strlen(filename) - 4, STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME);
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ID] = id;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS] = position;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_ROT] = rotation;

		// Moveable objects data
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS] = movePosition;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT] = moveRotation;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED] = moveSpeed;
		dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVETIMEOUT] = moveTimeout;

		if (modelID == SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTMODEL)// This object has the speed camera model
		{
			new XMLNode:speedcameraNode = XML_GetFirstChild(objectNode, "speedcamera");
			if (speedcameraNode)
			{
				XML_GetAttribute(speedcameraNode, "speedLimit", value);
				new speedLimit = strval(value);

				Foreach(speedCamerasArrayIndex, speedCameras)
				{
					if (!speedCameras[speedCamerasArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID])
					{
						speedCameras[speedCamerasArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_OBJECTID] = objectID;
						speedCameras[speedCamerasArrayIndex][SPEEDCAMERA_SPEEDLIMIT] = speedLimit;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				printf("Missing speedcamera element for object %d!", id);
			}
		}

		if (id >= nextDynamicObjectID)
		{
			nextDynamicObjectID = id + 1;
		}

		objectNode = XML_GetNextSibling(objectNode, "object");

		count++;
	}

	return count;
}
