CMD:givelicense(playerID, params[], StringID:511("Give license to a player"))// TODO: No permission check!
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	new licenseString[256];
	if (sscanf(params, "us[256]", targetPlayerID, licenseString))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "givelicense", "PlayerID/Name", "Bike|Boat|Car|Plane|Truck");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	new licenseArray[30][30];
	new license[30];
	explode(licenseString, licenseArray, ',', sizeof(licenseArray));
	for (new licenseIndex = 0; licenseIndex < sizeof(licenseArray); licenseIndex++)
	{
		license = licenseArray[licenseIndex];
		new newState = true;
		if (license[0] == '-')
		{
			strdel(license, 0, 1);
			newState = false;
		}
		if (strlen(license))
		{
			if (GiveLicense(playerID, targetPlayerID, license, newState))
			{
				if (newState)
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:513("You got a %l!"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:535("You gave a %l to %p"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license), targetPlayerID);
				}
				else
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:537("Your %l has been revoked!"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:536("You revoked the %l from %p!"), GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license), targetPlayerID);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (newState)
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:512("%p already owns that license (%l)!"), targetPlayerID, GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
				}
				else
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:538("%p does not own a %l!"), targetPlayerID, GetLicenseLanguageStringID(license));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/givepermission.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:givepermission[SERVERADMIN](playerID, params[], StringID:103("Give permissions to a player"))
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	new permissionString[16];
	if (sscanf(params, "us[16]", targetPlayerID, permissionString))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "givepermission", "PlayerID/Name", "Admin|Mapper|Moderator|Navi|NPCAdmin|ServerAdmin|SpawnVehicle|Teleport");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	if (IsPlayerConnected(targetPlayerID))
	{
		new permissionsArray[30][30];
		new permission[30];
		explode(permissionString, permissionsArray, ',', sizeof(permissionsArray));
		for (new permissionIndex = 0; permissionIndex < sizeof(permissionsArray); permissionIndex++)
		{
			permission = permissionsArray[permissionIndex];
			if (strcmp(permission, "userId", true))
			{
				new newState = true;
				if (permission[0] == '-')
				{
					strdel(permission, 0, 1);
					newState = false;
				}
				new permissionID = GetPermissionByName(permission);
				if (permissionID == -1)
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:381("Invalid permission: %s"), permission);
				}
				else
				{
					if (permissions[targetPlayerID][enum_permission:permissionID] == newState)
					{
						if (newState)
						{
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:70("%p already has the permission '%s'!"), targetPlayerID, permission);
						}
						else
						{
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:71("%p does not have the permission '%s' so it can not be removed!"), targetPlayerID, permission);
						}
						return COMMAND_ERROR;
					}
					MySQLQuery("SELECT `userId` FROM `permissions` WHERE `userId` = '%d'", PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
					mysql_store_result();
					new rows = mysql_num_rows();
					mysql_free_result();
					if (rows)
					{
						MySQLQuery("UPDATE `permissions` SET `%s` = '%d' WHERE `userId` = '%d'", MySQLEscapeString(permission), newState, PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
					}
					else
					{
						MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `permissions` (`userId`, `%s`) VALUES('%d', '%d')", MySQLEscapeString(permission), PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], newState);
					}
					permissions[targetPlayerID][enum_permission:permissionID] = newState;
					if (newState)
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:72("You got the permission '%s' from %p"), permission, playerID);
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:73("You gave the permission '%s' to %p"), permission, targetPlayerID);
						printf("%s got permission %s by %s", GetPlayerNameEx(targetPlayerID), permission, GetPlayerNameEx(playerID));
					}
					else
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:74("%p has revoked the permission '%s' from you"), playerID, permission);
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:75("You have revoked the permission '%s' from %p"), permission, targetPlayerID);
						printf("%s has revoked the permission %s of %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), permission, GetPlayerNameEx(targetPlayerID));
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	else
	{
		return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
	}
}

	return COMMAND_OK;

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/lockvehicle.inc
================================================================================

CMD:lockvehicle(playerID, params[], StringID:483("Lock or unlock a vehicle"))
{
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		new Float:posX;
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		vehicleID = GetClosestVehicleInRange(posX, posY, posZ, 5);
		if (!vehicleID)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:288("There is no vehicle in range!"));
			return COMMAND_ERROR;
		}
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
	{
		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] != PVar:playerID[USERID])
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:487("You are not the owner of this vehicle!"));
			return COMMAND_ERROR;
		}
	}
	else
	{
		if (!permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_MAPPER])
		{
			return COMMAND_PERMISSION_DENIED;
		}
	}
	if (IsVehicleLocked(vehicleID))
	{
		LockVehicle(vehicleID, false);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:485("The vehicle has been unlocked!"));
	}
	else
	{
		LockVehicle(vehicleID, true);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:484("The vehicle has been locked!"));
	}
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

PCMD:maptp[TELEPORT](playerID, params[], StringID:263("Teleport you to the target selected on the map"))
{
	if (PVar:playerID[MAP_POSX] && PVar:playerID[MAP_POSY])
	{
		SetPlayerPosFindZ(playerID, PVar:playerID[MAP_POSX], PVar:playerID[MAP_POSY], 6000.0);
		SetTimerEx("Timer_SetPlayerPosFindZ", 500, false, "dfff", playerID, PVar:playerID[MAP_POSX], PVar:playerID[MAP_POSY], 6000.0);// Workaround for http://forum.sa-mp.com/showthread.php?p=1800073
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:144("You got teleported"));
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	else
	{

	}
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/markobject.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:markobject[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:426("Mark an object on your map"))
{
	new objectID;
	if (sscanf(params, "d", objectID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "markobject", "objectID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	if (objectID <= 0 || objectID > CountDynamicObjects() || Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, objectID, E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID) != OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:427("Object not found!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	SetPlayerMapIcon(playerID, 0, dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_POS][0], dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_POS][1], dynamicObjects[objectID - 1][OBJECT_POS][2], 0, COLOR_MARKER_OBJECT, MAPICON_GLOBAL);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/markobjects.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:markobjects[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:482("Mark up to 100 objects on your map"))
{
	new modelID;
	if (sscanf(params, "d", modelID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "markobjects", "ModelID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	new count;
	new dynamicObjectsCount = CountDynamicObjects();
	new Float:foundObjects[100][3];
	Count(arrayIndex, dynamicObjectsCount)
	{
		if (Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, arrayIndex + 1, E_STREAMER_MODEL_ID) == modelID)
		{
			foundObjects[count][0] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0];
			foundObjects[count][1] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1];
			foundObjects[count][2] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2];
			count++;
			if (count >= 100)
			{
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	if (count)
	{
		Count(iconID, 100)
		{
			RemovePlayerMapIcon(playerID, iconID);
		}

		Count(iconID, count)
		{
			SetPlayerMapIcon(playerID, iconID, foundObjects[iconID][0], foundObjects[iconID][1], foundObjects[iconID][2], 0, COLOR_MARKER_OBJECT, MAPICON_GLOBAL);
		}

		return COMMAND_OK;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:425("No object found!"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

PCMD:mengine[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:111("Start or stop the engine of your vehicle"))
{

		return COMMAND_NOT_IN_VEHICLE;

	}
	SetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID, true);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:54("The engine of your vehicle has been turned on."));
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

		{

	}
	return COMMAND_ERROR;

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/moveobjects.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:moveobjects[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:636("Move all objects by the given coordinates in the given objects file"))
{
	new fileName[STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME];
	new Float:x;
	new Float:y;
	new Float:z;

	if (sscanf(params, "s[" #STRINGLENGTH_OBJECTFILENAME "]fff", fileName, x, y, z))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "moveobjects", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:634("Filename")), "X", "Y", "Z");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	new count;
	Foreach(arrayIndex, dynamicObjects)
	{
		if (!strcmp(dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_FILENAME], fileName, true))
		{
			dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0] + x;
			dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1] + y;
			dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2] = dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2] + z;
			SetDynamicObjectPos(arrayIndex + 1, dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][0], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][1], dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_POS][2]);
			count++;
		}
	}

	UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:635("%d objects were moved"), count);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/nocamproperty.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:nocamproperty[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:350("Teleport you to the next property without camera position"))
{
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` LEFT JOIN `pickups` ON `properties`.`pickupId` = `pickups`.`id` WHERE `cameraPosX` = '0' AND `cameraPosY` = '0' AND `cameraPosZ` = '0'");
	mysql_store_result();
	new rows = mysql_num_rows();
	if (rows)
	{
		SetPlayerPos(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")));
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:351("You got teleported to the next property (%s). There are %d properties without a camera position."), GetMySQLField("name"), rows);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (rows)
	{
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:352("There are no more properties without camera position!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/npccmd.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Command which gets called by a NPC if something changed.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player which called the command.
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="params">
 *	The parameters passed to this command.
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item>COMMAND_OK if the command is valid</item>
 *	<item>COMMAND_ERROR if the command is invalid</item>
 * </returns>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	This command can only be called by NPCs!
 * </remarks>
 */

NCMD:npccmd(playerID, params[], StringID:9("Report status to the server"))
{
	new command[256];
	new parameters[256];
	sscanf(params, "s[256]s[256]", command, parameters);

	new npcName[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
	GetPlayerName(playerID, npcName, sizeof(npcName));

	Foreach(arrayIndex, npcs)
	{
		if (IsStr(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME], npcName))
		{
			if (IsStr(command, "reclength"))
			{
				npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDINGLENGTH] = strval(parameters);
				return COMMAND_OK;
			}
			break;
		}
	}

	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

PCMD:npcinfo[NPCADMIN](playerID, params[], StringID:573("Show information about a NPC"))
{
	new npcPlayerID;

	}

	if (npcPlayerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
	{
		return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
	}

	Foreach(arrayIndex, npcs)
	{

		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:572("Last recording length: %s seconds"), FormatNumber(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_RECORDINGLENGTH]));
			return COMMAND_OK;
		}
	}

	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

	new Float:startPosZ;

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/relogin.inc
================================================================================

CMD:relogin(playerID, params[], StringID:507("Relogin with your current name or a new name"))
{
	if (!StrNotNull(params))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "relogin", "Playername");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	new checkPlayerID = GetPlayerID(params);
	if (checkPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID && checkPlayerID != playerID)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:508("Another player with this name is already connected!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	OnPlayerDisconnect(playerID, 3);
	if (SetPlayerName(playerID, params) == -1)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:509("Your name could not be changed! Your old name will be used."));
	}
	ForceClassSelection(playerID);
	TogglePlayerSpectating(playerID, true);
	TogglePlayerSpectating(playerID, false);
	OnPlayerConnect(playerID);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/removefriend.inc
================================================================================

CMD:removefriend(playerID, params[], StringID:446("Remove a player from your friend list"))
{
	new targetPlayerID;
	if (sscanf(params, "u", targetPlayerID))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "removefriend", "Playername/ID");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}
	if (targetPlayerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID || !IsLoggedIn(targetPlayerID))
	{
		return COMMAND_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
	}
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `friends` WHERE (`userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d') OR (`userId2` = '%d' AND `userId1` = '%d')", PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	new isInList = mysql_num_rows();
	mysql_free_result();
	if (!isInList)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:447("%p is not in your friendlist!"), targetPlayerID);
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `friends` WHERE (`userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d') OR (`userId2` = '%d' AND `userId1` = '%d')", PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID], PVar:playerID[USERID], PVar:targetPlayerID[USERID]);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:448("%p has been removed from your friend list"), targetPlayerID);
	SendClientMessageEx(targetPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:449("%p has removed you from his/her friend list"), playerID);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/removevehicle.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:removevehicle[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:455("Remove the current vehicle from the database"))
{
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		return COMMAND_NOT_IN_VEHICLE;
	}
	if (!VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:456("This vehicle is not a saved vehicle!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}
	MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `vehiclecomponents` WHERE `vehicleId` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID]);
	MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `vehicles` WHERE `id` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID]);
	MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `originalvehicles` WHERE `id` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID]);
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID] = 0;
	DestroyVehicle(vehicleID);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:457("The vehicle has been removed"));
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

CMD:repair(playerID, params[], StringID:296("Repair vehicle"))
{
	if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] == JOB_ADAC)
	{
		new targetPlayerID;
		new Float:price;
		if (sscanf(params, "uf", targetPlayerID, price))
		{
			CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "repair", "Playername/ID", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:298("Price")));
			return COMMAND_USAGE;
		}
		if (PVar:targetPlayerID[MONEY] >= price)
		{
			if (IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(targetPlayerID))
			{
				PVar:targetPlayerID[REPAIR_EXECUTOR] = playerID;
				PVar:targetPlayerID[REPAIR_PRICE] = price;
				ShowDialog:Repair(targetPlayerID);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:303("The request has been send to the player"));
				return COMMAND_OK;
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:300("%p is not in any vehicle"), targetPlayerID);
				return COMMAND_ERROR;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:299("%p has not enought money!"), targetPlayerID);
			return COMMAND_ERROR;
		}
	}
	return COMMAND_PERMISSION_DENIED;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/saveinfo.inc
================================================================================

CMD:saveinfo(playerID, params[], StringID:450("Save information like your current position, skin or vehicle model ID"))
{
	new File:file;
	new lines[2048];
	new year;
	new month;
	new day;
	new hour;
	new minute;
	new second;
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:angle;
	new Float:frontVectorX;
	new Float:frontVectorY;
	new Float:frontVectorZ;
	getdate(year, month, day);
	gettime(hour, minute, second);
	AddLine:lines("Player: %s", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID));
	AddLine:lines("Date: %d/%02d/%02d %02d:%02d:%02d", year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
	GetPlayerCameraPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	GetPlayerCameraFrontVector(playerID, frontVectorX, frontVectorY, frontVectorZ);
	new Float:lookX = floatadd(posX, frontVectorX);
	new Float:lookY = floatadd(posY, frontVectorY);
	new Float:lookZ = floatadd(posZ, frontVectorZ);
	AddLine:lines("Camera Position: %f x %f x %f", posX, posY, posZ);
	AddLine:lines("Camera Look: %f x %f x %f", lookX, lookY, lookZ);
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (vehicleID)
	{
		AddLine(lines, "Mode: Vehicle");
		AddLine:lines("ModelID: %d", GetVehicleModel(vehicleID));
		GetVehiclePos(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
		GetVehicleZAngle(vehicleID, angle);
		AddLine:lines("Vehicle Position: %f x %f x %f", posX, posY, posZ);
		AddLine:lines("Z Angle: %f", angle);
	}
	else
	{
		AddLine(lines, "Mode: On Foot");
		AddLine:lines("Skin: %d", GetPlayerSkin(playerID));
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
		AddLine:lines("Player Position: %f x %f x %f", posX, posY, posZ);
		AddLine:lines("Facing Angle: %f", angle);
	}
	if (StrNotNull(params))
	{
		AddLine:lines("Comment: %s", params);
	}
	file = fopen(FILE_SAVEINFO, io_readwrite);
	if (file)
	{
		if (flength(file))
		{
			Format:lines("\n\n%s", lines);
		}
		fseek(file, 0, seek_end);
		fwrite(file, lines);
		fclose(file);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:451("The information has been saved to the file '%s' on the server"), FILE_SAVEINFO);
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:452("Error while writing the file!"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/setnpcspawn.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:setnpcspawn[NPCADMIN](playerID, params[], StringID:282("Set the spawn position of a NPC"))
{
	new npcName[MAX_PLAYER_NAME];
	if (sscanf(params, "s[" #MAX_PLAYER_NAME "]", npcName))
	{
		CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "setnpcspawn", "Name");
		return COMMAND_USAGE;
	}

	Foreach(arrayIndex, npcs)
	{
		if (!IsStr(npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_NAME], npcName))
		{
			continue;
		}

		GetPlayerPos(playerID, npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][0], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][1], npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNPOS][2]);
		if (IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerID))
		{
			GetVehicleZAngle(GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID), npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE]);
		}
		else
		{
			GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, npcs[arrayIndex][NPC_SPAWNANGLE]);
		}

		SaveNPCs();

		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:283("The spawn position of the NPC has been changed"));
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:284("NPC not found!"));
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/setobjectmovepos.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:setobjectmovepos[MAPPER](playerID, params[], StringID:463("Set the position and rotation for the current selected object to move to"))
{
	if (!PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID])
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:464("No object selected! Select the object using /editobject and move it to the position you want."));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	if (Streamer_GetIntData(STREAMER_TYPE_OBJECT, PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], E_STREAMER_EXTRA_ID) != OBJECTTYPE_NORMAL)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:200("The object is not a streamed object or is already used in another way!"));
		return COMMAND_ERROR;
	}

	new Float:speed;
	new timeout;
	if (sscanf(params, "fd", speed, timeout))
	{
		if (sscanf(params, "f", speed))
		{
			CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "setobjectmovepos", "Speed", "[Timeout]");
			return COMMAND_USAGE;
		}
	}

	new arrayIndex = PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID] - 1;
	new Float:position[3];
	new Float:rotation[3];
	GetDynamicObjectPos(PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], position[0], position[1], position[2]);
	GetDynamicObjectRot(PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID], rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2]);

	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEPOS] = position;
	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVEROT] = rotation;
	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVESPEED] = speed;
	dynamicObjects[arrayIndex][OBJECT_MOVETIMEOUT] = timeout;

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:465("The target position has been saved. You can test the movement using /moveobject %d 1."), PVar:playerID[OBJEDITOR_CURRENTOBJECTID]);
	return COMMAND_OK;
}

}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/spawnvehicle.inc
================================================================================

PCMD:spawnvehicle[SPAWNVEHICLE](playerID, params[], StringID:505("Spawn a vehicle"))
{
	new vehicleName[20];
	new modelID;
	new color1;
	new color2;
	if (sscanf(params, "ddd", modelID, color1, color2))
	{
		if (!sscanf(params, "d", modelID))
		{
			color1 = -1;
			color2 = -1;
		}
		else
		{
			if (sscanf(params, "s[20]dd", vehicleName, color1, color2))
			{
				if (sscanf(params, "s[20]", vehicleName))
				{
					CmdUsageMsg(playerID, "spawnvehicle", "ModelID/Name/t:Type", "[Color1]", "[Color2]");
					return COMMAND_USAGE;
				}
				else
				{
					color1 = -1;
					color2 = -1;
				}
			}
			new type;
			new parameter[16];
			new vehicleList[2048];
			new foundVehicles;
			if (sscanf(vehicleName, "p<:>cs[16]", type, parameter))
			{
				Foreach(arrayIndex, vehicleModels)
				{
					if (strfind(vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME], vehicleName, true) != -1)
					{
						AddLine:vehicleList("%d\t%s", arrayIndex + 400, vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
						foundVehicles++;
						modelID = arrayIndex + 400;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (type)
				{
					case 't':
					{
						Foreach(arrayIndex, vehicleModels)
						{
							if (IsStr(vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], parameter))
							{
								AddLine:vehicleList("%d\t%s", arrayIndex + 400, vehicleModels[arrayIndex][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
								foundVehicles++;
								modelID = arrayIndex + 400;
							}
						}
					}
					default:
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:58("Invalid type!"));
						return COMMAND_ERROR;
					}
				}
			}
			if (foundVehicles > 1)
			{
				PVar:playerID[SPAWNVEHICLE_COLOR1] = color1;
				PVar:playerID[SPAWNVEHICLE_COLOR2] = color2;
				FormatNew:title[64](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:122("Spawn a vehicle [%s]")), vehicleName);
				CreateDialog(playerID, "SpawnVehicle", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, vehicleList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:205("Spawn")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
				modelID = -1;
			}
		}
	}
	if (modelID == -1)
	{
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	if (SpawnVehicle(playerID, modelID, color1, color2, true))
	{
		return COMMAND_OK;
	}
	return COMMAND_ERROR;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Commands/tow.inc
================================================================================

CMD:tow(playerID, params[], StringID:285("Tow vehicle"))
{
	if (PVar:playerID[JOBID] == JOB_ADAC)
	{
		if (IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerID))
		{
			new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
			if (GetVehicleModel(vehicleID) == 525)
			{
				if (IsTrailerAttachedToVehicle(vehicleID))
				{
					DetachTrailerFromVehicle(vehicleID);
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:289("Vehicle dettached"));
					return COMMAND_OK;
				}
				else
				{
					new Float:posX;
					new Float:posY;
					new Float:posZ;
					GetVehiclePos(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
					new trailerVehicleID = GetClosestVehicleInRange(posX, posY, posZ, 10.0, vehicleID);
					if (trailerVehicleID == INVALID_VEHICLE_ID)
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:288("There is no vehicle in range!"));
						return COMMAND_ERROR;
					}
					else
					{
						AttachTrailerToVehicle(trailerVehicleID, vehicleID);
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:290("Vehicle attached"));
						return COMMAND_OK;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:286("You have to be in a TowTruck!"));
				return COMMAND_ERROR;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			return COMMAND_NOT_IN_VEHICLE;
		}
	}
	else 
	{
		return COMMAND_PERMISSION_DENIED;
	}
}

ShowDialog:AddNaviLocation_Type(playerID)
{
	new options[2048];
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `navigationlocationtypes`");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new string[256];
		strcat(string, GetMySQLField("name"));
		new checkCharacter;
		new languageStringID;
		if (!sscanf(string, "p<:>cd", checkCharacter, languageStringID))
		{
			if (checkCharacter == 'L')
			{
				Format:string(LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID));
			}
		}
		AddLine(options, string);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:378("Add new type")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "AddNaviLocation_Type", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:377("Select location type")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:AddNaviLocation_Type(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:378("Add new type"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:AddNaviLocation_NewType(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			new typeID = GetNavigationLocationTypeByName(playerID, inputText);
			if (typeID)
			{
				new Float:posX;
				new Float:posY;
				new Float:posZ;
				GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
				MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `navigationlocations` (`type`, `posX`, `posY`, `posZ`) VALUES('%d', '%f', '%f', '%f')", typeID, posX, posY, posZ);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:383("The location has been added"));
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:143("An error occurred while processing the command!"));
			}
		}
	}
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_AddProperty_Name.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:AddProperty_Name(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "AddProperty_Name", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:168("Enter name")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:169("Enter the name for the property.")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:170("Create")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:AddProperty_Name(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new Float:posX;
		new Float:posY;
		new Float:posZ;
		GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
		MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `pickups` (`posX`, `posY`, `posZ`, `type`) VALUES('%f', '%f', '%f', '%s')", posX, posY, posZ, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE]);
		new pickupID = mysql_insert_id();
		if (pickupID)
		{
			if (AddPickup(pickupID, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], posX, posY, posZ))
			{
				MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `properties` (`pickupId`, `interiorId`, `name`, `price`) VALUES ('%d', '%d', '%s', '%f')", pickupID, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_INTERIORID], MySQLEscapeString(inputText), PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_PRICE]);
				new propertyID = mysql_insert_id();
				if (IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "BANK"))
				{
					MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `bankbranches` (`propertyId`, `bankId`) SELECT '%d', `id` FROM `banks` ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1", propertyID);
				}
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:10("The property %s (Price: %m) has been saved with ID %d. Remember to set the camera position using /setpropertycam!"), inputText, PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_PRICE], propertyID);
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:6("Error while creating the pickup!"));
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:6("Error while creating the pickup!"));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		if (IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "BANK") || IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "HOTEL") || IsStr(PVar:playerID[ADDPROPERTY_TYPE], "PLACE"))
		{
			ShowDialog:AddProperty_Type(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			ShowInteriorDialog(playerID, INTERIORDIALOG_ADDPROPERTY);
		}
	}
}

	{
		new type[STRINGLENGTH_PROPERTYTYPE];
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:173("Bank"))))

			type = "BANK";
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:174("Hotel"))))

			type = "HOTEL";

		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:175("House"))))

			ShowDialog:AddProperty_Name(playerID);
			return true;
		}
		ShowInteriorDialog(playerID, INTERIORDIALOG_ADDPROPERTY);
	}
	return true;
}

ShowDialog:Bank_NewAccount(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Bank_NewAccount", DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:210("New bank account")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:211("You do not own a bank account yet.\nDo you want to create a new one?")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:166("Yes")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:167("No")));

DialogResponse:Bank_NewAccount(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	new bankName[100];
	PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN] = RandomEx(BANK_PIN_MIN, BANK_PIN_MAX);

	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `banks` LEFT JOIN `bankbranches` ON `bankbranches`.`bankId` = `banks`.`id` WHERE `bankbranches`.`propertyId` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	strcat(bankName, GetMySQLField("name"));
	PVar:playerID[BANK_ID] = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
	mysql_free_result();

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:216("You now have a bank account at the %s"), bankName);
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:579("Your new PIN for your bank account is %d"), PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN]);

	if (PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL])
	{
		TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, false);
		StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_TUTORIAL_BANK_LEAVE, 0);
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
	}

	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Bank_PIN.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Bank_PIN(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Bank_PIN", DIALOG_STYLE_PASSWORD, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:580("Enter PIN")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:581("Enter the PIN of your bank account.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Bank_PIN(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	new pin = strval(inputText);
	if (pin < BANK_PIN_MIN || pin > BANK_PIN_MAX)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:582("The PIN must be between %d and %d!"), BANK_PIN_MIN, BANK_PIN_MAX);
		ShowDialog:Bank_PIN(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] >= BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:585("You have reached the maximum number of wrong tries! Your bank account has been blocked!"));
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN] == pin)
	{
		PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] = 0;
		ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
		return true;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:583("The entered PIN is not correct!"));
	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] >= BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:585("You have reached the maximum number of wrong tries! Your bank account has been blocked!"));
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS]++;
	if (PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS] >= BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:585("You have reached the maximum number of wrong tries! Your bank account has been blocked!"));
		LeaveProperty(playerID);
		return false;
	}

	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:584("You have %d more tries"), BANK_PIN_MAXATTEMPTS - PVar:playerID[BANK_PIN_ATTEMPTS]);
	ShowDialog:Bank_PIN(playerID);
	return false;
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Bank_WithdrawMoney.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Bank_WithdrawMoney", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:207("Withdraw money")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:213("Enter the amount how much money you want to withdraw from your account.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (!strlen(inputText))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:19("You have to enter the amount!"));
			ShowDialog:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			new Float:money = floatstr(inputText);
			if(money > PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY])
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:25("You don't have enough money at your bank!"));
				ShowDialog:Bank_WithdrawMoney(playerID);
			}
			else
			{
				new Float:newMoney = floatadd(PVar:playerID[MONEY], money);
				if (newMoney > MAX_MONEY)
				{
					newMoney = MAX_MONEY;
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:492("You have exceeded the cash limit of %m!"), MAX_MONEY);
				}
				money = floatsub(newMoney, PVar:playerID[MONEY]);
				SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_BANK, -money, true);
				SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_CASH, money, true);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:26("You got %m from your bank account"), money);
				ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Bank_HasAccount(playerID);
	}
}

ShowDialog:BuyHouse(playerID, Float:price)
{
	FormatNew:title[64](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:236("Buy house - %s")), GetMySQLValue("properties", "name", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID])));
	FormatNew:string[100](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:235("This house can be bought.\n\nPrice: $%s")), FormatMoney(price));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "BuyHouse", DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, title, string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:237("Buy")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:BuyHouse(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new propertyID = PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID];
		new Float:price = floatstr(GetMySQLValue("properties", "price", "id", val2str(propertyID)));
		if (price <= PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY])
		{
			TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, false);
			PlayAudio(playerID, "property_bought.ogg");
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` LEFT JOIN `pickups` ON `properties`.`pickupId` = `pickups`.`id` WHERE `properties`.`id` = '%d'", propertyID);
			mysql_store_result();
			SetPlayerCameraPos(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("cameraPosX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("cameraPosY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("cameraPosZ")));
			SetPlayerCameraLookAt(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")));
			mysql_free_result();
			GameTextForPlayer(playerID, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:28("Property bought")), 8000, 1);
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `ownerUserId` = '%d' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID], propertyID);
			SetPlayerMoney(playerID, MONEY_BANK, -price, true);
			ReloadPickup(strval(GetMySQLValue("properties", "pickupId", "id", val2str(propertyID))));
			SetTimerEx("Timer_ScreenFader", 8000, false, "ddddddd", playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_PROPERTYBOUGHT, 0);
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:22("You need %m to buy this property! But you only have %m at you bank account."), price, PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY]);
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_BuyVehicle.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:BuyVehicle(playerID, Float:price)
{
	FormatNew:string[100](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:244("Do you want to buy this vehicle?\n\nPrice: $%s")), FormatMoney(price));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "BuyVehicle", DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:245("Buy vehicle")), string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:166("Yes")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:167("No")));
}

DialogResponse:BuyVehicle(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
		if (!vehicleID)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (!VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SAVEID])
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE] <= PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY])
		{
			GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_BANK, -VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE]);
			if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID])
			{
				new sellerID = GetPlayerByUserID(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID]);
				if (sellerID == INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
				{
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `users` SET `money` = `money` + '%f' WHERE `id` = '%d'", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID]);
				}
				else
				{
					GivePlayerMoneyEx(sellerID, MONEY_BANK, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE]);
					SendClientMessageEx(sellerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:494("%p has bought your vehicle"), playerID);
				}
			}

			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] = PVar:playerID[USERID];
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID] = 0;
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR1] = VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR1];
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[COLOR2] = VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTCOLOR2];

			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:493("You have bought a vehicle"));
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:27("You need %m to buy this vehicle! But you only have %m at your bank account."), VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE], PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY]);
		}
	}
	return true;
}

ShowDialog:ChatMode(playerID)
{
	new options[1024];
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:311("In range (max 100m)")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:310("All")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:504("Friend")));
	AddLine(options, "Job");
	AddLine(options, "Admins");
	CreateDialog(playerID, "ChatMode", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:312("Change chat channel")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:ChatMode(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new oldChatMode[STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE];
		strcat(oldChatMode, PVar:playerID[CHATMODE]);
		if (IsStr(inputText, "Admins"))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("ADMINS");
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:310("All"))))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("ALL");
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:504("Friend"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:ChatMode_FriendList(playerID);
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:311("In range (max 100m)"))))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("INRANGE");
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, "Job"))
		{
			SetPVarStr:playerID[CHATMODE][STRINGLENGTH_CHATMODE]("JOB");
		}
		if (!IsStr(oldChatMode, PVar:playerID[CHATMODE]))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:313("Chat channel changed to '%s'"), GetChatModeName(playerID, PVar:playerID[CHATMODE]));
		}
	}
}

		ShowDialog:ChatMode(playerID);

	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("Order Vehicle")));

	{

		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = false;
			new time = gettime() - PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME];
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:360("You have ended your working day. Worked hours: %d"), time / 60 / 60);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:357("Start work"))))// Start work
		{
			PVar:playerID[ATWORK] = true;
			PVar:playerID[WORKSTARTTIME] = gettime();

		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:218("Cancel job"))))// Cancel job
		{
			PVar:playerID[JOBID] = JOB_UNEMPLOYED;
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:359("You have cancelled your job"));
			SetPlayerSkin(playerID, PVar:playerID[SKIN]);
		}
		if (!strcmp(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("OrderVehicle"))))
		{
			ShowDialog:OrderVehicle(playerID);
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_FriendRequests_Options.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:FriendRequests_Options(playerID, friendUserID)
{
	new list[2048];
	AddLine(list, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")));// Accept
	AddLine(list, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:499("Decline")));// Decline
	PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID] = friendUserID;
	CreateDialog(playerID, "FriendRequests_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:496("Options")), list, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:FriendRequests_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept"))))// Accept
		{
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `friends` SET `accepted` = '1' WHERE `userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID], PVar:playerID[USERID]);
			new friendPlayerID = GetPlayerByUserID(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID]);
			if (friendPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(friendPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:441("%p has confirmed your friend request"), playerID);
			}
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:442("%s has been added to your friend list"), GetMySQLValue("users", "username", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID])));
		}
		if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:499("Decline"))))// Decline
		{
			MySQLQuery("DELETE FROM `friends` WHERE `userId1` = '%d' AND `userId2` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID], PVar:playerID[USERID]);
			new friendPlayerID = GetPlayerByUserID(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID]);
			if (friendPlayerID != INVALID_PLAYER_ID)
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(friendPlayerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:500("%p has declined your friend request!"), playerID);
			}
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:501("You have declined the friend request of %s!"), GetMySQLValue("users", "username", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[FRIENDUSERID])));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:FriendRequests(playerID);
	}
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_House.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:House(playerID)
{
	FormatNew:title[64](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:329("Your house - %s")), GetMySQLValue("properties", "name", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID])));
	new options[1024];
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:268("Enter")));// Item 0
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:328("Sell")));// Item 1
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:476("Lock/Unlock")));// Item 2
	CreateDialog(playerID, "House", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:House(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		switch (listItem)
		{
			case 0:// Enter
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:481("This house is locked!")));
				}
				else
				{
					TeleportToProperty(playerID, PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
			}
			case 1:// Sell
			{
				MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `ownerUserId` = '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new Float:price = floatstr(GetMySQLField("price"));
				new pickupID = strval(GetMySQLField("pickupId"));
				mysql_free_result();
				GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_BANK, price);
				ReloadPickup(pickupID);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:330("Your house has been sold!"));
			}
			case 2:// Lock
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:477("You have unlocked your house")));
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked`= '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
				else
				{
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked` = '1' WHERE `id`= '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:478("You have locked your house")));
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Login.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Login(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Login", DIALOG_STYLE_PASSWORD, "Login", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:262("Please enter the password of your account.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Login(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		if (strlen(inputText))
		{
			MySQLQuery("SELECT `id` FROM `users` WHERE `username` = '%s' AND `password` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(GetPlayerNameEx(playerID)), MD5(inputText));
			mysql_store_result();
			if (mysql_num_rows())
			{
				PVar:playerID[USERID] = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:30("The entered password is wrong!"));
				ShowDialog:Login(playerID);
			}
			mysql_free_result();
			if (PVar:playerID[USERID])
			{
				MySQLQuery("UPDATE `users` SET `loginTime` = NOW(), `clientVersion` = '%s' WHERE `id` = '%d'", GetPlayerVersionEx(playerID), PVar:playerID[USERID]);
				printf("Player logged in: %s (UserID: %d)", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), PVar:playerID[USERID]);
				PlayerLoop(currentPlayerID)
				{
					if (currentPlayerID != playerID)
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(currentPlayerID, COLOR_JOINLEAVE, StringID:7("%p logged in"), playerID);
					}
				}
				LoadPlayer(playerID);
				ReloadTextDraws(playerID);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:35("You have been logged in successfully"));
				PVar:playerID[PLAYRANDOMCAMERACUTS] = false;
				if (PVar:playerID[INTUTORIAL])// The player is still in the tutorial (e.g. Quit game while in tutorial)
				{
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_TUTORIAL_START, 0);
				}
				else
				{
					StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 5, 0, FADE_LOGIN, 0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:36("You have to enter your password!"));
				ShowDialog:Login(playerID);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:36("You have to enter your password!"));
			ShowDialog:Login(playerID);
		}
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:37("You can now quit the game"));
		Kick(playerID);
	}
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Missions.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Missions(playerID)
{
	new missionList[2048];

	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `type`, `data` FROM `missions` WHERE `jobId` = '%d' AND `acceptUserId` = '0' ORDER BY `id` ASC", PVar:playerID[JOBID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new missionTitle[100];
		new type[100];
		new missionData[20][2][32];
		new validType;
		new missionID = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
		strcat(type, GetMySQLField("type"));
		GetMissionData(GetMySQLField("data"), missionData);

		if (IsStr(type, "GetOrderedCar"))
		{
			new modelID;
			Foreach(arrayIndex, missionData)
			{
				if (IsStr(missionData[arrayIndex][0], "modelId"))
				{
					modelID = strval(missionData[arrayIndex][1]);
				}
			}
			if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
			{
				if (IsStr(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], "Car"))
				{
					Format:missionTitle(LanguageString(playerID, StringID:586("Pickup an ordered car (%s)")), vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
				}
				else
				{
					printf("WARNING: %s is not a car!", vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				printf("WARNING: Invalid vehicle model ID (%d) for mission %d!", modelID, missionID);
			}
			validType = true;
		}

		if (validType)
		{
			AddLine:missionList("%d\t%s", missionID, missionTitle);
		}
		else
		{
			printf("Invalid mission type '%s' for mission %d", type, missionID);
		}
	}
	mysql_free_result();

	if (strlen(missionList))
	{
		CreateDialog(playerID, "Missions", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:163("Accept order")), missionList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:134("There are currently no missions available for your job!"));
	}
}

DialogResponse:Missions(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new accepted;
		new missionID;
		new text[100];
		sscanf(inputText, "p<\t>ds[100]", missionID, text);
		MySQLQuery("SELECT `creatorUserId`, `acceptUserId`, `type`, `data` FROM `missions` WHERE `id` = '%d'", missionID);
		mysql_store_result();
		if (strval(GetMySQLField("acceptUserId")))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:12("This job has been already accepted by another player!"));
		}
		else
		{
			new type[100];
			new missionData[20][2][32];

			strcat(type, GetMySQLField("type"));
			GetMissionData(GetMySQLField("data"), missionData);

			if (IsStr(type, "GetOrderedCar"))
			{
				new modelID;
				Foreach(arrayIndex, missionData)
				{
					if (IsStr(missionData[arrayIndex][0], "modelId"))
					{
						modelID = strval(missionData[arrayIndex][1]);
					}
				}
				if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
				{
					if (IsStr(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_TYPE], "Car"))
					{
						if (GetClosestVehicleInRange(ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSX, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSY, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSZ, ORDER_CAR_MINDISTANCE))
						{
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:46("Another vehicle has been already spawned!"));
							SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:47("Please try again later"));
						}
						else
						{
							new vehicleID = CreateVehicleEx(modelID, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSX, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSY, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_POSZ, ORDER_CAR_SPAWN_ANGLE, -1, -1, false);
							SetVehicleParamsForPlayer(vehicleID, playerID, true, false);
							accepted = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						printf("WARNING: %s is not a car!", vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					printf("WARNING: Invalid vehicle model ID (%d) for mission %d!", modelID, missionID);
				}
			}
		}
		mysql_free_result();

		if (accepted)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:15("You have accepted the job"));
			SendClientMessageEx(GetPlayerByUserID(strval(GetMySQLField("creatorUserId"))), COLOR_INFO, StringID:1("%p has accepted your job (Order ID: %d)"), playerID, missionID);
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `missions` SET `acceptUserId` = '%d', `acceptTime` = NOW() WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID], missionID);
		}
	}
}

ShowDialog:NaviTarget(playerID)
{
	new targets[2048];
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:173("Bank")));// Bank
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:384("Gas station")));// Gas station
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:411("Hospital")));// Hospital
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:174("Hotel")));// Hotel
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:175("House")));// House
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:437("Vehicle upgrader")));// Vehicle upgrader
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `name` FROM `navigationlocationtypes` ORDER BY `name` ASC");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new string[256];
		strcat(string, GetMySQLField("name"));
		new checkCharacter;
		new languageStringID;
		if (!sscanf(string, "p<:>cd", checkCharacter, languageStringID))
		{
			if (checkCharacter == 'L')
			{
				Format:string(LanguageString(playerID, languageStringID));
			}
		}
		AddLine(targets, string);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:342("Target on map")));// Target on map
	AddLine(targets, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:417("Name of a property")));// Name of a property
	CreateDialog(playerID, "NaviTarget", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:247("Select target")), targets, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:NaviTarget(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		return false;
	}
	Count(index, MAX_DISTANCECALCELEMENTS)
	{
		distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE] = 6000.0;
	}
	new pickupType[STRINGLENGTH_PICKUPTYPE];
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:173("Bank"))))// Bank
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "BANK");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:384("Gas station"))))// Gas station
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "GASSTATION");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:411("Hospital"))))// Hospital
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "HOSPITAL");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:174("Hotel"))))// Hotel
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "HOTEL");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:175("House"))))// House
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "HOUSE");
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:437("Vehicle upgrader"))))// Vehicle upgrader
	{
		strcat(pickupType, "UPGRADEVEHICLE");
	}
	if (strlen(pickupType))
	{
		Count(pickupID, MAX_PICKUPS)
		{
			if (IsStr(pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_TYPE], pickupType))
			{
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE] = GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSX], pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSY], pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSZ]);
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_POSX] = pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSX];
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_POSY] = pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSY];
				distanceCalcArray[pickupID][DISTANCECALC_POSZ] = pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_POSZ];
			}
		}
		SortDeepArray(distanceCalcArray, DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE);
		Count(index, MAX_NAVITARGETS)
		{
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_DISTANCE] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE];
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_POSX] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSX];
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_POSY] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSY];
			naviTargets[playerID][index][NAVITARGET_POSZ] = distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSZ];
		}
		ShowDialog:NaviTarget_TargetList(playerID);
		return true;
	}
	new Float:target[3];
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:342("Target on map"))))// Target on map
	{
		if (PVar:playerID[MAP_POSX] && PVar:playerID[MAP_POSY] && PVar:playerID[MAP_POSZ])
		{
			target[0] = PVar:playerID[MAP_POSX];
			target[1] = PVar:playerID[MAP_POSY];
			target[2] = PVar:playerID[MAP_POSZ];
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:264("You have not selected the target on your map!"));
			return false;
		}
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:417("Name of a property"))))// Name of a property
	{
		ShowDialog:NaviTarget_PropertyName(playerID);
		return true;
	}
	if (!target[0] && !target[1] && !target[2])
	{
		new typeID = GetNavigationLocationTypeByName(playerID, inputText);
		if (typeID)
		{
			new index;
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `navigationlocations` WHERE `type` = '%d'", typeID);
			mysql_store_result();
			while (FetchMySQLRow())
			{
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE]= GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")));
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSX] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX"));
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSY] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY"));
				distanceCalcArray[index][DISTANCECALC_POSZ] = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ"));
				index++;
				if (index >= MAX_DISTANCECALCELEMENTS)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			mysql_free_result();
			SortDeepArray(distanceCalcArray, DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE);
			Count(targetIndex, MAX_NAVITARGETS)
			{
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_DISTANCE] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_DISTANCE];
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_POSX] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_POSX];
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_POSY] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_POSY];
				naviTargets[playerID][targetIndex][NAVITARGET_POSZ] = distanceCalcArray[targetIndex][DISTANCECALC_POSZ];
			}
			ShowDialog:NaviTarget_TargetList(playerID);
			return true;
		}
	}
	if (target[0] || target[1] || target[2])
	{
		if (CalculateRoute(playerID, target[0], target[1], target[2]))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:414("Calculating route"));
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:415("No GPS!"));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:343("No target found!"));
	}
	return true;
}

		mysql_store_result();

		}
		mysql_free_result();
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:NaviTarget_PropertyName(playerID);

ShowDialog:NaviTarget_TargetList(playerID)
{
	new list[2048];
	Count(listIndex, MAX_NAVITARGETS)
	{
		if (naviTargets[playerID][listIndex][NAVITARGET_DISTANCE] == 6000.0)
		{
			break;
		}
		AddLine:list("%d:\t%.2fm", listIndex + 1, naviTargets[playerID][listIndex][NAVITARGET_DISTANCE]);
	}
	CreateDialog(playerID, "NaviTarget_TargetList", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:247("Select target")), list, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:NaviTarget_TargetList(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		ShowDialog:NaviTarget(playerID);
		return true;
	}
	if (listItem < MAX_NAVITARGETS && naviTargets[playerID][listItem][NAVITARGET_DISTANCE] != 6000.0)
	{
		if (CalculateRoute(playerID, naviTargets[playerID][listItem][NAVITARGET_POSX], naviTargets[playerID][listItem][NAVITARGET_POSY], naviTargets[playerID][listItem][NAVITARGET_POSZ]))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:414("Calculating route"));
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:415("No GPS!"));
		}
	}
	return true;
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Police_Options.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Police_Options(playerID)
{
	FormatNew:title[20](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:553("Trucker missions")));
	new options[1024];
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:268("Enter")));// Item 1
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:328("Sell")));// Item 2
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:476("Lock/Unlock")));// Item 3
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:45("Order Vehcle")));// Item 4
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Police Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Police_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		switch (listItem)
		{
			case 0:
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:481("This house is locked!")));
				}
				else
				{
					TeleportToProperty(playerID, PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
			}
			case 1:
			{
				MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `ownerUserId` = '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new Float:price = floatstr(GetMySQLField("price"));
				new pickupID = strval(GetMySQLField("pickupId"));
				mysql_free_result();
				GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_BANK, price);
				ReloadPickup(pickupID);
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:330("Your house has been sold!"));
			}
			case 2:
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:477("You have unlocked your house")));
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked`= '0' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
				else
				{
					MySQLQuery("UPDATE `properties` SET `locked` = '1' WHERE `id`= '%d'", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:478("You have locked your house")));
				}
			}
			case 3: 
			{
				ShowDialog:OrderVehicle(playerID);
			}
		}
	}
}

	Format:string(LanguageString(playerID, StringID:238("How much do you want to fill up (0 - %s)?\n\nCurrent price: $%s/Liter")), FormatNumber(PVar:playerID[REFUEL_MAXIMUM], 2, '.', ','), FormatMoney(gasPrice));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Refuel", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:239("Refuel")), string, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Refuel(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response && strlen(inputText))
	{
		new Float:amount = floatstr(inputText);
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
		new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
		if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
		{
			new Float:maximum = floatsub(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_MAXFUEL], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL]);
			if (amount > maximum)
			{
				amount = maximum;
			}
			TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, false);
			SetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID, false);
			GameTextForPlayer(playerID, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:265("Your vehicle gets filled up. Please wait...")), 3000, 4);
			Timer_RefuelVehicle(playerID, amount);
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:146("You are not in a vehicle!"));
		}
	}
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_Register_Birthdate.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:Register_Birthdate(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Register_Birthdate", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:253("Enter birthdate")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:254("Enter your birthdate in the format DD.MM.YYYY.\n\nExample: 05.02.1990")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:Register_Birthdate(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new day;
		new month;
		new year;
		if (sscanf(inputText, "p<.>ddd", day, month, year))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:40("Please use the format DD.MM.YYYY!"));
			ShowDialog:Register_Birthdate(playerID);
		}
		else
		{
			if (day > 0 && day <= 31 && month > 0 && month <=12 && year > 1900 && year < 2100)
			{
				SetPVarStr:playerID[BIRTHDATE][STRINGLENGTH_DATETIME]("%d-%02d-%02d", year, month, day);
				ShowDialog:Register_Location(playerID);
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:41("Invalid date!"));
				ShowDialog:Register_Birthdate(playerID);
			}
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Register_Gender(playerID);
	}
}

		PVar:playerID[SPAWNAFTERTUTORIALSTART] = false;
		PlayerPlaySound(playerID, 1063, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		PVar:playerID[PLAYRANDOMCAMERACUTS] = false;
		StartScreenFader(playerID, 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, FADE_TUTORIAL_START, 0);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:139("You were registered successfully and are now logged in."));
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:Register_Gender(playerID);
	}
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_SelectInterior.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:SelectInterior(playerID, dialogID, firstPage = true)
{
	new interiorList[2048];
	new firstItem;
	new lastItem;

	if (firstPage)
	{
		firstItem = 1;// The first (0) item is the world which is not a real interior
		lastItem = sizeof(interiors) / 2 - 1;
	}
	else
	{
		firstItem = sizeof(interiors) / 2;
		lastItem = sizeof(interiors) - 1;
	}

	for (new interiorID = firstItem; interiorID <= lastItem; interiorID++)
	{
		if (strlen(interiorList))
		{
			Format:interiorList("%s\n", interiorList);
		}
		Format:interiorList("%s%s", interiorList, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_NAME]);
	}

	if (firstPage)
	{
		Format:interiorList("%s\n%s", interiorList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next")));
	}
	else
	{
		Format:interiorList("%s\n%s", interiorList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
	}

	FormatNew:string[30]("%s", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:247("Select target")));
	PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID] = dialogID;
	CreateDialog(playerID, "SelectInterior", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, string, interiorList, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:SelectInterior(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (!response)
	{
		OnInteriorDialogSelect(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], 0);
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back"))))
	{
		ShowDialog:SelectInterior(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], true);
		return true;
	}
	if (IsStr(inputText, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:177("Next"))))
	{
		ShowDialog:SelectInterior(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], false);
		return true;
	}

	Foreach(interiorID, interiors)
	{
		if (!strcmp(interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_NAME], inputText))
		{
			OnInteriorDialogSelect(playerID,  PVar:playerID[SELECTINTERIOR_ID], interiorID);
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Dialogs/D_SellVehicle.inc
================================================================================

ShowDialog:SellVehicle(playerID)
{
	CreateDialog(playerID, "SellVehicle", DIALOG_STYLE_INPUT, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:488("Sell your vehicle")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:489("Enter the sale price.")), "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:SellVehicle(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (!response)
	{
		return true;
	}
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:146("You are not in a vehicle!"));
	}
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] != PVar:playerID[USERID])
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:487("You are not the owner of this vehicle!"));
		return true;
	}
	new Float:price = floatstr(inputText);
	if (price <= 0)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:490("The price must be positive!"));
		return true;
	}
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[OWNERUSERID] = 0;
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[PRICE] = price;
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SELLERUSERID] = PVar:playerID[USERID];
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:491("You have released your vehicle for sale"), inputText);
	RemovePlayerFromVehicle(playerID);
	return true;
}

}

ShowDialog:Shop(playerID)
{
	FormatNew:title[64](LanguageString(playerID, StringID:17("Shop")), GetMySQLValue("properties", "name", "id", val2str(PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID])));
	new options[1024];
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:268("Enter")));	
	CreateDialog(playerID, "Shop", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, title, options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:Shop(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		switch (listItem)
		{
			case 0: //Enter
			{
				MySQLQuery("SELECT `locked` FROM `properties` WHERE `id` = '%d' AND `locked`", PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				mysql_store_result();
				new isLocked = mysql_num_rows();
				mysql_free_result();
				if (isLocked)
				{
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:481("This house is locked!")));
				}
				else
				{
					TeleportToProperty(playerID, PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID]);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

ShowDialog:Stats(playerID)
{
	new string[1024];
	SavePlayer(playerID);

	Format:sqlQuery("SELECT `users`.`id`, `username`, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`users`.`birthDate`) AS `birthDate`, `location`, `mobilePhoneNumber`, `onlineTime`, `registerTime`, `loginTime`, `bankMoney`, `banks`.`name` AS `bank`, `jobs`.`name` AS `jobName` FROM `users`");
	MySQLQuery("%s LEFT JOIN `banks` ON `bankId` = `banks`.`id` LEFT JOIN `jobs` ON `jobs`.`id` = `users`.`jobId` WHERE `users`.`id` = '%d'", sqlQuery, PVar:playerID[USERID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	Format:string("ID: %s", GetMySQLField("id"));
	Format:string("%s\nName: %s", string, GetMySQLField("username"));
	Format:string("%s\n%s: %d %s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:226("Age")), CalculateAge(strval(GetMySQLField("birthDate"))), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:307("Years")));

	Format:string("%s\n%s: %s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:228("Mobile phone number")), GetMySQLField("mobilePhoneNumber"));

	{
		Format:string("%s\nBank: %s", string, GetMySQLField("bank"));
		Format:string("%s\n%s (Bank): %s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:229("Credit")), FormatMoney(floatstr(GetMySQLField("bankMoney"))));

	Format:string("%s\n%s: $%s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:229("Credit")), FormatMoney(PVar:playerID[MONEY]));
	if (StrNotNull(GetMySQLField("jobName")))
	{
		Format:string("%s\n%s: %s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:230("Occupation")), GetMySQLField("jobName"));
	}
	Format:string("%s\n%s: %s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:231("Online time")), FormatTime(strval(GetMySQLField("onlineTime"))));
	Format:string("%s\n%s: %s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:232("Registered since")), FormatDate(GetMySQLField("registerTime")));
	Format:string("%s\n%s: %s", string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:233("Last login")), FormatDate(GetMySQLField("loginTime")));
	mysql_free_result();

	CreateDialog(playerID, "Stats", DIALOG_STYLE_MSGBOX, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:234("Personal data")), string, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:506("Close")), "");
}

ShowDialog:TeleportLocations(playerID)
{
	new locations[2048];
	mysql_query("SELECT `name` FROM `teleports`");
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		if (strlen(locations))
		{
			Format:locations("%s\n", locations);
		}
		Format:locations("%s%s", locations, GetMySQLField("name"));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	CreateDialog(playerID, "TeleportLocations", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:246("Teleport")), locations, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
}

DialogResponse:TeleportLocations(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `teleports` WHERE `name` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(inputText));
		mysql_store_result();
		if (mysql_num_rows())
		{
			Teleport(playerID, floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ")), floatstr(GetMySQLField("angle")), strval(GetMySQLField("interior")), 0);
		}
		mysql_free_result();
	}
}

ShowDialog:Trucker_Options(playerID)
{
	new missionList[2048];
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `missions`.`id` FROM `missions` LEFT JOIN `jobs` ON `jobs`.`id` = `missions`.`jobId` WHERE `missions`.`jobId` = '%d' AND `missions`.`acceptUserId` = '0' ORDER BY `jobs`.`name`, `missions`.`id` ASC", PVar:playerID[JOBID]);
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		if (strlen(missionList))
		{
			Format:missionList("%s\n", missionList);
		}
		//Format:missionList("%s%s: %s", missionList, GetMySQLField("id"), LanguageString(playerID, GetMissionName(strval(GetMySQLField("id")))));
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	if (strlen(missionList))
	{
		CreateDialog(playerID, "Trucker_Options", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:163("Accept order")), missionList, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:164("Accept")), LanguageString(playerID, StringID:165("Cancel")));
	}
	else
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:134("There are currently no orders available for your job!"));
	}
}

DialogResponse:Trucker_Options(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new missionID;
		new text[100];
		sscanf(inputText, "p<:>ds[100]", missionID, text);
		if (strval(GetMySQLValue("missions", "acceptUserId", "id", val2str(missionID))))
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:12("This job has been already accepted by another player!"));
		}
		else
		{
			MySQLQuery("UPDATE `missions` SET `acceptUserId` = '%d' WHERE `id` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[USERID], missionID);
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:15("You have accepted the job"));
			SendClientMessageEx(GetPlayerByUserID(strval(GetMySQLValue("missions", "creatorUserId", "id", val2str(missionID)))), COLOR_INFO, StringID:1("%p has accepted your job (Order ID: %d)"), playerID, missionID);
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `missiondata` WHERE `missionId` = '%d' AND `name` = 'VehicleModelID'", missionID);
			mysql_store_result();
			// TODO: Missing code?
			mysql_free_result();
		}
	}
}

	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:365("Light blue")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:366("Light green")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:367("Orange")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:368("Pink")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:369("Purple")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:370("Red")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:371("Turquoise")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:372("White")));
	AddLine(options, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:373("Yellow")));
	CreateDialog(playerID, "UpgradeVehicle_Light", DIALOG_STYLE_LIST, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:376("Add neon lights")), options, "OK", LanguageString(playerID, StringID:171("Back")));
}

DialogResponse:UpgradeVehicle_Light(playerID, response, listItem, inputText[])
{
	if (response)
	{
		new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
		if (vehicleID)
		{
			switch (PVar:playerID[UPGRADEVEHICLE_LIGHTTYPE])
			{
				case 1:
				{
					VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID] = listItem + 1;
					SetVehicleLightsState(vehicleID, true);
				}
				case 2:
				{
					VehicleProperty:vehicleID[NEONLIGHTID] = listItem + 1;
					SetVehicleNeonLightsState(vehicleID, true);
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:146("You are not in a vehicle!"));
		}
	}
	else
	{
		ShowDialog:UpgradeVehicle(playerID);
	}
}
