================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/SetPlayerMoney.inc
================================================================================

SetPlayerMoney(playerID, type, Float:amount, add = false)
{
	switch (type)
	{
		case MONEY_BANK:// Money on bank account
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[BANK_ID])
			{
				if (add)
				{
					PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] = PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] + amount;
				}
				else
				{
					PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] = amount;
				}
				return true;
			}
			else
			{
				PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY] = 0;
			}
		}
		case MONEY_CASH:// Directly usable money (Shown on the player's screen)
		{
			if (add)
			{
				PVar:playerID[MONEY] = PVar:playerID[MONEY] + amount;
			}
			else
			{
				PVar:playerID[MONEY] = amount;
			}
			if (PVar:playerID[MONEY] > MAX_MONEY)
			{
				PVar:playerID[MONEY] = MAX_MONEY;
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:492("You have exceeded the cash limit of %m!"), MAX_MONEY);
				printf("%s reached MAX_MONEY (%2f)", GetPlayerNameEx(playerID), MAX_MONEY);
			}
			ResetPlayerMoney(playerID);
			GivePlayerMoney(playerID, floatround(PVar:playerID[MONEY] * 100, floatround_tozero));
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/SetPlayerProgressBar3ColorState.inc
================================================================================

/*
 * <summary>
 *	Set the state of a progress bar and change the color if the value is bellow the warning or critical value
 *	If the new value is above the warning value COLOR_BAR_OK will be used as color
 *	If the new value is above the critical value but bellow or equal to the warning value COLOR_BAR_WARNING will be used as color
 *	If the new value is bellow or equal to the critical value COLOR_BAR_CRITICAL will be used as color
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="barId">
 *	The ID of the progress bar (Return value of CreatePlayerProgressBar)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="warningValue">
 *	The warning value
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="criticalValue">
 *	The critical value
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="value">
 *	The new value of the progress bar
 * </param>
 */

SetPlayerBar3ColorState(playerID, PlayerBar:barId, Float:warningValue, Float:criticalValue, Float:value)
{
	new color = COLOR_BAR_OK;
	if (value <= criticalValue)
	{
		color = COLOR_BAR_CRITICAL;
	}
	else
	{
		if (value <= warningValue)
		{
			color = COLOR_BAR_WARNING;
		}
	}

	SetPlayerProgressBarColor(playerID, barId, color);
	SetPlayerProgressBarValue(playerID, barId, value);
}

SetVehicleLightsState(vehicleID, newState)
{
	new engine;
	new lights;
	new alarm;
	new doors;
	new bonnet;
	new boot;
	new objective;
	GetVehicleParamsEx(vehicleID, engine, lights, alarm, doors, bonnet, boot, objective);
	if (lights != newState)
	{
		SetVehicleParamsEx(vehicleID, engine, newState, alarm, doors, bonnet, boot, objective);
		if (newState)
		{
			if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID])
			{
				AddNeonLight(vehicleID, NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID] - 1);
				AddNeonLight(vehicleID, NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[FRONTLIGHTID] - 1);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Count(colorID, LIGHTOBJECT_MAXCOLORS)
			{
				if (vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT][colorID])
				{
					DestroyDynamicObject(vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT][colorID]);
					vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_LEFT][colorID] = 0;
				}
				if (vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT][colorID])
				{
					DestroyDynamicObject(vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT][colorID]);
					vehicleLightObjects[vehicleID][NEONTYPE_FRONT_RIGHT][colorID] = 0;
				}
			}
			UpdateObjectsForAllPlayers();
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/ShowGPSCheckpoint.inc
================================================================================

ShowGPSCheckpoint(playerID, id)
{
	new nextNodeID;
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:nextPosX;
	new Float:nextPosY;
	new Float:nextPosZ;
	if (id >= PVar:playerID[GPS_NODESCOUNT])
	{
		PVar:playerID[GPS_ENABLED] = false;
		return false;
	}
	PVar:playerID[GPS_ID] = id;
	GetNodePos(PVar:playerID[GPS_NODES][id], posX, posY, posZ);
	if (GetPlayerDistanceFromPoint(playerID, posX, posY, posZ) < 30 && id < PVar:playerID[GPS_NODESCOUNT] - 1)
	{
		return ShowGPSCheckpoint(playerID, id + 1);
	}
	for (nextNodeID = id + 1; nextNodeID < PVar:playerID[GPS_NODESCOUNT]; nextNodeID++)
	{
		GetNodePos(PVar:playerID[GPS_NODES][nextNodeID], nextPosX, nextPosY, nextPosZ);
		if (GetDistanceBetweenPoints(posX, posY, posZ, nextPosX, nextPosY, nextPosZ) >= 30)
		{
			break;
		}
	}
	SetPlayerRaceCheckpointEx(playerID, CHECKPOINT_NAVIGPS, Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:nextPosX, Float:nextPosY, Float:nextPosZ, 5);
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/ShowNews.inc
================================================================================

ShowNews(playerID, lastID)
{
	MySQLQuery("SELECT `id`, `date`, LEFT(`text_%s`, 255) AS `text` FROM `news` WHERE `id` > '%d' ORDER BY `date` DESC LIMIT %d", GetLanguageName(PVar:playerID[LANGUAGE]), lastID, NEWS_MAXIMUM);
	mysql_store_result();
	while (FetchMySQLRow())
	{
		new id = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
		if (id > lastID)
		{
			lastID = id;
		}
		FormatNew:string[NEWS_LINELENGTH + 30](GetMySQLField("text"));
		if (strlen(string) > NEWS_LINELENGTH + 3)
		{
			strmid(string, string, 0, NEWS_LINELENGTH, sizeof(string));
			Format:string("%s...", string);
		}
		Format:string("[%s] %s", FormatDate(GetMySQLField("date"), false), string);
		SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_INFO, string);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	PVar:playerID[LASTNEWSID] = lastID;
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:135("See all news on grgserver.net."));
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/SpawnVehicle.inc
================================================================================

SpawnVehicle(playerID, modelID, color1, color2, showMessage)
{
	if (!modelID)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:64("The vehicle was not found!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	if (modelID < 400 || modelID > 611)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:65("The model ID must be between 400 and 611!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	if (color1 < -1 || color1 > 127 || color2 < -1 || color2 > 127)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:63("The color must be between 0 and 127!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:angle;
	GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
	new vehicleID = CreateVehicleEx(modelID, posX, posY, posZ, angle, color1, color2, false);
	if (!vehicleID)
	{
		if (showMessage)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:461("The vehicle could not be spawned!"));
		}
		return false;
	}
	VehicleProperty:vehicleID[HASNAVI] = true;
	LinkVehicleToInterior(vehicleID, GetPlayerInterior(playerID));
	SetVehicleVirtualWorld(vehicleID, GetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerID));
	PutPlayerInVehicle(playerID, vehicleID, 0);
	if (showMessage)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:62("The vehicle has been spawned"));
	}
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/Str2Val.inc
================================================================================

Str2Val(string[])
{
	new index;
	new length = strlen(string);
	new number[30];
	Count(character, length)
	{
		if (string[character] >= 48 && string[character] <= 57)
		{
			number[index] = string[character];
			index++;
		}
	}
	return strval(number);
}

================================================================================

TeleportTo(playerID, Float:posX, Float:posY, Float:posZ, Float:angle, interior, virtualWorld)
{
	switch (GetPlayerState(playerID))
	{
		case PLAYER_STATE_ONFOOT:
		{
			SetPlayerPosEx(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
			SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
			SetPlayerInterior(playerID, interior);
			SetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerID, virtualWorld);
			return true;
		}
		case PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER, PLAYER_STATE_PASSENGER:
		{
			new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
			SetVehiclePos(vehicleID, posX, posY, posZ);
			LinkVehicleToInterior(vehicleID, interior);
			SetVehicleVirtualWorld(vehicleID, virtualWorld);
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

TeleportToInterior(playerID, interiorID)
{
	new result;
	if (interiorID > 0 && interiorID < sizeof(interiors))
	{
		SetPlayerPosEx(playerID, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_POS][0], interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_POS][1], interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_POS][2]);
		SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_ANGLE]);
		SetPlayerInterior(playerID, interiors[interiorID][INTERIOR_ID]);
		SetCameraBehindPlayer(playerID);
		PVar:playerID[CURRENTINTERIOR] = interiorID;
		result = true;
	}
	return result;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/explode.inc
================================================================================

stock explode(string[], dest[][], token = ' ', max = sizeof (dest), ml = sizeof (dest[]))
{
	new len = strlen(string);
	new idx;
	new i;
	new cur;
	while (idx < len)
	{
		if (string[idx] == token)
		{
			dest[cur][i] = '\0';
			cur++;
			if (cur == max)
			{
				return cur;
			}
			i = 0;
			while (idx < len && string[idx] == token)
			{
				idx++;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			dest[cur][i++] = string[idx++];
			if (i == ml)
			{
				dest[cur][--i] = '\0';
				while (idx < len && string[idx] != token)
				{
					idx++;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	dest[cur][i] = '\0';
	return cur + 1;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/str_replace.inc
================================================================================

stock str_replace(search[], replace[], source[])
{
	new newnick[256];
	new newlen;
	for (new i; i < strlen(source); i++)
	{
		if (strlen(search) > 1 && i != (strlen(source) - 1))
		{
			new matched = 1;
			new start = i;
			for (new s=0; s < strlen(search) && matched == 1; s++)
			{
				if (source[i] != search[s] && s == 0)
				{
					newnick[newlen] = source[i];
					matched = 0;
				} else
				{
					if (source[i] == search[s])
					{
						i++;
					} else
					{
						matched = 0;
					}
				}
			}
			if (matched == 0)
			{
				while (start <= i)
				{
					newnick[newlen] = source[start];
					newlen++;
					start++;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (new r; r < strlen(replace); r++)
				{
					newnick[newlen] = replace[r];
					newlen++;
				}
				i = (start + (strlen(search) - 1));
			}
		}
		else
		{
			if (strlen(search) == 1 && source[i] == search[0])
			{
				for (new r; r < strlen(replace); r++)
				{
					newnick[newlen] = replace[r];
					newlen++;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				newnick[newlen] = source[i];
				newlen++;
			}
		}
	}
	newnick[newlen] = EOS;
	return newnick;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/TogglePlayerVehicleEngine.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Toggles the engine of the vehicle the player is currently driver of.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <returns>
 *	<item name="true">The engine has been toggled</item>
 *	<item name="false">An error occured</item>
 * </returns>
 */

TogglePlayerVehicleEngine(playerID)
{
	if (GetPlayerState(playerID) != PLAYER_STATE_DRIVER)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:52("You are not the driver of this vehicle!"));
		return false;
	}

	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[ALLOWDRIVEPLAYERID] != playerID && !CheckVehiclePermission(playerID, vehicleID, true))
	{
		return true;
	}

	if (GetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID))
	{
		SetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID, false);
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:53("The engine of your vehicle has been turned off."));
		return true;
	}

	new Float:health;
	GetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, health);
	if (health < VEHICLE_MINHEALTH)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:55("The engine of your vehicle could not be started (Engine damaged)!"));
		return false;
	}

	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] <= 0)
	{
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:159("The tank of your vehicle is empty!"));
		return false;
	}

	SetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID, true);
	if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID])
	{
		PlayRadioStation(playerID, VehicleProperty:vehicleID[RADIOSTATIONID]);
	}
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:54("The engine of your vehicle has been turned on."));
	return true;
}

float2str(Float:value)

	FormatNew:string[30]("%f", value);
	return string;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/UpdatePlayerNeeds.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Called every 5 seconds for each connected player to update the player needs (bladder, hunger and thirst)
 *	This function also gets called while restoring the needs (e.g. while peeing or sleeping)
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 */

UpdatePlayerNeeds(playerID)
{
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER] = PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER] - NEEDS_BLADDER;
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY] = PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY] - NEEDS_ENERGY;
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER] = PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER] - NEEDS_HUNGER;
	PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST] = PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST] - NEEDS_THIRST;

	// Fix values which may be < 0
	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER] = 0;
		SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_WARNING, StringID:632("Your player could not hold it any longer. Use /pee to cancel."));
		PlayerPee(playerID, true);
	}
	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY] = 0;
	}
	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER] = 0;
	}
	if (PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST] <= 0)
	{
		PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST] = 0;
	}

	SetPlayerBar3ColorState(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_BLADDER], NEEDS_WARNING, NEEDS_CRITICAL, PVar:playerID[NEEDS_BLADDER]);
	SetPlayerBar3ColorState(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_ENERGY], NEEDS_WARNING, NEEDS_CRITICAL, PVar:playerID[NEEDS_ENERGY]);
	SetPlayerBar3ColorState(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_HUNGER], NEEDS_WARNING, NEEDS_CRITICAL, PVar:playerID[NEEDS_HUNGER]);
	SetPlayerBar3ColorState(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_THIRST], NEEDS_WARNING, NEEDS_CRITICAL, PVar:playerID[NEEDS_THIRST]);

	ShowPlayerProgressBar(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_BLADDER]);
	ShowPlayerProgressBar(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_ENERGY]);
	ShowPlayerProgressBar(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_HUNGER]);
	ShowPlayerProgressBar(playerID, PVar:playerID[PROGRESSBAR_NEEDS_THIRST]);

	PlayerTextDrawShow(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[NEEDS_TEXT]);
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Functions/strtoupper.inc
================================================================================

strtoupper(string[])
{
	new upperString[256];
	for (new character = 0; character < strlen(string); character++)
	{
		upperString[character] = toupper(string[character]);
	}
	return upperString;
}

PickupEvent:HOTEL(playerID, pickupID, eventType)
{
	switch (eventType)
	{
		case PICKUPEVENT_KEYPRESS:
		{
			PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID] = strval(GetMySQLValue("properties", "id", "pickupId", val2str(pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID])));
			SetPlayerPosEx(playerID, HOTEL_RECEPTION_POSX, HOTEL_RECEPTION_POSY, HOTEL_RECEPTION_POSZ);
			SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, HOTEL_RECEPTION_ANGLE);
			SetPlayerInterior(playerID, HOTEL_RECEPTION_INTERIOR);
			SetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerID, PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID]);
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `hotelrooms` WHERE `propertyId` = '%d' AND `ownerUserId` = '%d'", PVar:playerID[CURRENTPROPERTYID], PVar:playerID[USERID]);
			mysql_store_result();
			PVar:playerID[HOTEL_ROOMID] = strval(GetMySQLField("roomId"));
			mysql_free_result();
			if (PVar:playerID[HOTEL_ROOMID])
			{
				ShowDialog:Hotel_HasRoom(playerID);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!ShowDialog:Hotel_RoomList(playerID))
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:314("There are currently no rooms available"));
					if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_MAPPER])
					{
						SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:322("You have the permission 'MAPPER' and are now able to add hotel rooms using /addhotelroom"));
					}
					else
					{
						LeaveProperty(playerID);
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
		case PICKUPEVENT_PICKUP:
		{
			if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_MAPPER])
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:338("Press ~k~~SNEAK_ABOUT~ to select the property linked to this pickup"));
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

PickupEvent:HOUSE(playerID, pickupID, eventType)
{
	switch (eventType)
	{
		case PICKUPEVENT_KEYPRESS:
		{
			new ownerUserID = strval(GetMySQLValue("properties", "ownerUserId", "pickupId", val2str(pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID])));
			if (ownerUserID)
			{
				if (ownerUserID == PVar:playerID[USERID])
				{
					PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID] = strval(GetMySQLValue("properties", "id", "pickupId", val2str(pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID])));
					ShowDialog:House(playerID);
				}
				else
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:141("This house has been already bought by %s!"), GetMySQLValue("users", "username", "id", val2str(ownerUserID)));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				new Float:price = floatstr(GetMySQLValue("properties", "price", "pickupId", val2str(pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID])));
				if (price <= PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY])
				{
					PVar:playerID[DIALOGPROPERTYID] = strval(GetMySQLValue("properties", "id", "pickupId", val2str(pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID])));
					ShowDialog:BuyHouse(playerID, price);
				}
				else
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:22("You need %m to buy this property! But you only have %m at you bank account."), price, PVar:playerID[BANK_MONEY]);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
		case PICKUPEVENT_PICKUP:
		{
			if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_MAPPER])
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:338("Press ~k~~SNEAK_ABOUT~ to select the property linked to this pickup"));
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

PickupModelID:HOUSE(pickupID)
{
	if (strval(GetMySQLValue("properties", "ownerUserId", "pickupId", val2str(pickupID))))
	{
		return 1272;// Bought
	}
	else
	{
		return 1273;// Available
	}
}

PickupEvent:LINK(playerID, pickupID, eventType)
{
	switch (eventType)
	{
		case PICKUPEVENT_PICKUP:
		{
			MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `tplinks` WHERE `pickupId` = '%d'", pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID]);
			mysql_store_result();
			PVar:playerID[TELEPORT_LINKID] = strval(GetMySQLField("id"));
			new Float:posX = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posX"));
			new Float:posY = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posY"));
			new Float:posZ = floatstr(GetMySQLField("posZ"));
			new Float:angle = floatstr(GetMySQLField("angle"));
			new interior = strval(GetMySQLField("interior"));
			mysql_free_result();
			if (PVar:playerID[TELEPORT_LINKID])
			{
				if (posX || posY || posZ)
				{
					Teleport(playerID, posX, posY, posZ, angle, interior, 0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MySQLQuery("INSERT INTO `tplinks` (`pickupId`) VALUES('%d')", pickups[pickupID][PICKUP_ID]);
				PVar:playerID[TELEPORT_LINKID] = mysql_insert_id();
			}
			if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_MAPPER])
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:136("The pickup is linked to the target %d and is now selected. Use /settplink to set the target."), PVar:playerID[TELEPORT_LINKID]);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

PickupModelID:LINK(pickupID)
{
	return 19197;
}

			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

PickupModelID:VEHICLEDEALER(pickupID)
{
	return 1239;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Timers/Timer_Fast.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	<title>This timer executes the following tasks every 250ms:</title>
 *	<item>Check payday</item>
 *	<item>Call OnPlayerZoneChange if the zone has changed</item>
 *	<item>Update vehicle information</item>
 *	<item>Update vehicle information TextDraw in the bottom right corner</item>
 *	<item>Check speed cameras</item>
 *	<item>Update position in ShowPos TextDraw</item>
 * </summary>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	Only really fast stuff should be called in this timer!
 *	This means no file operations or database queries should be called directly (If required do a check whether the file operation or database query is really necessary).
 *	See the speed camera check for such a check (Database query in this timer).
 * </remarks>
 */

Timer:Fast()
{
	Count1(vehicleID, MAX_VEHICLES)
	{
		new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
		if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
		{
			new Float:velocityX;
			new Float:velocityY;
			new Float:velocityZ;
			new Float:health;
			GetVehicleVelocity(vehicleID, velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ);
			GetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, health);
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED] = floatround(floatsqroot(floatpower(velocityX, 2) + floatpower(velocityY, 2) + floatpower(velocityZ, 2)) * 100 * 1.61);
			new Float:distance = floatdiv(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED], floatdiv(1000 * 60 * 60, TIMER_FAST));
			VehicleProperty:vehicleID[MILEAGE] = floatadd(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[MILEAGE], distance);
			if (GetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID))
			{
				if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] <= 0)
				{
					VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					new Float:fuelUsage = distance * floatdiv(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_FUELUSAGE], 100);
					if (!VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED])
					{
						fuelUsage = 0.0001;// Fuel usage while engine is idle (Speed is 0 but engine is turned on)
					}
					VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] = floatsub(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL], fuelUsage);
				}
				if (health <= VEHICLE_MINHEALTH)
				{
					SetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, VEHICLE_MINHEALTH);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	Count(playerID, maxPlayers)
	{
		if (IsPlayerNPC(playerID))
		{
			new vehicleID = IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerID);
			if (vehicleID)
			{
				SetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, 1000);
			}
			continue;
		}
		new inVehicle;
		new zone = GetPlayerZone(playerID, true);
		if (zone != -1)
		{
			if (PVar:playerID[ZONE] == -1 || (PVar:playerID[ZONE] != zone && !IsStr(zones[PVar:playerID[ZONE]][ZONE_NAME], zones[zone][ZONE_NAME])))
			{
				PVar:playerID[ZONE] = zone;
				OnPlayerZoneChange(playerID, zone);
			}
		}
		if (IsPlayerInAnyVehicle(playerID))
		{
			new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
			new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
			if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
			{
				new Float:health;
				new healthColor;
				new fuelColor;
				GetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, health);
				new seatID = GetPlayerVehicleSeat(playerID);
				new Float:distance = floatdiv(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED], floatdiv(1000 * 60 * 60, TIMER_FAST));
				if (!seatID)
				{
					VehicleProperty:vehicleID[MILEAGE] = floatadd(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[MILEAGE], distance);
				}
				new Float:healthPercentage = floatdiv(health, 10);
				if (health < 1000 && !seatID && IsPlayerNPC(playerID))
				{
					SetVehicleHealth(vehicleID, 1000);
				}
				if (!seatID && GetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID))
				{
					if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] <= 0)
					{
						GameTextForPlayer(playerID, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:159("The tank of your vehicle is empty!")), 3000, 5);
						SetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID, false);
					}
					if (health <= VEHICLE_MINHEALTH)
					{
						GameTextForPlayer(playerID, LanguageString(playerID, StringID:158("Your vehicle is broken!")), 3000, 5);
						SetVehicleEngineState(vehicleID, false);
					}
				}
				new Float:fuelPercentage = floatmul(floatdiv(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL], vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_MAXFUEL]), 100);
				if (healthPercentage > 65)
				{
					healthColor = 'g';
				}
				else
				{
					if (healthPercentage > 40)
					{
						healthColor = 'y';
					}
					else
					{
						healthColor = 'r';
					}
				}
				if (fuelPercentage > 70)
				{
					fuelColor = 'g';
				}
				else
				{
					if (fuelPercentage > 30)
					{
						fuelColor = 'y';
					}
					else
					{
						fuelColor = 'r';
					}
				}
				FormatNew:textDrawString[60]("~n~%d Km/h~n~~%c~%s%%~w~~n~~%c~%s%%~w~~n~%sl~n~%s", VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED], healthColor, FormatNumber(healthPercentage, 2, '.', ','), fuelColor, FormatNumber(fuelPercentage, 2, '.', ','), FormatNumber(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_FUELUSAGE], 1, '.', ','), FormatNumber(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[MILEAGE], 2, '.', ','));
				PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SPEEDO_COLUMN2], textDrawString);
				PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[VEHICLENAME], vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_NAME]);
				PlayerTextDrawShow(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SPEEDO_COLUMN1]);
				PlayerTextDrawShow(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SPEEDO_COLUMN2]);
				PlayerTextDrawShow(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[VEHICLENAME]);
				inVehicle = true;
				if (VehicleProperty:vehicleID[SPEED] && !seatID)
				{
					CheckSpeedCamera(playerID);
				}
			}
		}
		if (!inVehicle)
		{
			PlayerTextDrawHide(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SPEEDO_COLUMN1]);
			PlayerTextDrawHide(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SPEEDO_COLUMN2]);
			PlayerTextDrawHide(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[VEHICLENAME]);
		}
		if (PVar:playerID[SHOWPOS])
		{
			new Float:posX;
			new Float:posY;
			new Float:posZ;
			new Float:angle;
			GetPlayerPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
			GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerID, angle);
			FormatNew:textDrawString[100]("~w~X: ~g~%.2f~w~~n~Y: ~g~%.2f~w~~n~Z: ~g~%.2f~w~~n~A: ~g~%.2f~w~~n~I: ~g~%d", posX, posY, posZ, angle, GetPlayerInterior(playerID));
			PlayerTextDrawSetString(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SHOWPOS], textDrawString);
		}
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Timers/Timer_FlyCam.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	This timer runs while a player has enabled the fly cam.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 */

Timer:FlyCam(playerID)
{
	new keys;
	new updown;
	new leftright;
	new Float:speed = FLYCAM_SPEED_NORMAL;
	new Float:posX;
	new Float:posY;
	new Float:posZ;
	new Float:vectorX;
	new Float:vectorY;
	new Float:vectorZ;
	new Float:angle;
	new Float:angleElevation;
	GetPlayerKeys(playerID, keys, updown, leftright);
	GetPlayerCameraPos(playerID, posX, posY, posZ);
	GetPlayerCameraFrontVector(playerID, vectorX, vectorY, vectorZ);
	angle = 90 - atan2(vectorY, vectorX);
	if (angle < 0.0)
	{
		angle = 360.0 + angle;
	}
	angleElevation = - (floatabs(atan2(floatsqroot(floatpower(vectorX, 2.0) + floatpower(vectorY, 2.0)), vectorZ)) - 90.0);
	if (keys & KEY_JUMP)
	{
		speed = FLYCAM_SPEED_FAST;
	}
	if (keys & KEY_WALK)
	{
		speed = FLYCAM_SPEED_SLOW;
	}
	if (updown == KEY_UP)
	{
		GetXYZFromAngle(posX, posY, posZ, angle, angleElevation, 50.0);
		MoveDynamicObject(PVar:playerID[FLYCAM_DUMMYOBJECT], posX, posY, posZ, speed);
	}
	if (updown == KEY_DOWN)
	{
		GetXYZFromAngle(posX, posY, posZ, angle, angleElevation, -50.0);
		MoveDynamicObject(PVar:playerID[FLYCAM_DUMMYOBJECT], posX, posY, posZ, speed);
	}
	if (leftright == KEY_LEFT)
	{
		GetXYFromAngle(posX, posY, -angle + 90.0, 50.0);
		MoveDynamicObject(PVar:playerID[FLYCAM_DUMMYOBJECT], posX, posY, posZ, speed);
	}
	if (leftright == KEY_RIGHT)
	{
		GetXYFromAngle(posX, posY, -angle + 90.0, -50.0);
		MoveDynamicObject(PVar:playerID[FLYCAM_DUMMYOBJECT], posX, posY, posZ, speed);
	}
	if (keys & KEY_SPRINT)
	{
		MoveDynamicObject(PVar:playerID[FLYCAM_DUMMYOBJECT], posX, posY, posZ + 50.0, speed);
	}
	if (keys & KEY_CROUCH)
	{
		MoveDynamicObject(PVar:playerID[FLYCAM_DUMMYOBJECT], posX, posY, posZ - 50.0, speed);
	}
	if (!(updown & KEY_UP || updown & KEY_DOWN || leftright & KEY_LEFT || leftright & KEY_RIGHT || keys & KEY_SPRINT || keys & KEY_CROUCH))
	{
		StopDynamicObject(PVar:playerID[FLYCAM_DUMMYOBJECT]);
	}
}

DATEI: includes/grgserver/Timers/Timer_RefuelVehicle.inc

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Refuel the current vehicle of the player up to the specific amount.
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="totalAmount">
 *	The amount in liters
 * </param>
 *
 * <remarks>
 *	The vehicle gets refuelled till the given amount or maximum of the vehicle has been reached.
 * </remarks>
 */

Timer:RefuelVehicle(playerID, Float:totalAmount)
{
	new vehicleID = GetPlayerVehicleID(playerID);
	if (vehicleID)
	{
		if (PVar:playerID[MONEY] >= PVar:playerID[CURRENTGASPRICE])
		{
			new modelID = GetVehicleModel(vehicleID);
			if (modelID >= 400 && modelID <= 611)
			{
				new Float:maximum = floatsub(vehicleModels[modelID - 400][VEHICLEMODEL_MAXFUEL], VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL]);
				if (totalAmount > 0 && maximum > 0)
				{
					new Float:amount;
					if (maximum < 1)
					{
						amount = maximum;
					}
					else
					{
						amount = 1.0;
					}
					VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL] = floatadd(VehicleProperty:vehicleID[CURRENTFUEL], amount);
					GivePlayerMoneyEx(playerID, MONEY_CASH, -floatmul(PVar:playerID[CURRENTGASPRICE], amount));// TODO: Do not get money at this point, instead use real life stuff (Pay after refuelling)
					SetTimerEx("Timer_RefuelVehicle", GASSTATION_REFUELSPEED, false, "df", playerID, floatsub(totalAmount, amount));
					return true;
				}
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_INFO, StringID:91("Your vehicle has been refueled."));
			}
			else
			{
				SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:146("You are not in a vehicle!"));
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_ERROR, StringID:92("You have not enough money!"));
		}
	}
	TogglePlayerControllable(playerID, true);
	return true;
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Timers/Timer_ScreenFader.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Fade the screen to a specific color (Or back to normal)
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="red">
 *	The amount of red color (0 - 255)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="green">
 *	The amount of green color (0 - 255)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="blue">
 *	The amount of blue color (0 - 255)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="steps">
 *	The number of color steps in the time defined in TIMER_SCREENFADER
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="waitOnEnd">
 *	Time in milliseconds to wait after the screen fading has finished
 *	OnScreenFadeStop will be triggered twice (Directly after the screen fading and after the timer has expired)
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="extraID">
 *	An ID to identify the screen fade
 * </param>
 *
 * <param name="subID">
 *	A second ID to identify a screen fade in a group (e.g. to use Normal -> Black and Black -> Normal in the same extraID but different subIDs)
 * </param>
 */

Timer:ScreenFader(playerID, red, green, blue, steps, waitOnEnd, extraID, subID)
{
	new alpha;
	PVar:playerID[SCREENFADE_CURRENTSTEP] += steps;
	if (steps < 0)
	{
		alpha = 255 + PVar:playerID[SCREENFADE_CURRENTSTEP];
	}
	else
	{
		alpha = PVar:playerID[SCREENFADE_CURRENTSTEP];
	}
	if (alpha < 0)
	{
		alpha = 0;
	}
	if (alpha > 255)
	{
		alpha = 255;
	}
	PlayerTextDrawBoxColor(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SCREENFADER], GetColor(red, green, blue, alpha));
	PlayerTextDrawShow(playerID, PTextDraw:playerID[SCREENFADER]);
	if ((steps < 0 && !alpha) || (steps > 0 && alpha == 255))
	{
		PVar:playerID[SCREENFADE_CURRENTSTEP] = 0;
		CallLocalFunction("OnScreenFadeStop", "dddd", playerID, extraID, subID, false);
		if (waitOnEnd)
		{
			SetTimerEx("OnScreenFadeStop", waitOnEnd, false, "dddd", playerID, extraID, subID, true);
		}
	}
	else
	{
		SetTimerEx("Timer_ScreenFader", TIMER_SCREENFADER, false, "dddddddd", playerID, red, green, blue, steps, waitOnEnd, extraID, subID);
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Timers/Timer_Slow.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	<title>This timer executes the following tasks every 5 seconds:</title>
 *	<item>Trigger OnServerTimeChange if the hour or minute changes</item>
 *	<item>Check for update notification file and notify players with the ServerAdmin permission</item>
 * </summary>
 */

Timer:Slow()
{
	new hour;
	new minute;
	gettime(hour, minute);
	if (hour != oldHour)
	{
		OnServerTimeChange(hour, minute, TIMECHANGE_HOUR);
		oldHour = hour;
	}
	if (minute != oldMinute)
	{
		OnServerTimeChange(hour, minute, TIMECHANGE_MINUTE);
		oldMinute = minute;
	}

	Count(playerID, maxPlayers)
	{
		new onlineTime = GetOnlineTime(playerID);
		if (onlineTime - PVar:playerID[LASTPAYDAY] >= PAYDAY_INTERVAL)
		{
			PVar:playerID[LASTPAYDAY] = onlineTime;
			PayDay(playerID);
		}
	}

	if (fexist(FILE_UPDATENOTIFICATION))
	{
		new string[256];
		new File:file = fopen(FILE_UPDATENOTIFICATION, io_read);
		fread(file, string);// Skip "------------------------------------------------------------------------"
		fread(file, string);// Read "rXXX | user | yyyy-mm-dd hh:ii:ss +xxxx (ddd, dd mmm yyyy) | x line(s)"
		new revisionString[10];
		new committerName[100];
		new commitDate[50];
		new lineCount[20];
		sscanf(string, "p<|>s[10]s[100]s[50]s[20]", revisionString, committerName, commitDate, lineCount);
		new revision = Str2Val(revisionString);
		if (revision > COMPILER_SVN_REVISION)
		{
			printf("Detected update to revision %d", revision);
			fread(file, string);// Skip ""
			LoggedInPlayers(playerID)
			{
				if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_SERVERADMIN])
				{
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_SYSTEM, StringID:127("An update to revision %d is available!"), revision);
					SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_SYSTEM, StringID:128("Committed by: %s"), committerName);
					SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_SYSTEM, "*** SVN Changelog:");
				}
			}
			while (fread(file, string))
			{
				RemoveNewLine(string);
				if (strlen(string) && strcmp(string, "------------------------------------------------------------------------"))
				{
					Format:string("> %s", string);
					LoggedInPlayers(playerID)
					{
						if (permissions[playerID][PERMISSION_SERVERADMIN])
						{
							SendClientMessage(playerID, COLOR_SYSTEM, string);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		fclose(file);
		fremove(FILE_UPDATENOTIFICATION);
	}

	LoggedInPlayers(playerID)
	{
		UpdatePlayerNeeds(playerID);
	}
}

================================================================================
DATEI: includes/grgserver/Timers/Timer_SpawnPlayer.inc
================================================================================

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Spawn a player
 * </summary>
 *
 * <param name="playerID">
 *	The ID of the player
 * </param>
 */

Timer:SpawnPlayer(playerID)
{
	SpawnPlayer(playerID);
	if (IsPlayerNPC(playerID))
	{
		return true;
	}
	TogglePlayerSpectating(playerID, true);
	PVar:playerID[PLAYRANDOMCAMERACUTS] = true;
	PlayRandomCameraCuts(playerID);
	MySQLQuery("SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `username` = '%s'", MySQLEscapeString(GetPlayerNameEx(playerID)));
	mysql_store_result();
	if (strval(GetMySQLField("id")))
	{
		PVar:playerID[LANGUAGE] = GetLanguageID(GetMySQLField("language"));
		PVar:playerID[REGISTERED] = true;
		ShowDialog:PreviewInfo(playerID);
	}
	else
	{
		new countryCode[3];
		strcat(countryCode, GetPlayerCountryCode(playerID));
		if (strlen(countryCode) && (!strcmp(countryCode, "AT", true) || !strcmp(countryCode, "CH", true) || !strcmp(countryCode, "DE", true)))
		{
			PVar:playerID[LANGUAGE] = LANGUAGE_GERMAN;
		}
		else
		{
			PVar:playerID[LANGUAGE] = LANGUAGE_ENGLISH;
		}
		PVar:playerID[REGISTERED] = false;
		PlaySound(playerID, musicSoundIDs[random(sizeof(musicSoundIDs))]);
		ShowDialog:Register_Language(playerID);
	}
	mysql_free_result();
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_SYSTEM, StringID:138("Welcome to the GRG server!"));
	SendClientMessageEx(playerID, COLOR_SYSTEM, StringID:5("Currently revision %d of our game mode is running on this server."), COMPILER_SVN_REVISION);
	PlayerLoop(currentPlayerID)
	{
		if (!IsPlayerNPC(currentPlayerID) && currentPlayerID != playerID)
		{
			SendClientMessageEx(currentPlayerID, COLOR_JOINLEAVE, StringID:3("%p has joined the server"), playerID);
		}
	}
	ReloadTextDraws(playerID);
	return true;
}

/**
 * <summary>
 *	Mark the current SVN revision as stable after 10 minutes
 * </summary>
 */

Timer:StableCheck()
{
	new File:file = fopen(FILE_STABLEREVISION, io_write);
	fwrite(file, val2str(COMPILER_SVN_REVISION));
	fclose(file);
	print("Gamemode is still running after 10 minutes -> Marked as stable");
}

public OnPlayerCommandText(playerid, cmdtext[])
{
    if (RoleplayUI_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (UiHub_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (TextWars_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (AdminSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (JailSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (EmergencySystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (GarageSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (WeaponShopSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (StateEventSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (SocialSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (RoleplayCommandSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (AdminMappingSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, cmdtext))
        return 1;

    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/tutorial", true) == 0)
    {
        TutorialSystem_Start(playerid);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/city", true) == 0)
    {
        new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
        if (StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
        {
            StateSpawnSystem_Apply(playerid, stateid);
            CameraSystem_PlayStateScene(playerid, stateid);
        }
        else
        {
            LoginSystem_SetPlayerHomeState(playerid, STATE_LOS_SANTOS);
            CameraSystem_PlayStateScene(playerid, STATE_LOS_SANTOS);
        }
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/gov", true) == 0)
    {
        GovernmentSystem_ShowStateInfo(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/services", true) == 0)
    {
        StateServices_ShowPlayerServices(playerid);
        MunicipalSystem_ShowOverview(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/treasury", true) == 0)
    {
        StateBudgetSystem_ShowOverview(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/spawn", true) == 0)
    {
        StateSpawnSystem_Apply(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/state", true) == 0)
    {
        new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
        new stateName[32];
        new leaderName[24];
        StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
        StateSystem_GetLeaderName(stateid, leaderName, sizeof(leaderName));
        new msg[256];
        format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[STATE] %s | Budget: $%d | Steuer: %d%% | Leader: %s | Services: %d", stateName, StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid), StateSystem_GetTaxRate(stateid), leaderName, StateServices_GetStateServiceCount(stateid));
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/municipal", true) == 0)
    {
        MunicipalSystem_ShowOverview(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/stateinfo", true) == 0)
    {
        new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
        new stateName[32];
        new leaderName[24];
        StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
        StateSystem_GetLeaderName(stateid, leaderName, sizeof(leaderName));
        new msg[192];
        format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[STATE] %s | Budget: $%d | Steuer: %d%% | Leader: %s | Services: %d", stateName, StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid), StateSystem_GetTaxRate(stateid), leaderName, StateServices_GetStateServiceCount(stateid));
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/districts", true) == 0)
    {
        DistrictSystem_ShowDistricts(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/workers", true) == 0)
    {
        TransportWorkers_ShowWorkers(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/factories", true) == 0)
    {
        FactoryNetwork_ShowFactories(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/marketplace", true) == 0)
    {
        MarketplaceSystem_Show(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/governance", true) == 0)
    {
        StateGovernance_ShowOverview(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/contraband", true) == 0)
    {
        ContrabandSystem_Show(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/taxi", true) == 0)
    {
        TaxiSystem_ShowNetwork(playerid);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/district_economy", true) == 0)
    {
        DistrictEconomy_Show(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/tax", true) == 0)
    {
        StateTaxSystem_ShowSummary(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/market", true) == 0)
    {
        MarketSystem_ShowMarket(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/dispatch", true) == 0)
    {
        DispatchSystem_ShowQueue(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/adminconfig", true) == 0)
    {
        if (AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
        {
            AdminConfigSystem_ShowMenu(playerid);
            return 1;
        }
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/stats", true) == 0)
    {
        ProgressionSystem_ShowStats(playerid);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/wanted", true) == 0)
    {
        LawSystem_ShowWanted(playerid);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/crime", true) == 0)
    {
        CrimeSystem_ShowCrimeInfo(playerid);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/routes", true) == 0)
    {
        TransportSystem_ShowRoutes(playerid);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/economy", true) == 0)
    {
        CityEconomy_ShowOverview(playerid);
        return 1;
    }
    if (strcmp(cmdtext, "/shops", true) == 0)
    {
        ShopSystem_ShowStateShops(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

public OnPlayerSpawn(playerid)
{
    StateSystem_OnPlayerSpawn(playerid);
    if (LoginSystem_IsActive(playerid))
    {
        TutorialSystem_Start(playerid);
        CameraSystem_PlayStateScene(playerid, LoginSystem_GetHomeState(playerid));
        RoleplayUI_ShowDashboard(playerid);
        PhoneSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid);
        PrisonSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid);
    }
    return 1;
}

public OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, inputtext[])
{
    if (UiHub_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, inputtext))
        return 1;
    if (JobCenter_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, inputtext))
        return 1;
    if (StateControl_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, inputtext))
        return 1;
    if (TextWars_OnDialogResponse(playerid, dialogid, response, listitem, inputtext))
        return 1;
    return 0;
}

    return TextWars_OnClickPlayerTextDraw(playerid, playertextid) ? 1 : 0;
}

    TextWars_OnClickTextDraw(playerid, clickedid);
    return 0;
}

    JobCenter_OnEnterCheckpoint(playerid);
    return 1;
}

public OnPlayerDeath(playerid, killerid, reason)
{
    TextWars_OnPlayerDeath(playerid, killerid);
    return 1;
}

public OnPlayerKeyStateChange(playerid, newkeys, oldkeys)
{
    if ((newkeys & KEY_YES) && !(oldkeys & KEY_YES))
        UiHub_ShowMain(playerid);
    else if ((newkeys & KEY_NO) && !(oldkeys & KEY_NO))
        TextWars_Toggle(playerid);
    return 1;
}

#if !defined ADMIN_CONFIG_SYSTEM_INC

stock AdminConfigSystem_Initialize()
{
    gAdminConfigStateEnabled[0] = 1;
    gAdminConfigStateEnabled[1] = 1;
    gAdminConfigStateEnabled[2] = 1;

    gAdminConfigStateBudget[0] = 500000;
    gAdminConfigStateBudget[1] = 450000;
    gAdminConfigStateBudget[2] = 400000;

    gAdminConfigStateTax[0] = 8;
    gAdminConfigStateTax[1] = 7;
    gAdminConfigStateTax[2] = 9;

    print("[ADMIN_CFG] Ingame-Konfigurationssystem initialisiert");
}

stock AdminConfigSystem_IsStateEnabled(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return gAdminConfigStateEnabled[stateid] == 1;
}

stock AdminConfigSystem_SetStateBudget(stateid, budget)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    gAdminConfigStateBudget[stateid] = budget;
    StateSystem_SetTreasuryBalance(stateid, budget);
}

stock AdminConfigSystem_SetStateTax(stateid, tax)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    gAdminConfigStateTax[stateid] = tax;
    gStateTaxRate[stateid] = tax;
}

stock AdminConfigSystem_ToggleState(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    gAdminConfigStateEnabled[stateid] = 1 - gAdminConfigStateEnabled[stateid];
}

stock AdminConfigSystem_ToggleGangWar()
{
    gAdminConfigGangWarEnabled = 1 - gAdminConfigGangWarEnabled;
}

#if !defined ADMIN_MAPPING_SYSTEM_INC
#define ADMIN_MAPPING_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_MAP_LOCATIONS 220
#define MAX_MAP_ZONES 100

#define MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE 1
#define MAP_LOCATION_INACTIVE 0

#define MAP_ZONE_ACTIVE 1
#define MAP_ZONE_DISABLED 0

enum E_MAP_LOCATION
{
    EML_NAME[48],
    EML_STATE,
    Float:EML_X,
    Float:EML_Y,
    Float:EML_Z,
    EML_INTERIOR,
    EML_VW,
    Float:EML_ANGLE,
    EML_ACTIVE
}

new gMapLocations[MAX_MAP_LOCATIONS][E_MAP_LOCATION];
new gMapLocationCount = 0;

enum E_MAP_ZONE
{
    EMZ_NAME[32],
    EMZ_STATE,
    Float:EMZ_MIN_X,
    Float:EMZ_MIN_Y,
    Float:EMZ_MAX_X,
    Float:EMZ_MAX_Y,
    EMZ_ACTIVE
}

new gMapZones[MAX_MAP_ZONES][E_MAP_ZONE];
new gMapZoneCount = 0;

new gAdminMapSelectedLocation[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gAdminMapMode[MAX_PLAYERS];
new Text:gAdminMapTD[MAX_PLAYERS][12];

stock AdminMappingSystem_Initialize()
{
    gMapLocationCount = 0;
    gMapZoneCount = 0;

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gAdminMapSelectedLocation[i] = -1;
        gAdminMapMode[i] = 0;
    }

    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("LS_Spawn", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1500.0, -1710.0, 13.0, 0, 0, 0.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("LS_PD", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1561.0, -1675.0, 16.0, 0, 0, 180.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("LS_Hospital", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1187.0, -1323.0, 14.0, 0, 0, 90.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);

    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("SF_Spawn", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -1930.0, 120.0, 27.0, 0, 0, 90.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("SF_PD", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -1626.0, 690.0, 12.0, 0, 0, 90.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("SF_Hospital", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -2672.0, 410.0, 7.0, 0, 0, 90.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);

    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("LV_Spawn", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1700.0, 1210.0, 16.0, 0, 0, 180.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("LV_PD", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1590.0, 1000.0, 10.0, 0, 0, 270.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation("LV_Hospital", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1421.0, 1853.0, 13.0, 0, 0, 270.0, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);

    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterZone("LS_Gangwar", STATE_LOS_SANTOS, 1500.0, -1800.0, 1900.0, -1200.0, MAP_ZONE_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterZone("SF_Gangwar", STATE_SAN_FIERRO, -2100.0, -200.0, -1400.0, 500.0, MAP_ZONE_ACTIVE);
    AdminMappingSystem_RegisterZone("LV_Gangwar", STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, 1400.0, 850.0, 2000.0, 1700.0, MAP_ZONE_ACTIVE);

    print("[ADMIN_MAP] Vollwertiges Mapping-/Teleport-System initialisiert");
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation(const name[], stateid, Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, interior, vw, Float:angle, active)
{
    if (gMapLocationCount >= MAX_MAP_LOCATIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_NAME], 48, "%s", name);
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_STATE] = stateid;
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_X] = x;
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_Y] = y;
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_Z] = z;
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_INTERIOR] = interior;
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_VW] = vw;
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_ANGLE] = angle;
    gMapLocations[gMapLocationCount][EML_ACTIVE] = active;

    DB_SaveMapLocation(name, stateid, x, y, z, interior, vw, angle, active);
    gMapLocationCount++;
    return true;
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_RegisterZone(const name[], stateid, Float:minX, Float:minY, Float:maxX, Float:maxY, active)
{
    if (gMapZoneCount >= MAX_MAP_ZONES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gMapZones[gMapZoneCount][EMZ_NAME], 32, "%s", name);
    gMapZones[gMapZoneCount][EMZ_STATE] = stateid;
    gMapZones[gMapZoneCount][EMZ_MIN_X] = minX;
    gMapZones[gMapZoneCount][EMZ_MIN_Y] = minY;
    gMapZones[gMapZoneCount][EMZ_MAX_X] = maxX;
    gMapZones[gMapZoneCount][EMZ_MAX_Y] = maxY;
    gMapZones[gMapZoneCount][EMZ_ACTIVE] = active;

    DB_SaveMapZone(name, stateid, minX, minY, maxX, maxY, active);
    gMapZoneCount++;
    return true;
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_CreateLocationForPlayer(playerid, const name[], stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new Float:x, Float:y, Float:z, Float:a;
    GetPlayerPos(playerid, x, y, z);
    GetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid, a);

    return AdminMappingSystem_RegisterLocation(name, stateid, x, y, z, GetPlayerInterior(playerid), GetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerid), a, MAP_LOCATION_ACTIVE);
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_UpdateLocation(locationid, const name[], stateid)
{
    if (locationid < 0 || locationid >= gMapLocationCount)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gMapLocations[locationid][EML_NAME], 48, "%s", name);
    gMapLocations[locationid][EML_STATE] = stateid;
    GetPlayerPos(0, gMapLocations[locationid][EML_X], gMapLocations[locationid][EML_Y], gMapLocations[locationid][EML_Z]);
    return true;
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_RemoveLocation(locationid)
{
    if (locationid < 0 || locationid >= gMapLocationCount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = locationid; i < gMapLocationCount - 1; i++)
    {
        gMapLocations[i] = gMapLocations[i + 1];
    }
    gMapLocationCount--;
    return true;
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_TeleportPlayerToLocation(playerid, locationid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (locationid < 0 || locationid >= gMapLocationCount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    SetPlayerPos(playerid, gMapLocations[locationid][EML_X], gMapLocations[locationid][EML_Y], gMapLocations[locationid][EML_Z]);
    SetPlayerFacingAngle(playerid, gMapLocations[locationid][EML_ANGLE]);
    SetPlayerInterior(playerid, gMapLocations[locationid][EML_INTERIOR]);
    SetPlayerVirtualWorld(playerid, gMapLocations[locationid][EML_VW]);
    gAdminMapSelectedLocation[playerid] = locationid;
    return true;
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_ShowLocationList(playerid)
{
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[MAP] Verfügbare Orte:");
    for (new i = 0; i < gMapLocationCount && i < 20; i++)
    {
        new msg[128];
        format(msg, sizeof(msg), "ID %d | %s | State %d | X: %.2f Y: %.2f Z: %.2f", i, gMapLocations[i][EML_NAME], gMapLocations[i][EML_STATE], gMapLocations[i][EML_X], gMapLocations[i][EML_Y], gMapLocations[i][EML_Z]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, msg);
    }
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_ShowZoneList(playerid)
{
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[MAP] Verfügbare Zonen:");
    for (new i = 0; i < gMapZoneCount && i < 20; i++)
    {
        new msg[128];
        format(msg, sizeof(msg), "ZONE %d | %s | Staat %d | Min: %.2f,%.2f | Max: %.2f,%.2f", i, gMapZones[i][EMZ_NAME], gMapZones[i][EMZ_STATE], gMapZones[i][EMZ_MIN_X], gMapZones[i][EMZ_MIN_Y], gMapZones[i][EMZ_MAX_X], gMapZones[i][EMZ_MAX_Y]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, msg);
    }
}

stock AdminMappingSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (!AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new cmd[32];
    new idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/mapmenu", true) == 0)
    {
        AdminMappingSystem_ShowAdminMenu(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/mapadd", true) == 0)
    {
        new params[64];
        new name[32];
        new stateid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]s[32]d", params, name, stateid) != 0 || strlen(name) == 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MAP] Syntax: /mapadd <Name> <StateID>");
            return true;
        }

        if (AdminMappingSystem_CreateLocationForPlayer(playerid, name, stateid))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[MAP] Standort gespeichert.");
        }
        else
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MAP] Fehler beim Speichern des Standorts.");
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/maptp", true) == 0)
    {
        new params[64];
        new locid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", params, locid) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MAP] Syntax: /maptp <ID>");
            return true;
        }

        if (AdminMappingSystem_TeleportPlayerToLocation(playerid, locid))
        {
            new locationName[48];
            format(locationName, sizeof(locationName), "%s", gMapLocations[locid][EML_NAME]);
            printf("[MAP] Spieler %d teleportiert nach %s", playerid, locationName);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[MAP] Teleportiert.");
        }
        else
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MAP] Ungültige Location ID.");
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/maplist", true) == 0)
    {
        AdminMappingSystem_ShowLocationList(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/mapzones", true) == 0)
    {
        AdminMappingSystem_ShowZoneList(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/mapdel", true) == 0)
    {
        new params[64];
        new locid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", params, locid) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MAP] Syntax: /mapdel <ID>");
            return true;
        }

        if (AdminMappingSystem_RemoveLocation(locid))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[MAP] Location gelöscht.");
        }
        else
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MAP] Location konnte nicht gelöscht werden.");
        }
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#endif

#if !defined ADMIN_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define ADMIN_RANK_SUPPORT 1
#define ADMIN_RANK_MODERATOR 2
#define ADMIN_RANK_STATE_ADMIN 3

#define ADMIN_RANK_OWNER 5

new gAdminLevel[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gAdminState[MAX_PLAYERS];

    print("[ADMIN] System initialisiert");
    print("[ADMIN] 3x/1Admin System aktiviert");

stock AdminSystem_Shutdown()

    print("[ADMIN] System heruntergefahren");

stock AdminSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gAdminLevel[playerid] = 0;
    gAdminState[playerid] = -1;
    Core_SetPlayerAdminLevel(playerid, 0);
    Core_SetPlayerAdminState(playerid, -1);
    Core_NormalizePlayerState(playerid);
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE] = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);

    gAdminLevel[playerid] = 0;
    gAdminState[playerid] = -1;

stock AdminSystem_IsOwner(playerid)

    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    return (gAdminLevel[playerid] >= ADMIN_RANK_OWNER) || Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_OWNER) || StateAdminSystem_IsGlobalOwner(playerid);
}

stock AdminSystem_IsStateLeader(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    return (gAdminLevel[playerid] >= ADMIN_RANK_STATE_LEADER) || Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_STATE_LEADER) || StateAdminSystem_IsStateLeader(playerid);
}

stock AdminSystem_IsStateAdmin(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    return (gAdminLevel[playerid] >= ADMIN_RANK_STATE_ADMIN) || Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_STATE_ADMIN) || StateAdminSystem_IsStateAdmin(playerid);
}

stock AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    return (gAdminLevel[playerid] >= ADMIN_RANK_MODERATOR) || Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_RANK_MODERATOR) || StateAdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid);

stock AdminSystem_SetRank(playerid, level)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (level < 0 || level > ADMIN_RANK_OWNER)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gAdminLevel[playerid] = level;
    Core_SetPlayerAdminLevel(playerid, level);
    return true;
}

stock AdminSystem_SetStateRank(playerid, stateid, level)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (level < 0 || level > ADMIN_RANK_STATE_LEADER)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gAdminState[playerid] = stateid;
    Core_SetPlayerAdminState(playerid, stateid);
    gAdminLevel[playerid] = level;
    Core_SetPlayerAdminLevel(playerid, level);
    return true;
}

stock AdminSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] == '/')
    {
        new cmd[32], idx;
        idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
        if (idx == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (strcmp(cmd, "admin", true) == 0)
        {
            if (AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
            {
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[ADMIN] Du bist im Adminsystem aktiv.");
                return true;
            }
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[ADMIN] Kein Adminzugang.");
            return true;
        }

        if (strcmp(cmd, "state", true) == 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFF00AA, "[STATE] Verfügbar: Los Santos, San Fierro, Las Venturas");
            return true;
        }

        if (strcmp(cmd, "config", true) == 0)
        {
            if (AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
            {
                AdminConfigSystem_ShowMenu(playerid);
                return true;
            }
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[ADMIN] Kein Zugangsrecht zur Konfiguration.");
            return true;
        }

        if (strcmp(cmd, "togglewar", true) == 0)
        {
            if (AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
            {
                GangWarSystem_Toggle();
                SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[GANGWAR] Status gewechselt.");
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

#if !defined STATE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_INC
#define STATE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define STATE_ADMIN_COUNT 3
#define ADMIN_ROLE_NONE 0
#define ADMIN_ROLE_SUPPORT 1
#define ADMIN_ROLE_MODERATOR 2
#define ADMIN_ROLE_STATE_ADMIN 3
#define ADMIN_ROLE_STATE_LEADER 4
#define ADMIN_ROLE_SERVER_OWNER 5

stock StateAdminSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gAdminLevel[i] = ADMIN_ROLE_NONE;
        gAdminState[i] = -1;
        Core_SetPlayerAdminLevel(i, ADMIN_ROLE_NONE);
        Core_SetPlayerAdminState(i, -1);
    }

    print("[ADMIN_STATE] 3x/1Admin-System initialisiert");
}

stock StateAdminSystem_GetRoleName(level, output[], len)
{
    if (len <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }
    output[0] = '\0';

    if (level <= ADMIN_ROLE_NONE)
    {
        format(output, len, "Kein Rang");
        return;
    }
    if (level == ADMIN_ROLE_SUPPORT)
    {
        format(output, len, "Support");
        return;
    }
    if (level == ADMIN_ROLE_MODERATOR)
    {
        format(output, len, "Moderator");
        return;
    }
    if (level == ADMIN_ROLE_STATE_ADMIN)
    {
        format(output, len, "State Admin");
        return;
    }
    if (level == ADMIN_ROLE_STATE_LEADER)
    {
        format(output, len, "State Leader");
        return;
    }
    if (level == ADMIN_ROLE_SERVER_OWNER)
    {
        format(output, len, "Server Owner");
        return;
    }
    format(output, len, "Unknown");
}

stock StateAdminSystem_AssignGlobal(playerid, level)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (level < ADMIN_ROLE_NONE || level > ADMIN_ROLE_SERVER_OWNER)
    {
        level = ADMIN_ROLE_NONE;
    }

    gAdminLevel[playerid] = level;
    gAdminState[playerid] = -1;
    Core_SetPlayerAdminLevel(playerid, level);
    Core_SetPlayerAdminState(playerid, -1);
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_ADMIN_LEVEL] = level;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_ADMIN_STATE] = -1;
}

stock StateAdminSystem_AssignState(playerid, stateid, level)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    if (level < ADMIN_ROLE_NONE || level > ADMIN_ROLE_STATE_LEADER)
    {
        level = ADMIN_ROLE_NONE;
    }

    gAdminLevel[playerid] = level;
    gAdminState[playerid] = stateid;
    Core_SetPlayerAdminLevel(playerid, level);
    Core_SetPlayerAdminState(playerid, stateid);
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_ADMIN_LEVEL] = level;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_ADMIN_STATE] = stateid;
}

stock StateAdminSystem_HasAccess(playerid, requiredLevel, stateid = -1)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (requiredLevel <= ADMIN_ROLE_NONE)
    {
        return true;
    }

    if (gAdminLevel[playerid] >= requiredLevel || Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, requiredLevel))
    {
        return true;
    }

    if (stateid != -1 && gAdminState[playerid] == stateid && gAdminLevel[playerid] >= requiredLevel)
    {
        return true;
    }

    return (gAdminLevel[playerid] >= requiredLevel);
}

    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)

}

    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)

{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    return (gAdminLevel[playerid] >= ADMIN_ROLE_MODERATOR) || Core_HasAdminLevel(playerid, ADMIN_ROLE_MODERATOR);
}

stock StateAdminSystem_ShowSummary(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }

    new roleName[32];
    new stateName[32];
    new level = gAdminLevel[playerid];
    StateAdminSystem_GetRoleName(level, roleName, sizeof(roleName));

    if (gAdminState[playerid] != -1)
    {
        StateSystem_GetStateName(gAdminState[playerid], stateName, sizeof(stateName));

    else
    {
        format(stateName, sizeof(stateName), " Global");
    }

    printf("[ADMIN_STATE] %d -> %s%s", playerid, roleName, stateName);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[ADMIN_STATE] Rollenstatus aktualisiert.");
}

#if !defined BUSINESS_SYSTEM_INC
#define BUSINESS_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_BUSINESSES 30
#define BUSINESS_TYPE_NONE 0
#define BUSINESS_TYPE_BAR 1
#define BUSINESS_TYPE_SHOP 2
#define BUSINESS_TYPE_GARAGE 3
#define BUSINESS_TYPE_CLUB 4
#define BUSINESS_TYPE_CASINO 5
#define BUSINESS_TYPE_LOGISTICS 6

new gBizState[MAX_BUSINESSES];
new gBizOwner[MAX_BUSINESSES];
new gBizType[MAX_BUSINESSES];
new gBizValue[MAX_BUSINESSES];
new gBizIncome[MAX_BUSINESSES];
new gBizName[MAX_BUSINESSES][32];
new gBizTaxRate[MAX_BUSINESSES];
new gBizActive[MAX_BUSINESSES];

stock BusinessSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_BUSINESSES; i++)
    {
        gBizState[i] = -1;
        gBizOwner[i] = -1;
        gBizType[i] = BUSINESS_TYPE_NONE;
        gBizValue[i] = 0;
        gBizIncome[i] = 0;
        gBizTaxRate[i] = 10;
        gBizActive[i] = 1;
        format(gBizName[i], 32, "Unbenannt");
    }

    BusinessSystem_CreateBusiness(0, 0, BUSINESS_TYPE_SHOP, 150000, -1, "Los Santos Market");
    BusinessSystem_CreateBusiness(1, 1, BUSINESS_TYPE_BAR, 180000, -1, "San Fierro Lounge");
    BusinessSystem_CreateBusiness(2, 2, BUSINESS_TYPE_CLUB, 220000, -1, "LV Casino Lounge");
    BusinessSystem_CreateBusiness(3, 0, BUSINESS_TYPE_LOGISTICS, 260000, -1, "LS Cargo Hub");
    BusinessSystem_CreateBusiness(4, 2, BUSINESS_TYPE_CASINO, 420000, -1, "Venturas Royale");

    gBizTaxRate[0] = 8;
    gBizTaxRate[1] = 7;
    gBizTaxRate[2] = 9;
    gBizTaxRate[3] = 10;
    gBizTaxRate[4] = 12;

    print("[BIZ] Bizen und Gewerbe-System initialisiert");
}

stock BusinessSystem_CreateBusiness(bizid, stateid, type, value, ownerid, const name[])
{
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gBizState[bizid] = stateid;
    gBizOwner[bizid] = ownerid;
    gBizType[bizid] = type;
    gBizValue[bizid] = value;
    gBizIncome[bizid] = value / 25;
    gBizTaxRate[bizid] = 10;
    gBizActive[bizid] = 1;
    format(gBizName[bizid], 32, "%s", name);
    return true;
}

stock BusinessSystem_BuyBusiness(playerid, bizid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(gBizState[bizid]))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[BIZ] Dieses Geschäft ist keinem gültigen Staat zugeordnet.");
        return false;
    }
    if (gBizOwner[bizid] != -1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[BIZ] Dieses Geschäft ist bereits vergeben.");
        return false;
    }
    if (gBizActive[bizid] != 1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[BIZ] Dieses Geschäft ist momentan nicht aktiv.");
        return false;
    }

    if (gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] < gBizValue[bizid])
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[BIZ] Du hast nicht genug Geld auf der Bank für das Business.");
        return false;
    }

    if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, -gBizValue[bizid]))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[BIZ] Kontostand reicht für den Kauf nicht aus.");
        return false;
    }

    gBizOwner[bizid] = playerid;
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(gBizState[bizid], gBizValue[bizid] / 10);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[BIZ] Geschäft erfolgreich erworben.");
    return true;
}

stock BusinessSystem_CollectIncome(bizid)
{
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gBizOwner[bizid] == -1)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gBizIncome[bizid] = max(0, gBizIncome[bizid]);
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(gBizState[bizid], gBizIncome[bizid] / 4);
    return true;
}

// Zahlt das aufgelaufene Einkommen abzüglich Staatsanteil auf das Bankkonto des Besitzers aus.
stock int:BusinessSystem_PayoutToOwner(playerid, bizid)
{
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES || gBizOwner[bizid] != playerid)
    {
        return -1;
    }

    new income = max(0, gBizIncome[bizid]);
    new net = income - income / 4;
    if (income == 0 || !BusinessSystem_CollectIncome(bizid))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, net))
    {
        return -1;
    }
    gBizIncome[bizid] = 0;
    return net;
}

stock BusinessSystem_TransferIncomeToOwner(bizid, amount)
{
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gBizOwner[bizid] == -1)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gBizIncome[bizid] += amount;
    return true;
}

stock int:BusinessSystem_GetOwner(bizid)
{
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gBizOwner[bizid];
}

stock int:BusinessSystem_GetState(bizid)
{
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gBizState[bizid];
}

stock BusinessSystem_ShowInfo(playerid, bizid)
{
    if (bizid < 0 || bizid >= MAX_BUSINESSES)
    {
        return;
    }

    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[BIZ] %s | Staat: %d | Typ: %d | Wert: %d | Gewinn: %d | Besitzer: %d", gBizName[bizid], gBizState[bizid], gBizType[bizid], gBizValue[bizid], gBizIncome[bizid], gBizOwner[bizid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);
}

#endif

#if !defined CAMERA_SYSTEM_INC
#define CAMERA_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define CAMERA_MODE_NONE 0
#define CAMERA_MODE_TUTORIAL 1

new gCameraMode[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock CameraSystem_Initialize()
{
    print("[CAMERA] Kamerasystem initialisiert");
}

stock CameraSystem_Reset(playerid)

#if !defined MARKETPLACE_SYSTEM_INC
#define MARKETPLACE_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_MARKETPLACE_ITEMS 30

new gMarketplaceState[MAX_MARKETPLACE_ITEMS];
new gMarketplaceItem[MAX_MARKETPLACE_ITEMS][40];
new gMarketplacePrice[MAX_MARKETPLACE_ITEMS];
new gMarketplaceSupply[MAX_MARKETPLACE_ITEMS];
new gMarketplaceCount = 0;

stock MarketplaceSystem_Initialize()
{
    gMarketplaceCount = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MARKETPLACE_ITEMS; i++)
    {
        gMarketplaceState[i] = -1;
        format(gMarketplaceItem[i], 40, "");
        gMarketplacePrice[i] = 0;
        gMarketplaceSupply[i] = 0;
    }

    MarketplaceSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Mauerbau", 1200, 15);
    MarketplaceSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Elektronik", 1800, 12);
    MarketplaceSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Luxuswaren", 2600, 9);

    print("[MARKETPLACE] Handelsplattform und Konsumgüter initialisiert");
}

stock MarketplaceSystem_RegisterItem(stateid, const item[], price, supply)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gMarketplaceCount >= MAX_MARKETPLACE_ITEMS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gMarketplaceCount;
    gMarketplaceState[idx] = stateid;
    format(gMarketplaceItem[idx], 40, "%s", item);
    gMarketplacePrice[idx] = price;
    gMarketplaceSupply[idx] = supply;
    gMarketplaceCount++;
    return true;
}

stock MarketplaceSystem_Show(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MARKETPLACE] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[MARKETPLACE] %s | Angebot: %d", stateName, gMarketplaceCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gMarketplaceCount; i++)
    {
        if (gMarketplaceState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new line[180];
            format(line, sizeof(line), "- %s | Preis: $%d | Vorrat: %d", gMarketplaceItem[i], gMarketplacePrice[i], gMarketplaceSupply[i]);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
        }
    }
}

new gPhoneContactCount[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock PhoneSystem_Initialize()
{
    DB_EnsureContactSchema();
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gPhoneState[i] = PHONE_STATE_OFF;
        gPhoneNumber[i] = 100000 + i;
        gPhoneContactCount[i] = 0;
        gPhoneMessageCount[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[PHONE] Handy-/SIM-System initialisiert");

stock PhoneSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gPhoneState[playerid] = PHONE_STATE_ON;
    gPhoneNumber[playerid] = 100000 + playerid;
    gPhoneContactCount[playerid] = 0;
    gPhoneMessageCount[playerid] = 0;
    DB_AddPlayerContact(playerid, "Support", "100000");
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, "[PHONE] SIM aktiv. Deine Nummer: 100000");
}

stock PhoneSystem_AddContact(playerid, const contactName[])
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (gPhoneContactCount[playerid] >= MAX_PHONE_CONTACTS)
    {
        return;
    }

    format(gPhoneContacts[playerid][gPhoneContactCount[playerid]], 32, "%s", contactName);
    DB_AddPlayerContact(playerid, contactName, "100000");
    gPhoneContactCount[playerid]++;
}

stock PhoneSystem_SendSMS(playerid, const message[])
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (gPhoneMessageCount[playerid] >= MAX_SMS_COUNT)
    {
        return;
    }

    format(gPhoneMessages[playerid][gPhoneMessageCount[playerid]], 64, "%s", message);
    gPhoneMessageCount[playerid]++;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x66FF66AA, "[PHONE] SMS gespeichert.");
}

{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[PHONE] Kontakte: %d | Nummer: %d", gPhoneContactCount[playerid], gPhoneNumber[playerid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);

stock Float:GetDistanceBetweenPoints3D(Float:x1, Float:y1, Float:z1, Float:x2, Float:y2, Float:z2)
{
    return floatsqroot(((x2 - x1) * (x2 - x1)) + ((y2 - y1) * (y2 - y1)) + ((z2 - z1) * (z2 - z1)));
}

#define CORE_VERSION "1.0.0"
#define MAX_STATES 3
#define STATE_COUNT 3
#define STATE_LOS_SANTOS 0
#define STATE_SAN_FIERRO 1

// Architektonische Contract-Regeln:
// 1. core.inc MUSS zuerst in gamemode.pwn inkludiert werden.
// 2. Alle Player-Arrays mit einem zentralen Strukturmodell verwalten.
// 3. Module dürfen keine eigenen globalen Player-Daten als „zweite Quelle der Wahrheit" definieren.
// 4. Beim Hinzufügen neuer Module immer zuerst das zentrale Profil erweitern und danach die einzelnen Module kompatibel halten.

enum E_PLAYER_PROFILE
{
    E_PLAYER_STATE,
    E_PLAYER_HOME_STATE,
    E_PLAYER_ADMIN_LEVEL,
    E_PLAYER_ADMIN_STATE,
    E_PLAYER_LEVEL,
    E_PLAYER_XP,
    E_PLAYER_REP,
    E_PLAYER_BANK,
    E_PLAYER_WANTED,
    E_PLAYER_JAIL_ACTIVE,
    E_PLAYER_JAIL_TIME,
    E_PLAYER_LAW_ROLE,
    E_PLAYER_EMERGENCY_ROLE,
    E_PLAYER_EMERGENCY_STATE,
    E_PLAYER_PROFILE_COUNT
};

new gPlayerData[MAX_PLAYERS][E_PLAYER_PROFILE_COUNT];
new gPlayerBank[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPlayerCash[MAX_PLAYERS];

stock Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid)
{
    return (playerid >= 0 && playerid < MAX_PLAYERS);
}

stock Core_ResetPlayerData(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < E_PLAYER_PROFILE_COUNT; i++)
    {
        gPlayerData[playerid][i] = 0;
    }

    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_HOME_STATE] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_LEVEL] = 1;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] = 2500;
    gPlayerBank[playerid] = 2500;
    gPlayerCash[playerid] = 2500;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_ADMIN_LEVEL] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_ADMIN_STATE] = -1;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_WANTED] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_ACTIVE] = 0;
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_JAIL_TIME] = 0;
}

stock Core_IsValidState(stateid)
{
    return (stateid >= STATE_LOS_SANTOS && stateid < STATE_COUNT);
}

stock int:Core_ResolveStateId(stateid)
{
    if (Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return stateid;
    }
    return STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
}

stock Core_IsValidAdminState(stateid)
{
    return (stateid == -1 || Core_IsValidState(stateid));
}

stock int:Core_GetPlayerState(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }
    return gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE];
}

stock Core_NormalizePlayerState(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return;
    }

    if (!Core_IsValidState(gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE]))
    {
        gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    if (!Core_IsValidState(gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_HOME_STATE]))
    {
        gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_HOME_STATE] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }
}

stock int:Core_GetPlayerBank(playerid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    if (gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] != gPlayerBank[playerid])
    {
        gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] = gPlayerBank[playerid];
    }
    return gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK];
}

stock Core_SetPlayerBank(playerid, amount)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return;
    }
    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] = amount;
    gPlayerBank[playerid] = amount;
}

stock Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, delta)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new nextBank = Core_GetPlayerBank(playerid) + delta;
    if (nextBank < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_BANK] = nextBank;
    gPlayerBank[playerid] = nextBank;
    return true;
}

    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))

        return 0;

DATEI: gamemodes/modules/core/module_contract.inc
