#if !defined MODULE_CONTRACT_INC
#define MODULE_CONTRACT_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define CORE_LIFECYCLE_BOOT 0
#define CORE_LIFECYCLE_DB_READY 1
#define CORE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_READY 2
#define CORE_LIFECYCLE_AUTH_READY 3
#define CORE_LIFECYCLE_WORLD_READY 4
#define CORE_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_READY 5
#define MAX_MODULE_CONTRACTS 48

new gLifecycleStage = CORE_LIFECYCLE_BOOT;
new gLifecycleModuleCount = 0;
new gLifecycleModules[MAX_MODULE_CONTRACTS][32];
new gLifecycleModuleMinStage[MAX_MODULE_CONTRACTS];
new gLifecycleModuleReady[MAX_MODULE_CONTRACTS];

stock Core_SetLifecycleStage(stage)
{
    if (stage < CORE_LIFECYCLE_BOOT || stage > CORE_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_READY)
    {
        return;
    }
    gLifecycleStage = stage;
}

stock int:Core_GetLifecycleStage()
{
    return gLifecycleStage;
}

// minStage: frühester Lifecycle-Stage, in dem das Modul initialisiert werden darf.
stock Core_RegisterModuleContract(const moduleName[], minStage = CORE_LIFECYCLE_BOOT)
{
    if (minStage < CORE_LIFECYCLE_BOOT || minStage > CORE_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_READY)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < gLifecycleModuleCount; i++)
    {
        if (strcmp(gLifecycleModules[i], moduleName, true) == 0)
        {
            gLifecycleModuleMinStage[i] = max(gLifecycleModuleMinStage[i], minStage);
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (gLifecycleModuleCount >= MAX_MODULE_CONTRACTS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(gLifecycleModules[gLifecycleModuleCount], 32, "%s", moduleName);
    gLifecycleModuleMinStage[gLifecycleModuleCount] = minStage;
    gLifecycleModuleReady[gLifecycleModuleCount] = 0;
    gLifecycleModuleCount++;
    return true;
}

stock int:Core_FindModuleContract(const moduleName[])
{
    for (new i = 0; i < gLifecycleModuleCount; i++)
    {
        if (strcmp(gLifecycleModules[i], moduleName, true) == 0)
        {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

// Markiert ein Modul als initialisiert. Schlägt fehl, wenn es nicht registriert ist
// oder sein Mindest-Stage noch nicht erreicht wurde (verfrühter DB-/State-Zugriff).
stock Core_MarkModuleReady(const moduleName[])
{
    new idx = Core_FindModuleContract(moduleName);
    if (idx < 0)
    {
        printf("[CORE] Modul '%s' ohne Contract initialisiert!", moduleName);
        return false;
    }
    if (gLifecycleStage < gLifecycleModuleMinStage[idx])
    {
        printf("[CORE] Modul '%s' zu früh initialisiert (Stage %d < %d)", moduleName, gLifecycleStage, gLifecycleModuleMinStage[idx]);
        return false;
    }
    gLifecycleModuleReady[idx] = 1;
    return true;
}

stock Core_IsModuleReady(const moduleName[])
{
    new idx = Core_FindModuleContract(moduleName);
    return idx >= 0 && gLifecycleModuleReady[idx] == 1;
}

stock Core_AssertLifecycleStage(minStage)
{
    return gLifecycleStage >= minStage;
}

stock Core_PrintLifecycleReport()
{
    printf("[CORE] Lifecycle stage: %d", gLifecycleStage);
    for (new i = 0; i < gLifecycleModuleCount; i++)
    {
        printf("[CORE] Contract[%d]: %s (minStage %d, ready: %d)", i, gLifecycleModules[i], gLifecycleModuleMinStage[i], gLifecycleModuleReady[i]);
        if (gLifecycleModuleReady[i] != 1)
        {
            printf("[CORE] WARNUNG: Modul '%s' wurde nicht initialisiert!", gLifecycleModules[i]);
        }
    }
}

#endif

#if !defined PRODUCTION_GUARD_INC
#define PRODUCTION_GUARD_INC

#include <a_samp>

#if !defined MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS
#define MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS 24
#endif
#if !defined MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS
#define MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS 12
#endif
#if !defined MAX_UBB_VEHICLES
#define MAX_UBB_VEHICLES 100
#endif

stock Core_ValidatePlayerSlot(playerid)
{
    return (playerid >= 0 && playerid < MAX_PLAYERS);
}

stock Core_ValidateInventorySlot(slot)
{
    return (slot >= 0 && slot < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS);
}

stock Core_ValidateHouseStorageSlot(slot)
{
    return (slot >= 0 && slot < MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS);
}

stock Core_ValidateVehicleIndex(vehicleid)
{
    return (vehicleid >= 0 && vehicleid < MAX_UBB_VEHICLES);
}

stock Core_ValidateQuantityRange(quantity, maxLimit)
{
    return (quantity >= 0 && maxLimit >= 0 && quantity <= maxLimit);
}

stock Core_ValidateItemStack(itemid, quantity, maxStack, bool:isStackable)
{
    if (itemid < INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (quantity < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (quantity == 0)
    {
        return true;
    }
    if (maxStack <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (isStackable)
    {
        return quantity <= maxStack;
    }
    return quantity == 1;
}

stock Core_ValidateStateTransition(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_ValidatePlayerSlot(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

stock Core_EmitRuntimeGuardReport()
{
    print("[CORE_GUARD] Production safety guard active");
    print("[CORE_GUARD] Inventory slots, house storage slots and UBB vehicles are bounded");
    print("[CORE_GUARD] Transaction boundaries and state transitions are validated before mutation");
}

#if !defined CRIME_SYSTEM_INC
#define CRIME_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define CRIME_TYPE_NONE 0
#define CRIME_TYPE_ROBBERY 1
#define CRIME_TYPE_DRUG_RUN 2
#define CRIME_TYPE_ARSON 3
#define CRIME_TYPE_WEAPON_SMUGGLING 4

new gCrimeHeat[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gCrimeProgress[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gPlayerCrimeState[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gLastCrimeType[MAX_PLAYERS];
new Text:gCrimeTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];

stock CrimeSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gCrimeHeat[i] = 0;
        gCrimeProgress[i] = 0;
        gPlayerCrimeState[i] = 0;
        gLastCrimeType[i] = CRIME_TYPE_NONE;
    }

    print("[CRIME] Verbrechens- und Crime-System initialisiert");
}

stock CrimeSystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gCrimeHeat[playerid] = 0;
    gCrimeProgress[playerid] = 0;
    gPlayerCrimeState[playerid] = 0;
    gLastCrimeType[playerid] = CRIME_TYPE_NONE;
}

stock CrimeSystem_StartRobbery(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }

    gPlayerCrimeState[playerid] = 1;
    gCrimeProgress[playerid] = 25;
    gLastCrimeType[playerid] = CRIME_TYPE_ROBBERY;

    if (stateid >= 0 && stateid <= 2)
    {
        gCrimeHeat[playerid] += 5;
    }

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF6666AA, "[CRIME] Raubüberfall gestartet. Die Polizei ist aufmerksam.");
}

stock CrimeSystem_AddHeat(playerid, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    gCrimeHeat[playerid] += amount;
    if (gCrimeHeat[playerid] > 100)
    {
        gCrimeHeat[playerid] = 100;
    }

    if (gCrimeHeat[playerid] >= 35)
    {
        LawSystem_AddWanted(playerid, 1);
    }
}

stock CrimeSystem_CommitCrime(playerid, type)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gLastCrimeType[playerid] = type;
    gPlayerCrimeState[playerid] = 1;
    gCrimeProgress[playerid] = 100;

    switch (type)
    {
        case CRIME_TYPE_ROBBERY: CrimeSystem_AddHeat(playerid, 22);
        case CRIME_TYPE_DRUG_RUN: CrimeSystem_AddHeat(playerid, 18);
        case CRIME_TYPE_ARSON: CrimeSystem_AddHeat(playerid, 26);
        case CRIME_TYPE_WEAPON_SMUGGLING: CrimeSystem_AddHeat(playerid, 30);
        default: gCrimeProgress[playerid] = 0;
    }

    return true;
}

stock CrimeSystem_ShowCrimeInfo(playerid)
{
    CrimeSystem_HideCrimeInfo(playerid);

    gCrimeTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 30.0, "CRIME TRACKER");
    TextDrawAlignment(gCrimeTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gCrimeTD[playerid][0], 0.52, 1.4);
    TextDrawColor(gCrimeTD[playerid][0], 0xFF4040AA);

    new heatText[64];
    format(heatText, sizeof(heatText), "Heat: %d | Progress: %d%%", gCrimeHeat[playerid], gCrimeProgress[playerid]);
    gCrimeTD[playerid][1] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 62.0, heatText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gCrimeTD[playerid][1], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gCrimeTD[playerid][1], 0.24, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gCrimeTD[playerid][1], 0xFFFFFFFF);

    new typeText[64];
    format(typeText, sizeof(typeText), "Aktivitaet: %d | Staat: %d", gLastCrimeType[playerid], StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
    gCrimeTD[playerid][2] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 86.0, typeText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gCrimeTD[playerid][2], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gCrimeTD[playerid][2], 0.22, 0.9);
    TextDrawColor(gCrimeTD[playerid][2], 0xFFCC66FF);

    for (new i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    {
        if (gCrimeTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gCrimeTD[playerid][i]);
        }
    }
}

stock CrimeSystem_HideCrimeInfo(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gCrimeTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gCrimeTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gCrimeTD[playerid][i]);
            gCrimeTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

stock DB_InitializeRuntimeCaches()
{
    for (new playerid = 0; playerid < MAX_PLAYERS; playerid++)
    {
        gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
        gDBPlayerHomeStateCache[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
        gDBPlayerBankCache[playerid] = 0;
        gDBPlayerCashCache[playerid] = 0;

        for (new slot = 0; slot < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; slot++)
        {
            gDBPlayerInventoryCache[playerid][slot] = 0;
            gDBPlayerInventoryQtyCache[playerid][slot] = 0;
            format(gDBPlayerInventoryMetaCache[playerid][slot], 32, "NONE");
        }
    }

    for (new houseid = 0; houseid < MAX_HOUSES; houseid++)
    {
        for (new slot = 0; slot < MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS; slot++)
        {
            gDBHouseStorageCache[houseid][slot] = 0;
            gDBHouseStorageQtyCache[houseid][slot] = 0;
            format(gDBHouseStorageMetaCache[houseid][slot], 32, "NONE");
        }
    }

    for (new vehicleid = 0; vehicleid < MAX_UBB_VEHICLES; vehicleid++)
    {
        gDBUBBVehicleModelCache[vehicleid] = 0;
        gDBUBBVehicleOwnerCache[vehicleid] = -1;
        gDBUBBVehicleStateCache[vehicleid] = 0;
        gDBUBBVehicleFuelCache[vehicleid] = 100;
        gDBUBBVehiclePriceCache[vehicleid] = 0;
    }
}

stock DB_BeginTransaction()
{
    return DB_Execute("BEGIN EXCLUSIVE TRANSACTION");
}

stock DB_CommitTransaction()
{
    return DB_Execute("COMMIT");
}

stock DB_RollbackTransaction()
{
    return DB_Execute("ROLLBACK");
}

stock DB_ExecuteAtomicWrite(const preQuery[], const postQuery[], const rollbackQuery[] = "")
{
    if (!DB_BeginTransaction())
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (preQuery[0] != '\0' && !DB_Execute(preQuery))
    {
        if (rollbackQuery[0] != '\0')
        {
            DB_Execute(rollbackQuery);
        }
        DB_RollbackTransaction();
        return false;
    }

    if (postQuery[0] != '\0' && !DB_Execute(postQuery))
    {
        if (rollbackQuery[0] != '\0')
        {
            DB_Execute(rollbackQuery);
        }
        DB_RollbackTransaction();
        return false;
    }

    return DB_CommitTransaction();
}

stock DB_ExecuteTransaction(const preQuery[], const postQuery[])
{
    if (!DB_BeginTransaction())
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (preQuery[0] != '\0' && !DB_Execute(preQuery))
    {
        DB_RollbackTransaction();
        return false;
    }

    if (postQuery[0] != '\0' && !DB_Execute(postQuery))
    {
        DB_RollbackTransaction();
        return false;
    }

    return DB_CommitTransaction();
}

stock DB_TransactionWriteWithGuard(const preQuery[], const postQuery[], const rollbackQuery[])
{
    if (!DB_BeginTransaction())
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (preQuery[0] != '\0' && !DB_Execute(preQuery))
    {
        if (rollbackQuery[0] != '\0')
        {
            DB_Execute(rollbackQuery);
        }
        DB_RollbackTransaction();
        return false;
    }

    if (postQuery[0] != '\0' && !DB_Execute(postQuery))
    {
        if (rollbackQuery[0] != '\0')
        {
            DB_Execute(rollbackQuery);
        }
        DB_RollbackTransaction();
        return false;
    }

    return DB_CommitTransaction();
}

stock DB_Initialize()
{
    switch (gDBBackend)
    {
        case DB_BACKEND_SQLITE:
        {
            print("[DB] SQLite Backend aktiviert");
            DB_SQLite_Initialize();
        }
        case DB_BACKEND_MYSQL:
        {
            print("[DB] MySQL Backend aktiviert");
            DB_MySQL_Initialize();
        }
        default:
        {
            print("[DB] Kein gültiges Backend erkannt, fallback zu SQLite");
            gDBBackend = DB_BACKEND_SQLITE;
            DB_SQLite_Initialize();
        }
    }

    DB_InitializeRuntimeCaches();
    DB_Execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;");
    DB_RepairCriticalTables();
    DB_ValidateCriticalTables();
    print("[DB] Runtime-Caches und kritische Schema-/Constraint-Checks initialisiert");
}

stock DB_Shutdown()
{
    if (gDBBackend == DB_BACKEND_SQLITE)
    {
        DB_SQLite_Shutdown();
    }
    else if (gDBBackend == DB_BACKEND_MYSQL)
    {
        DB_MySQL_Shutdown();
    }
}

    return gDBBackend == DB_BACKEND_SQLITE;
}

stock DB_IsMySQL()
{
    return gDBBackend == DB_BACKEND_MYSQL;
}

}

}

stock DB_SanitizeMetadata(const input[], output[], len)
{
    if (strlen(input) <= 0)
    {
        format(output, len, "NONE");
        return true;
    }

    new sanitized[128];
    new idx = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < strlen(input) && i < sizeof(sanitized) - 2; i++)
    {
        if (input[i] == '\'')
        {
            sanitized[idx++] = '\'';
            sanitized[idx++] = '\'';
            continue;
        }
        sanitized[idx++] = input[i];
    }
    sanitized[idx] = '\0';
    format(output, len, "%s", sanitized);
    return true;
}

stock DB_EnsurePlayerRecord(playerid, defaultState)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new stateid = Core_ResolveStateId(defaultState);
    new playerName[32];
    format(playerName, sizeof(playerName), "Player_%d", playerid);

    new query[320];
    format(query, sizeof(query),
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO players (id, name, state_id, money, admin_level, admin_state, home_state, phone_number, has_health_insurance, created_at) VALUES (%d, '%s', %d, 0, 0, -1, %d, 'NONE', 0, datetime('now'));",
        playerid,
        playerName,
        stateid,
        stateid);
    if (!DB_Execute(query))
    {
        return false;
    }

    format(query, sizeof(query),
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO player_state (player_id, state_id, last_updated) VALUES (%d, %d, datetime('now'));",
        playerid,
        stateid);
    return DB_Execute(query);
}

stock DB_EnsureHouseRecord(houseid, stateid, owner_player_id, const name[])
{
    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        stateid = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    new safeName[32];
    DB_SanitizeMetadata(name, safeName, sizeof(safeName));

    new query[320];
    format(query, sizeof(query),
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO houses (id, owner_player_id, state_id, name, price, x, y, z, locked, created_at) VALUES (%d, %d, %d, '%s', 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, datetime('now'));",
        houseid,
        owner_player_id,
        stateid,
        safeName);
    return DB_Execute(query);
}

stock DB_SetPlayerState(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (!DB_EnsurePlayerRecord(playerid, stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    new query[128];
    format(query, sizeof(query), "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO player_state (player_id, state_id, last_updated) VALUES (%d, %d, datetime('now'))", playerid, stateid);
    return DB_Execute(query);
}

stock int:DB_GetPlayerState(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    if (gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] >= STATE_LOS_SANTOS && gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] < STATE_COUNT)
    {
        return gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid];
    }

    if (gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE] >= STATE_LOS_SANTOS && gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE] < STATE_COUNT)
    {
        gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] = gPlayerData[playerid][E_PLAYER_STATE];
        return gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid];
    }

    gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    return gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid];
}

stock DB_LoadPlayerState(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new query[192];
    format(query, sizeof(query), "SELECT state_id FROM player_state WHERE player_id = %d LIMIT 1;", playerid);
    if (!DB_Query(query))
    {
        gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
        gDBPlayerHomeStateCache[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
        return false;
    }

    gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    gDBPlayerHomeStateCache[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    return true;
}

stock DB_SavePlayerState(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gDBPlayerStateCache[playerid] = stateid;
    gDBPlayerHomeStateCache[playerid] = stateid;

    new query[192];
    format(query, sizeof(query), "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO player_state (player_id, state_id, last_updated) VALUES (%d, %d, datetime('now'));", playerid, stateid);
    return DB_Execute(query);
}

stock DB_LoadPlayerInventory(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS; i++)
    {
        gDBPlayerInventoryCache[playerid][i] = INVENTORY_ITEM_NONE;
        gDBPlayerInventoryQtyCache[playerid][i] = 0;
        format(gDBPlayerInventoryMetaCache[playerid][i], 32, "NONE");
    }

    new query[192];
    format(query, sizeof(query), "SELECT item_id, slot_index, quantity, metadata FROM player_inventory WHERE player_id = %d ORDER BY slot_index ASC;", playerid);
    if (!DB_Query(query))
    {
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

stock DB_SavePlayerInventoryItem(playerid, itemid, slot_index, quantity, const metadata[])
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (slot_index < 0 || slot_index >= MAX_INVENTORY_SLOTS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (itemid < 0 || quantity < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gDBPlayerInventoryCache[playerid][slot_index] = itemid;
    gDBPlayerInventoryQtyCache[playerid][slot_index] = quantity;
    format(gDBPlayerInventoryMetaCache[playerid][slot_index], 32, "%s", metadata);

    new query[256];
    format(query, sizeof(query), "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO player_inventory (player_id, item_id, slot_index, quantity, metadata) VALUES (%d, %d, %d, %d, '%s')", playerid, itemid, slot_index, quantity, metadata);
    return DB_Execute(query);
}

stock DB_LoadHouseStorage(houseid)

    if (houseid < 0 || houseid >= MAX_HOUSES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_HOUSE_STORAGE_SLOTS; i++)

        gDBHouseStorageCache[houseid][i] = 0;

    new query[192];

        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

new gDrugPrice[3][MAX_DRUG_TYPES];

stock DrugSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new stateIndex = 0; stateIndex < 3; stateIndex++)
    {
        for (new typeIndex = 0; typeIndex < MAX_DRUG_TYPES; typeIndex++)
        {
            gDrugStock[stateIndex][typeIndex] = 25 + (stateIndex * 5) + (typeIndex * 3);
            gDrugPrice[stateIndex][typeIndex] = 500 + (typeIndex * 250) + (stateIndex * 100);
        }
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        for (new typeIndex = 0; typeIndex < MAX_DRUG_TYPES; typeIndex++)
        {
            gPlayerDrugInventory[i][typeIndex] = 0;
        }
    }

    print("[DRUGS] Drogenhandel und illegaler Markt initialisiert");
}

stock DrugSystem_BuyDrug(playerid, stateid, type, amount)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (type < 0 || type >= MAX_DRUG_TYPES)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount <= 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gDrugMarketActive != 1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[DRUGS] Der Drogenticker ist derzeit deaktiviert.");
        return false;
    }

    if (gDrugStock[stateid][type] < amount)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[DRUGS] Nicht genug Vorrat im Markt.");
        return false;
    }

    gDrugStock[stateid][type] -= amount;
    gPlayerDrugInventory[playerid][type] += amount;
    CrimeSystem_AddHeat(playerid, 6 + amount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[DRUGS] Drogen erworben.");
    return true;
}

stock int:DrugSystem_GetInventory(playerid, type)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    if (type < 0 || type >= MAX_DRUG_TYPES)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gPlayerDrugInventory[playerid][type];
}

stock DrugSystem_ShowMarket(playerid, stateid)
{
    DrugSystem_HideMarket(playerid);

    gDrugTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 28.0, "DRUG MARKET");
    TextDrawAlignment(gDrugTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gDrugTD[playerid][0], 0.55, 1.5);
    TextDrawColor(gDrugTD[playerid][0], 0x66FF66AA);

    new lineY = 60;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_DRUG_TYPES && i < 5; i++)
    {
        new drugText[64];
        format(drugText, sizeof(drugText), "%d: %d x $%d", i, gDrugStock[stateid][i], gDrugPrice[stateid][i]);
        gDrugTD[playerid][1 + i] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, float(lineY), drugText);
        TextDrawAlignment(gDrugTD[playerid][1 + i], 2);
        TextDrawLetterSize(gDrugTD[playerid][1 + i], 0.22, 0.8);
        TextDrawColor(gDrugTD[playerid][1 + i], 0xFFFFFFFF);
        lineY += 18;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < 6; i++)
    {
        if (gDrugTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gDrugTD[playerid][i]);
        }
    }
}

stock DrugSystem_HideMarket(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gDrugTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gDrugTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gDrugTD[playerid][i]);
            gDrugTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

new gAmmuState[MAX_AMMU_SHOPS];

new Float:gAmmuPosY[MAX_AMMU_SHOPS];
new Float:gAmmuPosZ[MAX_AMMU_SHOPS];
new gAmmuOpen[MAX_AMMU_SHOPS];
new gAmmuName[MAX_AMMU_SHOPS][32];

stock AmmuSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_AMMU_SHOPS; i++)
    {
        gAmmuState[i] = -1;
        gAmmuPosX[i] = 0.0;
        gAmmuPosY[i] = 0.0;
        gAmmuPosZ[i] = 0.0;
        gAmmuOpen[i] = 1;
        format(gAmmuName[i], 32, "Ammu Nation");
    }

    AmmuSystem_RegisterShop(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Ammu Nation Los Santos", 1365.0, -1278.0, 13.0);
    AmmuSystem_RegisterShop(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Ammu Nation San Fierro", -2078.0, 251.0, 35.0);
    AmmuSystem_RegisterShop(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Ammu Nation Las Venturas", 2117.0, 933.0, 10.0);

    print("[AMMU] Ammu Nations Systeme initialisiert");
}

stock AmmuSystem_RegisterShop(stateid, const name[], Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_AMMU_SHOPS; i++)
    {
        if (gAmmuState[i] == -1)
        {
            gAmmuState[i] = stateid;
            gAmmuPosX[i] = x;
            gAmmuPosY[i] = y;
            gAmmuPosZ[i] = z;
            gAmmuOpen[i] = 1;
            format(gAmmuName[i], 32, "%s", name);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

stock AmmuSystem_IsNearShop(playerid, stateid, Float:radius)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_AMMU_SHOPS; i++)
    {
        if (gAmmuState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new Float:x, Float:y, Float:z;
            GetPlayerPos(playerid, x, y, z);
            if (GetDistanceBetweenPoints3D(x, y, z, gAmmuPosX[i], gAmmuPosY[i], gAmmuPosZ[i]) <= radius)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock AmmuSystem_ShowNearbyInfo(playerid)
{
    new stateid = StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }

    if (AmmuSystem_IsNearShop(playerid, stateid, 25.0))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC00AA, "[AMMU] Ammu Nation: Waffen, Munition und Ausrüstung für deinen Staat.");
    }
}

#if !defined CONTRABAND_SYSTEM_INC
#define CONTRABAND_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_CONTRABAND_ITEMS 12

new gContrabandState[MAX_CONTRABAND_ITEMS];
new gContrabandName[MAX_CONTRABAND_ITEMS][32];
new gContrabandPrice[MAX_CONTRABAND_ITEMS];
new gContrabandRisk[MAX_CONTRABAND_ITEMS];
new gContrabandCount = 0;

stock ContrabandSystem_Initialize()
{
    gContrabandCount = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_CONTRABAND_ITEMS; i++)
    {
        gContrabandState[i] = -1;
        gContrabandPrice[i] = 0;
        gContrabandRisk[i] = 0;
        format(gContrabandName[i], 32, "");
    }

    ContrabandSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Stolen Goods", 1800, 65);
    ContrabandSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Smugglers Supply", 2200, 70);
    ContrabandSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Luxury Smuggling", 2800, 78);

    print("[CONTRABAND] Black-market logistics initialized");
}

stock ContrabandSystem_RegisterItem(stateid, const name[], price, risk)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gContrabandCount >= MAX_CONTRABAND_ITEMS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gContrabandState[gContrabandCount] = stateid;
    format(gContrabandName[gContrabandCount], 32, "%s", name);
    gContrabandPrice[gContrabandCount] = price;
    gContrabandRisk[gContrabandCount] = risk;
    gContrabandCount++;
    return true;
}

stock ContrabandSystem_Show(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[CONTRABAND] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new message[256];
    format(message, sizeof(message), "[CONTRABAND] %s | Items: %d", stateName, gContrabandCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, message);

    for (new i = 0; i < gContrabandCount; i++)
    {
        if (gContrabandState[i] == stateid)
        {
            new line[180];
            format(line, sizeof(line), "- %s | Price: $%d | Risk: %d%%", gContrabandName[i], gContrabandPrice[i], gContrabandRisk[i]);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
        }
    }
}

stock ContrabandSystem_Trade(playerid, stateid, itemIndex, quantity)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !Core_IsValidState(stateid) || itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= gContrabandCount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gContrabandState[itemIndex] != stateid)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new totalCost = gContrabandPrice[itemIndex] * quantity;
    if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, -totalCost))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[CONTRABAND] Du hast nicht genug Geld.");
        return false;
    }

    new stateIncome = totalCost / 2;
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, stateIncome);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[CONTRABAND] Handel abgeschlossen.");
    return true;
}

#if !defined DEALERSHIP_SYSTEM_INC
#define DEALERSHIP_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_DEALERSHIPS 12
#define DEALERSHIP_TYPE_NONE 0
#define DEALERSHIP_TYPE_STANDARD 1
#define DEALERSHIP_TYPE_IMPORT 2
#define DEALERSHIP_TYPE_LUXURY 3

new gDealerState[MAX_DEALERSHIPS];
new gDealerModel[MAX_DEALERSHIPS];
new gDealerPrice[MAX_DEALERSHIPS];
new gDealerVehicleId[MAX_DEALERSHIPS];
new gDealerName[MAX_DEALERSHIPS][32];
new gDealerCount = 0;

stock DealershipSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_DEALERSHIPS; i++)
    {
        gDealerState[i] = -1;
        gDealerModel[i] = 0;
        gDealerPrice[i] = 0;
        gDealerVehicleId[i] = -1;
        format(gDealerName[i], 32, "");
    }

    DealershipSystem_CreateListing(0, STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "LS Standard Autos", 400, 25000, DEALERSHIP_TYPE_STANDARD);
    DealershipSystem_CreateListing(1, STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "SF Import Center", 541, 32000, DEALERSHIP_TYPE_IMPORT);
    DealershipSystem_CreateListing(2, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "LV Luxury Motors", 562, 75000, DEALERSHIP_TYPE_LUXURY);

    print("[DEALER] Staatliche Autohäuser initialisiert");
}

stock DealershipSystem_CreateListing(dealerid, stateid, const name[], modelid, price, type)
{
    if (dealerid < 0 || dealerid >= MAX_DEALERSHIPS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!StateSystem_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gDealerState[dealerid] = stateid;
    gDealerModel[dealerid] = modelid;
    gDealerPrice[dealerid] = price;
    gDealerVehicleId[dealerid] = -1;
    format(gDealerName[dealerid], 32, "%s", name);
    gDealerCount++;

    return true;
}

stock DealershipSystem_BuyVehicle(playerid, dealerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (dealerid < 0 || dealerid >= MAX_DEALERSHIPS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new price = gDealerPrice[dealerid];
    new stateid = gDealerState[dealerid];
    if (GetPlayerMoney(playerid) < price)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[DEALER] Du hast nicht genug Geld für das Fahrzeug.");
        return false;
    }

    GivePlayerMoney(playerid, -price);
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, price);

    gDealerVehicleId[dealerid] = CreateVehicle(gDealerModel[dealerid], 0.0, 0.0, 5.0, 0.0, 1, 1, 600000);
    new msg[128];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[DEALER] Fahrzeug gekauft. Staatseinnahme: $%d | Fahrzeug-ID: %d", price, gDealerVehicleId[dealerid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, msg);
    return true;
}

stock int:DealershipSystem_GetDealerPrice(dealerid)
{
    if (dealerid < 0 || dealerid >= MAX_DEALERSHIPS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gDealerPrice[dealerid];
}

stock int:DealershipSystem_GetDealerState(dealerid)
{
    if (dealerid < 0 || dealerid >= MAX_DEALERSHIPS)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gDealerState[dealerid];
}

stock DealershipSystem_ShowCatalog(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[DEALER] Listings: %d | Staat: %d", gDealerCount, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFF66AA, msg);
}

#if !defined MARKET_SYSTEM_INC
#define MARKET_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_MARKET_ITEMS 12

new gMarketItemCount[STATE_COUNT];
new gMarketItemName[STATE_COUNT][MAX_MARKET_ITEMS][32];
new gMarketItemPrice[STATE_COUNT][MAX_MARKET_ITEMS];
new gMarketItemStock[STATE_COUNT][MAX_MARKET_ITEMS];

stock MarketSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new stateid = 0; stateid < STATE_COUNT; stateid++)
    {
        gMarketItemCount[stateid] = 0;
        for (new i = 0; i < MAX_MARKET_ITEMS; i++)
        {
            format(gMarketItemName[stateid][i], 32, "");
            gMarketItemPrice[stateid][i] = 0;
            gMarketItemStock[stateid][i] = 0;
        }
    }

    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Groceries", 250, 50);
    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Fuel Canister", 300, 30);
    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Repair Kit", 800, 12);

    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Electronics", 450, 20);
    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Construction Pack", 600, 18);
    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Medical Supply", 420, 25);

    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Luxury Goods", 700, 10);
    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Tourism Kit", 550, 22);
    MarketSystem_RegisterItem(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Casino Chips", 990, 15);

    print("[MARKET] State Market System initialisiert");
}

stock MarketSystem_RegisterItem(stateid, const name[], price, itemStock)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gMarketItemCount[stateid] >= MAX_MARKET_ITEMS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gMarketItemCount[stateid];
    format(gMarketItemName[stateid][idx], 32, "%s", name);
    gMarketItemPrice[stateid][idx] = price;
    gMarketItemStock[stateid][idx] = itemStock;
    gMarketItemCount[stateid]++;
    return true;
}

stock int:MarketSystem_GetItemPrice(stateid, index)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || index < 0 || index >= gMarketItemCount[stateid])
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gMarketItemPrice[stateid][index];
}

stock int:MarketSystem_GetItemStock(stateid, index)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || index < 0 || index >= gMarketItemCount[stateid])
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gMarketItemStock[stateid][index];
}

stock MarketSystem_BuyItem(playerid, stateid, itemIndex)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= gMarketItemCount[stateid])
    {
        return false;
    }

    new itemPrice = gMarketItemPrice[stateid][itemIndex];
    if (Core_GetPlayerBank(playerid) < itemPrice)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MARKET] Nicht genug Geld auf der Bank.");
        return false;
    }

    if (gMarketItemStock[stateid][itemIndex] <= 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[MARKET] Dieser Artikel ist momentan ausverkauft.");
        return false;
    }

    if (!Core_ChangePlayerBank(playerid, -itemPrice))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gMarketItemStock[stateid][itemIndex]--;
    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, itemPrice / 4);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[MARKET] Einkauf erfolgreich.");
    return true;
}

stock MarketSystem_ShowMarket(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[MARKET] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new message[256];
    format(message, sizeof(message), "[MARKET] %s Markt | Bank: $%d", stateName, Core_GetPlayerBank(playerid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, message);

    for (new i = 0; i < gMarketItemCount[stateid]; i++)
    {
        new itemText[128];
        format(itemText, sizeof(itemText), "[%d] %s | Preis: $%d | Lager: %d", i, gMarketItemName[stateid][i], gMarketItemPrice[stateid][i], gMarketItemStock[stateid][i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, itemText);
    }
}

stock int:StateBank_GetBalance(stateid)

    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {

    for (new i = 0; i < STATE_COUNT; i++)
    {
        gStateBudgetAlert[i] = 0;
        gStateBudgetLastTransfer[i] = 0;
    }
    print("[STATE_BUDGET] Staatliche Treasury- und Budget-Übersicht initialisiert");

stock StateBudgetSystem_Transfer(stateid, amount, const reason[], const actor[])
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || amount == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (!StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, amount))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gStateBudgetLastTransfer[stateid] = amount;
    if (StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid) < 50000)
    {
        gStateBudgetAlert[stateid] = 1;
    }
    else
    {
        gStateBudgetAlert[stateid] = 0;
    }

    return StateLedgerSystem_LogTransaction(stateid, (amount > 0) ? 1 : 4, amount, actor, reason);
}

    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))

        return 0;

    return gStateBudgetAlert[stateid];
}

    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gStateBudgetLastTransfer[stateid];
}

        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[STATE_BUDGET] Ungültiger Staat.");

    new stateName[32];
    new policy[32];
    new leader[32];

    StateSystem_GetPolicy(stateid, policy, sizeof(policy));
    StateSystem_GetLeaderName(stateid, leader, sizeof(leader));

    new msg[256];

    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);
}

        return false;

    new revenue = StateSystem_GetBankCash(stateid) * taxRate / 100;
    return StateTaxSystem_CollectRevenue(stateid, revenue);
}

DATEI: gamemodes/modules/emergency/dispatch_system.inc

#if !defined DISPATCH_SYSTEM_INC
#define DISPATCH_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_DISPATCH_CALLS 16
#define DISPATCH_PRIORITY_LOW 1
#define DISPATCH_PRIORITY_MEDIUM 2
#define DISPATCH_PRIORITY_HIGH 3

new gDispatchCallState[MAX_DISPATCH_CALLS];
new gDispatchCallActive[MAX_DISPATCH_CALLS];
new gDispatchCallPriority[MAX_DISPATCH_CALLS];
new gDispatchCallType[MAX_DISPATCH_CALLS][32];
new gDispatchCallCount = 0;

stock DispatchSystem_Initialize()
{
    gDispatchCallCount = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_DISPATCH_CALLS; i++)
    {
        gDispatchCallState[i] = -1;
        gDispatchCallActive[i] = 0;
        gDispatchCallPriority[i] = DISPATCH_PRIORITY_LOW;
        format(gDispatchCallType[i], 32, "");
    }

    DispatchSystem_CreateCall(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "Störung in der Innenstadt", DISPATCH_PRIORITY_MEDIUM);
    DispatchSystem_CreateCall(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Fahrzeugunfall am Hafen", DISPATCH_PRIORITY_HIGH);
    DispatchSystem_CreateCall(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Casino-Sicherung alarmiert", DISPATCH_PRIORITY_HIGH);

    print("[DISPATCH] Emergency Dispatch System initialisiert");
}

stock DispatchSystem_CreateCall(stateid, const callType[], priority)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gDispatchCallCount >= MAX_DISPATCH_CALLS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gDispatchCallCount;
    gDispatchCallState[idx] = stateid;
    gDispatchCallActive[idx] = 1;
    gDispatchCallPriority[idx] = priority;
    format(gDispatchCallType[idx], 32, "%s", callType);
    gDispatchCallCount++;
    return true;
}

stock DispatchSystem_ShowQueue(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[DISPATCH] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[DISPATCH] %s Dispatch Queue | %d offene Anrufe", stateName, gDispatchCallCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gDispatchCallCount; i++)
    {
        if (gDispatchCallState[i] != stateid || gDispatchCallActive[i] == 0)
        {
            continue;
        }

        new entry[128];
        format(entry, sizeof(entry), "[%d] %s | Prioritaet: %d", i, gDispatchCallType[i], gDispatchCallPriority[i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, entry);
    }
}

stock DispatchSystem_AcceptCall(playerid, callIndex)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS || callIndex < 0 || callIndex >= gDispatchCallCount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gDispatchCallState[callIndex] != StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[DISPATCH] Dieser Einsatz liegt nicht in deinem Staat.");
        return false;
    }

    if (gDispatchCallActive[callIndex] == 0)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[DISPATCH] Einsatz bereits angenommen.");
        return false;
    }

    gDispatchCallActive[callIndex] = 0;
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[DISPATCH] Einsatz erfolgreich angenommen und bearbeitet.");
    return true;
}

stock DispatchSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
    {
        return false;
    }

    new cmd[32], idx;
    idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/dispatch", true) == 0)
    {
        DispatchSystem_ShowQueue(playerid, StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/acceptcall", true) == 0)
    {
        new callid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", cmd, callid) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[DISPATCH] Syntax: /acceptcall <ID>");
            return true;
        }

        DispatchSystem_AcceptCall(playerid, callid);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#endif

stock EmergencySystem_Initialize()
{
    gEmergencyStationCount = 0;

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++)
    {
        gEmergencyRole[i] = EMERGENCY_ROLE_NONE;
        gEmergencyState[i] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    EmergencySystem_RegisterStation(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "LSPD HQ", 1535.0, -1675.0, 13.0);
    EmergencySystem_RegisterStation(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, "LS EMS", 1184.0, -1323.0, 14.0);
    EmergencySystem_RegisterStation(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "SF Police", -1930.0, 289.0, 35.0);
    EmergencySystem_RegisterStation(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "SF EMS", -2025.0, 142.0, 28.0);
    EmergencySystem_RegisterStation(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "LV Police", 1668.0, 1447.0, 10.0);
    EmergencySystem_RegisterStation(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "LV EMS", 1418.0, 1308.0, 12.0);

    print("[EMERGENCY] Polizei- und EMS-System initialisiert");
}

stock EmergencySystem_RegisterStation(stateid, const name[], Float:x, Float:y, Float:z)
{
    if (gEmergencyStationCount >= MAX_EMERGENCY_STATIONS)
        return false;
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
        return false;

    gEmergencyStationState[gEmergencyStationCount] = stateid;
    format(gEmergencyStationName[gEmergencyStationCount], 32, "%s", name);
    gEmergencyStationX[gEmergencyStationCount] = x;
    gEmergencyStationY[gEmergencyStationCount] = y;
    gEmergencyStationZ[gEmergencyStationCount] = z;
    gEmergencyStationCount++;
    return true;
}

stock EmergencySystem_OnPlayerConnect(playerid)
{
    gEmergencyRole[playerid] = EMERGENCY_ROLE_NONE;
    gEmergencyState[playerid] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
}

stock EmergencySystem_SetRole(playerid, role, stateid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return;
    if (role < EMERGENCY_ROLE_NONE || role > EMERGENCY_ROLE_EMS)
        return;

    gEmergencyRole[playerid] = role;
    if (Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        gEmergencyState[playerid] = stateid;
    }
}

stock int:EmergencySystem_GetRole(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return EMERGENCY_ROLE_NONE;
    return gEmergencyRole[playerid];
}

stock EmergencySystem_HealPlayer(playerid, targetid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS || targetid < 0 || targetid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
        return;

    SetPlayerHealth(targetid, 100.0);
    SetPlayerArmour(targetid, 50.0);
    SendClientMessage(targetid, 0x00FF00AA, "[EMS] Du wurdest behandelt und stabilisiert.");
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[EMS] Behandlung wurde erfolgreich ausgeführt.");
}

stock EmergencySystem_ShowStations(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[EMERGENCY] Verfügbare Einsatzstationen: %d", gEmergencyStationCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x66CCFFAA, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gEmergencyStationCount; i++)
    {
        new stationMsg[128];
        format(stationMsg, sizeof(stationMsg), "%s | Staat %d | Pos: %.0f %.0f %.0f", gEmergencyStationName[i], gEmergencyStationState[i], gEmergencyStationX[i], gEmergencyStationY[i], gEmergencyStationZ[i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, stationMsg);
    }
}

stock EmergencySystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
        return false;

    new cmd[32], idx;
    idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
        return false;

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/ems", true) == 0)
    {
        if (gEmergencyRole[playerid] != EMERGENCY_ROLE_EMS)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[EMS] Du bist kein EMS-Mitarbeiter.");
            return true;
        }

        new target;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", cmd, target) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[EMS] Syntax: /ems <PlayerID>");
            return true;
        }

        EmergencySystem_HealPlayer(playerid, target);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/police", true) == 0)
    {
        if (gEmergencyRole[playerid] != EMERGENCY_ROLE_POLICE)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[POLICE] Du bist kein Polizeibeamter.");
            return true;
        }

        new msg[128];
        format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[POLICE] Staat: %d | Bereitschaft: %d | Wanted-Status aktiv", gEmergencyState[playerid], StateSystem_GetPlayerState(playerid));
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00A6FFAA, msg);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/stations", true) == 0)
    {
        EmergencySystem_ShowStations(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#if !defined STATE_EVENT_SYSTEM_INC
#define STATE_EVENT_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_STATE_EVENTS 10
#define EVENT_TYPE_NONE 0
#define EVENT_TYPE_FESTIVAL 1
#define EVENT_TYPE_POLICE_SWEEP 2
#define EVENT_TYPE_GANG_TENSION 3
#define EVENT_TYPE_ECONOMY 4

new gStateEventCount = 0;
new gStateEventType[MAX_STATE_EVENTS];
new gStateEventState[MAX_STATE_EVENTS];
new gStateEventActive[MAX_STATE_EVENTS];
new gStateEventMinutes[MAX_STATE_EVENTS];
new gStateEventText[MAX_STATE_EVENTS][64];

stock StateEventSystem_Initialize()
{
    gStateEventCount = 0;

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_STATE_EVENTS; i++)
    {
        gStateEventType[i] = EVENT_TYPE_NONE;
        gStateEventState[i] = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
        gStateEventActive[i] = 0;
        gStateEventMinutes[i] = 0;
        gStateEventText[i][0] = 0;
    }

    StateEventSystem_RegisterEvent(STATE_LOS_SANTOS, EVENT_TYPE_FESTIVAL, 45, "Beach Festival – Los Santos");
    StateEventSystem_RegisterEvent(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, EVENT_TYPE_ECONOMY, 35, "Staatsbudget-Sitzung – San Fierro");
    StateEventSystem_RegisterEvent(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, EVENT_TYPE_GANG_TENSION, 60, "Gang-Konflikt – Las Venturas");

    print("[STATE_EVENT] Staatliche Event- und Newslogik initialisiert");
}

stock StateEventSystem_RegisterEvent(stateid, type, minutes, const text[])
{
    if (gStateEventCount >= MAX_STATE_EVENTS)
        return false;
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
        return false;
    if (type < EVENT_TYPE_NONE || type > EVENT_TYPE_ECONOMY)
        return false;

    gStateEventState[gStateEventCount] = stateid;
    gStateEventType[gStateEventCount] = type;
    gStateEventActive[gStateEventCount] = 1;
    gStateEventMinutes[gStateEventCount] = minutes;
    format(gStateEventText[gStateEventCount], 64, "%s", text);
    gStateEventCount++;
    return true;
}

stock StateEventSystem_ToggleForState(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
        return;

    for (new i = 0; i < gStateEventCount; i++)
    {
        if (gStateEventState[i] == stateid)
        {
            gStateEventActive[i] = 1 - gStateEventActive[i];
        }
    }
}

stock StateEventSystem_ShowEvents(playerid)
{
    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[EVENTS] Laufende Staatsevents: %d", gStateEventCount);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFD700AA, msg);

    for (new i = 0; i < gStateEventCount; i++)
    {
        if (gStateEventActive[i] == 1)
        {
            new eventMsg[128];
            format(eventMsg, sizeof(eventMsg), "%s | Staat %d | Typ %d | %d min", gStateEventText[i], gStateEventState[i], gStateEventType[i], gStateEventMinutes[i]);
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, eventMsg);
        }
    }
}

stock StateEventSystem_HandleCommand(playerid, const cmdtext[])
{
    if (cmdtext[0] != '/')
        return false;

    new cmd[32], idx;
    idx = sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]", cmd);
    if (idx == 0)
        return false;

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/events", true) == 0)
    {
        StateEventSystem_ShowEvents(playerid);
        return true;
    }

    if (strcmp(cmd, "/eventtoggle", true) == 0)
    {
        if (!AdminSystem_IsModerator(playerid))
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[EVENTS] Kein Adminzugriff.");
            return true;
        }

        new stateid;
        if (sscanf(cmdtext, "s[32]d", cmd, stateid) != 0)
        {
            SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[EVENTS] Syntax: /eventtoggle <StateID>");
            return true;
        }

        StateEventSystem_ToggleForState(stateid);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[EVENTS] Eventzustand gewechselt.");
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

#define FACTION_SYSTEM_INC

#define MAX_FACTION_MEMBERS 32

new gFactionOwner[MAX_FACTIONS];
new gFactionType[MAX_FACTIONS];
new gFactionRank[MAX_PLAYERS];
new gFactionBalance[MAX_FACTIONS];
new gFactionMemberCount[MAX_FACTIONS];
new gFactionMemberList[MAX_FACTIONS][MAX_FACTION_MEMBERS];
new gFactionName[MAX_FACTIONS][32];
new gFactionLeader[MAX_FACTIONS];

stock FactionSystem_Initialize()

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_FACTIONS; i++)
    {
        gFactionState[i] = -1;
        gFactionOwner[i] = -1;
        gFactionLeader[i] = -1;
        gFactionType[i] = FACTION_TYPE_NONE;
        gFactionBalance[i] = 0;
        gFactionMemberCount[i] = 0;
        gFactionIsActive[i] = 0;
        for (new j = 0; j < MAX_FACTION_MEMBERS; j++)
        {
            gFactionMemberList[i][j] = -1;
        }
        format(gFactionName[i], 32, "Unbenannt");
        format(gFactionTag[i], 8, "N/A");
    }

    FactionSystem_CreateFaction(0, 0, FACTION_TYPE_GANG, -1, "Vatos Locos");
    FactionSystem_CreateFaction(1, 1, FACTION_TYPE_GANG, -1, "San Fierro Syndicate");
    FactionSystem_CreateFaction(2, 2, FACTION_TYPE_LEGAL, -1, "Las Venturas Union");
    FactionSystem_CreateFaction(3, 0, FACTION_TYPE_STATE, -1, "Los Santos PD");
    FactionSystem_CreateFaction(4, 1, FACTION_TYPE_STATE, -1, "San Fierro FD");
    FactionSystem_CreateFaction(5, 2, FACTION_TYPE_EMERGENCY, -1, "LV EMS");

    format(gFactionTag[0], 8, "VLC");
    format(gFactionTag[1], 8, "SFS");
    format(gFactionTag[2], 8, "LVU");
    format(gFactionTag[3], 8, "LSPD");
    format(gFactionTag[4], 8, "SFFD");
    format(gFactionTag[5], 8, "LVEMS");

    gFactionIsActive[0] = 1;
    gFactionIsActive[1] = 1;
    gFactionIsActive[2] = 1;
    gFactionIsActive[3] = 1;
    gFactionIsActive[4] = 1;
    gFactionIsActive[5] = 1;

    FactionSystem_TransferToBalance(0, 15000);
    FactionSystem_TransferToBalance(1, 12000);
    FactionSystem_TransferToBalance(2, 18000);

    print("[FACTION] Fraktions- und Gangsystem initialisiert");
}

stock FactionSystem_CreateFaction(factionid, stateid, type, ownerid, const name[])
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    gFactionState[factionid] = stateid;
    gFactionOwner[factionid] = ownerid;
    gFactionLeader[factionid] = ownerid;
    gFactionType[factionid] = type;
    gFactionIsActive[factionid] = 1;
    format(gFactionName[factionid], 32, "%s", name);
    format(gFactionTag[factionid], 8, "FRCT");
    format(gFactionRankName[factionid], 32, "Mitglied");
    gFactionBalance[factionid] = 25000;
    gFactionMemberCount[factionid] = 0;
    return true;
}

stock FactionSystem_JoinFaction(playerid, factionid, rank)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gFactionIsActive[factionid] != 1)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (!Core_IsValidState(gFactionState[factionid]))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gFactionMemberCount[factionid] >= MAX_FACTION_MEMBERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_FACTION_MEMBERS; i++)
    {
        if (gFactionMemberList[factionid][i] == playerid)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    gFactionMemberList[factionid][gFactionMemberCount[factionid]] = playerid;
    gFactionMemberCount[factionid]++;
    gFactionRank[playerid] = rank;

    if (rank >= 5)
    {
        gFactionLeader[factionid] = playerid;
    }

    if (Core_IsValidState(Core_GetPlayerState(playerid)) && Core_GetPlayerState(playerid) != gFactionState[factionid])
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC00AA, "[FACTION] Hinweis: Du bist in einem anderen Staat aktiv.");
    }

    new factionName[32];
    format(factionName, sizeof(factionName), "%s", gFactionName[factionid]);
    printf("[FACTION] %d tritt %s bei (Rang: %d)", playerid, factionName, rank);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, "[FACTION] Fraktion/Clan beigetreten.");
    return true;
}

stock FactionSystem_SetRankName(factionid, const rankName[])
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return;
    }
    format(gFactionRankName[factionid], 32, "%s", rankName);
}

stock int:FactionSystem_GetMemberState(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_FACTIONS; i++)
    {
        if (FactionSystem_IsPlayerMember(playerid, i))
        {
            return gFactionState[i];
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

stock FactionSystem_IsPlayerMember(playerid, factionid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_FACTION_MEMBERS; i++)
    {
        if (gFactionMemberList[factionid][i] == playerid)
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock FactionSystem_SetLeader(factionid, playerid)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gFactionLeader[factionid] = playerid;
    gFactionOwner[factionid] = playerid;
    gFactionRank[playerid] = 5;
    return true;
}

stock FactionSystem_RemoveMember(playerid, factionid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_FACTION_MEMBERS; i++)
    {
        if (gFactionMemberList[factionid][i] == playerid)
        {
            gFactionMemberList[factionid][i] = -1;
            gFactionMemberCount[factionid] = max(0, gFactionMemberCount[factionid] - 1);
            if (gFactionRank[playerid] > 0)
            {
                gFactionRank[playerid] = 0;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

stock int:FactionSystem_GetState(factionid)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gFactionState[factionid];
}

stock int:FactionSystem_GetRank(playerid)
{
    if (playerid < 0 || playerid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gFactionRank[playerid];
}

stock int:FactionSystem_GetBalance(factionid)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gFactionBalance[factionid];
}

stock FactionSystem_TransferToBalance(factionid, amount)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gFactionBalance[factionid] += amount;
    if (gFactionState[factionid] >= 0)
    {
        new treasuryShare = amount / 10;
        if (treasuryShare > 0)
        {
            StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(gFactionState[factionid], treasuryShare);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

stock FactionSystem_DeductFromBalance(factionid, amount)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (amount < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gFactionBalance[factionid] < amount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gFactionBalance[factionid] -= amount;
    return true;
}

stock int:FactionSystem_GetMemberCount(factionid)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return 0;
    }
    return gFactionMemberCount[factionid];
}

stock int:FactionSystem_GetLeader(factionid)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return -1;
    }
    return gFactionLeader[factionid];
}

stock FactionSystem_ShowInfo(playerid, factionid)
{
    if (factionid < 0 || factionid >= MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        return;
    }

    new msg[256];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[FACTION] %s [%s] | Staat: %d | Typ: %d | Kasse: %d | Mitglieder: %d | Leiter: %d", gFactionName[factionid], gFactionTag[factionid], gFactionState[factionid], gFactionType[factionid], gFactionBalance[factionid], gFactionMemberCount[factionid], gFactionLeader[factionid]);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF66CCAA, msg);
}

#if !defined GANG_FIGHT_SYSTEM_INC
#define GANG_FIGHT_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

#define MAX_GANG_FIGHTS 6
#define GANG_FIGHT_NONE 0
#define GANG_FIGHT_ACTIVE 1

new gGangFightActive[MAX_GANG_FIGHTS];
new gGangFightState[MAX_GANG_FIGHTS];
new gGangFightA[MAX_GANG_FIGHTS];
new gGangFightB[MAX_GANG_FIGHTS];
new gGangFightTimer[MAX_GANG_FIGHTS];
new gGangFightScoreA[MAX_GANG_FIGHTS];
new gGangFightScoreB[MAX_GANG_FIGHTS];
new Text:gGangFightTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];

stock GangFightSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS; i++)
    {
        gGangFightActive[i] = GANG_FIGHT_NONE;
        gGangFightState[i] = -1;
        gGangFightA[i] = -1;
        gGangFightB[i] = -1;
        gGangFightTimer[i] = 0;
        gGangFightScoreA[i] = 0;
        gGangFightScoreB[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[GANG_FIGHT] Gangfight-System initialisiert");
    Core_MarkModuleReady("factions");
}

// Erste aktive Auseinandersetzung eines Staates oder -1.
stock int:GangFightSystem_GetActiveFightForState(stateid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS; i++)
    {
        if (gGangFightActive[i] == GANG_FIGHT_ACTIVE && gGangFightState[i] == stateid)
        {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

stock int:GangFightSystem_GetFactionA(fightid)
{
    return (fightid >= 0 && fightid < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS) ? gGangFightA[fightid] : -1;
}

stock int:GangFightSystem_GetFactionB(fightid)
{
    return (fightid >= 0 && fightid < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS) ? gGangFightB[fightid] : -1;
}

stock int:GangFightSystem_GetScoreA(fightid)
{
    return (fightid >= 0 && fightid < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS) ? gGangFightScoreA[fightid] : 0;
}

stock int:GangFightSystem_GetScoreB(fightid)
{
    return (fightid >= 0 && fightid < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS) ? gGangFightScoreB[fightid] : 0;
}

stock int:GangFightSystem_GetTimeLeft(fightid)
{
    return (fightid >= 0 && fightid < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS) ? gGangFightTimer[fightid] : 0;
}

stock GangFightSystem_StartFight(stateid, factionA, factionB)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }

    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS; i++)
    {
        if (gGangFightActive[i] == GANG_FIGHT_NONE)
        {
            gGangFightActive[i] = GANG_FIGHT_ACTIVE;
            gGangFightState[i] = stateid;
            gGangFightA[i] = factionA;
            gGangFightB[i] = factionB;
            gGangFightTimer[i] = 180;
            gGangFightScoreA[i] = 0;
            gGangFightScoreB[i] = 0;
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

stock GangFightSystem_ResolveFight(fightid, winnerFactionId)
{
    if (fightid < 0 || fightid >= MAX_GANG_FIGHTS)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gGangFightActive[fightid] != GANG_FIGHT_ACTIVE)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (winnerFactionId != gGangFightA[fightid] && winnerFactionId != gGangFightB[fightid])
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (winnerFactionId >= 0 && winnerFactionId < MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        FactionSystem_TransferToBalance(winnerFactionId, 8000);
        new winState = FactionSystem_GetState(winnerFactionId);
        if (Core_IsValidState(winState))
        {
            StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(winState, 2000);
        }
    }

    gGangFightActive[fightid] = GANG_FIGHT_NONE;
    gGangFightState[fightid] = -1;
    gGangFightA[fightid] = -1;
    gGangFightB[fightid] = -1;
    gGangFightTimer[fightid] = 0;
    gGangFightScoreA[fightid] = 0;
    gGangFightScoreB[fightid] = 0;
    return true;
}

stock GangFightSystem_AddScore(fightid, factionid, points)
{
    if (fightid < 0 || fightid >= MAX_GANG_FIGHTS)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (gGangFightActive[fightid] != GANG_FIGHT_ACTIVE)
    {
        return;
    }

    if (factionid == gGangFightA[fightid])
    {
        gGangFightScoreA[fightid] += points;
    }
    else if (factionid == gGangFightB[fightid])
    {
        gGangFightScoreB[fightid] += points;
    }

    if (gGangFightScoreA[fightid] >= 6 || gGangFightScoreB[fightid] >= 6)
    {
        if (gGangFightScoreA[fightid] > gGangFightScoreB[fightid])
        {
            GangFightSystem_ResolveFight(fightid, gGangFightA[fightid]);
        }
        else if (gGangFightScoreB[fightid] > gGangFightScoreA[fightid])
        {
            GangFightSystem_ResolveFight(fightid, gGangFightB[fightid]);
        }
    }
}

stock GangFightSystem_Tick()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < MAX_GANG_FIGHTS; i++)
    {
        if (gGangFightActive[i] == GANG_FIGHT_ACTIVE)
        {
            if (gGangFightTimer[i] > 0)
            {
                gGangFightTimer[i]--;
            }
            else
            {
                gGangFightActive[i] = GANG_FIGHT_NONE;
                gGangFightState[i] = -1;
                gGangFightA[i] = -1;
                gGangFightB[i] = -1;
            }
        }
    }
}

stock GangFightSystem_ShowStatus(playerid)
{
    GangFightSystem_HideStatus(playerid);

    new fightid = GangFightSystem_GetActiveFightForState(Core_GetPlayerState(playerid));
    if (fightid == -1)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[GANG_FIGHT] In deinem Staat läuft aktuell kein Gangfight.");
        return;
    }
    gGangFightTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 30.0, "GANGFIGHT HUD");
    TextDrawAlignment(gGangFightTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gGangFightTD[playerid][0], 0.50, 1.4);
    TextDrawColor(gGangFightTD[playerid][0], 0xFF3333AA);

    new fightText[128];
    format(fightText, sizeof(fightText), "A:%d vs B:%d | Time:%d", gGangFightA[fightid], gGangFightB[fightid], gGangFightTimer[fightid]);
    gGangFightTD[playerid][1] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 58.0, fightText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gGangFightTD[playerid][1], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gGangFightTD[playerid][1], 0.22, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gGangFightTD[playerid][1], 0xFFFFFFFF);

    new scoreText[128];
    format(scoreText, sizeof(scoreText), "Score: %d:%d", gGangFightScoreA[fightid], gGangFightScoreB[fightid]);
    gGangFightTD[playerid][2] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 82.0, scoreText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gGangFightTD[playerid][2], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gGangFightTD[playerid][2], 0.22, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gGangFightTD[playerid][2], 0xFFFF00FF);

    for (new i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    {
        TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gGangFightTD[playerid][i]);
    }
}

stock GangFightSystem_HideStatus(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gGangFightTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gGangFightTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gGangFightTD[playerid][i]);
            gGangFightTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

#endif

#if !defined GANGWAR_SYSTEM_INC
#define GANGWAR_SYSTEM_INC

#include <a_samp>

new gGangWarEnabled = 1;
new gGangWarActive[3];
new gGangWarFactionA[3];
new gGangWarFactionB[3];
new gGangWarScoreA[3];
new gGangWarScoreB[3];
new Text:gGangWarTD[MAX_PLAYERS][8];

stock GangWarSystem_Initialize()
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    {
        gGangWarActive[i] = 0;
        gGangWarFactionA[i] = -1;
        gGangWarFactionB[i] = -1;
        gGangWarScoreA[i] = 0;
        gGangWarScoreB[i] = 0;
    }

    print("[GANGWAR] Gangwar-System initialisiert");
    Core_MarkModuleReady("factions");
}

stock GangWarSystem_IsActive(stateid)
{
    return Core_IsValidState(stateid) && gGangWarActive[stateid] == 1;
}

stock int:GangWarSystem_GetFactionA(stateid)
{
    return Core_IsValidState(stateid) ? gGangWarFactionA[stateid] : -1;
}

stock int:GangWarSystem_GetFactionB(stateid)
{
    return Core_IsValidState(stateid) ? gGangWarFactionB[stateid] : -1;
}

stock int:GangWarSystem_GetScoreA(stateid)
{
    return Core_IsValidState(stateid) ? gGangWarScoreA[stateid] : 0;
}

stock int:GangWarSystem_GetScoreB(stateid)
{
    return Core_IsValidState(stateid) ? gGangWarScoreB[stateid] : 0;
}

stock GangWarSystem_Toggle()
{
    gGangWarEnabled = 1 - gGangWarEnabled;
}

stock GangWarSystem_StartWar(stateid, factionA, factionB)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gGangWarEnabled != 1)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (factionA < 0 || factionB < 0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (factionA == factionB)
    {
        return false;
    }

    gGangWarActive[stateid] = 1;
    gGangWarFactionA[stateid] = factionA;
    gGangWarFactionB[stateid] = factionB;
    gGangWarScoreA[stateid] = 0;
    gGangWarScoreB[stateid] = 0;
    return true;
}

stock GangWarSystem_EndWar(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }

    gGangWarActive[stateid] = 0;
    gGangWarFactionA[stateid] = -1;
    gGangWarFactionB[stateid] = -1;
    gGangWarScoreA[stateid] = 0;
    gGangWarScoreB[stateid] = 0;
}

stock GangWarSystem_ResolveWar(stateid, winnerFactionId)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (gGangWarActive[stateid] != 1)
    {
        return false;
    }
    if (winnerFactionId != gGangWarFactionA[stateid] && winnerFactionId != gGangWarFactionB[stateid])
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (winnerFactionId >= 0 && winnerFactionId < MAX_FACTIONS)
    {
        FactionSystem_TransferToBalance(winnerFactionId, 15000);
        new winState = FactionSystem_GetState(winnerFactionId);
        if (Core_IsValidState(winState))
        {
            StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(winState, 5000);
        }
    }

    StateSystem_ApplyTreasuryDelta(stateid, 2500);
    GangWarSystem_EndWar(stateid);
    return true;
}

stock GangWarSystem_AddScore(stateid, factionid, points)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return;
    }
    if (gGangWarActive[stateid] != 1)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (factionid == gGangWarFactionA[stateid])
    {
        gGangWarScoreA[stateid] += points;
    }
    else if (factionid == gGangWarFactionB[stateid])
    {
        gGangWarScoreB[stateid] += points;
    }

    if (gGangWarScoreA[stateid] >= 10 || gGangWarScoreB[stateid] >= 10)
    {
        if (gGangWarScoreA[stateid] > gGangWarScoreB[stateid])
        {
            GangWarSystem_ResolveWar(stateid, gGangWarFactionA[stateid]);
        }
        else if (gGangWarScoreB[stateid] > gGangWarScoreA[stateid])
        {
            GangWarSystem_ResolveWar(stateid, gGangWarFactionB[stateid]);
        }
    }
}

stock GangWarSystem_ShowStatus(playerid)
{
    GangWarSystem_HideStatus(playerid);

    new stateid = Core_GetPlayerState(playerid);
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        stateid = STATE_LOS_SANTOS;
    }

    gGangWarTD[playerid][0] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 35.0, "GANGWAR STATUS");
    TextDrawAlignment(gGangWarTD[playerid][0], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gGangWarTD[playerid][0], 0.55, 1.5);
    TextDrawColor(gGangWarTD[playerid][0], 0xFF0000FF);

    new warText[128];
    format(warText, sizeof(warText), "Aktiv: %s | Phase: %d", (gGangWarEnabled == 1) ? ("Ja") : ("Nein"), gGangWarActive[stateid]);
    gGangWarTD[playerid][1] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 60.0, warText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gGangWarTD[playerid][1], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gGangWarTD[playerid][1], 0.22, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gGangWarTD[playerid][1], 0xFFFFFFFF);

    new factionText[128];
    format(factionText, sizeof(factionText), "A: %d | B: %d | Punkte: %d:%d", gGangWarFactionA[stateid], gGangWarFactionB[stateid], gGangWarScoreA[stateid], gGangWarScoreB[stateid]);
    gGangWarTD[playerid][2] = TextDrawCreate(320.0, 84.0, factionText);
    TextDrawAlignment(gGangWarTD[playerid][2], 2);
    TextDrawLetterSize(gGangWarTD[playerid][2], 0.22, 1.0);
    TextDrawColor(gGangWarTD[playerid][2], 0xFFFF00FF);

    for (new i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    {
        TextDrawShowForPlayer(playerid, gGangWarTD[playerid][i]);
    }
}

stock GangWarSystem_HideStatus(playerid)
{
    for (new i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        if (gGangWarTD[playerid][i] != Text:0)
        {
            TextDrawHideForPlayer(playerid, gGangWarTD[playerid][i]);
            TextDrawDestroy(gGangWarTD[playerid][i]);
            gGangWarTD[playerid][i] = Text:0;
        }
    }
}

#endif
