    TerritorySystem_RegisterTerritory(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Bayview District", TERRITORY_TYPE_RESIDENTIAL, 310000, STATE_SAN_FIERRO);
    TerritorySystem_RegisterTerritory(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "Airport Logistics", TERRITORY_TYPE_INDUSTRIAL, 470000, STATE_SAN_FIERRO);
    TerritorySystem_RegisterTerritory(STATE_SAN_FIERRO, "City Center", TERRITORY_TYPE_COMMERCIAL, 420000, STATE_SAN_FIERRO);

    TerritorySystem_RegisterTerritory(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "The Strip", TERRITORY_TYPE_COMMERCIAL, 620000, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS);
    TerritorySystem_RegisterTerritory(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Marina Plaza", TERRITORY_TYPE_RECREATIONAL, 360000, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS);
    TerritorySystem_RegisterTerritory(STATE_LAS_VENTURAS, "Old Town", TERRITORY_TYPE_RESIDENTIAL, 340000, STATE_LAS_VENTURAS);

    print("[TERRITORY] Territorien, Districts und Einflusszonen initialisiert");
    Core_MarkModuleReady("world");
}

stock TerritorySystem_RegisterTerritory(stateid, const name[], type, value, controller)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid) || gTerritoryCount >= MAX_TERRITORIES)
    {
        return false;
    }

    new idx = gTerritoryCount;
    gTerritoryState[idx] = stateid;
    gTerritoryType[idx] = type;
    gTerritoryControl[idx] = controller;
    gTerritoryValue[idx] = value;
    format(gTerritoryName[idx], 40, "%s", name);
    gTerritoryCount++;
    return true;
}

stock int:TerritorySystem_GetTotalCount()
{
    return gTerritoryCount;
}

// Liefert die n-te (0-basiert) Territoriums-ID, deren Gebiet im Staat liegt, oder -1.
stock int:TerritorySystem_GetNthForState(stateid, nth)
{
    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < gTerritoryCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTerritoryState[i] == stateid)
        {
            if (count == nth)
            {
                return i;
            }
            count++;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

stock TerritorySystem_GetName(territoryId, output[], len)
{
    if (territoryId < 0 || territoryId >= gTerritoryCount)
    {
        format(output, len, "Unbekannt");
        return;
    }
    format(output, len, "%s", gTerritoryName[territoryId]);
}

stock int:TerritorySystem_GetControl(territoryId)
{
    return (territoryId >= 0 && territoryId < gTerritoryCount) ? gTerritoryControl[territoryId] : -1;
}

stock int:TerritorySystem_GetValue(territoryId)
{
    return (territoryId >= 0 && territoryId < gTerritoryCount) ? gTerritoryValue[territoryId] : 0;
}

stock int:TerritorySystem_GetType(territoryId)
{
    return (territoryId >= 0 && territoryId < gTerritoryCount) ? gTerritoryType[territoryId] : 0;
}

stock int:TerritorySystem_GetControlCount(controlState)
{
    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < gTerritoryCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTerritoryControl[i] == controlState)
        {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

stock int:TerritorySystem_GetCountForState(stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        return 0;
    }

    new count = 0;
    for (new i = 0; i < gTerritoryCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTerritoryState[i] == stateid)
        {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

stock TerritorySystem_ShowTerritories(playerid, stateid)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidState(stateid))
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFF0000AA, "[TERRITORY] Ungültiger Staat.");
        return;
    }

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(stateid, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new message[256];
    format(message, sizeof(message), "[TERRITORY] %s | Bezirke: %d", stateName, TerritorySystem_GetCountForState(stateid));
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00D9FFFF, message);

    for (new i = 0; i < gTerritoryCount; i++)
    {
        if (gTerritoryState[i] != stateid)
        {
            continue;
        }

        new line[160];
        format(line, sizeof(line), "- %s | Typ: %d | Wert: $%d | Kontrolle: %d", gTerritoryName[i], gTerritoryType[i], gTerritoryValue[i], gTerritoryControl[i]);
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFFFFFFF, line);
    }
}

stock TerritorySystem_ClaimTerritory(playerid, territoryId, newState)
{
    if (!Core_IsValidPlayerId(playerid) || !Core_IsValidState(newState))
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (territoryId < 0 || territoryId >= gTerritoryCount)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if (gTerritoryControl[territoryId] == newState)
    {
        SendClientMessage(playerid, 0xFFCC66AA, "[TERRITORY] Dieses Territorium gehört bereits diesem Staat.");
        return false;
    }

    gTerritoryState[territoryId] = newState;
    gTerritoryControl[territoryId] = newState;
    gTerritoryValue[territoryId] += 25000;

    new stateName[32];
    StateSystem_GetStateName(newState, stateName, sizeof(stateName));
    new msg[160];
    format(msg, sizeof(msg), "[TERRITORY] %s übernommen. Einflussbereich für %s erweitert.", gTerritoryName[territoryId], stateName);
    SendClientMessage(playerid, 0x00FF00AA, msg);
    return true;
}

# Debug- und Wartungswerkzeuge

Dieses Verzeichnis enthält Python 3 basierte Hilfswerkzeuge zur Fehleranalyse, Log-Überwachung und Server-Konfigurationsprüfung für den GTA:SA-Reallife-Modus.

## Verfügbare Tools

- `log_tail.py` – Live-Verfolgung von Server-/Plugin-Logs
- `analyze_logs.py` – automatische Analyse von Logdateien nach Fehlern, Warnungen und wiederkehrenden Problemen
- `validate_server_cfg.py` – prüft `server.cfg` und `sql.cfg` auf typische Konfigurationsfehler
- `autorun.py` – startet den Server, überwacht Logs und sammelt Fehlerstatus in einer Zusammenfassung

## Beispiele

Log-Datei live ansehen:

```bash
python3 tools/log_tail.py --log ./logs/server.log
```

Log-Dateien analysieren:

```bash
python3 tools/analyze_logs.py ./logs/server.log
python3 tools/analyze_logs.py .
```

Server-Konfiguration prüfen:

```bash
python3 tools/validate_server_cfg.py --root .
python3 tools/validate_server_cfg.py --root . --fix
```

Server starten mit Log-Überwachung:

```bash
python3 tools/autorun.py --root . --server-bin ./samp03svr --log ./logs/server.log
```

## Empfehlungen

- Logs immer in einem eigenen Ordner wie `logs/` sammeln
- `server.log` und `server-console.log` getrennt halten
- vor dem Live-Deploy die Konfigurationsprüfung laufen lassen
- bei Fehlern zuerst `analyze_logs.py` und dann gezielt `log_tail.py` nutzen

## Hinweis

Diese Hilfswerkzeuge sind keine Plattform- oder Hosting-Umstellung. Sie sind bewusst als lokales Debug- und Wartungs-Tooling im Projekt selbst verankert, damit man ohne Wechsel zu externen Plattformen schnell auf Fehler und Konfigurationsprobleme reagieren kann.


================================================================================
DATEI: tools/analyze_logs.py
================================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

ERROR_KEYWORDS = [
    "error",
    "failed",
    "fatal",
    "critical",
    "exception",
    "panic",
    "unable",
    "not found",
    "missing",
    "invalid",
    "could not",
    "assert",
]

PATTERN_CLASSES = {
    "plugin_error": re.compile(r"(plugin|plugins?)\s+.*(failed|error|not found|missing|load)", re.I),
    "mysql_error": re.compile(r"(mysql|sql)\s+.*(error|failed|timeout|connect|refused)", re.I),
    "pawn_error": re.compile(r"(pawn|script|gamemode|include)\s+.*(error|failed|compile|missing|not found)", re.I),
    "server_error": re.compile(r"(fatal|critical|exception|panic|assert|segmentation|access violation)", re.I),
    "file_error": re.compile(r"(cannot|can't|unable|missing|not found)\s+(open|read|write|load)\s+.*(file|config|log|script)", re.I),
    "network_error": re.compile(r"(connect|bind|listen|socket|port|address)\s+.*(failed|error|refused|in use)", re.I),
}


def iter_log_files(root: Path):
    search_roots = [root, root / "logs", root / "log"]
    files = []
    for folder in search_roots:
        if folder.exists():
            files.extend(folder.rglob("*.log"))
            files.extend(folder.rglob("*.txt"))

    for path in root.glob("*.log"):
        files.append(path)
    for path in root.glob("*.txt"):
        if "log" in path.name.lower() or "server" in path.name.lower():
            files.append(path)

    unique = []
    seen = set()
    for item in files:
        if item.is_file() and item not in seen:
            unique.append(item)
            seen.add(item)
    return unique


def categorize_line(line: str):
    text = line.strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    for name, pattern in PATTERN_CLASSES.items():
        if pattern.search(text):
            return name
    lower = text.lower()
    for keyword in ERROR_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in lower:
            return "generic_error"
    return None


def analyze_file(path: Path):
    hits = []
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        for idx, line in enumerate(handle, 1):
            category = categorize_line(line)
            if category:
                hits.append({
                    "line": idx,
                    "category": category,
                    "message": line.strip(),
                })
    return hits


def summary_report(results):
    categories = Counter()
    for item in results:
        categories[item["category"]] += 1
    return categories


def print_report(root: Path):
    log_files = iter_log_files(root)
    if not log_files:
        print(f"[INFO] Keine Logdateien unter {root} gefunden.")
        return 0

    all_hits = []
    for file in sorted(log_files):
        hits = analyze_file(file)
        if hits:
            print(f"\n=== {file.relative_to(root)} ===")
            for entry in hits[:20]:
                print(f"[{entry['category']}] L{entry['line']}: {entry['message']}")
            all_hits.extend((file, hit) for hit in hits)

    if not all_hits:
        print(f"[INFO] Keine Fehler- oder Warnungszeilen in {len(log_files)} Logdatei(en) gefunden.")
        return 0

    categories = summary_report([hit for _, hit in all_hits])
    print("\n=== Zusammenfassung ===")
    for name, count in categories.most_common():
        print(f"{name}: {count}")

    print("\n=== Empfehlungen ===")
    if any(c in categories for c in ["plugin_error", "mysql_error", "file_error", "pawn_error"]):
        print("- Prüfe zuerst Plugin- und Include-Fehler im Server-Log.")
    if "mysql_error" in categories:
        print("- Prüfe DB-Verbindungsdaten, Host, Port und MySQL-Login.")
    if "file_error" in categories:
        print("- Prüfe server.cfg, sql.cfg und das Vorhandensein der referenzierten Dateien.")
    if "pawn_error" in categories:
        print("- Prüfe kompilierten Gamemode, Includes und die Include-Reihenfolge in gamemode.pwn.")
    return 0


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Analysiert SA:MP-/GameMode-Logdateien nach Fehlern")
    parser.add_argument("path", nargs="?", default=".", help="Pfad zu Logdateien oder Projektordner")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    root = Path(args.path).resolve()
    return print_report(root)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

DATEI: tools/autorun.py
================================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

COMMON_SERVER_BINARIES = [
    "samp03svr",
    "samp-server",
    "samp-server.exe",
    "gta_sa_server",
    "gta_sa_server.exe",
    "server",
]


def find_server_binary(root: Path):
    candidates = [root / binary for binary in COMMON_SERVER_BINARIES]
    candidates += list(root.rglob("samp*"))
    candidates += list(root.rglob("*server*"))
    for item in candidates:
        if item.is_file() and os.access(item, os.X_OK):
            return item
    return None


def find_log_file(root: Path):
    for path in [root / "logs" / "server.log", root / "log" / "server.log", root / "server_log.txt", root / "server.log"]:
        if path.exists():
            return path
    return root / "logs" / "server.log"


def tail_log(path: Path, lines: int = 40):
    if not path.exists():
        return
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        data = handle.read().splitlines()
    for line in data[-lines:]:
        print(line)


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Server-Launcher mit Log-Überwachung")
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=str, default=".", help="Projektwurzel")
    parser.add_argument("--server-bin", type=str, default="", help="Pfad zum SA:MP-Server-Binary")
    parser.add_argument("--log", type=str, default="", help="Pfad zur Logdatei")
    parser.add_argument("--watch", action="store_true", help="Log-Datei nach dem Start beobachten")
    parser.add_argument("--check-only", action="store_true", help="Nur prüfen, ob Launcher-/Serverdaten vorhanden sind")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
    server_bin = Path(args.server_bin).expanduser() if args.server_bin else find_server_binary(root)
    log_path = Path(args.log).expanduser() if args.log else find_log_file(root)

    if not server_bin:
        print("[WARN] Kein SA:MP-Server-Binary im Projekt gefunden.")
        print("[INFO] Beispiel: --server-bin ./samp03svr")
        return 1

    if args.check_only:
        print(f"[INFO] Server-Binary gefunden: {server_bin}")
        print(f"[INFO] Log-Ziel: {log_path}")
        return 0

    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = [str(server_bin)]
    print(f"[INFO] Starte Server: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    print(f"[INFO] Logdatei: {log_path}")

    with open(log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as log_handle:
        process = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=log_handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, cwd=str(root))
        try:
            while True:
                return_code = process.poll()
                if return_code is not None:
                    print(f"[INFO] Server beendet. Exit-Code: {return_code}")
                    break
                time.sleep(2)
                if args.watch:
                    tail_log(log_path, lines=20)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[INFO] Server-Session per Ctrl+C beendet.")
            process.terminate()
            return 0

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

DATEI: tools/log_tail.py
================================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_KEYWORDS = [
    "error",
    "failed",
    "warning",
    "fatal",
    "critical",
    "plugin",
    "mysql",
    "sqlite",
    "sql",
    "pawn",
    "assert",
    "exception",
]


def find_candidate_logs(root: Path):
    candidates = []
    search_roots = [root, root / "logs", root / "log"]
    for folder in search_roots:
        if folder.exists():
            for item in folder.rglob("*.log"):
                candidates.append(item)
            for item in folder.rglob("*.txt"):
                if "server" in item.name.lower() or "log" in item.name.lower():
                    candidates.append(item)
    seen = set()
    ordered = []
    for p in candidates:
        if p not in seen:
            seen.add(p)
            ordered.append(p)
    return ordered


def tail_file(path: Path, lines: int = 60, keyword_filter: str = None):
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"[WARN] Logdatei nicht gefunden: {path}")
        return

    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        all_lines = handle.read().splitlines()

    if keyword_filter:
        filtered = [line for line in all_lines if keyword_filter.lower() in line.lower()]
    else:
        filtered = all_lines

    if not filtered:
        print(f"[INFO] Keine Einträge für '{keyword_filter}' in {path.name} gefunden.")
        return

    start = max(0, len(filtered) - lines)
    for line in filtered[start:]:
        print(line)


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Live-Log Viewer für SA:MP-Server")
    parser.add_argument("--log", type=str, default="", help="Pfad zur Logdatei")
    parser.add_argument("--keyword", type=str, default="", help="Nur Zeilen mit Stichwort anzeigen")
    parser.add_argument("--lines", type=int, default=60, help="Anzahl der zuletzt anzuzeigenden Zeilen")
    parser.add_argument("--watch", action="store_true", help="Datei in Echtzeit beobachten")
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=str, default=".", help="Projektwurzel")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
    log_path = None

    if args.log:
        log_path = Path(args.log).resolve()
    else:
        candidates = find_candidate_logs(root)
        if candidates:
            log_path = candidates[0]
            print(f"[INFO] Nutze Logdatei: {log_path}")
        else:
            print("[WARN] Keine Logdatei im Projekt gefunden. Beispiel: ./logs/server.log")
            return 1

    if not log_path.exists():
        print(f"[WARN] Datei nicht gefunden: {log_path}")
        return 1

    if args.watch:
        print(f"[INFO] Beobachte {log_path} (Ctrl+C zum Beenden)")
        last_size = 0
        while True:
            try:
                if log_path.exists():
                    size = log_path.stat().st_size
                    if size != last_size:
                        with log_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
                            handle.seek(max(0, last_size))
                            data = handle.read()
                            if data:
                                print(data, end="")
                        last_size = size
                time.sleep(1)
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                print("\n[INFO] Log-Observer beendet.")
                break
        return 0

    keyword = args.keyword if args.keyword else ""
    tail_file(log_path, lines=args.lines, keyword_filter=keyword)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

DATEI: tools/validate_server_cfg.py
================================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REQUIRED_KEYS = {
    "gamemode0": "gamemode0 <name> <mode>",
    "hostname": "hostname <name>",
    "maxplayers": "maxplayers <count>",
    "port": "port <port>",
    "plugins": "plugins <plugin list>",
}


def parse_cfg(path: Path):
    data = {}
    if not path.exists():
        return data
    for raw_line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if " " not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split(None, 1)
        data[key.lower()] = value.strip()
    return data


def ensure_list(value: str):
    return [item.strip() for item in value.split() if item.strip()]


def validate_cfg(root: Path, do_fix: bool = False):
    issues = []
    server_cfg_path = root / "server.cfg"
    sql_cfg_path = root / "sql.cfg"

    if not server_cfg_path.exists():
        issues.append(f"[ERROR] server.cfg fehlt: {server_cfg_path}")
    else:
        cfg = parse_cfg(server_cfg_path)
        for key, hint in REQUIRED_KEYS.items():
            if key not in cfg:
                issues.append(f"[WARN] {key} fehlt in server.cfg ({hint})")

        if "gamemode0" in cfg:
            mode_name = cfg["gamemode0"].split()[0] if cfg["gamemode0"].split() else ""
            mode_file = root / "gamemodes" / f"{mode_name}.pwn"
            if mode_name and not mode_file.exists():
                issues.append(f"[WARN] Gamemode-Datei nicht gefunden: {mode_file}")

        if "plugins" in cfg:
            plugins = ensure_list(cfg["plugins"])
            if not plugins:
                issues.append("[WARN] plugins-Liste ist leer")
            else:
                for plugin in plugins:
                    plugin_path = root / "plugins" / plugin
                    if plugin_path.exists() is False and not plugin.endswith(".dll"):
                        if not (root / f"{plugin}").exists():
                            issues.append(f"[WARN] Plugin-Datei nicht gefunden: {plugin}")

        hostname = cfg.get("hostname", "")
        if not hostname or hostname.lower() in {"changeme", "localhost", "example", "default"}:
            issues.append("[WARN] hostname ist leer oder placeholderhaft")

        port_value = cfg.get("port", "")
        if port_value and not port_value.isdigit():
            issues.append("[WARN] port sollte numerisch sein")

        rcon_password = cfg.get("rcon_password", "")
        if rcon_password.lower() == "changeme":
            issues.append("[WARN] rcon_password verwendet Standardwert changeme")

    if sql_cfg_path.exists():
        sql_cfg = parse_cfg(sql_cfg_path)
        for key in ["mysql_host", "mysql_user", "mysql_db"]:
            if key not in sql_cfg:
                issues.append(f"[WARN] {key} fehlt in sql.cfg")
    else:
        issues.append(f"[INFO] sql.cfg fehlt; falls MySQL genutzt wird, bitte anlegen: {sql_cfg_path}")

    if do_fix and server_cfg_path.exists():
        text = server_cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        if "gamemode0" not in text.lower():
            text += "\n# auto-added by validator\ngamemode0 gtasa_reallife 1\n"
        if "hostname" not in text.lower():
            text += "hostname GTA:SA Reallife Modular\n"
        if "maxplayers" not in text.lower():
            text += "maxplayers 100\n"
        if "port" not in text.lower():
            text += "port 7777\n"
        if "plugins" not in text.lower():
            text += "plugins crashdetect streamer sscanf2 sqlite mysql zcmd\n"
        if "rcon_password" not in text.lower():
            text += "rcon_password changeme\n"
        server_cfg_path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[INFO] server.cfg wurde mit Standardwerten ergänzt: {server_cfg_path}")

    for issue in issues:
        print(issue)

    return 0 if not any(issue.startswith("[WARN]") or issue.startswith("[ERROR]") for issue in issues) else 1


def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Validiert die SA:MP-Konfiguration")
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=str, default=".", help="Projektwurzel")
    parser.add_argument("--fix", action="store_true", help="Standardwerte ergänzen, falls Konfigurationsfelder fehlen")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main():
    args = parse_args()
    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
    return validate_cfg(root, do_fix=args.fix)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# Nexus Core Control Panel

## Zweck

Das Control Panel ist ein eigenständiges Web-Managementmodul für den GTA:SA-Reallife-Gamemode. Es ist bewusst vom SA:MP-Pawn-Gamemode entkoppelt und liest dieselbe SQLite-Datenbank, damit Betriebsüberwachung, Administration und Weiterentwicklung ohne direkte Einbindung in die Spielserver-Logik möglich bleiben.

## Funktionen

- serverweite Zustandsübersicht
- Länder-/Staatskassenübersicht für LS, SF und LV
- Spielerdaten, Adminlisten, Jobs, Fraktionen und Businesses
- Haus-, Property-, Fahrzeug- und UBB-/Ownership-Status
- Event-, Market-, Dispatch- und Economy-Übersichten
- vorbereitete Admin-/UCP-/Webbridge-Integration

## Architektur

```text
control-panel/
├── README.md
├── package.json
├── server.js
├── public/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── styles.css
│   └── app.js
├── .gitignore
└── node_modules/
```

## Voraussetzungen

- Node.js 18+
- Zugriff auf `../data/db/gtasa_reallife.db`
- gültiges SQLite-Schema mit Tabellen wie `states`, `state_bank`, `players`, `jobs`, `factions`, `houses`, `businesses`, `vehicle_mods`, `server_events`

## Starten

```bash
cd control-panel
npm install
npm start
```

Danach ist das Dashboard unter `http://localhost:3001/` erreichbar.

## API-Endpunkte

- `GET /api/overview`
- `GET /api/summary`
- `GET /api/states`
- `GET /api/players`
- `GET /api/admins`
- `GET /api/jobs`
- `GET /api/factions`
- `GET /api/houses`
- `GET /api/businesses`
- `GET /api/server-info`
- `GET /api/vehicle-mods`
- `GET /api/transport-workers`
- `GET /api/mission-board`
- `GET /api/factory-network`
- `GET /api/marketplace`
- `GET /api/governance`
- `GET /api/contraband`
- `GET /api/taxi`
- `GET /api/district-economy`
- `GET /api/web-sync`
- `GET /api/events`

## Designprinzipien

- nur lesender Zugriff auf SQLite
- stateless und leicht erweiterbar
- Fallbacks bei leeren bzw. unvollständigen Tabellen
- State-Normalisierung auf LS/SF/LV
- geteilte Datenbasis mit dem Gamemode, ohne direkte Asset-/Runtime-Abhängigkeiten

## Veröffentlichungsstand

Das Control Panel ist als modernes Betriebs- und Monitoringmodul veröffentlicht und auf den erweiterten RP-Stand des Projekts abgestimmt. Es bildet die betriebliche Sicht für Treasury, State-Management, Fahrzeug-Ownership, House-/Property-Status und Admin-Informationen.

## Erweiterungsplan

1. Live-Admin-Aktionen im Panel
2. Fraktions- und Business-Management-Views
3. Treasury-Charting und Cashflow-Diagramme
4. Mission-/Factory-/Transport-Panel je Staat
5. UCP-/Forum-Bridge und Auth-Integration
6. Logs und Audit-Tracking

## Wichtig

Das Panel ist bewusst nur als Betriebs- und Managementschicht konzipiert. Die eigentliche Spiel- und Besitzlogik bleibt im SA:MP-Gamemode, während das Panel als sichere, lesende Schnittstelle für Zustände, Kassen und Statusdaten dient.

  "description": "Modern SQLite-backed control panel for the GTA:SA modular roleplay project",
  "main": "server.js",

    "start": "node server.js",

DATEI: control-panel/server.js

const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();

const app = express();
const port = process.env.PORT || 3001;
const dbPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../data/db/gtasa_reallife.db');

const stateNameMap = {
  0: 'Los Santos',
  1: 'San Fierro',
  2: 'Las Venturas'
};

app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

const db = new sqlite3.Database(dbPath, sqlite3.OPEN_READONLY, (err) => {
  if (err) {
    console.error('DB connection failed:', err.message);
  } else {
    console.log('Connected to SQLite database:', dbPath);
  }
});

function tableExists(tableName) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get(
      "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = ?",
      [tableName],
      (err, row) => {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve(Boolean(row));
      }
    );
  });
}

function queryRows(sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve(rows || []);
    });
  });
}

function querySingle(sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve(row || null);
    });
  });
}

async function safeTableRows(tableName, selectSql, fallbackLimit = 25) {
  const exists = await tableExists(tableName);
  if (!exists) return [];
  return queryRows(selectSql, [], fallbackLimit);
}

function normalizeStateName(stateId, fallbackName) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(stateId))) {
    return fallbackName || 'Unbekannt';
  }
  const id = Number(stateId);
  return stateNameMap[id] || fallbackName || 'Unbekannt';
}

async function getServerSummary() {
  const tables = await queryRows("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name");
  const stateCount = await querySingle('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM states');
  const playerCount = await querySingle('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM players');
  const adminCount = await querySingle('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM admin_roles');
  const jobCount = await querySingle('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM jobs');
  const stateSum = await querySingle('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(treasury), 0) AS total FROM states');
  const bankSum = await querySingle('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS total FROM state_bank');
  const stateBudgetRows = await tableExists('states') ? queryRows('SELECT id, treasury, tax_rate, name FROM states ORDER BY id ASC') : [];

  const stateBudgetSummary = stateBudgetRows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    name: normalizeStateName(row.id, row.name),
    treasury: Number(row.treasury || 0),
    taxRate: Number(row.tax_rate || 0)
  }));

  return {
    tables: tables.map((row) => row.name),
    stateCount: stateCount ? stateCount.count : 0,
    playerCount: playerCount ? playerCount.count : 0,
    adminCount: adminCount ? adminCount.count : 0,
    jobCount: jobCount ? jobCount.count : 0,
    treasuryTotal: stateSum ? stateSum.total : 0,
    bankTotal: bankSum ? bankSum.total : 0,
    stateBudgets: stateBudgetSummary,
    project: 'Nexus Core Gamemode',
    panelVersion: '1.1.0'
  };
}

app.get('/api/server-info', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const summary = await getServerSummary();
    res.json({ status: 'online', database: dbPath, ...summary });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
  }
});

app.get('/api/summary', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const summary = await getServerSummary();
    const states = await tableExists('states') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM states ORDER BY id ASC') : [];
    const players = await tableExists('players') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM players ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const admins = await tableExists('admin_roles') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM admin_roles ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const jobs = await tableExists('jobs') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM jobs ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const factions = await tableExists('factions') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM factions ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const houses = await tableExists('houses') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM houses ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const businesses = await tableExists('businesses') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM businesses ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];

    res.json({
      ...summary,
      states,
      players,
      admins,
      jobs,
      factions,
      houses,
      businesses,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
  }
});

app.get('/api/overview', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const summary = await getServerSummary();
    const states = await tableExists('states') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM states ORDER BY id ASC') : [];
    const players = await tableExists('players') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM players ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const admins = await tableExists('admin_roles') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM admin_roles ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const jobs = await tableExists('jobs') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM jobs ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const factions = await tableExists('factions') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM factions ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const houses = await tableExists('houses') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM houses ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];
    const businesses = await tableExists('businesses') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM businesses ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 20') : [];

    res.json({
      states,
      players,
      admins,
      jobs,
      factions,
      houses,
      businesses,
      summary,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
  }
});

app.get('/api/states', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const rows = await tableExists('states') ? queryRows('SELECT * FROM states ORDER BY id ASC') : [];
    res.json(rows.map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      name: normalizeStateName(row.id, row.name),
      short_name: row.short_name || ['LS', 'SF', 'LV'][Number(row.id)] || 'UNK'
    })));
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
  }
});

async function fetchJson(url) {
  const response = await fetch(url);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error('Request failed');
  }
  return response.json();
}

function renderStates(states) {
  const container = document.getElementById('states-container');
  if (!states.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="data-row"><span>Keine Daten verfügbar</span></div>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = states.map((state) => {
    const label = state.name || { 0: 'Los Santos', 1: 'San Fierro', 2: 'Las Venturas' }[state.id] || 'Unbekannt';
    const treasury = Number(state.treasury || 0);
    const taxRate = Number(state.tax_rate || 0);

    return `
      <div class="data-row">
        <strong>${label}</strong>
        <span>Budget ${treasury} · Steuer ${taxRate}%</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function renderPlayers(players) {
  const container = document.getElementById('players-container');
  if (!players.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="data-row"><span>Keine Daten verfügbar</span></div>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = players.map((player) => `
    <div class="data-row">
      <strong>${player.name}</strong>
      <span>State ${player.state_id || 0} · Geld ${player.money || 0}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function renderAdmins(admins) {
  const container = document.getElementById('admins-container');
  if (!admins.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="data-row"><span>Keine Daten verfügbar</span></div>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = admins.map((admin) => `
    <div class="data-row">
      <strong>${admin.player_name}</strong>
      <span>Rang ${admin.rank || 0} · State ${admin.state_id || -1}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function renderJobs(jobs) {
  const container = document.getElementById('jobs-container');
  if (!jobs.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="data-row"><span>Keine Daten verfügbar</span></div>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = jobs.map((job) => `
    <div class="data-row">
      <strong>${job.name}</strong>
      <span>Type ${job.type || 0} · State ${job.state_id || 0}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function renderFactions(factions) {
  const container = document.getElementById('factions-container');
  if (!factions.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="data-row"><span>Keine Daten verfügbar</span></div>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = factions.map((faction) => `
    <div class="data-row">
      <strong>${faction.name || 'Faction'}</strong>
      <span>State ${faction.state_id || 0} · Typ ${faction.type || 0}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function renderHouses(houses) {
  const container = document.getElementById('houses-container');
  if (!houses.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="data-row"><span>Keine Daten verfügbar</span></div>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = houses.map((house) => `
    <div class="data-row">
      <strong>${house.name || 'Haus'}</strong>
      <span>State ${house.state_id || 0} · Besitzer ${house.owner_id ?? 'N/A'}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function renderBusinesses(businesses) {
  const container = document.getElementById('businesses-container');
  if (!businesses.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="data-row"><span>Keine Daten verfügbar</span></div>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = businesses.map((biz) => `
    <div class="data-row">
      <strong>${biz.name || 'Business'}</strong>
      <span>State ${biz.state_id || 0} · Umsatz ${biz.revenue || 0}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

async function loadDashboard() {
  try {
    const overview = await fetchJson('/api/overview');
    const info = await fetchJson('/api/server-info');

    document.getElementById('server-status').textContent = info.status || 'online';
    document.getElementById('server-project').textContent = info.project || 'Nexus Core';
    document.getElementById('state-count').textContent = info.stateCount || overview.states?.length || 0;
    document.getElementById('player-count').textContent = info.playerCount || overview.players?.length || 0;
    document.getElementById('admin-count').textContent = info.adminCount || overview.admins?.length || 0;
    document.getElementById('job-count').textContent = info.jobCount || overview.jobs?.length || 0;
    document.getElementById('treasury-total').textContent = `${info.treasuryTotal || 0}$`;

    renderStates(overview.states || []);
    renderPlayers(overview.players || []);
    renderAdmins(overview.admins || []);
    renderJobs(overview.jobs || []);
    renderFactions(overview.factions || []);
    renderHouses(overview.houses || []);
    renderBusinesses(overview.businesses || []);
  } catch (error) {
    document.getElementById('server-status').textContent = 'offline';
    document.getElementById('server-project').textContent = 'Datenbank nicht erreichbar';
  }
}

document.getElementById('refreshBtn').addEventListener('click', loadDashboard);
loadDashboard();

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DB_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "db"
SCHEMA_PATH = ROOT / "data" / "sql" / "schema.sql"
DB_PATH = DB_DIR / "gtasa_reallife.db"

DB_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")

with SCHEMA_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    schema_sql = handle.read()

conn.executescript(schema_sql)
conn.commit()

print(f"[SQLite] Datenbank initialisiert: {DB_PATH}")
print("[SQLite] Schema erfolgreich angewendet.")
conn.close()
